1100161015.alt: A wide view of a green valley under a cloudy sky, distant mountains and a lawn with white figures below.
1100161015.story: From the terrace, the valley spreads out in long green waves, fields and forest stitched together. Distant mountains show faintly blue under heavy clouds. Down below, a curved lawn holds a cluster of white garden figures, tiny from up here. The light is soft and grey-gold. It's the kind of view that makes everyone at the railing go quiet for a minute.

3557208739.alt: Canvas-roofed pavilion with sunbeams falling across a lawn of striped poufs, trees and hills behind
3557208739.story: Rays of light slant down through the haze toward the pavilion, visible as faint beams in the air. A figure stands at the open side of the tent, one of the few people in sight. Striped poufs sit on blankets on the grass. Shadows stretch long. It is the hour when everything looks a little like a memory already.

40e18db485.alt: Terracotta and cream buildings on a hillside above palm trees and pink flowers under a blue, cloud-streaked sky
40e18db485.story: At half past nine the hill is already lit like a stage set. Terracotta roofs climb in tiers, palms stand guard below, and a white car waits by the roundabout as if parked by a props crew. Pink blossoms crowd the foreground, still cool from the night. Clouds drift in thin strokes overhead, and the whole town looks borrowed from somewhere far west of here.

bb76c81cdd.alt: Ornate black street lamp beside a curved cream wall and stairs leading up to a peach building under cloudy sky
bb76c81cdd.story: A cast-iron lamp holds three glass lanterns over an empty plaza, unlit and patient. The curved wall below catches shade while the peach facade beyond takes the morning full on. Stairs lead up past a green kiosk toward a door nobody has opened yet. A café sign hangs at the top edge of the frame, hinting at coffee somewhere just out of sight.

522501cab9.alt: Open dark-framed glass door leading from a dim tiled room to a bright arched passage outside
522501cab9.story: Inside, the tiles are cool and the walls hold the dusk-brown colour of old honey. The door stands open, its glass panes doubling the light. Beyond it, an arched passage burns almost white in the sun, a gate visible at the far end. The room seems to be waiting for someone to step through, or for the morning to step in.

5a11e9a370.alt: Three wall signs reading First Aid, Security Hot Line with phone numbers, and Please Clean Up After Your Dog
5a11e9a370.story: Three signs, stacked like channel listings. First Aid in green, Security Hot Line in amber, and at the bottom a small dog and a figure with a scoop under the plea to Please Clean Up After Your Dog. Between the pastel arches and the iron balconies, this is the plain broadcast of practical life, numbers printed large enough to read from across the lane.

49b0493138.alt: Narrow cobbled lane between pastel buildings with iron balconies under a bright, overcast sky
49b0493138.story: Late afternoon, and the lane has emptied out. Cobbles run in a straight seam between rose, ochre and green walls, balconies stacked overhead like opera boxes with no audience. Wires strung between the rooftops cut faint lines across a washed-out sky. A single potted plant sits by a doorway. Somewhere at the far end, a turn waits that the eye cannot quite reach.

ed519e3849.alt: Tall cylindrical tower with rings of arched windows above a staircase, string lights and silhouetted visitors
ed519e3849.story: The tower rises in stacked rings of arches, pale against a sky going soft and grey after five. String lights loop from its flanks to the surrounding roofs, not yet switched on. At the foot of the staircase, small dark figures climb and linger. It stands straight here, whatever its famous cousin does, and it looks almost like an antenna waiting for a signal.

3ec85d0a49.alt: Terracotta arcades and balconies along a paved promenade with iron railings, planters and strung lights
3ec85d0a49.story: Arches run down the left side like a row of open mouths, each one shadowed. The paving shines faintly where the light skims across it. Iron posts and a chain railing guide the way along the water, and a string of bulbs sags between poles toward a far building with a small tower. The promenade is nearly empty, saving itself for the evening.

b53cb9a899.alt: Two glass pavilions with curved green roofs on a stone embankment beside a calm lake under a grey sky
b53cb9a899.story: Two glasshouses sit on the water's edge, roofs curved like green tin barrels. Their panes reflect the overcast sky so well they almost disappear into it. The lake in front ripples in slow bands, and dark trees hem the far shore. No one moves inside. They look like conservatories built for a weather that has not yet arrived.

e0cf9ca577.alt: Waiters setting tables at an outdoor café in a paved square framed by pastel Italian-style buildings
e0cf9ca577.story: Two waiters in white shirts work through the tables, setting things straight before the dinner crowd. Chairs are pushed in at careful angles. Behind them the square opens onto green, cream and rust facades, and a small hanging sign with a single letter D swings above. The light is flat and patient. In an hour these seats will be full and loud.

78c0610901.alt: Row of colourful facades including a cream building marked Portofino, with people seated near a pond edge
78c0610901.story: Pink, ochre and sage facades line up shoulder to shoulder, with a taller cream building marked Portofino rising in the middle like a host. Small figures sit on the low steps by the water, resting their feet. A lamp pole cuts the frame on the left. The pond's curved rim catches a little of the sky, a pale stripe in the dark water.

8bae08373d.alt: Orange building with balconies and striped closed umbrellas on a waterside terrace, dark water in front
8bae08373d.story: The building stands square to the water, every window with its own small iron balcony. On the terrace, striped umbrellas are folded tight, waiting for a sun that has gone behind cloud. Lamp posts mark the railing at even intervals. Below, the water is almost black, broken only by a faint sparkle on the right where the evening light still reaches.

22ff110911.alt: Peach and cream buildings with arched windows above a staircase and a dark pond edged by chain posts
22ff110911.story: Peach walls glow against a sky of slate and blue. Visitors climb the wide red staircase toward the arched windows, small against the scale of the facade. In the foreground, black posts and a looping chain fence off the pond, its surface holding a smeared copy of the buildings. Evening is coming on, and the colours are deepening by the minute.

e2714e6dfd.alt: Orange, green and red facades with balconies facing a paved plaza and a round pond with reeds
e2714e6dfd.story: Three houses stand side by side in three different colours, like swatches pinned to a board. Each has its balconies, its shutters, its door under an arch. A round pond sits in the plaza, a few green reeds poking up from its still water. Someone is just visible in the central passage, framed by the green arch, heading somewhere else.

38074f46bd.alt: Terracotta steps leading to a narrow shadowed passage between green-trimmed and cream walls
38074f46bd.story: The steps are wide and warm, then the passage narrows to a slot of shadow. At its far end, two figures stand in the half-light, small and indistinct. Iron handrails curve down on either side. A lantern is fixed to the cream wall, unlit. The gap feels like a doorway between channels: bright plaza here, something quieter and unknown over there.

d2a63adad8.alt: Yellow neon sign reading E-Sarn Tapas below a wrought iron balcony, beside a red Portofino awning
d2a63adad8.story: A yellow neon sign spells out E-Sarn Tapas in loose, hand-drawn letters, a northeastern flavour slipped into an Italian dress. Above it, a wrought iron balcony and a single lamp. Next door, a red awning reads Portofino, and a striped umbrella leans by the entrance. The neon is already on, a little early, signalling that the evening programme has begun.

fd6c377da1.alt: Covered tiled passage with wall lanterns opening onto a bright view of green trees and hedges
fd6c377da1.story: The corridor runs straight through the building like a tunnel cut for the light. Lanterns on the walls stay dark; they are not needed yet. At the end, a red-trimmed awning frames a wide green picture of hedges, palms and trees. A tall plant stands in its pot by the opening. The tiles shine faintly, reflecting the garden back toward the shade.

ff6adf6376.alt: Terrace with wicker chairs, small tables, tall lamp posts and striped umbrellas beside a pastel building
ff6adf6376.story: Wicker chairs gather round small round tables on the terrace, a few still empty, a few claimed. Tall black lamp posts stand along the edge, and striped umbrellas lean half-open in the soft light. A yellow flag lifts from the roofline. People drift toward the far end, where the water must be. It is just after five, the hour when everyone finds a seat.

c9b4ea9a0e.alt: Pink and orange facades with a painted Ravello sign, navy umbrellas and people by a curved pond edge
c9b4ea9a0e.story: A painted sign reading Ravello hangs across the orange facade, its letters framed by a little landscape. Navy umbrellas stand furled outside the restaurant, and white urns line the edge of the terrace. A few people gather near the stairs, talking. The pond curves along the bottom of the frame, holding warm reflections that tremble whenever the breeze crosses it.

392013be88.alt: Arcade corridor with brick paving leading to a green wall with a red fire hose cabinet and plants
392013be88.story: Down the arcade, the light falls in long slants across the brick floor. At the end, a red fire hose cabinet is mounted on a sage-green wall, the brightest thing in the corridor, as if someone set it there to be seen. A climbing plant reaches in from the right. Everything else is cream, quiet, and very still.

ff880ee7ae.alt: Wide pond with a small fountain, stone steps, lamp posts, string lights and green-roofed pavilions beyond
ff880ee7ae.story: The pond lies broad and silver in the late light, a small fountain sending up a thin white plume in the middle distance. Steps lead down to the water on the far side. Lamp posts stand in a row and string lights loop between them. The green-roofed pavilions sit at the back, and a handful of visitors pause along the railing.

a5a35d4998.alt: Pale stone wall with small First Aid, security and dog signs between two stone urns holding round shrubs
a5a35d4998.story: The same three signs again, smaller now, pinned to a wall of pale stone blocks. Two urns flank them like guards, each holding a neatly clipped shrub. A drain cover sits in the dark paving below. It is a tidy, symmetrical little scene, the kind of corner that repeats itself across the whole village, rerun after rerun.

4776d417c9.alt: Small café with a green striped awning and La Tosca sign, a nutcracker figure by the door and two people at a table
4776d417c9.story: Under a green striped awning, a café called La Tosca keeps its door open. A painted nutcracker soldier stands guard beside the entrance, very upright and very out of season. Two people sit at a small table on the wooden deck, drinks between them. String lights hang across the lane overhead, not yet lit, waiting for the sky to darken a little more.

af99edbaa9.alt: Stone fountain shaped like a large shell with a carved face, a thin jet of water and a balustrade behind
af99edbaa9.story: A carved face peers out from the back of a stone shell, and a thin jet of water rises from the basin in front of it. The spray is caught mid-climb, a bright white thread. Behind the fountain, a balustrade and a striped awning lead the eye to an orange building. The water keeps up its small, steady noise.

089d9ff3bb.alt: Two people climbing dark stairs toward a tall round tower with arched windows and hanging banners
089d9ff3bb.story: Two figures climb the dark steps, backs turned, heading up toward the round white tower. Banners hang from the lamp posts on either side, one reading Eatery. The tower fills the top of the frame, its rows of windows repeating like a test pattern. The climbers keep going, and in a moment they will be swallowed by the arches at the top.

8e32078fb1.alt: Base of a cream tower with a clock, a balustrade and mosaic panels showing colourful town buildings above steps
8e32078fb1.story: At the foot of the tower, mosaic panels show the village in miniature: rows of pastel houses rendered in tiny chips of tile, a round rosette in the centre. Above them, a balustrade and a clock face, its black hands marking a little before half past five. The steps below are dark and empty. The town is looking at a picture of itself.

f42e63528a.alt: Hillside of pastel buildings above palm trees, clipped hedges, a small wooden guard hut and pink flowers
f42e63528a.story: From the garden, the hillside village looks like a painted backdrop. Palms stand in a loose row, hedges are clipped into low walls, and pink flowers spill along the path. A small wooden hut with a peaked roof sits on the left, like a booth for someone who has stepped away. White clouds pile up softly above the rooftops.

e6a2fc0b5d.alt: Garden of clipped hedges and palms with a shallow fountain basin and two people standing before a hillside village
e6a2fc0b5d.story: A step to the right and the view shifts: the fountain basin comes into the frame, low and round, and two people stand at its edge, looking up at the hill. The hedges curve in green bands across the foreground. A thin lamp post rises from the middle. The sky is pale blue, clearing, as the afternoon tips toward evening.

ea9b21ea27.alt: Forecourt with orange traffic cones, a parked silver car and golf carts by a round building and ornate lamps
ea9b21ea27.story: Orange cones are scattered across the paved forecourt like pieces left on a game board. A silver car is parked at an angle, and two golf carts wait in the shade of the round building. Ornate lamp posts stand along the edge. Beyond the railing the sky opens out, pale and wide, with a faint ridge of hills on the horizon.

9d002b6fe7.alt: Road lined with hedges and palms, a row of traffic cones, a yellow and a white car, and green hills behind
9d002b6fe7.story: The road out runs straight between clipped hedges, a dotted line of orange cones down its middle. A yellow car and a white one sit at the kerb, noses pointed toward the gate in the distance. Green hills close off the horizon, a thin mast standing on one ridge. The village is behind now. Signal fading, the day's broadcast nearly done.

012cc4f0a6.alt: Small red barn-shaped hut on a grassy enclosure in front of forest, with a blurred hand in the foreground
012cc4f0a6.story: Twenty to eight, and the zoo is still waking. A small red hut with a white door and a shingled roof sits on the lawn like a toy someone forgot to put away. Fallen leaves dot the grass. A hand drifts into the foreground, blurred, mid-gesture, as if adjusting the picture before the morning programme begins.

1308410eaa.alt: Pale pony in a red halter stretching its open mouth over a wooden gate toward a carrot held out by a hand
1308410eaa.story: The pony leans over the gate with its mouth already wide open, teeth showing, neck stretched as far as it will go. A hand holds out a thin orange carrot just short of reach. The halter is red, the mane pale and tousled. Nine seconds after the last frame, breakfast has become the only thing in the world.

d4a604209f.alt: Red miniature barn on a leaf-scattered lawn ringed by wooden fences, trees and a red round platform
d4a604209f.story: Pulled back, the red hut is just one small piece of a wide green yard. Wooden fences run along the edges, a pile of cut branches lies in the corner, and a round red platform pokes into the frame on the right. Far off, a couple of visitors stand by the rail. The trees overhead keep the whole enclosure in soft shade.

f3fa499d8e.alt: Two capybaras resting on grey artificial rocks near a thatched shelter and a white wall
f3fa499d8e.story: Two capybaras sit on the grey rock ledges, round and unhurried, like loaves left to cool. A thatched shelter casts a square of shade behind them, and a potted palm stands at the corner. The white wall glows in the morning light. Neither animal seems to have plans. Both seem fine with that.

8a0aaa6ead.alt: Dense green trees above a dry red-earth clearing scattered with rocks inside a forest enclosure
8a0aaa6ead.story: Afternoon now, and this enclosure gives nothing away. Red earth, a scatter of grey rocks, and a thick wall of trees that could hide anything. Every shadow under the branches might be an animal, or might be just a shadow. The leaves hang still in the heat. It is a channel showing only its landscape, its star off-screen.

0e66d3d826.alt: Black and white piglet standing on a concrete ledge beside a blue trough, behind chain-link fencing
0e66d3d826.story: A piglet with black patches stands on the concrete ledge, ears up, snout pink, looking straight out through the fence. One hoof is placed just so beside the blue trough. The chain-link throws a soft grid across the shadows. For a moment, the piglet holds the pose of someone who has heard their name called.

d8619e1590.alt: Large dark mesh aviary under tall trees, with stone steps leading up and two people walking alongside
d8619e1590.story: The aviary rises in black ribs and mesh, tall as a hall, half hidden among the trees. Stone steps climb the grassy bank toward it. Two people walk along the front, reading the small signs set on posts. A garden hose snakes through the grass. Inside, somewhere among the perches, a bird is probably already watching them come.

7ffe58d6ee.alt: White cockatoo perched behind dark wire mesh inside an aviary, looking to the side
7ffe58d6ee.story: A white cockatoo, glimpsed behind the mesh, sits on a dark branch, feathers fluffed, beak turned in profile. The wire forms a fine net of squares across the frame, and the curved bars of the cage arch overhead. The bird holds very still, as if listening to a frequency only it can hear.

58d50b96cd.alt: Close view of a white cockatoo through blurred wire mesh, its dark eye and curved beak in focus
58d50b96cd.story: Closer. The mesh goes soft and the cockatoo comes forward, its dark round eye now clear, the curved beak a pale grey hook. Feathers ruffle at the neck. Behind it the aviary blurs into green and brown. The wires cross in front like interference lines on an old screen, and the bird looks through them without blinking.

31ba02859b.alt: Orangutan sitting against a wire fence with one long arm raised to grip the mesh above
31ba02859b.story: One long arm reaches straight up and hooks the wire, the other rests against the chest. The orangutan sits low behind the fence, long copper hair hanging in strands. Behind, a pale rock wall and a small dark window. The face is turned slightly away, considering something on the other side of the grid that no one else can see.

4abd9becf0.alt: Orangutan hanging from a wire fence with both arms raised high, long orange hair falling down
4abd9becf0.story: Now both arms are up, hands curled over the top of the mesh, and the orangutan hangs there, body loose, face forward. The long hair falls from the arms like curtains. It looks less like climbing and more like stretching, or waiting, or simply holding the fence because it is there. The afternoon light stays soft and grey.

0457405c0f.alt: Orangutan with both arms raised gripping a wire fence, seen against a grey rock wall
0457405c0f.story: Wider, and the scene settles: the grey rock wall, a low ledge, the grid of wire, and in the middle the orangutan with both arms raised, as though signalling to someone far away. One foot hooks the lower mesh. The pose is held a long time, long enough for the visitors to drift on and new ones to arrive.

8632a8eba9.alt: Pale lion yawning wide with its tongue out, lying behind black iron bars on a sandy floor
8632a8eba9.story: The lion yawns so wide the whole face folds back around it, tongue curled and pink, eyes squeezed shut. Its pale mane spills over the shoulders. Black bars cut the frame into narrow strips, but the yawn fills them all. It is three in the afternoon and the hottest part of the day, and the lion has opinions about that.

d5749c8caa.alt: Pale lion lying on a sandy floor behind black iron bars, looking calmly toward the front
d5749c8caa.story: The yawn is over. The lion lies with its chin lifted, gaze level and unbothered, paws stretched out on the sand. Light catches the pale mane. Behind the bars it seems almost sleepy, but the eyes are open and fixed on something just past the fence. A minute ago it was all teeth. Now it is all patience.

ba68d87295.alt: Prairie dog standing upright with its paws on a chain-link fence, belly fur lit softly
ba68d87295.story: Upright on its hind legs, the prairie dog presses both small paws against the chain-link and peers up. Its belly fur is pale and soft in the low light, its whiskers just visible. The diamond grid fills the frame around it. It stands as straight as a sentry, and seems to expect something to arrive any second now.

635e66793c.alt: Prairie dog sitting inside a large wooden wheel resting on a plank, with dirt and rocks behind
635e66793c.story: Inside a big wooden wheel, a prairie dog sits on its haunches, front paws tucked in, looking out with mild curiosity. The wheel is worn, patched with pale scuffs, and propped on a plank. Light filters in through the dust. It does not run. It simply sits in the middle of the ring as if it were a stage and the show had paused.

ce487082b5.alt: Close view of a prairie dog's face pressed near a chain-link fence, paws on the wire, a yellow feeder above
ce487082b5.story: Nose almost touching the wire, the prairie dog stares straight ahead, eyes dark and round, cheeks full. Its paws grip the diamond mesh on either side. A yellow feeder hangs blurred at the top of the frame. The look is direct and a little demanding, the look of a creature that knows exactly where the snacks come from.

870818363f.alt: Prairie dog climbing up a chain-link fence with outstretched paws in a dim enclosure
870818363f.story: Higher now, the prairie dog has started to climb, toes spread on the chain-link, one paw reaching above its head. The background falls into shadow and a little green. Its body stretches long and thin. The fence is tall and the animal is small, but it keeps going, one diamond at a time, toward whatever waits at the top.

f18f82272a.alt: Two people walking across leaf-strewn grass toward a reptile house with green railings and a metal roof
f18f82272a.story: Two visitors cross the dry grass toward a low building under a rusted metal roof, one already turning to look inside, the other a step behind with hands in pockets. Green rails run along the front. Potted plants sit on the ledge in the shade. Leaves crunch underfoot. It is just after three, and the next exhibit is a few paces away.

96808b5fd1.alt: Green iguana resting its chin and claws on the back of another iguana, with blurred cage bars behind
96808b5fd1.story: One iguana has made a bed of another, chin propped on a green back, claws spread loosely. Its gold-ringed eye is half open. The bars of the enclosure dissolve into soft vertical streaks, and a couple of bright smudges hang in the blur above. Neither animal looks troubled by the arrangement. They lie like two pieces of the same lime-green landscape.

0c534dd7c5.alt: Green iguana clinging upright to thin wire cage bars, one foreleg hooked over a crossbar
0c534dd7c5.story: This one has decided to climb. It hangs on the wire bars, one forefoot hooked over a crossbar, head turned to look sideways out of the cage. The spines along its neck catch the light. Behind it, everything melts into green and brown. It is not escaping, exactly. It is just checking what the view is like from higher up.

420d0d707b.alt: Green iguana climbing vertical wire bars with one foreleg raised above its head
420d0d707b.story: Closer still: the iguana is fully upright now, one arm stretched overhead to grip the bar, the other braced lower down. Its throat fold hangs pale beneath the jaw. Its eye is calm and dark. The wire runs in straight silver lines through the frame, and the lizard fits between them like a note written on a stave.

e06d7738d7.alt: Green iguana climbing the inside wall of a wire cage above branches, a metal bowl and other iguanas
e06d7738d7.story: From further back the full cage comes into view: branches, a steel water bowl, a tangle of green bodies on the floor, and one iguana halfway up the wall, reaching for the ceiling. The mesh top is visible now. The climb has a clear limit. The iguana keeps reaching anyway, unbothered by the geometry of the situation.

d6ec9f4f2f.alt: Pale lion sitting in a rocky enclosure behind a tall metal fence above a stone retaining wall
d6ec9f4f2f.story: Across the moat, a pale lion sits up on the dirt, ears forward, watching. The enclosure is big, with rocks, a tree trunk and a dark cave mouth, but the animal has chosen a spot right by the fence. A stone wall runs along the bottom of the frame, and green leaves poke in at the corner. Neither side looks away first.

61f037652a.alt: Crowd of black, white and ginger guinea pigs on a sandy floor seen from above
61f037652a.story: Looking down, the floor is crowded: black and white, ginger and cream, one long-haired white guinea pig fluffed out like a dandelion. They scatter and regroup in small bursts, noses busy. Sunlight falls flat across the sand. Every one of them seems to be heading somewhere important, and none of them agree on where.

a15167b343.alt: Group of tricolour guinea pigs huddled together on a sandy floor in a patch of light
a15167b343.story: A tighter knot now, five or six guinea pigs pressed close, patterned in patches of black, white and rust. One at the front lifts its head as if it heard a bag rustle. The light hits the sand in a pale wedge behind them. They move as one small herd, never more than a whisker from each other.

35603549a2.alt: Three guinea pigs gathered in the corner of a pen beside a black mat scattered with feed pellets
35603549a2.story: Three have broken away to the corner, where a black mat holds a scatter of pellets. Two white ones and one with a black face stand nose to nose, considering their options. The wall is bare, the floor dusty. Another guinea pig hurries in from the bottom of the frame, late to the meeting, eager not to miss a thing.

9e28231a29.alt: Many guinea pigs gathered on and around a black feeding mat in a sunlit corner of a white-walled pen
9e28231a29.story: The whole crowd has found the mat. In a corner where the sun cuts in across the white walls, the guinea pigs bunch together around the food, round backs touching, a few stragglers on the edge. Their patterns make a moving patchwork on the dark rubber. The pen is quiet except for the small, steady sound of chewing.

f5b9c8cb70.alt: Pale lion lying on a raised wooden platform behind metal bars, with a tree trunk and rocks behind
f5b9c8cb70.story: On a raised wooden platform, a pale lion lies with front paws crossed, head up, mane full around the face. The bars stand in front like a barcode. Behind, the bark of a big tree, some rocks, some green. The lion looks straight down the line of the enclosure, regal and slightly bored, broadcasting calm.

64f03794dc.alt: Shaded paved road under tall trees with two people walking and golf carts parked in the distance
64f03794dc.story: A quiet road runs under tall trees, the asphalt dappled with shade. Two people walk along the left edge, unhurried, one slightly ahead. Golf carts wait further down, parked by the kerb. The air looks heavy and warm. Between enclosures, the zoo turns into a park, and for a few minutes nothing is behind bars at all.

af83e06b24.alt: Lioness standing on rocks behind tall dark bars, head turned to the side in a shaded enclosure
af83e06b24.story: A lioness stands on the rocks with her head turned, ears pricked toward some sound off to the right. Tall dark bars cross the frame in close rows. Leaves press against the top of the cage, and a plant leans in from the corner. She holds very still, the way cats do just before they decide whether something is worth getting up for.

3e3c64148f.alt: Lioness walking along a rock ledge behind bars, near a round concrete water bowl
3e3c64148f.story: She has decided it was. Now the lioness pads along the ledge, shoulders rolling, head low, moving out of the frame to the right. A round concrete bowl sits empty on the ground below. The bars slice her body into strips as she passes. One more step and she will be gone, leaving only the rocks and the light.

20c0d3367d.alt: Shaded path lined with rocks, small signs and roofed pavilions under tall trees
20c0d3367d.story: The path bends gently under a ceiling of branches. On either side, roofed pavilions sit in deep shade, and small signs lean on posts at the edge of the rocks, each one introducing an animal waiting somewhere inside. Sunlight breaks through in patches on the concrete. Nobody is on the path right now. It is an intermission.

f609ba3d0e.alt: Pink and grey cockatoo seen through chain-link fencing against a dark background
f609ba3d0e.story: Rose pink on the chest, pale pink on the crown, grey at the wing edge: the cockatoo sits close to the wire, which runs in soft brown diamonds across its face. The background is almost black. Its eye is a small bright point. It tilts its head a few degrees, as if adjusting its own reception.

8e9f66151f.alt: Giraffe head and neck under a branch of bright red flowers against a pale blue sky and green trees
8e9f66151f.story: A giraffe's head swings into the frame beneath a branch heavy with red-orange blossoms. Its eye is dark and soft, its horns tipped with tufts. The sky is a hazy pale blue, the treeline far below. The flowers hang just above its ears like a decoration it did not ask for and does not seem to mind.

8ff8058f89.alt: Giraffe at the edge of the frame beside a dusty yard with raised feeders, wooden fences and trees
8ff8058f89.story: The giraffe stands at the right edge, neck rising out of the frame, looking out over its own dusty yard. Tall feeders on poles wear little thatched hats. A wooden pen sits in the middle distance, and a line of trees holds back a sky full of white cloud. The whole yard waits for the next feeding, the next visitor, the next breeze.

ad6ea208d8.alt: Giraffe chewing leaves, its long spotted neck filling the frame, with a dusty yard, feeders and blue sky behind
ad6ea208d8.story: Mid-chew, a sprig of leaves hanging from its mouth, the giraffe turns its head toward the fence. The spotted neck sweeps up from the bottom corner, filling half the frame. Behind it, the yard stretches out flat and sandy, feeders standing on their poles. White clouds drift over the treetops. The giraffe keeps eating, entirely unhurried, as if the afternoon belonged to it.

5d548be0c5.alt: Wide dusty yard with tall thatched feeders, a wooden pen, trees and a small animal far in the distance
5d548be0c5.story: Out of frame now, the giraffe has stepped away, and the yard is left to itself. Two thatched feeders stand on poles like empty lookout posts. A rough wooden pen rings a bare tree. Far in the middle, a single small striped animal grazes, almost lost against the sand. Blue sky, a few clouds, a long green fence. Wide shot, quiet channel.

0a4bfb8506.alt: Horned, sandy-coloured goats standing on pale rocks beside a pink-walled shelter under trees
0a4bfb8506.story: A herd of horned, sandy-coloured goats picks its way over a jumble of pale rocks toward a pink-walled shelter. Their horns curl back in thick arcs. One stands on the highest boulder, another pauses mid-step below. The trees lean in over the roof. Each animal seems to have its own private ledge, and to know exactly which one it is.

05f05686b2.alt: Herd of long-haired horned goats on a rocky slope in front of an open shed with a pink wall
05f05686b2.story: Further along the rail, the herd fills out: long fringes of hair hang from their chests and forelegs, and their curved horns catch the afternoon light. They are scattered across the rocks at different heights, like figures arranged on a set. The shed behind them is open and dim. One goat in the foreground walks out of the frame, done posing.

acc7930ec8.alt: Clusters of pink flowers on a leafy green shrub growing beside a pale rock
acc7930ec8.story: Between enclosures, a shrub spills over a pale rock, its long narrow leaves topped with clusters of pink flowers. Some are wide open, some still tight buds. A wire fence hovers out of focus behind. It is a small, bright interruption on the path, the kind of thing that catches the eye between the main attractions.

b09bf3d8a9.alt: Dense green shrubs and grasses with small pale blue flowers along a shaded garden bed
b09bf3d8a9.story: A thick bank of leaves rises up the slope, broad and dark at the top, feathery grasses in the middle. Lower down, a few pale blue flowers break through. Spiky plants poke out from the shade above. The garden here is left a little wild, with nothing to look at but layer after layer of green.

14cdb2c181.alt: Clusters of pale blue flowers among bright green leaves with darker foliage behind
14cdb2c181.story: Closer, the blue flowers resolve into small star-shaped clusters, pale and slightly washed out, as if seen through a faded screen. Bright green leaves crowd around them. In the background, a tree trunk and long grasses fall away into darkness. The flowers seem to glow faintly, the only cool colour in a warm afternoon.

1eeaa7e588.alt: Close view of a tortoise's head facing forward beneath its blurred patterned shell
1eeaa7e588.story: The tortoise pushes its head forward until it fills the middle of the frame, scaly skin pebbled and dry, small dark eyes set deep. The shell looms behind it, blurred into a pattern of ochre plates. It looks ancient and faintly annoyed, like someone woken from a very long nap to answer the door.

744f476536.alt: Tortoise walking past a tree trunk on sandy ground, its ridged shell and head in profile
744f476536.story: Now seen side-on, the tortoise moves past the base of a tree, one heavy leg planted forward. Its shell rises in ridged plates, each one ringed with darker growth lines. The sand is pale and scuffed with tracks. Its head is low and steady. Wherever it is going, it will get there at exactly its own speed.

c102de4535.alt: Enclosure with several tortoises on sandy ground around a small round pool, stone path and tall trees
c102de4535.story: Wider now, the enclosure appears: a sandy ground scattered with tortoises, a shallow round pool, a curving stone path and a wall of tall trees. The animals are spread out, some heading for the water, some staying put. Nobody is in a hurry. It looks like a slow-motion replay of a crowd in a town square.

842747069f.alt: Single tortoise walking across a sandy enclosure near rocks, a tree trunk and a pink-flowered bush
842747069f.story: One tortoise has struck out across the open sand on its own, mid-stride, shell tilted slightly forward. A boulder rests by the tree trunk to the right, and a bush with pink flowers leans over the back wall. The light is soft and warm. In the time it takes to read this, it will have covered about a step.

e6a4732bee.alt: Ornate stone fountain in a round basin surrounded by lawn, clipped hedges and tall trees
e6a4732bee.story: In a clearing among the trees, an ornate stone fountain stands in the middle of a round basin. Its carved tiers rise in a column, but no water runs. Hedges are clipped in neat green blocks around the edge, and a concrete path leads up to it. It feels like a stage that someone forgot to light.

f20fc4ba46.alt: Small red barn-style hut behind a fence, beside a green bench, a tree and a paved path
f20fc4ba46.story: Back where the morning began: the little red hut sits behind its fence, white trim bright in the shade. A green bench waits empty at the edge of the path, and a broad tree trunk leans in from the left. Round dark shapes hang in its branches. The day has come full circle, and the barn has not moved an inch.

c221cb48a3.alt: Group of white deer resting in the shade of a metal shelter, with fence shadows crossing the dirt
c221cb48a3.story: Pale deer lie under a metal roof in the shade, legs folded, heads up. One stands at the edge, watching. In the foreground, the shadow of the fence stretches across the reddish dirt in big diagonal loops, like a static pattern laid over the scene. The air has the heavy stillness of mid-afternoon.

6bdaa74abc.alt: Close view of a pale deer with short antler stubs, head turned to the side on a reddish dirt ground
6bdaa74abc.story: One deer has come close to the fence. Its coat is a creamy white, its ears wide, two short stubs where antlers are just beginning. The eye is half-lidded, the nose damp and dark. The dirt behind it blurs into a warm rust. It looks sideways, curious but careful, ready to step back at the first sudden move.

e53ab4d6fe.alt: White deer walking away across dirt toward a long shed, with another deer's blurred back in the foreground
e53ab4d6fe.story: It steps back. The white deer turns and walks off toward the long shed, tail flicking, head turned over one shoulder for a last look. Another deer's back rises soft and blurred in the foreground. Light slips through the trees above the roof. The visit is over, from the deer's side at least.

5846e3b620.alt: Pale deer in profile behind chain-link fencing, with other deer blurred on the dirt behind
5846e3b620.story: Another deer, or the same one returned, stands in profile behind the chain-link. Its face is long and pale, the eye gentle, the ear cocked back toward the herd. The wire crosses its neck in faint lines. Behind, the others wander on the red dirt, out of focus. For a moment this one is the only face on the screen.

f606dcd4c1.alt: Pale deer leaning over a low wire fence with tufts of grass, a red-roofed shed blurred behind
f606dcd4c1.story: Leaning over the low fence, a deer stretches its neck toward a clump of grass just outside its reach. Its ears are wide and pink inside, its nose pointing down. The red roof of a shed blurs in the background. It has clearly noticed that the greener grass is, quite literally, on the other side.

cfc66187d8.alt: Garden path with a wire arch hung with plants, a bright lawn, shrubs and tall tree trunks
cfc66187d8.story: A metal arch draped with trailing plants marks the way into a garden. Beyond it, a lawn glows an almost artificial green in a patch of sun. Spiky plants and shrubs crowd the beds, and tall tree trunks cast long shadows across the path. The scene is calm and slightly unreal, a garden tuned to a brighter channel.

c64802d8af.alt: Meerkat sitting hunched on a mossy rock with its tail hanging down, rocks and a pole behind
c64802d8af.story: A meerkat sits on a mossy boulder, back rounded, head tucked down toward its own chest, grooming or simply thinking. Its tail drapes over the edge of the rock. The enclosure is a jumble of pale stones and shade. Then its ears twitch, and in a second the head will come up again to check the horizon.

c872e6c4c0.alt: Three meerkats on a concrete floor looking up, one standing upright on its hind legs by a rock
c872e6c4c0.story: Three meerkats, three faces turned upward. One stands tall on its hind legs by the rock, paws hanging loose, while the other two sit lower and stare straight up at whoever is leaning over the wall. Dark eye patches give them all a look of surprised attention. A fourth tail flicks past on top of the boulder.

786ae5a8c9.alt: Meerkat standing upright looking up while another sniffs the ground beside a mossy rock
786ae5a8c9.story: Now just two remain in view. One stands up straight, front paws tucked, head tilted to the sky, keeping watch. The other has given up on the visitors and is nosing the ground for something better. On the rock above, another tail hangs down. Sentry and searcher, a small two-part programme running on loop.

43c7f38bf2.alt: Small cream building with a roll-up door under tall trees, beside a gravel path and a black bench
43c7f38bf2.story: Set back from the road, a small cream building sits among the trees, its roll-up door shut, a window and a plant beside it. A black bench stands at the edge of the gravel. The trunks rise straight and thin in front, and the light falls through in patches. It looks like a place where keys are kept, and where very little happens.

d8c3c58158.alt: Meerkat enclosure of pale sculpted rock and pipes under a metal roof, with two meerkats standing upright
d8c3c58158.story: From above, the meerkats' world comes into view: pale sculpted rock, round pipes for tunnels, a back wall stained brown, a metal roof. In the middle, two small figures stand upright side by side, both looking the same way. The whole set is built to their scale. They patrol it like they own the building.

2c8caf6cf5.alt: Sloped dirt enclosure with concrete pipes, wooden tables, trees and a group of white goats in the distance
2c8caf6cf5.story: A sloping yard runs down from a raised platform, with concrete pipes lying on the dirt and rough wooden tables set among the trees. In the far corner, a small crowd of white goats gathers by a fence. Sunlight spills across the grass on the right. The yard waits like a playground before the bell goes.

bf585783f8.alt: Small hut with a brown roof and red rails behind a chain-link fence, with flowers and gravel in front
bf585783f8.story: Behind a chain-link fence, a small hut with a brown shingled roof and red railings stands on short legs. In front, flowers in pink and yellow push up through the weeds, and the gravel path runs past along the bottom. A board leans against the hut. It looks like a holiday cabin built for someone very small.

93594d8069.alt: Small red-railed hut with a wooden ramp in an enclosure among trees and a stone wall
93594d8069.story: Seen side-on, the hut has a ramp leading down to the ground, slatted like a ladder, and a little porch with red rails. A stone wall curves around it, and trees crowd the slope behind. The dirt below is scuffed with tracks. Whoever lives here prefers to enter on foot and make a slow, dignified descent.

b3f14078ff.alt: Black and white goat pushing its face up to a chain-link fence, other goats blurred behind
b3f14078ff.story: A black and white goat presses its nose right up to the chain-link, one ear flopping through a gap. Its eye is amber and steady, its expression somewhere between curiosity and complaint. Behind, the rest of the herd mills around on the dirt, soft and blurred. This one has come to the front of the line and is making its case.

befc6f9198.alt: Several white goats walking across a sunny dirt yard with trees, a shelter and distant hills
befc6f9198.story: The herd is on the move, white goats trotting across the bare yard in a loose line toward the shade. One pauses to look back. A tall goat stands by the shelter on the right. Beyond the fence, green countryside rolls out toward low hills under a pale sky. It is a quarter to four and the afternoon is bright.

6985d51ec1.alt: White goat standing between rustic wooden chairs near a rocky shelter and a small pool
6985d51ec1.story: A goat noses between two rustic wooden chairs, as if looking for a seat at a table nobody set. Behind it, a rocky shelter rises, with stumps arranged like stools inside. A shallow pool reflects a little sky. The scene is half farmyard, half outdoor café, and the goat seems unsure which one it has wandered into.

db725d819b.alt: Crowd of brown sheep packed together in a shaded walled pen, with trees and hills beyond
db725d819b.story: Under the roof's shade, the sheep stand shoulder to shoulder, a sea of brown wool and long, drooping faces. A few look up at once. The concrete wall behind them is pale, and beyond it trees and distant hills sit in haze. Nobody moves much. It is cooler here than anywhere else, and every sheep knows it.

6a070dbbd5.alt: Sheep with long drooping ears resting its chin on a fence rail, other sheep blurred behind
6a070dbbd5.story: One sheep has worked its way to the rail and rests its chin there, long ears hanging down, the inside of one glowing pink in the light. Its eye is dark and calm. The rest of the flock dissolves into a soft blur behind. It gazes out with the patient face of someone queuing for something they are sure is worth it.

95462640ed.alt: Flock of sheep resting in a shaded pen framed by dark trees, with a bright view of distant hills
95462640ed.story: Deep in the pen, the sheep are dark shapes resting in the shade, the light beyond falling bright on green hills and a far horizon. Tree branches frame the top of the frame like curtains. The contrast is strong: cool shadow here, wide sunlit country there. The flock stays in, content with the view.

447f508b48.alt: Curving paved path under tall leafy trees beside fences, with a lone person walking in the distance
447f508b48.story: Pale and dappled, the path curves away under a canopy of tall trees, its surface pale and dappled. A lone figure walks far ahead, small against the long run of fences on the right. Ferny plants spill in from the bottom corner. The zoo is starting to thin out. The afternoon has that end-of-programme feeling, credits not yet rolling but close.

f3d77dcb92.alt: Crowned crane with a golden feather crest half hidden behind chain-link fencing and a rusty post
f3d77dcb92.story: A burst of golden bristles rises above a black-and-white head, half hidden behind a rusty post. The crane leans toward the fence, its face blurred, its grey body soft in the background. The chain-link crosses everything in front. It is only a glimpse, like catching a strange channel for one second while flicking past.

5907475c49.alt: Close view of a crowned crane through chain-link, showing its golden crest, red cheek patch and grey neck
5907475c49.story: Then it turns, and the bird comes into full view: a crown of stiff golden plumes, a black cap, a red and white patch on the cheek, a pale eye fixed sideways. The grey neck curves down out of the frame. The wire diamonds frame the face like a lattice window. It looks dressed for an occasion nobody told the rest of the zoo about.

12773fc6cc.alt: Path running beside a sunlit lawn under leafy trees, with a few people walking in the distance
12773fc6cc.story: Further on, the path runs along the edge of a bright lawn, trees leaning over it from both sides. Far ahead, a few visitors walk toward a covered area, small dark shapes in the light. The grass is a vivid green where the sun lands, dark where it doesn't. It is just before four, and the shadows are starting to stretch.

18f3a565f0.alt: Sandy arena with a shade sail and white fence, a single small pony standing near the far side
18f3a565f0.story: A tan shade sail stretches over one end of the arena, and beneath it the sand is raked smooth. At the far rail, a single small pony stands alone, tail hanging, looking at nothing in particular. The white fence runs in a long loop around the empty ring. It looks like a set after the show, with one performer who has not left.

5c482402c6.alt: Brown pony with a pale mane and pink halter resting its head on a fence rail
5c482402c6.story: Up close, the pony has a thick pale fringe that falls over its eyes, and a pink halter buckled under its chin. It leans against the rail, head low, coat glossy brown. Someone in a white shirt stands blurred in the background. The pony looks drowsy and content, like it has decided the afternoon can carry on without it.

62a2df9002.alt: Shaded stall with metal railings, a green bucket and long shadows across sandy ground
62a2df9002.story: Light falls inside the stall in long hard stripes, the railing posts printing dark bars across the sand. A green bucket hangs in the corner. Beyond the roof, a road, a few trees and a ridge of green hill. No animal is home. Only shadows, slowly rotating as the sun goes down.

5362a344cb.alt: Empty sandy arena beneath a tan shade sail, enclosed by a white fence with trees and flowers beyond
5362a344cb.story: From under the shade sail the arena looks wider still, its sand dark where the canvas shades it and pale where the sun lands. The white fence bends away into a corner, with yellow flowers and a tall tripod-like frame beyond. The pony is gone from the ring now. Just sand, rail, light, and the tail end of the afternoon.

254e59ebe4.alt: Silhouetted person walking through a dark leafy archway toward a bright hall with a car park beyond
254e59ebe4.story: A tunnel of leaves frames the way out, dark green and dense, opening onto a bright hall. A figure walks through it, half in silhouette, heading for the light. Inside the hall, a blue bin and a small table, and beyond, a row of parked cars. It is the zoo's last doorway, and the channel is about to change.

bf910b6d45.alt: Open pavilion with a red log-style wall, a small green chair and a colourful painted mural
bf910b6d45.story: Under an open pavilion, a wall of red-painted logs runs along one side, and a single small green chair stands on the concrete in front of it, waiting for a very small audience. A colourful mural fills the back wall. Sunlight falls across the floor in pale shapes. It is three minutes to four, and the show here seems to have ended.

06bc2a7232.alt: Inside a bus with rows of blue seats trimmed in yellow, blue curtains and a bright window on the left
06bc2a7232.story: Rows of blue seats with yellow trim stretch toward the front of the bus, their headrests lined up like an audience facing a dark screen. Blue curtains are pulled to one side. Bright light pours in through the window on the left, washing out the view. The engine hums. The journey has only just begun.

51c8100cd1.alt: Concrete elevated rail pillars framing a cream building with arched windows, beyond railway tracks
51c8100cd1.story: Through the gap between concrete pillars, a long cream building with rows of arched windows comes into view. Railway tracks run across the middle ground, and a striped kerb in black and white runs along the bottom edge. The sky is pale and hazy. The city appears in widescreen, framed by its own infrastructure.

3912e330a3.alt: Cream building with arched windows framed between concrete pillars and an elevated track, a clock tower behind
3912e330a3.story: A few seconds on, and the frame tightens. The pillars now stand like the edges of a screen, the cream building squared in the middle, a small clock tower poking up behind it on the right. A concrete barrier runs along the bottom. The light is flat and dusty. It is a picture that holds very still while everything around it moves.

091a12e281.alt: Elevated station stairway with curving metal canopies above railway tracks and a fenced platform
091a12e281.story: A station staircase climbs up the side of a concrete deck, its metal canopy curving overhead like a ribbon caught mid-air. Below it, a fence lines the platform and gravel lies between the tracks. The road in the foreground is empty. The whole structure looks new and a little unfinished, as if the trains have not quite arrived yet.

dd11c16ca3.alt: Small boxy yellow car parked in front of a wooden house among green trees, shrubs and boulders
dd11c16ca3.story: A small, boxy yellow car sits parked in the afternoon sun, rounded at every edge like a toy. Behind it, a wooden house hides among trees and clipped shrubs, with a stone lantern by the path and large boulders at the foot of the steps. The light is warm and golden. It feels like the opening shot of a gentle cartoon.

db572cc1d3.alt: Round marble café table with a potted red anthurium and two black bentwood chairs by a large window
db572cc1d3.story: By the window, a round marble table holds one potted plant with glossy red blooms. Two black bentwood chairs face each other, empty, as if in the middle of a conversation that paused. White curtains frame the glass. Outside, parked cars glint in the light. Inside, the room stays dim and quiet, a small still life arranged for nobody in particular.

c25d0186d5.alt: Backlit painting of two small dogs on sand above a cabinet with flower arrangements, a lamp and a green radio
c25d0186d5.story: A lit-up painting glows on the wall: two small dogs trotting across a golden dune, one dark, one pale. Beneath it, a rattan cabinet holds a crowd of objects, a bouquet of coral roses and lilies, a milk-glass lamp, a basket of cream flowers and a green radio set, tuned to nothing. Everything is bathed in the same honeyed light.

d222f48ee9.alt: Person seen from behind with hands clasped, standing on a shaded garden path facing a sunlit lawn
d222f48ee9.story: In the shade of the trees, a figure stands on the path with hands clasped behind the back, facing the open lawn. A stone lantern rises among the plants to the right. The grass beyond is bright and wide, almost glowing. It is a few minutes past four, and the garden holds that pause between looking and stepping out.

b0652b51c1.alt: Person walking away along stepping stones through a shaded garden toward a bright lawn
b0652b51c1.story: Then the step is taken. The figure moves along the stepping stones, out of the shade and toward the light, one foot lifting mid-stride. The lantern stands on its pedestal to the right, unmoved. Small rocks and low plants line the path. In a few seconds the lawn will swallow the walker into its green.

ea210b8792.alt: Garden path with stepping stones and a stone lantern leading to a wide lawn, a small figure far away
ea210b8792.story: Soon the path empties out. The figure has reached the lawn and is now just a small shape far across the grass. Trees arch over both sides of the frame, and the stone lantern keeps its post. Late sun warms the edges of every leaf. The garden looks like a still that has been held a little too long on screen.

6f52a6db2f.alt: Vintage green van converted into a flower stall, surrounded by potted pink and red flowers in white pots
6f52a6db2f.story: An old green van has been turned into a flower stall, its side opened up to show shelves of small pots and a yellow watering can. In front, flowers spill out of white planters: pink, coral, red. A black stanchion stands at one side. The van will not drive anywhere again, and seems perfectly happy about it.

c10207b1ee.alt: Lush garden with grasses and broad-leaved plants around a small rocky stream, a parked pickup beyond
c10207b1ee.story: Long grasses and broad leaves crowd around a little stream that trickles between rounded rocks. The water catches a faint glint of light. Through a gap in the greenery, a pickup truck sits parked by the road, a reminder that the outside world is right there. Here, though, it is all green layers and cool shadow.

7086b9b9a6.alt: White ornate garden table and four chairs under a canvas umbrella on a stone patio among trees
7086b9b9a6.story: Four white chairs with curling iron backs gather around a square table, an umbrella raised over them on a single pole. The stone patio is paved in irregular slabs, and the garden presses in from every side. No cups, no menus, no one sitting. The set is ready. The actors are late.

47f36314c5.alt: Curving pebble path through a shaded garden of trees and low ground cover toward a wooden pavilion
47f36314c5.story: A pebbled path winds through the garden, its stones pressed into the earth in a soft mosaic. Low ground cover spreads on either side in silver-green mats. Branches lean overhead, and at the end of the curve a small wooden pavilion catches the late light. It is the kind of path that asks to be followed slowly.

2e3b38964b.alt: Stepping stones crossing a shallow stream through a lawn, with slender trees on wooden supports
2e3b38964b.story: Flat stones cross a shallow stream in an easy line, inviting a hop from one to the next. Young trees stand on the lawn, propped up by wooden supports like patients on crutches. Taller trees crowd behind, light filtering through their thin leaves. The grass is lush and very green, and the water barely moves.

7ab6871648.alt: Large tree trunk rising from the centre of curved stone steps set into a lawn
7ab6871648.story: A broad tree grows from the middle of a shallow amphitheatre, its curved stone tiers stepping down around the trunk. The lawn rolls out beyond, and more trees stand at the edges. The seats face the tree as if it were the performer. On a quiet afternoon, it is giving a very long, very still show.

32ae7f9e30.alt: Looking up a thick tree trunk into a tangle of bare and leafy branches against a pale sky
32ae7f9e30.story: Looking straight up, the trunk splits into a dozen branches, some bare and pale, some still hung with feathery leaves. The sky shows through in pale gaps. Lower down, a few green boughs from other trees cross the frame. It is a tangle with its own logic, like wiring behind a very old set.

bffca05f19.alt: Small waterfall tumbling over rocks beside a lawn with two blue wooden lounge chairs in afternoon sun
bffca05f19.story: Water spills over a stack of dark rocks into a shallow pool, white and fizzing as it falls. Beyond the stones, the lawn opens up, and two blue wooden lounge chairs sit side by side facing the light. The sun pours in from the right, hazy and gold. It is nearly half past four, and the chairs are still waiting.

4cc819e06d.alt: Two dark blue wooden lounge chairs on a sloping lawn with rocks in front and sun haze through trees
4cc819e06d.story: The two blue chairs again, now seen from below the slope, angled toward each other like a pair in quiet conversation. Rocks jut from the grass in the foreground. The sun is low behind the trees, filling the top of the frame with a soft golden haze. A stepping-stone path leads away to the right, toward more seats and more shade.

9f1d415f0e.alt: Close view of water falling over stacked rocks into a shallow pool, with ferns and leaves around
9f1d415f0e.story: Nearer the falls, the water breaks into separate strands, silver against the dark stone. Ferns lean in from the left, and moss clings to the cracks. The pool below is shallow, its surface fizzing white. The sound would be steady and endless, the garden's own broadcast on a frequency that never switches off.

d7209ee7f1.alt: Wooden deck between two pale tree trunks with two pale yellow chairs and a small table, dense green behind
d7209ee7f1.story: A wooden deck sits on the lawn between two pale trunks, set with two pale yellow chairs and a little table between them. The bushes behind are thick and dark green. The arrangement looks like a stage built for a two-hander, the actors wandered off between scenes, leaving their chairs angled toward each other.

6617f52098.alt: Several teal wooden deck chairs on a sunny lawn under leaning tree trunks and leafy trees
6617f52098.story: Teal deck chairs are scattered across the lawn in small groups, some facing the sun, some turned away. A leaning trunk cuts diagonally through the frame, casting a long shadow over the grass. Autumn-coloured leaves blaze in the trees behind. Every chair is empty. Every chair looks extremely comfortable.

dca4f9705b.alt: Wide sloping lawn bordered by trees, with a leaning trunk on the right and small blue chairs in the distance
dca4f9705b.story: Seen from the foot of the slope, the lawn looks wider than ever, a long green sweep with a couple of blue chairs dotted along its far edge. A leaning trunk frames the right side. Trees soften into haze at the back. The sun is lower now, and the light lies across the grass in long, quiet bands.

c1c052e75c.alt: Dark green pond edged with lush plants and lily pads, a garden lamp and red chairs in the distance
c1c052e75c.story: A slow green pond curves through the garden, its surface dark and still, lily pads gathering at one edge. Thick shrubs and trees crowd the far bank. On the left, small red chairs sit beside a young tree tied to stakes, and a low garden lamp stands in the grass. The colours are deep and saturated, the water barely breathing.

ea001e8fa5.alt: Still pond with a cluster of round lily pads in front of a bank of dry brown and green foliage
ea001e8fa5.story: Closer to the water, the lily pads float in a wide raft of round green leaves. Behind them the bank is a mix of dry brown stems and fresh green, tangled and overgrown. The pond reflects almost nothing, its surface a murky olive. It is the wildest corner of the garden, left alone on purpose, perhaps.

3119e8b40e.alt: Thick tree trunk standing beside low terraced stone steps on a sunlit lawn under pale sky
3119e8b40e.story: The great tree from the amphitheatre again, now seen from the side, its trunk leaning and forking into heavy limbs. The stone steps run behind it in rough-cut tiers. Sunlight lies flat on the grass beyond. A thin mast pokes up in the far distance. The afternoon is turning bronze at the edges.

916157917f.alt: Two teal deck chairs on a sloping lawn beneath tall trees and leafy shrubs
916157917f.story: Two teal chairs sit low on the slope, tilted toward the bottom of the hill, as if watching something no one else has noticed. Tall trees rise above them, their crowns lit and their trunks in shade. Stepping stones lead up past more chairs among the shrubs. The grass looks soft enough to lie on instead.

5bb94f90d8.alt: Wide green lawn with a single wooden bench in the middle, a line of trees and hazy sky behind
5bb94f90d8.story: A single low bench sits in the middle of a broad lawn, small against the open grass. A line of trees closes off the horizon, with a roof just visible behind them. The sky is pale and hazy, warm at the edges. One bench, one view, all that green: the garden has been reduced to its simplest signal.

f043893ed5.alt: Café interior with a cream arch, floral wallpaper, wooden tables and chairs and a herringbone wood floor
f043893ed5.story: Indoors, a cream arch frames the dining room. Floral wallpaper covers the far wall, a wooden door with a glass panel stands half lit, and dark wooden chairs gather around small tables. The herringbone floor gleams in the low light. It is twenty-five past four and the room is nearly empty, warm and hushed like a radio left on low.

e7a669b662.alt: Slice of cheesecake with red berry topping and a fork beside an iced dark drink in a domed cup on a wooden table
e7a669b662.story: A slice of cheesecake with a glossy red berry topping rests on a small plate, a fork already laid across it. Beside it, an iced dark drink in a domed plastic cup, a black straw standing straight up. The wooden table glows amber, and the room behind dissolves into soft circles of light. The first bite has not happened yet.

902d0512f7.alt: Wide view of a café room with floral wallpaper, an arched doorway, wooden tables and a dark sofa
902d0512f7.story: Another angle on the room: the arch now on the left, a dark green sofa on the right, and between them wooden tables and a low coffee table on the herringbone floor. A chandelier hangs in the corner like a cluster of frost. Windows let in a green afternoon. The room feels assembled from several decades at once.

50a74d295e.alt: Floral wallpapered wall beneath a staircase with an arched glass door, window, bar stools, lamp and sofa
50a74d295e.story: Beneath the staircase, floral wallpaper climbs toward the ceiling in tiny blue blossoms. A wooden door with an arched pane looks out onto greenery, and a window above a narrow bar frames more green. Two tall stools wait by the counter. A small lamp glows warm on a side table next to a patterned sofa.

38f5b50054.alt: Gramophone with a large horn on a round table beside a potted plant at a tall window with a white curtain
38f5b50054.story: A gramophone stands on a round table by the window, its dark horn turned toward the room as though about to speak. Beside it, a potted plant with red flowers. A white curtain hangs to the right. Through the glass, the terrace and garden glow green. The horn says nothing, but it looks ready to play the afternoon back.

b87c2f701d.alt: Lit painting of two small dogs on sand above a cabinet with flowers, a lamp and a green radio in dim light
b87c2f701d.story: Back at the painted dogs, the lighting has dimmed. The two of them still trot across their golden sand above the cabinet, the bouquets still crowded below them, the green radio still waiting for someone to turn the dial. A quarter of an hour has passed. In this corner, nothing has changed at all.

7407426059.alt: Orange pom-pom flower on a long stem in focus, with a blurred sofa, drink and window behind
7407426059.story: One orange pom-pom flower rises on a long stem in the foreground, sharp and round as a dandelion clock. Everything behind it is soft: a mustard sofa, a cup on a low table, a tall window glowing at the back. The scene is all warm tones, honey and rust. The flower is the one thing holding still in focus.

6d725af041.alt: Bright café room with tall black-framed windows, white curtains, patterned tile floor and round tables
6d725af041.story: In this room, the windows run floor to ceiling in black frames, white curtains gathered at each one. The floor is patterned in grey and white tiles, and round tables with dark chairs stand in loose rows. Through the glass, the garden glows green. Light pours in at a low angle, catching the backs of the chairs.

b8cd78d2ff.alt: Round dark pedestal table with a potted red anthurium between two bentwood chairs at a bright window
b8cd78d2ff.story: Back on screen, the window table: a round top on a heavy turned pedestal, a potted red anthurium in the middle, two black bentwood chairs facing each other. White curtains are drawn back on either side. A tree branch reaches across the glass outside. The afternoon has returned to where it started.

ccaacd4f49.alt: Corner shelf holding a small decorated Christmas tree, gnome figurines, a retro radio and lanterns
ccaacd4f49.story: One small Christmas tree stands on a dark corner shelf, decorated with red and gold baubles, a star on top. Around it, little gnome figures in pointed hats, a retro radio, lanterns and a few ornaments. February light falls through the white curtains. The holiday has been left up a little longer than usual, and nobody seems to mind.

3124fecb15.alt: Tall windows onto green trees beside a round table with two wooden chairs on a patterned tile floor
3124fecb15.story: Tall windows open onto a wall of green leaves, light flooding in across the patterned floor tiles. A round white table stands in the middle with two wooden chairs, a single small vase on top. A lamp glows on a shelf by the floral wallpaper. Shadows from the window frames fall long and dark. Twenty to five, and the light is perfect.

f4765d14dd.alt: Nearly identical view of tall windows, round table, two chairs and patterned tile floor in late sun
f4765d14dd.story: Seconds later, the frame shifts slightly to the right. The same table, the same chairs, the same patterned floor, the curtain now just in view on the edge. The leaves outside have moved a little in the breeze. It is like watching the same scene on two channels, one broadcasting a beat behind the other.

21b5fbfc99.alt: Long wooden table with a ribbed glass vase of red and blue flowers and two cans, windows onto trees behind
21b5fbfc99.story: A ribbed glass vase on a long wooden table holds a loose bunch of red and blue flowers, stems leaning in every direction. Two small cans stand nearby, labels turned away. The chairs are pushed in. Behind, the windows frame the terrace and the trees, the light outside brighter than in. Someone was here a moment ago, or will be soon.

9eb9c3b272.alt: Cream archway framing woven globe pendant lights above a wooden staircase with white turned balusters
9eb9c3b272.story: Through a cream archway, a cluster of woven globe lights hangs at different heights, glowing softly like small moons. Behind them, a wooden staircase climbs with white turned balusters, and the floral wallpaper appears again at the edge. The arch crops it all into a neat curve, a window onto another set in the same building.

20852a07e9.alt: Coffee bar with an espresso machine labelled Spirit, wooden cabinets, pendant lamps and draped fabric ceiling
20852a07e9.story: The coffee bar glows behind the counter: an espresso machine with Spirit in white script across its front, grinders lined up beside it, wooden cabinets lit from within. Fabric drapes across the ceiling in soft waves, and metal pendant lamps hang down on long cords. A pastry case shines on the right. The whole wall looks ready for its close-up.

8e8df2081e.alt: Potted red anthurium on a round white table in front of a café counter, pastry case and wooden blinds
8e8df2081e.story: A potted anthurium sits on a round white table, its glossy red blooms catching the light from the window. Beyond it, the counter: a pastry case, a till screen, a tablet stand, wooden blinds glowing amber. Leaves from outside push into the right edge of the frame. The plant is the star; everything else is set dressing.

d4d76bd7bd.alt: Espresso machine labelled Spirit on a dark counter with rattan panels, wooden blinds glowing behind
d4d76bd7bd.story: The espresso machine sits squarely on the dark counter, Spirit lettered across its front, cups stacked on top. Behind it, the wooden blinds catch the low sun and glow in warm stripes. Rattan panels below the counter are lit from underneath. The machine is quiet for now, a pause between orders, steam held in reserve.

458e5b830b.alt: Espresso machine and white grinder on a dark counter under draped fabric, wooden blinds behind
458e5b830b.story: A half step to the side, and a white grinder comes into view at the left edge, tall and narrow beside the machine. The blinds still glow, the draped fabric still billows across the ceiling. A row of cups sits on top of the espresso machine, waiting their turn. The scene plays on, one more angle on the same small theatre.

a339bd7504.alt: Garden with mist drifting low over potted pink flowers, stepping stones, a boulder and ferns
a339bd7504.story: Mist drifts low across the garden, released from somewhere near the ground. It softens the potted pink flowers and the ferns in the foreground, and blurs the stepping stones as they curve away. A large boulder sits half hidden in the leaves. It is just after five, and the whole corner looks briefly like a dream sequence.

874e39465e.alt: Wooden boardwalk leading through dense trees with young trunks held by wooden supports, warm late light
874e39465e.story: Pale planks of a boardwalk lead away between the trees, its pale planks catching the late light. Young trunks are held up by slanted wooden supports on either side. Leaves crowd in thick from above and below. At the far end, a roof peeks through the greenery. The path seems to promise somewhere just slightly better than here.

4ae532a1ba.alt: Orange-spotted fish and a dark fish swimming in a shallow pool with rippling light on a sandy floor
4ae532a1ba.story: Just before seven in the morning, the pool is shallow and bright, its floor a pale green with light rippling across it. An orange fish blotched with darker patches glides through the middle, while a dark one hangs nose-down nearby. Another pink shape drifts at the top. The water wobbles every reflection into soft, moving lines.

fa6e81e2a5.alt: Dark fish rising toward the surface with its mouth open and pectoral fins spread, in pale green water
fa6e81e2a5.story: Three seconds later, the dark fish has come right up to the surface, mouth open, fins fanned out like small transparent wings. It seems to be asking for something. Its eyes are set wide on either side of a blunt face. The pale floor of the pool blurs out behind. It is very clear what it thinks people are for.

8f4d9faa91.alt: Silver fish with yellow and red fins swimming in a tank with a bright blue background
8f4d9faa91.story: Lit against a bright blue backing, a small school of silver fish hangs in place, scales catching the light like sequins. Their fins are tipped with yellow and orange, their eyes round and gold. One turns toward the glass. The colour is almost too vivid, like a broadcast with the saturation turned all the way up.

80dc9c6353.alt: Two angelfish, one with an orange head, swimming in a curved glass bowl against a bright window
80dc9c6353.story: Two angelfish drift behind the curve of a glass bowl: one with a bright orange head and black and white body, the other dark and striped, fins trailing long threads. Behind them, a window glows white and the bowl's edge warps the view. Scratches and reflections float on the glass. It is like watching the fish through an old television tube.

06ba5c5bfc.alt: Dark striped angelfish silhouetted against a bright window behind a curved glass tank and a dark rock
06ba5c5bfc.story: Early afternoon now, and the bowl is darker. A single striped angelfish hangs against the bright window, its tall fins making a thin, sharp silhouette. A shadowy rock fills the left half of the frame. The glass is milky with light. The fish turns slowly in place, a small dark sign in a pale screen.

80810383d9.alt: Large aquarium with branching coral on rocks, fish swimming above and rings of light on the surface
80810383d9.story: The big tank runs teal and deep. Branching coral grows on the rocks at the bottom, and fish drift overhead in loose groups. Above, the surface throws down rings of pale light, wobbling like signals from far away. A dark fish crosses the top of the frame, close to the glass, and swims on.

f25fe85dfb.alt: Coral reef display with purple branching coral and round corals on rocks under bright turquoise water
f25fe85dfb.story: The reef is built in layers: purple branching coral, round brain-like domes in pink and blue, rough grey rocks below. Turquoise water fills the top of the frame, and small fish float through it like specks of dust in a beam of light. Light rings ripple on the ceiling. The whole thing glows like an aquarium screensaver come to life.

9768cb8d9e.alt: Lionfish with striped spines hovering alone in a dark blue tank beneath bubbles at the surface
9768cb8d9e.story: Alone in a dark blue tank, a lionfish hovers, spines fanned out in pale red and white stripes. Above it, a scatter of bubbles clings to the surface like stars in a night sky. The rest of the water is deep and empty. The fish barely moves. It does not need to; everything about it already says keep your distance.

8a5d6301b6.alt: Large crab with very long jointed legs pressed against the glass of a dark tank, a small sign beside it
8a5d6301b6.story: A crab with impossibly long legs spreads itself across the glass, its knobbly body in the middle, each jointed limb reaching toward a different corner. A small sign is fixed to the frame on the left. In the reflection, a visitor's shirt hovers ghostlike behind the creature. It looks less like an animal than an antenna array.

e1a5b12414.alt: Orange and white clownfish swimming among rocks, an orange coral and a green columnar coral
e1a5b12414.story: Clownfish weave between the rocks, orange bodies with white bands outlined in black. Two hide by a fiery orange coral on the left, and another hovers beside a tall green column. A sprig of green plant floats to the right. The tank is full of small, busy motion, everyone darting in and out of their own doorways.

9cf339935c.alt: Two clownfish swimming beside a tall green textured coral column, with rocks and an orange coral nearby
9cf339935c.story: Two of the clownfish now hold their position by the green column, one above the other, like they have been asked to pose. Their bands stand out crisp against the blue-grey rocks. The orange coral blurs at the left edge. A few seconds of stillness before they flick off again into the shadows.

b4b74cfa30.alt: Dimly lit tank with rocks, gravel and a lumpy dark shape that could be a camouflaged fish
b4b74cfa30.story: This tank is almost all shadow. A low bed of black and white gravel, a few rounded stones, a fan of dark coral behind. In the middle sits a lumpy brown shape, rough and still. It might be a rock. It might be a fish pretending to be a rock. The longer you look, the less sure you are.

71670aea4a.alt: Eel with a black and white leopard-like pattern peeking out of a terracotta pot in a dark tank
71670aea4a.story: An eel pokes its head out of a terracotta pot, patterned in black blotches on white like a leopard print. Its mouth is slightly open. The pot is ringed with grooves and chipped at the rim. Behind, the tank fades to blue darkness. It looks like a puppet rising from a vase to deliver one line.

9e33d79236.alt: Spotted black and white eel emerging from a terracotta pot with rocks blurred in the dark background
9e33d79236.story: Slightly wider, the pot and its tenant sit alone in the gloom, a few blurred rocks behind. The eel has not moved, its patterned head held upright, eye fixed on the glass. Tiny particles drift through the water around it. It has the stillness of a performer waiting for the curtain, or for food.

8cd4ff7ac9.alt: School of fish with dark vertical stripes swimming in teal water above pale coral
8cd4ff7ac9.story: In teal water, a loose school of striped fish swims past, dark bars running down their pale yellow sides. Some face left, some right, as though they cannot agree on a direction. Pale coral tips poke up from the bottom of the frame. The light is cool and dim, the colour of a screen in a dark room.

203bbbef09.alt: Close view of a tall silver disc-shaped fish with dark vertical bands near a sandy bottom
203bbbef09.story: A tall, flat fish slides into the frame, its silver body shaped like a disc with dark bands running down from the eye. It swims low over the sand, close enough to the glass to blur at the edges. A branch of coral stands faded behind. The fish turns and shows its face, round-eyed and faintly surprised.

9c5a8b13fd.alt: Small pale spotted puffer fish resting on top of a branching green coral in a dark tank
9c5a8b13fd.story: On top of a branching green coral, a small pale puffer fish rests, its round body speckled, its little fins spread. The coral looks soft and bubbly under the cool light, and the rest of the tank sinks into near-black. The fish looks like it has climbed to the top of a hill to watch for something.

7c2a0cb856.alt: Lionfish in profile with long red and white striped fins spread wide against a dark blue blurred background
7c2a0cb856.story: Another lionfish, or the same one revisited, now in full profile: long feathered fins spread wide, striped red and cream, its body tapering into a fan of a tail. Behind it, blurred blue light spots float like stage lights. It drifts slowly past the glass, the last slow pan of the afternoon, before the screen fades to blue.

5017b5b78b.alt: A long grey shark-like fish gliding over rocks behind a curved tunnel strut, with small fish above
5017b5b78b.story: A pale strut cuts the view in half, and the long grey body slides through it without slowing. Small silver fish scatter above the dorsal fin, then regroup. On the rock below, everything is the colour of old sponge. For a second the shape looks drawn rather than alive, a flat silhouette pinned behind the glass, until the tail moves and it is gone past the bend.

c04e490cb2.alt: A small brown fish hanging alone in blue water above coral, specks drifting in the light
c04e490cb2.story: Out in the open blue, one brown fish holds still while the others keep to the coral.
