Light falls in from somewhere high and turns every speck in the water into dust in a projector beam. Nothing happens. The fish turns a few degrees, considers the glass, and stays where it is, as if waiting for the programme to start again.

38c81e843a.alt: A pale, flat, round fish with tall fins swimming through murky green water
38c81e843a.story: The pale fish arrives sideways, a flat white disc with fins swept back like a paper kite. The water around it is thick and greenish, the surface wrinkling far above. It drifts closer to the glass, one dark eye turned outward, then tilts and shows only its edge, nearly vanishing. Whatever it saw on this side, it seemed unimpressed.

9ad5803d82.alt: Looking up from the bottom of a large tank: a school of fish, a sunken log and coral below a bright surface
9ad5803d82.story: From below, the surface is a sheet of shaken light. A school of silver fish crosses it in loose formation, while a sunken wooden barrel and a fallen beam rest on the reef floor, props from a set nobody strikes. The blue goes deep and even. It is the middle of the afternoon outside, but in here it reads like a broadcast from the seabed.

179283318f.alt: A dark striped fish in a green-lit tank, with orange fish and blurred lamps behind
179283318f.story: A dark fish with faint stripes swims across a room it cannot see: blurred doorways, round lamps, a pale corridor beyond the glass. Two orange fish cruise along the top edge. The colours are muted, like a picture on a set with the contrast turned down. The striped one keeps its course, steady and unbothered, past the reflection of a light.

2cd24615a2.alt: An orange fish with dark spots swimming in front of a bright, blurred window
2cd24615a2.story: Behind the speckled orange fish, a bright rectangle glows, maybe a doorway, maybe a window onto the afternoon. Inside the tank, the light turns everything into soft green haze. Two pale circles float near the top like stray moons. The fish moves left, unhurried, its spots sharp against the glare, and for a moment it seems to be heading for the exit.

2d65d79332.alt: A small spotted fish in a hazy green tank beside a dark rock shape and a bright vertical strip of light
2d65d79332.story: Seven seconds later the spotted fish is smaller, further off, caught between a dark rock and a bright vertical strip of light. Another fish hovers in the shadow at the left, almost invisible. The rock looks like a statue's shoulder. Everything except the little fish has gone soft, as though the tank were slowly losing reception.

a1c0794672.alt: A crowded freshwater tank with many fish in orange, grey and black against a pale lit doorway
a1c0794672.story: Suddenly the tank is busy. Orange fish, grey fish, black ones with pale bellies, all crossing in different directions like commuters at a station. Behind the glass a lit doorway and a small square sign hang in the blur. Bubbles rise along one edge. Nobody seems to be in charge, and nobody collides.

53bcd4032f.alt: A pinkish-orange fish swimming close to the glass, with a dark fish and a bright window blurred behind
53bcd4032f.story: The pink-orange fish comes close enough to show the soft edges of its fins. Its eye catches a sliver of light from the window behind. Up in the corner, a dark fish turns away, smudged by motion. Four seconds after the crowd, the tank feels empty again, just one fish on the screen and a pale glow where the outside world should be.

b8523d7228.alt: A blue-grey fish beside mossy rock, with a tan fish and round bokeh lights behind it
b8523d7228.story: A blue fish noses along the mossy wall, scales flecked with grey like a faded print. Below and behind it, a tan fish blurs into the background with the lamps. One round light hangs just above its back, a small white moon in a green sky. The tank hums. The blue fish never once looks at the glass.

c4bafc0610.alt: Two small fish near a clay pot and rocks in a dim tank, a pale window frame behind
c4bafc0610.story: Down at the bottom, a clay pot sits half sunk among rounded stones, and a pale fish tucks against it as if for shelter. Above, a tiny silver fish and a darker one drift past each other without a word. A window frame glows faintly through the water. The afternoon outside has been reduced to a grey rectangle.

1a25574ee3.alt: A shark with black-tipped fins swimming above a sloping rock wall in deep blue water
1a25574ee3.story: Out of the blue comes the shark, long and pale, black on the tips of every fin. Behind it a second one follows at the edge of the frame. The rock wall slopes away beneath them, rough and dark green. The water above is wrinkled by the surface. It passes at the same calm speed it has kept all afternoon, which is somehow the unsettling part.

2cdc7d5cfa.alt: A shark's head and pectoral fin emerging from behind a rock ledge in dim green water
2cdc7d5cfa.story: Just the front half this time: a blunt head and a black-tipped fin sliding out from behind the rock. The rest of the body is still hidden in the green. The mouth sits low, closed, almost polite. It is a minute after the last pass and the shark has come round again, keeping to its loop like a rerun on a late channel.

fc53c9e67d.alt: View up through an aquarium tunnel at large fish silhouetted against the glittering surface
fc53c9e67d.story: Lie back under the tunnel and the surface turns to static, a field of white flecks shivering overhead. Big fish pass between it and the floor, dark shapes with pale bellies, one turning its head toward the glass. The light comes down in pieces. It is hard to tell which way is up, and for a moment it doesn't matter.

ecb6241b42.alt: Three silver fish swimming together above a rocky slope, the bright surface glittering above
ecb6241b42.story: Three silver fish hold formation along the rocks, then a fourth joins from below, its tail bent in a turn. The shimmer on the surface above is constant, like a screen between channels. Twenty seconds earlier they were shadows overhead. Now they slide off toward the dark end of the tank, close together, fins trimmed, going somewhere only they know about.

8ad39ff0fd.alt: A shark seen from below, silhouetted against the rippling bright surface of the tank
8ad39ff0fd.story: Seen from underneath, the shark is mostly outline: a pale belly, a fin raised like a sail, the head angled down toward the tunnel. Behind it the surface boils with light. A curved seam of the glass runs diagonally through the dark. It crosses overhead in a few seconds, and the ceiling goes back to being only water and glare.

55f889b26c.alt: Close view of a huge grouper's head and thick lips, its body filling the frame in green water
55f889b26c.story: The grouper fills the window like a face pressed to a bus. Thick lips, a small round eye, skin mottled and heavy. It does not seem to swim so much as hang, moving forward a centimetre at a time. Above its head the water glitters and a dark fin cuts through the top corner, someone else's business entirely.

35872fe992.alt: A black-tipped shark passing close overhead in front of a large rock in teal water
35872fe992.story: Thirty seconds later the shark comes back, closer, low enough to read the line of its gills. The dorsal fin is dipped in black, sharp against the teal. Behind it a big rounded rock looms out of focus. Sunlight hits the surface above in coins. It is all very calm, the way a slow pan across an empty set is calm.

b2c340a909.alt: Two large groupers nose to nose under the bright rippling surface of an aquarium tank
b2c340a909.story: Two groupers drift into each other, one face-on, the other twisting away to show its spotted flank and wide fins. Overhead the surface flickers with bright, loose static. Neither one hurries. They look like two old hosts meeting in a studio corridor, nodding without stopping, before the bigger one slides off into the green.

98254894a0.alt: A grouper's broad head beside a dark tunnel pillar, a pale fish swimming through the background
98254894a0.story: One dark pillar of the tunnel splits the view, and the grouper pushes its broad head right up against it. Behind, a smaller pale fish crosses a strip of brighter water near the rocks. The grouper's mouth is set in that permanent downturn that reads as mild disappointment. Ten seconds pass. It doesn't move, and neither does the pillar.

8deb7d41b0.alt: Small striped fish scattered across a bright blue tank wall above a cluster of artificial plants
8deb7d41b0.story: A new room, a new colour. The water here is flat electric blue, painted backdrop and all, and a handful of small striped fish hang in it like notes on a staff. Down in the corner, plastic plants in orange and green sprout from a white shell. Light rakes across the wall in thin diagonal lines, and the whole thing looks tuned a little too bright.

4c3c237ae0.alt: Small white fish with long fins swimming in a vivid blue tank, a dark pipe in the top corner
4c3c237ae0.story: Closer, the little fish turn out to be white with ragged fins, almost paper cut-outs against the blue. Three line up in a column near the top, others drift lower and blur. A black pipe pokes in from the corner. They move in small jerks, then stop, as though someone keeps pausing and unpausing the tape.

966524e8eb.alt: A spiny shell resting alone on pale sand at the bottom of a dim aquarium
966524e8eb.story: On a floor of fine sand, a single spiny shell sits slightly tilted, its ridges catching a little warm light. Something yellow blurs at the far end of the tank. There is no movement at all, and that is the point of this tank: a quiet corner between the big shows, where the only thing happening is the sand holding still.

e2f8a95516.alt: A starfish and several spiral shells laid out on sand in a glass tank, small plants at the back
e2f8a95516.story: Someone has arranged the sand like a still life. A brittle starfish lies on the left, a row of spiral shells stands in a line, and faint star-shaped prints are pressed into the floor where others used to be. Small plants dot the back wall. Lit from above in orange and green, it looks like a set for a children's programme that ended long ago.

2d22bc962f.alt: A hermit crab inside a large spiky shell on sand, near a piece of orange coral and a dark rock
2d22bc962f.story: Under the big spiky shell, a pair of legs and a pale face peer out. The hermit crab has stopped mid-step on the sand, a twig of orange coral beside it, a dark rock behind. Twelve seconds after the still life, here is the one thing in the tank that is actually alive, and it is not in any hurry to prove it.

761027483e.alt: A small tank with pink sand and colourful artificial corals arranged in rows, a lamp glowing above
761027483e.story: Pink sand, blue walls, plastic corals in purple and orange planted in neat rows. A small round lamp glows in the top corner like a moon on a stage. Swirled tracks run through the sand, the only sign that something lives here. It is a tidy little world, slightly unreal, the kind you might see behind a newsreader in an old studio.

0cff6a1c95.alt: A dark fish swimming over gravel among orange, white and blue artificial corals
0cff6a1c95.story: Flat and dark, a fish crosses the gravel with its tail tucked, past orange fronds and pale branching coral. A second, darker shape glides below it, half in shadow. Colours pop against the black water like bright buttons on a control panel. The fish turns its head toward the glass once, decides there is nothing new out here, and carries on.

db9011b223.alt: A small fish hovering near a branching artificial coral and a cone-shaped shell on pink sand
db9011b223.story: Against a deep blue wall, a small grey fish hangs beside a cone-shaped shell, peering at it from above. A branching coral reaches up on the left like antlers. The pink sand is ridged and clean. It is twelve seconds since the last tank, and here the stage is even emptier, just three objects waiting for someone to say a line.

af9e340283.alt: A spotted, pinkish puffer-like fish swimming in a blue tank with a column of bubbles at left
af9e340283.story: Round and freckled, the fish paddles across the blue with small fins working fast, its body barely moving. A column of bubbles rises on the left edge, ticking upward. The face looks permanently surprised. It swims straight toward the corner where two walls meet, stops, and seems to reconsider everything.

c4ffc3653a.alt: Two crabs beside a terracotta pipe on white sand, one crab reflected in the glass of the tank
c4ffc3653a.story: A clay pipe lies on its side in the white sand, and a crab sits inside it like a tenant at the door. Another crab steps out beside it, legs splayed, and its reflection walks into the glass at the right, a ghost image a little out of register. The light here is bright and even, almost clinical, the opposite of the tunnel.

1cb00924ee.alt: Two fish, one pale and one dark, swimming in a green tank with a pipe and a mesh-covered shape
1cb00924ee.story: Green water now, cloudier, with a white pipe running along the top like the plumbing of a backstage room. A pale fish and a dark one swim almost side by side, one lit, one in shadow, like two versions of the same picture. A mesh-covered block sits behind them. Fifty seconds after the crabs, the colour has changed channel again.

f39000cc18.alt: A sea turtle swimming near the surface, silhouetted against light pouring through the water
f39000cc18.story: Back in the tunnel, a turtle paddles near the top of the tank, a dark shape cut out of the glare. Light pours down beside it in a thick white column, breaking on the ripples. Its flippers move slowly, one stroke and a long glide. The rest of the frame is deep green shadow, the kind that makes the eye keep searching for something more.

8ec16ae597.alt: A large fish silhouetted from below against a bright, rippling water surface
8ec16ae597.story: Twenty seconds later something heavier passes: a big fish, all silhouette, its fins sharp against a surface that shines like hammered metal. The belly is in shadow, the tail flexed mid-stroke. From down here, it could be any size at all. It moves across the ceiling the way a cloud does, then the light closes in behind it.

60cdc31ec7.alt: A large silver fish with big scales swimming beside a vertical pole in blue water
60cdc31ec7.story: Every scale on this fish is outlined, a neat grid of silver plates catching the light. It holds steady beside a brown pole, mouth slightly open, fins spread. The blue behind it is calm and empty. Up close, it looks less like an animal and more like a well-made machine, idling, waiting for a signal to move.

c2e02e2fc5.alt: A large pale fish with a small eye beside a ring of rippling light in blue water
c2e02e2fc5.story: Heavy and pale, a fish noses into the frame from the right, all forehead and small bright eye. Behind it, a strange ring of light ripples on the water, a halo the surface made out of nothing. The fish seems to be looking straight through the glass. Its expression is fixed and faintly grumpy, as though it had been kept waiting.

24eb40511b.alt: Underside of a stingray pressed close above the viewer, showing its nostrils and mouth like a face
24eb40511b.story: Then the ceiling smiles. The underside of a ray drifts directly overhead, close enough to see two small nostrils and a curved mouth that look exactly like a face. Gill slits run below in neat rows. For three seconds the whole sky is pale skin and that calm cartoon expression, then the wing tips lift and it slides away.

e7bfa8fca2.alt: A large pale fish near the glass with dark rock and bright light breaking through behind it
e7bfa8fca2.story: That pale fish returns four seconds after the ray, half hidden in shadow now. Behind it, bright water breaks through a gap in dark rock like a cloud lit from behind. The fish's eye catches a single point of light. It hangs there with its lips pursed, an old character returning for a cameo nobody asked for.

0d27adaf65.alt: A stingray seen from below gliding across the arched glass of an aquarium tunnel
0d27adaf65.story: The ray crosses the arch now, a flat, rounded shape with a darker rim, its tail trailing toward the corner. Light glints through the water behind it in scattered spots. Seen from below it looks like a paper cut-out held up against a lamp. It moves without effort, the edges of its wings rippling, and the glass bends the outline slightly.

97459503f3.alt: A stingray banking through blue water between tunnel pillars, other fish swimming below
97459503f3.story: A minute and a half later the ray banks hard, one wing tipped up, tail whipping out behind like a cable. It passes between two pillars of the tunnel, while below it larger fish drift in pale blue haze. The pale underside shows a faint pattern of marks. For a moment it looks like it is waving, which it probably isn't.

cbcc8bca9a.alt: Two visitors seen from behind, looking into a dim tank where a large fish rests on the bottom
cbcc8bca9a.story: Two visitors stand at the glass, backs turned, shoulders almost touching. One wears a patterned shirt, the other has long hair falling over a light top. Inside the tank, a long dark fish lies low near a rusted frame, barely moving. Neither of them speaks. They just watch it, the way people watch a television that has been left on in another room.

8e8a724b49.alt: Two dark, deep-bodied fish swimming past a rough rock wall in green aquarium water
8e8a724b49.story: Two fish move in tandem past the rock, one in front, one slightly above and behind, as if practising a routine. Their bodies are tall and dark, edged in orange. The rock wall on the left is pocked and rough, and beyond it the water opens into pale blue. Somewhere up there the light is breaking on the surface, but it never quite reaches them.

f3550dc1f9.alt: A small banded shrimp near a pink artificial plant on pale sand in a dark tank
f3550dc1f9.story: A small banded shrimp, on a stretch of pale sand, picks its way past a pink plastic plant. Its antennae are long, thin lines catching the light. A larger shrimp waits in the shadow of green fronds on the right. Two minutes after the big fish, everything here is miniature and careful, every step measured in millimetres.

3ae4060e46.alt: A red-and-white banded shrimp with long antennae walking on sand under a green artificial plant
3ae4060e46.story: The striped shrimp has taken the spotlight, seven seconds closer. Red and white bands run down its legs, and its antennae sweep across the sand in two long arcs. A green plant leans over it like a stage curtain. Behind the glass edge, the tank darkens to blue-black. It pauses, tests the ground, and walks on toward the corner.

b2d8461d85.alt: A performer in a red mermaid tail swimming past coral inside a large tunnel tank
b2d8461d85.story: A red tail flicks across the reef. A performer in a mermaid costume glides low over the coral, arms stretched ahead, hair trailing. The fish part for her. Light ripples on the arch above in loose white ovals. Twenty to three on a Saturday, and the tunnel suddenly has a show running, somewhere between a dream and a children's programme.

12b97aaabf.alt: A silvery, diamond-shaped fish with yellow fins swimming over coral in a dark reef tank
12b97aaabf.story: In a darker reef tank, a flat silver fish turns sideways like a coin showing its face. Yellow edges its fins. Behind it, smaller fish hang like sparks over brown and grey coral. The water is so still that the whole tank could be a painting, until the silver one tilts and the light slides off it, gone.

15b3dada77.alt: A red-and-cream striped fish with a large eye swimming in clear teal water, a banded fish above
15b3dada77.story: Fifteen seconds and one tank over, a striped fish with an oversized eye floats in clear teal water, every line on its body ruled straight. A banded fish passes above, a little out of focus. The background is empty and smooth, the colour of a test screen. It hangs there long enough to seem posed, then flicks its tail.

1f9c31a597.alt: A small orange, black and white striped fish beside a pitted rock in an aquarium
1f9c31a597.story: Beside a pitted grey rock, a tiny fish in orange, black and white bands appears, the brightest thing for metres. It keeps close to the stone, hovering in the shadow of a ledge. The rock above is honeycombed with holes. At this size the fish could be a sticker someone pressed onto the glass, if it weren't for the tiny beating fins.

ea5ba18be6.alt: A small banded orange and white fish swimming past a honeycombed rock with pale coral above
ea5ba18be6.story: Six seconds later it has moved half a body length to the left, still hugging the rock. A pale green coral sits on the ledge above like a hat. The light is sharper here, picking out each ridge on the stone. The little fish turns, showing its white stripes edge on, and seems to check whether anyone is still watching.

78ee9a8186.alt: A small banded fish suspended in murky water between two blurred rock faces
78ee9a8186.story: Now it is out in the open, caught between two soft walls of rock that have gone completely blurred. The stripes still read clearly, three white bands on orange. Everything else is noise, grey and brown and green. For a moment it is the only thing in focus anywhere, a small clear signal in a fuzzy channel.

e7b8d43b6f.alt: A banded orange and white fish swimming left past a blurred pale rock, another fish behind
e7b8d43b6f.story: It swims left and a second one appears far behind, just a smudge of orange at the top right. The rock has turned pale and soft. This one is sharp from nose to tail, black-edged fins spread wide. Four frames in a row and it never once left the reef; it just kept doing small laps of the same few centimetres.

b8c25f10a9.alt: A spotted stingray resting on a rocky ledge in a dim, blue-lit tank
b8c25f10a9.story: A spotted ray rests on a ledge of pale rock, its tail trailing over the edge. The tank is mostly darkness, lit from one side by a cool blue lamp that catches the speckles on its back. It doesn't move. After the busy tunnel, it feels like a channel that has gone to the late-night test pattern, just this one quiet image held on screen.

4aa91f70b3.alt: A long, thin fish with a pointed snout resting on sand next to a dark rounded shape
4aa91f70b3.story: A long, narrow fish lies on the sandy floor, snout pointed down, patterned scales catching a little light. A dark rounded shadow of something larger sits beneath it. A clay pot or wooden crate shape looms in the back. The colours are murky green and brown, like a picture recorded too many times onto the same tape.

3e5be1e997.alt: A small orange lizard raising one front foot against the glass of a wooden-framed tank
3e5be1e997.story: Up on its hind legs at the glass, a small orange lizard lifts one front foot, fingers spread, as if waving. Its tail curls across the white sand behind it. A dark wooden frame edges the tank. Nobody taught it this, presumably, but the gesture lands anyway. Half the people walking past would wave back.

682c2ef3ae.alt: A small orange lizard peering over the wooden edge of its glass enclosure
682c2ef3ae.story: The lizard, six seconds after the wave, has dropped back down and peers over the wooden lip of the frame, chin resting on the edge. Its eyes are fixed on something outside. The tail still trails across the sand. The moment is over, the hand is down, and it has gone back to just watching, like everyone on the other side.

57bb8c7453.alt: A grey snake partly hidden among wood and pale shavings in a dim enclosure
57bb8c7453.story: It takes a second to find anything. Pale wood shavings, a twisted branch, a dark log curving overhead. Then the shape resolves: a grey snake, head resting low, body lost under the timber. It does not move at all. The longer you look, the more the whole box seems to be holding its breath.

85f75bc2f7.alt: A pale lizard with spiny sides looking out from behind the glass of its enclosure
85f75bc2f7.story: Almost white, a pale lizard rises at the front of its tank, chin lifted, spines bristling along its jaw. One foot rests on the glass. The light is soft and creamy here, the sand behind it smoothed into gentle dunes. It looks straight out, composed and patient, the way a host looks into a lens before the red light comes on.

e72cf51d43.alt: A pale lizard with one foot raised, its shadow cast across the sand of its enclosure
e72cf51d43.story: Eight seconds on, the pale lizard has shifted down and to the left, one foot still lifted. Its shadow stretches long across the sand behind it, a darker twin that looks more like a dragon than the lizard does. The wooden frame shines at the bottom of the glass. Of the two of them, only the shadow seems in the mood for drama.

2fcc03bcaa.alt: A spotted snake coiled along the back corner of a sandy enclosure
2fcc03bcaa.story: Pushed right into the back corner, a spotted snake lies in a long, loose line against the wall, head tucked near the glass. The sand in front is bright and empty, raked almost white by the lamp. Everything is very still and very clean. It is the kind of image that seems paused, though nothing has been paused at all.

0fc6d62324.alt: An orange and cream patterned snake coiled beneath a twisted branch on pale sand
0fc6d62324.story: Under a twisted grey branch, an orange snake with cream blotches loops round itself in a loose knot. Its head points out toward the sand, one eye glinting. The back wall is painted with rocks in rust and white. A water dish blurs across the bottom of the frame. It is an arrangement that looks almost deliberate, like a set dressed for one shot.

d09dfe5ff2.alt: A dark snake with tan markings curled on sand next to a twisted branch and a clay dish
d09dfe5ff2.story: This one wears a darker coat, brown and black with pale patches, coiled close to a twisted stick that rises out of the frame. A clay dish blurs in the foreground. Behind the glass, a painted backdrop of green foliage hangs slightly crooked. The snake's head rests on its own coils, as if it had just switched off for the afternoon.

3b45886a10.alt: A hairy dark spider with orange-banded legs on dry fibre bedding beside a clay dish
3b45886a10.story: Dead centre on a bed of dry fibre, a dark spider sits with its legs splayed, each one ringed with orange. A clay dish sits behind it, a teal one off to the side. It faces straight out, square to the glass, perfectly symmetrical. There is something oddly formal about it, like a station ident that holds on screen a beat too long.

bfb65c16ff.alt: A large tan lizard lying flat on sand, its eye half closed, a red number 14 on the glass
bfb65c16ff.story: Flat out on the sand, a big tan lizard rests its chin and half closes one eye, spines softened by the warm light. A red number 14 is painted on the corner of the glass. Behind it, a clay bowl and a pale log sit out of focus. It is ten to three, and whatever happens next in the building, this one has opted out.

66ae9cba83.alt: A green and turquoise lizard with a spiny crest gripping a branch in a dim enclosure
66ae9cba83.story: A lizard in turquoise and grey clings to a slanted branch, front feet curled tight, crest raised along its neck. The tail and lower body glow almost blue in the lamp. Behind it, everything melts into brown darkness. Its eye is half lidded, unimpressed, like a commentator who has seen this crowd every afternoon for years.

7aad194b0f.alt: A small pale lizard resting on bark chips under a branch, a clay pipe and orange leaves nearby
7aad194b0f.story: Tucked beneath a slanted branch, a small pale lizard rests on a bed of bark chips. Plastic leaves in orange and green hang overhead, out of focus, like stage foliage. A clay pipe lies on its side to the left. The lizard is barely bigger than a finger. It stays perfectly still, banking on nobody noticing it at all.

c23e5ed3a7.alt: A yellow and black spotted gecko draped over the rim of a clay water dish
c23e5ed3a7.story: Draped over the rim of a clay dish, a spotted gecko rests, chin on the edge, body flowing down the back like spilled paint. The pattern is all black dots on pale yellow. Behind, a grey rock wall rises out of focus. It is the posture of someone who sat down by the water and simply forgot to get up.

0df2c389ed.alt: A lizard with a pale head and dark banded body lying between two pale rocks
0df2c389ed.story: Between two chalky rocks, a long lizard with a smooth pale head and dark bands along its back lies with its chin lifted. The scales look polished. Bark chips scatter the ground. It is twenty past three, and the animals here seem to have reached a collective agreement to do nothing, which they are honouring carefully.

61c691cd38.alt: A large pale frog sitting on green moss behind glass, a pink number 2 on the tank
61c691cd38.story: A pink number 2 is stuck to the glass, and behind it sits a large pale frog, round and solid, with one gold-ringed eye fixed forward. The green moss under it looks like carpet. Soft round stones blur in the background. The frog could be an exhibit in a museum of very calm objects, except for the faint rise and fall of its throat.

ae62dbd9af.alt: A wide, mottled green and brown frog sitting beside a grey stone on dark ground
ae62dbd9af.story: Next door, a wider frog sits low, patterned in green and rust like an old map. Its mouth is a long, straight line. A grey stone leans beside it. The background dissolves into teal haze. The two frogs, thirteen seconds apart, seem to be staring at the same point in the corridor, waiting for the same thing to appear.

b81c6e86e8.alt: A dark spotted lizard lying on gravel beside a clay dish against a teal wall
b81c6e86e8.story: Low against a scuffed teal wall, a dark lizard speckled with pale dots stretches across the gravel next to a clay dish. A pale scrape runs across the wall above it like a scratch on old film. The light is warm and grainy. This tank looks older than the others, and the lizard fits it perfectly, patient and dusty and wide awake.

737c8c8e60.alt: A busy open-air courtyard under a white canopy, people seated beside a pool strung with bunting
737c8c8e60.story: The courtyard under the white tented roof is crowded and bright. Strings of coloured bunting run along the railing beside a rocky pool, people sit in rows behind it, and a man in a white T-shirt walks through the foreground. Umbrellas stand by the café. It is the noise after the quiet, the ad break after a long programme.

bdd229edf8.alt: Three people walking across a car park toward an arch with Thai lettering and a blue fish statue
bdd229edf8.story: Outside, the sky is pale and full of wires. Three figures walk across the tarmac toward the car park, one in a pink dress, two in patterned shirts. Behind them a white arch carries Thai lettering and a large blue fish statue leaps above the hedges. The air must be heavy at five to three, and nobody is in a hurry.

159bbf9135.alt: A long reflecting pool between a white building and a dark green hedge under a pale sky
159bbf9135.story: Forty minutes later, a different kind of water. A long, shallow pool runs between a white building and a thick wall of hedge, so still that it holds the reflection of the trees. One small figure stands far off at the end of the path. Everything is clean lines and green. After the aquarium, it reads like the opposite channel.

e1fb31f9d1.alt: A shallow pool with a pebbled bottom bordered by trimmed hedges and tall trees
e1fb31f9d1.story: Ninety seconds on, the pool turns toward the trees. Pebbles show through the clear water. A low hedge has been clipped into a perfect rectangle on the left, and behind it the bigger trees rise loose and dark. The edge of a white roof cuts in from the top right. It is so quiet that even the water seems to be resting.

6bb6dcf66c.alt: A figure in a red shirt reflected in a mirror in an open lobby with stone floors and a hanging rattan seat
6bb6dcf66c.story: A tall mirror stands in the open lobby, and in it a figure in a red shirt and pale trousers stands among the grey stones. Behind, a rattan seat hangs from the ceiling like a cocoon, and two people sit in its shade. The ceiling is layered wood, rippling like sand. The reflection looks back with its hands raised to its face.

9b866bee19.alt: A curved wooden canopy over a stone wall and sloping lawn, a sign listing Lobby, Dining Room, Beach
9b866bee19.story: A wooden canopy curves over a slope of white stone and close-clipped green. Half hidden in the shadow, a small sign lists three directions: Lobby, Dining Room, Beach. The beams branch like trees. Above it, the sky is white and hazy. It is a place that tells you exactly where to go, which is restful in its own way.

156bb9f95a.alt: A hotel room shelf with a kettle, bottled water, glasses and a mini fridge beside the door lock
156bb9f95a.story: Five to four, and the room is finally theirs. Next to the door, a lit shelf holds a kettle, a row of glass bottles, upturned cups and a tray of small packets. Below, a mini fridge glows dimly through its glass door. A blue edge runs along the frame. Everything is lined up, waiting for someone to break the arrangement.

d9030e6643.alt: Two white bathrobes hanging on hangers against a dark teal wall
d9030e6643.story: Two white robes hang side by side on wooden hangers against a dark teal wall, belts tied, sleeves slightly lifted. They look like two guests standing at attention, waiting to be introduced. A light switch sits beside them, a wooden panel on the left. The scene is so neat that it is almost funny.

241ab1b93d.alt: A bathroom alcove with a hanging glass bulb, a white robe and a round basin on a wooden counter
241ab1b93d.story: Step back and the robes gain a room. A clear glass globe hangs from the ceiling with a bare bulb glowing inside. Below it, a round white basin sits on a pale wooden shelf, folded towels stacked underneath. The teal walls swallow the light. It is warm and quiet, and the single bulb hums like a channel left on low.

61e93bacca.alt: A teal bathroom with two white robes, a hanging bulb, a basin on a wooden shelf and a towel rail
61e93bacca.story: Wider still: the alcove framed by a glass door, a hand towel hanging from a rail on the left, both robes visible now, and the bulb still glowing above the basin. A thin strip of daylight cuts down the right edge. Three versions of the same corner in under a minute, each one admitting a little more of the room.

33e9ca01be.alt: A hotel bed with white pillows and a woven headboard, a red bag and a blue item on the covers
33e9ca01be.story: The bed has already been claimed. A red patterned bag lies on the white covers next to something blue and a scrap of paper, dropped there the moment the door shut. The headboard is a weave of rust and grey threads. Light comes softly from the left, through a sheer curtain. The pillows are still perfect, for now.

41e2e4685b.alt: A hotel sitting area with a striped-cushion sofa, plant pot, lamp, folding chair and wall relief of figures
41e2e4685b.story: Above the long sofa, a white relief shows a row of small carved figures standing shoulder to shoulder, like a choir that never sings. Striped cushions line up below them. On the table, a plant in a clay pot, a wooden bowl, a menu. A canvas folding chair leans toward the lamp. Everything in the room seems to be quietly lined up for inspection.

12b40f3fdb.alt: A covered balcony with a narrow plunge pool, glass railing and a white coral-like wall sculpture
12b40f3fdb.story: Through the door, a narrow pool runs the length of the balcony, glass railing on one side, a white sculpture shaped like a fan of coral on the wall. Trees and rooftops fill the gap beyond. The water is perfectly flat. After a day of looking into tanks, here is one with nothing in it at all, waiting to be stepped into.

22012aa38e.alt: Rolled white towels topped with a purple orchid on a small table, a pool blurred behind
22012aa38e.story: Two rolled white towels sit stacked in a woven tray, a single purple orchid placed on top like a full stop. Behind them, the plunge pool glows pale blue, out of focus. Someone took care with this, folded each edge under. It feels almost rude to unroll them, so for now they stay exactly as they were.

93e046eb46.alt: Built-in bunk beds with white bedding, cushions and a small soft toy, lit warmly from inside
93e046eb46.story: Set into the wall like drawers, two bunk beds glow from within. White sheets, plump cushions, and a small soft toy sitting upright on each level, as if waiting to see who will be sleeping there. A white lampshade cuts across the corner. It is a little like looking into a dollhouse, with the lights already on for evening.

40cff666b2.alt: A wide beach at low tide with rippled wet sand, people wading far out and a distant coastline
40cff666b2.story: The tide has gone a long way out. Rippled sand runs to the water, wet and shining under a cloudy sky, and small figures stand scattered across the flats like pieces left on a board. Two children crouch near the left edge, absorbed in something at their feet. Far off, the coastline fades into blue haze and a line of distant towers.

b0c807fd4a.alt: Two tall residential towers and a dark tree rising behind beach umbrellas, a person in the foreground
b0c807fd4a.story: White towers, two of them, rise out of the beachfront, one slim and square, the other stepped and rounded, with a single dark pine standing between them like a punctuation mark. White umbrellas cluster below. In the lower corner, the top of someone's head and a patterned shoulder slip into the frame, heading the other way.

a0996e4f6b.alt: A beach with scattered people below tall city towers and palm trees, under a pale cloudy sky
a0996e4f6b.story: Further along, the skyline opens up. A sharp, thin tower and a half-built block stand above the palms, and smaller buildings trail off along the curve of the bay. On the sand, people sit and stroll in loose groups. One person sits alone near the right edge, knees drawn up. The sky is pale and bright and flat, like an overexposed screen.

492a572691.alt: Wet, rippled sand reflecting the sky at low tide, people far off and towers along the shore
492a572691.story: Wet sand at the waterline holds a copy of the sky, patched with ripples. Figures stand far out in the shallows, tiny and dark. The towers march away along the shore, getting smaller and paler until the haze erases them. A child on the left edge is caught mid-step. Everything here is horizontal, except the buildings.

bc690c2d39.alt: A silhouetted figure standing in shallow water facing a hazy sun, ships on the horizon
bc690c2d39.story: The sun is a white disc behind thin cloud, and the sea beneath it turns to hammered silver. One figure stands in the shallows, dark against the shine, a smaller shape crouched beside them. Out on the horizon, a long ship sits like a bar of static. Quarter to six, and the light flattens everything into silhouettes.

e27cc1f53c.alt: A hazy sun over a calm sea, a ship and a few small figures wading near the horizon
e27cc1f53c.story: Sixty seconds on, the sun has slipped slightly lower, still blurred behind cloud. The beach has dropped out of the frame, leaving only water: low waves, a broad path of light, a couple of heads bobbing far out. Two ships sit on the horizon, one with a long crane arm. The whole scene could be a slow test card for the end of the day.

cdf02e6fc4.alt: A cloudy sky over the sea with a soft sun, a ship with a long crane on the horizon
cdf02e6fc4.story: Nobody in the frame this time, just the sea and the sun breaking through a gap in the cloud. The ship with its long crane arm sits on the horizon, with a smaller boat behind. A broad path of light runs toward the shore. The waves are small and regular, keeping time like a slow clock.

a650e8e542.alt: Low waves rolling onto a long beach lined with hotels and towers under a pale blue sky
a650e8e542.story: Turned the other way, the beach unrolls toward the town. Low waves fold over one after another, each leaving a thin white edge on the sand. Hotels and towers line the far shore, and distant hills sit low on the horizon. The sky here is still pale blue. Behind, the sun is setting; in front, the afternoon has not quite heard.

1401d7b505.alt: A small dead silver fish lying on wet sand beside a curved line of foam and footprints
1401d7b505.story: On the wet sand, a small silver fish lies still inside a curve left by the last wave. Footprints arc around it, half washed away. Foam gathers along the right edge, about to return. After a whole day of fish behind glass, here is one with no glass at all, just the tide deciding what to do with it next.

8864e12926.alt: An adult and a small kid in a blue cap walking hand in hand along the waterline, buildings behind
8864e12926.story: Two figures walk the waterline hand in hand, one tall in a red shirt, one small in a blue cap, heads both turned toward the sea. Behind them the beach curves away under hotels and a few slim towers. The sand is wet and shining. It is a very ordinary moment, which is exactly why it stays in the frame.

11e221f6a4.alt: Choppy grey sea stretching to a low line of distant hills under a soft cloudy sky
11e221f6a4.story: Nothing but sea, cloud, and a long low shape of hills on the horizon. The water is choppy, small waves crossing one another without much purpose. The light is even and grey. For a moment the beach, the towers and the people have all dropped away, and the frame holds only the steady hiss of a channel with no programme on it.

61c9b76c9d.alt: Waves rolling toward the shore under a hazy sun, light reflecting on the water
61c9b76c9d.story: Twenty to six and the sun has sunk into a thick band of haze, throwing a soft column of light down onto the sea. Waves break in layers, each one catching a strip of brightness. The foreground is dark and wet. It feels like the closing shot of a long day, held a little longer than it needs to be.

b9175b1509.alt: A low sun behind thin cloud above dark, foamy waves breaking on the shore
b9175b1509.story: Almost the same view half a minute later, but the waves have moved up the frame and the foam is thicker. The sun is a smudge of white in a cream sky. Clouds stretch across it in long, flat strokes. There is no one here at all. Just the light and the water, saying the same thing again in slightly different words.

4586bdba1d.alt: Waders and swimmers scattered in a choppy grey sea, ships on the horizon and towers to the right
4586bdba1d.story: Small groups of swimmers stand waist deep, dark heads in a row. Two ships rest on the horizon, one with a long arm reaching out. Towers poke up on the right where the coast curves. The sky is low and cream-coloured, the kind that makes everything look a few years older than it is.

ac7da9305b.alt: A man in a patterned shirt walking away along the wet beach toward hotels and towers
ac7da9305b.story: He walks away now, back turned, heading down the beach toward the distant hotels. The wet sand reflects him in a long, broken line. Little bits of debris dot the shore. The sky has gone completely flat white. Walking into it, he looks like someone leaving the edge of a picture, a few steps from being out of frame.

0d65aefbc9.alt: A hazy sun reflected in wet sand at the edge of the sea, a few dark pebbles in the foreground
0d65aefbc9.story: A quarter to six. The sun sits low in its pale haze and pours a long path of light down the sand, all the way to a few dark stones near the bottom. Thin waves have just pulled back, leaving the beach glassy. It is a picture of almost nothing, which is what the end of a beach day mostly is.

34ef7a9e52.alt: A silhouetted figure in swimwear standing at the waterline, the hazy sun reflected on wet sand
34ef7a9e52.story: A figure has stepped into the path of light, a dark silhouette at the edge of the waves, one arm out for balance. Her reflection stretches down across the wet sand. The sun is still hidden in haze above. Thirty-nine seconds after the empty beach, the scene has a character now, though she is only passing through.

a2676dfd0b.alt: A small figure walking on wet sand near tall towers, people sitting on the beach beyond
a2676dfd0b.story: Two minutes later, the view swings back to the towers. A small figure in a white top stands on the wet sand, reflected neatly beneath, while groups of people sit further up the beach. The tall, pointed tower and its half-finished neighbour rise against a clean sky. It looks like a postcard someone forgot to colour in.

fbd69f5d97.alt: A low sun over wide, shining mudflats beside the yellow railing of a long causeway
fbd69f5d97.story: Next evening, different shore. The tide here has drained away almost entirely, leaving broad mudflats that shine like wet slate under a low white sun. A yellow railing runs off along the left edge, straight as a ruler. Thin channels wander through the mud. It is twenty to six and the whole view has the stillness of a frozen frame.

6bd8d122c5.alt: A low sun in a peach sky over mudflats, figures silhouetted along a railing in the foreground
6bd8d122c5.story: Half a minute later, the colour has turned. The sky goes peach, the sun a pale disc sliding toward the water, and the mud catches long copper reflections. Along the railing, two figures stand in silhouette, faces turned to the light. Parked cars line up behind them in shadow. Everything warm is out there; everything near is going dark.

5bba164f49.alt: Parked cars on a causeway under tall street lamps and black flags, a towering cloud lit pink
5bba164f49.story: Over the cars and lamp posts, a huge cloud has stacked itself up, catching pink on its edges. Black flags hang from poles along the road, their lettering too dark to read. Street lamps curve overhead like question marks. The hood of a car fills the bottom corner. It is quarter to six and the sky has become the main event.

726eeb0239.alt: A gravel car park with a metal barrier, low buildings and signs, a craggy limestone hill behind
726eeb0239.story: Nine in the morning, and the car park is mostly empty. A metal barrier stands loose on the gravel, cars wait near the low buildings, and road signs crowd together by the gate. Behind all of it rises a craggy hill with bare limestone faces catching the light. The air looks dry and bright, the kind that will be hot by noon.

c67d6529c3.alt: A tall barn completely covered in green ivy, its wooden doors open, cars and visitors in front
c67d6529c3.story: The barn has disappeared under its own ivy. Every wall, every edge of the steep roof, is a single block of green, with only the tall wooden doors left open in the middle like a dark mouth. Visitors stand around the entrance in twos and threes. Two cars park in front, white and grey. It looks less built than grown.

161ca91bb1.alt: Yellow trumpet-shaped flowers scattered through dense green leaves on a climbing vine
161ca91bb1.story: Move in and the green turns busy. Yellow flowers hang in loose clusters among glossy leaves, some open wide, some still folded. Bright morning sun picks out every petal and leaves the gaps between the leaves dark. It is the sort of wall that hums with bees, though none are visible here. A minute after the barn, the same green, just closer.

18f49c796f.alt: A window with a red wooden frame almost hidden under thick green ivy
18f49c796f.story: Seven hours later, back at the barn, the ivy has almost swallowed a window. Only the red wooden frame and a few dark panes show through, with a pale curtain behind the glass. Leaves overlap the edges like hands closing a book. Whoever is inside would see only green, and a little afternoon light leaking in.

fc94612787.alt: A market table with baskets of red and yellow tomatoes, punnets of berries and a checked cloth
fc94612787.story: Baskets on a wooden table by a pale wall overflow with tomatoes, big ribbed red ones, cherry ones in yellow and green, a pile of small red peppers. Clear punnets of strawberries and dark berries are stacked to the right. A checked cloth hangs off the edge. Afternoon light lies across it all like a painting of a harvest that is still for sale.

82858ea49c.alt: A small open shelter with a stone wall at the end of a concrete drive, trees around it
82858ea49c.story: Among the trees, a small shelter with a flat roof and a wall of stacked stone sits at the end of a pale concrete drive. A curved metal fence lines the path. The afternoon sun is low enough now to lay long shadows across the ground. Nobody is here. It looks like a stop on a route where the bus no longer comes.

4f98aee4c2.alt: A single pink flower bud on a thin stem with green leaves against a blurred background
4f98aee4c2.story: One pink bud on a thin stem, its petals still wrapped tight, a single pale stamen poking out like a fuse. A broad leaf opens below it. Everything else dissolves into soft reds and greens. It holds very still in the frame, waiting for a breeze or a decision, neither of which seems to be coming soon.

da257e2aab.alt: Close view of a pale, spidery flower with thin curling petals against a dark red wall
da257e2aab.story: A strange, pale flower hangs out over the dark, its petals thin and curling like loose threads, or the fine wires inside an old radio. Behind it, a brick-red wall fades into shadow. Only the closest strands are sharp; the rest blur into a soft haze. It looks less like a plant than a small signal flare caught mid-burst.

3b44f9e788.alt: A paved courtyard with parked cars, steps and trees, a tall rocky hill rising behind
3b44f9e788.story: Back outside, the courtyard opens up: parked cars, a short flight of steps, trees crowding in from every side, and behind it all that same craggy hill from the morning, pale in the late light. Two people stand at the bottom right, backs turned, deciding where to go next. Purple flowers spill over the railing on the left.

9343dbd5cb.alt: The steep corner of a wooden building with ivy climbing up its weathered planks, blue sky above
9343dbd5cb.story: Look up at the corner of the building and the ivy is still climbing, thin green threads spreading across weathered planks toward the overhanging roof. The wood is grey and gold in the late sun. A sliver of clear blue sky sits above the eave. It seems possible that, given a few more years, this wall will look just like the barn.

148f67cbbd.alt: A wooden alcove filled with plants and glass cake domes on stands, a masked person at a counter
148f67cbbd.story: An alcove set into a wooden wall holds a tiny indoor forest: ferns and leaves packed tight around glass domes on wooden stands. A small spotlight shines down from above. To the left, at the counter, someone in a face mask stands beside a woven basket. The whole display looks like a diorama of a woodland, built to be peered into.

9fb2f0d7d6.alt: A black claw machine full of pale blue balls standing against a wooden wall, a cloud backdrop inside
9fb2f0d7d6.story: Against the plank wall stands a black claw machine, its glass front showing a pale blue backdrop with paper clouds. Below, a pile of round blue and white capsules waits for the claw. A coin slot gleams on the front panel. It sits there humming quietly, a small arcade cabinet in a wooden room, ready for anyone who feels lucky.

a20a55381f.alt: A white macramé hanging chair with a cushion against a wooden wall, a small plant hanger beside it
a20a55381f.story: A macramé chair hangs from a hook in a corner by the white doorway, its cushion plumped and empty. A small plant dangles from a knotted cord beside it, and a little wooden box of greenery is fixed higher on the wall. The planks are weathered silver. A dark ornament sits on the floor at the left. The chair sways very slightly, or seems to.

b931c3946d.alt: Silhouetted tree branches and leaves framing a view of power lines and a distant hill
b931c3946d.story: From the shade, the world outside is all silhouette: branches and big leaves fanning across the light, power lines strung across a pale sky, a hill dim in the distance. Near the bottom, the dark outline of a head sits just inside the frame. The contrast is so strong that it looks like a picture on a set with the brightness turned all the way down.

f5a3d879e5.alt: Two iced drinks in plastic cups with cloud prints on a wooden tray, reflected in a glass table
f5a3d879e5.story: Two iced drinks arrive on a wooden tray, one pale and layered, one deep red-brown, both printed with small white clouds. A folded receipt leans against them. The glass table doubles everything in a dark reflection below. Behind, the café blurs into warm wood and bright windows. Nobody has touched them yet; the ice is still sharp.

a516ee87bb.alt: Looking down from above at two masked café staff working behind a counter by large windows
a516ee87bb.story: From upstairs, two staff in face masks work behind the counter below. One leans over something on the bench, the other glances up. Beside them, large black-framed windows look onto bright trees and outdoor tables. A dark rail cuts across the foreground. From up here, the café runs like a small machine with two careful operators.

e3f8141760.alt: Two silhouetted people seated by tall black-framed windows looking out onto bright trees
e3f8141760.story: Inside, two figures sit in near total silhouette against tall black-framed windows. One faces away, one turned in profile toward the glass. Outside, trees and a greenhouse frame glow in the late light. A curtain hangs to the right. The room has gone dark around them, like a television showing only the brightest parts of the picture.

1b763aeba7.alt: Blurred roadside greenery and tall trees seen from a moving car, forested hills in the distance
1b763aeba7.story: Seven thirty in the morning, and the road is already climbing. Out of the window, roadside trees blur past in streaks of green, a concrete barrier sliding along the bottom edge. Far off, forested hills fade into a damp grey sky. The air must smell of wet leaves. The day has only just started broadcasting.

8c95bb2d92.alt: A quiet roundabout with large leafy trees, a sign and low buildings behind, cars parked nearby
8c95bb2d92.story: Afternoon now, three o'clock. A curve of tarmac bends around a grassy island where big trees spread their branches wide. A sign stands among them, too far to read. Low buildings with brown roofs sit in the shade, and a row of motorbikes waits on the right. The light is even and green, the place quiet between visitors.

8cabc54021.alt: A shop entrance under a sign reading Souvenir Shop in Thai and English, T-shirts and shelves inside
8cabc54021.story: A sign in Thai and English reads Souvenir Shop, and the doorway below it opens onto racks of T-shirts and shelves of small things to take home. A pedestal fan stands outside, switched off. A fire extinguisher hangs by the glass. The floor shines. It is the kind of shop that every long drive eventually leads to, whether anyone planned it or not.

0ffa85d86e.alt: Small glass specimen vials pinned to a corkboard with printed labels naming insect orders
0ffa85d86e.story: Small glass vials stand in rows on a corkboard, each one paired with a neat printed card. The nearest labels read Order Diptera and Order Lepidoptera, in tidy type. A tuft of white cotton floats out of focus at the top. Behind the glass, the air is still. It is a filing system for things that once buzzed.

4756afeafa.alt: A model of a young elephant in a museum diorama with trees, leaves and a lizard model
4756afeafa.story: A young elephant model stands in a recreated forest, trunk curled up toward the branches, as if reaching for something just out of reach. Orange and green leaves hang overhead. In the undergrowth, a lizard model lies frozen mid-stride. A label stand juts out in front. The whole scene is lit like a stage set waiting for the curtain.

50f797545b.alt: A pale model of a long-armed ape hanging from a tree branch in a museum display
50f797545b.story: Up in the painted canopy, a pale, long-armed ape hangs by one hand from a branch, the other arm swinging free, feet tucked up. Its face is dark and small. The leaves around it are glossy and fake but convincing at a glance. Frozen in mid-swing, it looks like a frame paused at the exact middle of a movement.

b3fc4e77c3.alt: A brimmed ranger-style hat displayed in a glass case below a black panel of Thai and English text
b3fc4e77c3.story: Behind glass on a black wall, a wide-brimmed hat sits mounted on a green board, a small plaque below it and a woven band at its side. Above, a long text in Thai and English describes an agreement between two parks. The hat is the only thing here with any shape. Everything else is words, small and dense, under spotlight.

afd8148215.alt: Bones, dark feathers and sticks laid out inside a dim glass display case
afd8148215.story: Under glass, a scatter of pale bones lies across sticks and dark feathers, arranged loosely as if dropped there. Reflections slide across the top of the case. The light is low and warm. It is hard to tell what it all once belonged to, and no label is in view. The display seems to prefer it that way.

f2b17ecc73.alt: An empty hall with a white tiled floor, a wave-shaped wall with seating and large windows behind
f2b17ecc73.story: The big hall is empty. A wave-shaped wall curves across the middle, painted in stripes of teal and blue, a low row of cushioned seats tucked against it and a round hole cut through near the top. Tall windows show green beyond. The tiled floor shines under fluorescent tubes. A standing fan waits, switched off, on the right.

1db5c80b4e.alt: A wide hall with a curved striped wall, bench seating, a green display shelf and bright windows
1db5c80b4e.story: Wider now: bunting-like triangles painted along the upper walls, a green shelf shaped like a tree on the left, and the wave wall rolling through the centre. Through the glass, the forest presses against the building. Still nobody here. The space looks like a children's programme set after everyone has gone home.

52c2167b1c.alt: Broad striped leaves hanging over a border of pale stones and dry soil with fallen leaves
52c2167b1c.story: Outside, under broad striped leaves, a border of pale rocks keeps the soil in place. Dry leaves and twigs scatter across the dirt. One small yellow leaf sits on its own like a dropped coin. The light is soft and grey. Nothing seems to be happening, which is usually when something is.

9075520aca.alt: A small brown lizard perched on a pale rock beneath broad green leaves
9075520aca.story: And there it is: a small brown lizard perched on top of a pale rock, head raised, tail hanging behind. Its body is the exact colour of the dry leaves around it. Broad green leaves arch overhead. It holds very still, deciding whether this is a threat, and evidently concluding that it is not worth moving yet.

cf68fe8462.alt: A small brown lizard lying head-down on a broad green leaf among dense foliage
cf68fe8462.story: Twenty-five seconds later, the lizard has moved onto a broad leaf, head down, legs spread, its tail stretching up along the central vein. The leaf bends slightly under it. Larger leaves crowd the frame. Pale and patterned, it is almost invisible against the green, except for the outline that gives it away.

9929d142c4.alt: A tropical garden with palms, ferns and a small lawn in front of a pale grey building
9929d142c4.story: The garden behind the building is dense and layered: palms, ferns, a slim pale trunk leaning in from the left, a patch of bright lawn in the middle. The wall behind is soft grey, half hidden. Everything grows in different directions at once. It is quarter past three, and the greens seem to be competing for the same patch of light.

454ba022dc.alt: A still brown stream through thick forest, a thin rope bridge crossing above it
454ba022dc.story: A brown stream lies still between walls of forest, the trees leaning in from both banks. A thin rope bridge crosses high above it, almost lost in the greenery. The water reflects nothing much, just a dull version of the sky. The view is so thick with growth that it feels like the edge of an unexplored channel.

ae5bd1d634.alt: An empty wooden deck with built-in benches and a table, dense forest beyond the railing
ae5bd1d634.story: Empty, a wooden deck sits at the edge of the forest, built-in benches running along the railing, a table in the corner. Beyond the rail, trees rise in every shade of green, some bare branches white against the sky. The planks are still damp from rain. It is the sort of place built for watching, waiting for someone to sit down.

22ea35ec12.alt: A calm brown river winding into dense forest, trees on both banks reflected in the water
22ea35ec12.story: Past the deck rail, the stream runs straight back into the forest, banks thick with vines and leaning trunks. The surface is calm, holding a faint copy of the trees. A railing just edges into the right side of the frame. It is so quiet that the water seems to have stopped moving altogether, like a still image left on the screen.

fa3aad70ca.alt: A dark spider in the centre of its web, blurred tree trunk and leaves behind it
fa3aad70ca.story: Strung across a gap between branches, an almost invisible web holds a dark spider in its centre. Its legs are long and banded, spread wide in a cross. Behind it, a tree trunk and green leaves are melted into blur. Only the spider is sharp. It waits, perfectly patient, for something to fly into the frame.

6c56b5ac56.alt: A black and white spider sitting in its web, with blurred tree bark and leaves behind
6c56b5ac56.story: Sixteen seconds later, a slightly different angle. The spider has not moved, but the web now shows its faint radiating lines, catching the grey light. One leg is lifted, as though tuning something. The blurred bark behind looks soft as fabric. It is a small, exact thing in a very large forest, and it seems completely in control.

48015a64b2.alt: Tall forest trees and a flowering tree seen over a wooden railing under a white sky
48015a64b2.story: Beyond the wooden rail, the forest climbs in layers. Tall trees, a pale flowering crown in the middle, darker growth below. The sky above is flat white. Three minutes after the spider, the view has opened out again, trading one small detail for a great mass of green that is too dense to read all at once.

d893196863.alt: Three visitors walking toward a pale building with glass doors and a Thai sign, trees around
d893196863.story: Three figures cross the paved courtyard toward a pale building with glass doors and a wooden sign in Thai lettering. One wears a pink cap and floral top, one a white T-shirt, one a black shirt and jeans, all walking at slightly different speeds. A tree trunk cuts down the left side. Inside, the lights look dim and cool.

833b211563.alt: A wooden café terrace with tree-trunk tables and stools, a drink on the table, plants and glass behind
833b211563.story: A single iced drink waits on a wooden terrace, on a table cut from a tree trunk, stools made of slices of log tucked around it. Thick wooden posts frame the scene like a doorway. A tree grows straight up through the deck. Plants crowd the glass wall behind. Whoever ordered the drink has stepped away, and the table holds its place.

6092a5c982.alt: A man walking past a round emblem sign reading World Heritage on a stump, a pickup truck behind
6092a5c982.story: A big round emblem sits on a carved stump by the road, its gold lettering reading World Heritage around the rim. A man in a dark T-shirt strides past it, head down, headed for the silver pickup parked behind. Tall trees shade the car park. He doesn't look at the sign, which has probably seen a lot of people not looking at it.

784987b193.alt: A wide shaded clearing with tall trees, wooden buildings and a dirt path, a few people in the distance
784987b193.story: Tall trees stand in a loose grove over a clearing of bare earth and grass. Wooden buildings with dark roofs sit under them on the left. Far off, a figure in red sits on a low wall and motorbikes park in the shade. A few lilac blossoms show at the top. It is twenty past three, and the light has gone warm and patient.

d9ec8c994c.alt: A curving road through trees with a motorcyclist, wooden signposts and a sign reading Khao Yai Cafe
d9ec8c994c.story: A road bends away under the trees, a lone motorcyclist leaning into the curve. Low posts strung with chain line the verge. Signboards stand at the edge, one in the shade reading Khao Yai Cafe. The forest closes in on both sides. Everything moves slowly here, even the traffic, as if the road itself had been told to keep its voice down.

f0a0829a3c.alt: A wooden park entrance sign reading Khao Yai National Park in Thai and English, framed by trees
f0a0829a3c.story: Carved and painted in gold, the big wooden sign reads in two languages: Thai script above, and below it, Khao Yai National Park, Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation, Thailand. Round emblems are fixed to the posts on either side. A model bird perches on top of one stump. Behind it, trees rise thick and dark. Officially, then, this is where the day has been.

b7ef1ad185.alt: Two people standing by a small white shelter in a shaded garden, above a low stone wall
b7ef1ad185.story: Above a low wall of rounded stones, a shaded lawn rises toward a small white shelter. Two figures stand near it, backs mostly turned, looking into the trees. A pale boulder rests on the grass. Lilac flowers hang from a branch on the right. It feels like a quiet place to stand for a minute, which is exactly what they are doing.

813fd3dee0.alt: Two people standing by a small wooden shelter at the edge of a forest, a dark post in front
813fd3dee0.story: Closer in, the two figures stand side by side near the shelter, one in a white printed T-shirt, one in black. A dark post rises in the foreground, a round boulder beside it. The forest behind them is deep and layered. They seem to be listening to something, a bird or a branch, somewhere off in the green.

226940f45d.alt: Clusters of pink frilly blossoms on a flowering tree, green leaves and sky behind
226940f45d.story: Pink blossoms crowd the frame in soft, frilly clusters, each flower crinkled like tissue paper. Green leaves fill the gaps, and a few patches of white sky show through. The nearest sprays are sharp; the rest dissolve into pink haze. After all the forest greens, the colour arrives like someone suddenly turning up the saturation.

7d358659e1.alt: A sunny park lawn with a path, tall trees and a wooden building with a tiled roof
7d358659e1.story: A path curves across the lawn toward a wooden building with a red-tiled roof, its windows dark under the eaves. Tall trees lean over everything, one trunk splitting into two right in the middle. Cars are parked far off in the shade. Patches of sunlight lie across the grass like spilled paint. It is twenty-four past three and nothing is in a hurry.

717d042e14.alt: Pink blossoms and round green buds on a branch, with soft pink and green blur behind
717d042e14.story: One cluster of pink blossoms leans into the frame on a thin stem, surrounded by round green buds that have not opened yet. The background is pure blur, pink and green and white. It is almost the same tree as before, a minute later and much closer, the kind of detail that could only be noticed by standing still.

5658b12223.alt: Deer grazing on a grassy slope under a tree, tents and parked cars in the background
5658b12223.story: Twenty minutes later, the deer have arrived. Three or four of them wander the grassy slope under a tree, heads down, tails flicking. Beyond them, beige tents stand in a row and cars park along the road. One deer looks up toward the frame, ears forward. The campsite and the herd share the lawn as if they had agreed on it long ago.

4a737ce300.alt: A deer standing on grass in front of a beige tent, another deer grazing behind it
4a737ce300.story: Closer, one deer stands side on in front of a beige tent, ears tall and turned, a dark patch at the base of its neck. Another grazes behind, almost touching the guy ropes. The grass is very green, the sky white. It looks steadily to the right, alert but unbothered, like a host waiting for the next guest to arrive.

93a02a08f1.alt: A deer standing in profile on grass near tents, its ears raised, another deer behind it
93a02a08f1.story: Two seconds later, almost the same frame, but the deer's head has lifted slightly and its ears have swung. The deer behind has moved to the right edge, nosing along the grass. A small pit of dug-up earth sits near its feet. Between the two frames, nothing and everything has changed, the way it does in a slow-motion replay.

172e16d414.alt: A deer with short antlers lying on the grass, a red wooden kiosk and parked cars behind
172e16d414.story: Across the lawn, a deer with short, velvety antlers lies folded on the grass, legs tucked, head held low and forward. Behind it, a red wooden kiosk sits under a brown roof, and cars are parked along the road. Another young deer rests further back. It is nearly quarter to four, and the sun has made everyone a little lazy.

e4b48b45cb.alt: A resting deer with small antlers lying on grass in front of a wooden kiosk and parked cars
e4b48b45cb.story: Head turned now, the deer has stretched its neck out along the ground, eyes half closed. The kiosk and the cars wait in the background. The grass in front glows bright where the sun lands. Whatever the rest of the park is doing, this one has decided to sit it out, chin almost on the lawn.

b6aa6f77d4.alt: Close view of a deer with short antlers lying on the grass, ears spread and eyes half closed
b6aa6f77d4.story: Close up, the deer fills the frame: two short antlers, ears spread wide like satellite dishes, eyes heavy, one foreleg folded in front. Fallen leaves lie scattered around it on the grass. Trees and sky blur together behind. It looks out with the drowsy calm of something that has been on air all afternoon and is finally signing off.

f022a8230f.alt: A young deer lies on a green lawn, ears raised, looking forward, with parked cars blurred behind.
f022a8230f.story: Just before four in the afternoon, the lawn belongs to the deer. It has folded its legs beneath it like a parcel, ears tilted wide as satellite dishes, catching whatever signal the car park is sending. Behind it the white cars sit still and blurred. A few dry leaves lie in the grass. Nobody moves first, and for a while nobody needs to.

fe85aa0cf7.alt: Vertical view of the same young deer resting on grass, a flowering tree and parked cars behind.
fe85aa0cf7.story: Half a minute later the deer has not moved at all. The frame has turned upright, and now there is room for the sky: pale, almost white, and a tree overhead with a crown faintly pink. Brown leaves are scattered across the green near its hooves. The animal keeps its steady look, patient, like a test card waiting for the programme to start.

cbeabf999c.alt: The resting deer turns its head to the left, showing its profile against the grass and trees.
cbeabf999c.story: Something off to the left has its attention now. The head swings round into profile, a dark eye, a soft muzzle, ears still turned up, while the body stays exactly where it was. Three seconds have passed since the last look. Whatever made the sound is outside the picture, and the deer, unhurried, decides it is not worth getting up for.

6f192d1040.alt: A brown river bends past dense green forest, with a low grassy islet and overhanging leaves on the right.
6f192d1040.story: The river runs the colour of strong tea, thick with the afternoon. Vines have climbed over the trees on the far bank until the whole wall of forest looks draped, like furniture under dust sheets. A low island of grass floats near the shore. On the right, a branch leans in uninvited. The surface holds the reflections loosely, as if it might let them go.

57f38c50d9.alt: A wider view of the brown river with a small grassy island, forest on both banks under a white sky.
57f38c50d9.story: Turn a little and the river opens out. A tuft of island sits mid-stream, green and flat, almost too neat, as though someone placed it there. Trees crowd both banks to the waterline and stand upside down again in the brown water. The sky is a blank white sheet. Somewhere downstream the current goes on, quietly, without anyone to watch it.

6eda977bcd.alt: Thin grass stems in sharp focus in the foreground, with blurred brown river water and green bank behind.
6eda977bcd.story: Close to the bank, a few stalks of grass stand up sharp, thin green lines drawn across the water. Something small and rust-coloured rests on one tip, a dry leaf or a perched insect, too slight to name. The river behind has gone soft, a wash of brown and green. Near and far trade places for a moment, and the far side loses.

31ca1c1b34.alt: Rippled brown river water in front of a bank of broad-leaved plants and tall trees.
31ca1c1b34.story: A breeze crosses the river and writes fine lines across it, row after row, like the scan lines on an old screen. On the far side, broad leaves crowd the bank in a pale green mass, and behind them the trees climb higher and darker. It is ten to four. The water keeps rewriting the same message and never finishes it.

30ce224e41.alt: Two deer walk along a grassy riverbank, a larger grey-brown one leading a smaller tan one.
30ce224e41.story: They come along the bank in single file: the larger animal first, grey-brown and heavy-shouldered, the smaller one behind it, bright tan, ears up. The grass is cropped short here, the river flat and brown at their backs. Neither looks across. They walk as if this stretch is a road they use every afternoon and know by heart.

81094f8449.alt: The two deer a moment later on the riverbank, the smaller one pausing with its head raised.
81094f8449.story: One second on. The leader has kept walking; the little one has stopped mid-step, head lifted, ears turned outward toward the open lawn. Between them the gap has widened by a stride. Light sits evenly on the grass, and the forest across the water stays dark and dense. Then, presumably, the small one remembers where it was going and hurries after.

6586332e50.alt: A wall of vine-covered trees rises over a muddy river, with a pale shape near the waterline.
6586332e50.story: Opposite, the forest stands so thick it looks solid, a green cliff hung with creepers right down to the water. At its foot, by the line where mud meets leaf, something pale catches the light: a stump, a bird, a stray piece of paper. Hard to say from here. The brown river in front is completely still, holding nothing back and giving nothing away.

4957311622.alt: A deer swims across a brown river, only its head and neck above the water, leaving a spreading wake.
4957311622.story: Only the head shows now, ears up, nose just clear of the surface, as the deer pushes out into the river. Behind it a wake fans open in long silver lines that run all the way to the bank. The far shore is green and close, but not that close. It swims steadily, without splashing, as though crossing water were simply another kind of walking.

e63023808b.alt: The swimming deer further out on the river, its wake widening behind it toward the near bank.
e63023808b.story: Four seconds later it is farther out, a small brown shape at the tip of a widening V. The ripples have reached the near bank and are folding back on themselves. Across the water, a low green strip of reeds waits. The whole river seems to tilt toward that one moving point, like a dial being slowly turned to find the station.

aa746d946b.alt: Two deer wade through shallow river water toward a green far bank, trees reflected around them.
aa746d946b.story: By five to four the crossing is nearly done. Two deer wade through the shallows near the far bank, water up to their knees, small rings opening around each step. The forest above them is thick and bright, its reflection laid out in the brown river like a second, wobblier copy. One more stretch of mud and they will be back on grass, dripping.

4001ebce55.alt: A curving campground road with parked cars, a wooden hut, a blue sign with an arrow and a street lamp.
4001ebce55.story: The road curves past a row of parked cars and a small wooden hut with a sloping roof. A blue sign points straight up, arrow and letter, toward the sky or perhaps just onward. A lamp post with its arms raised stands beside it, waiting for dark, which is still a few hours off. A flowering tree adds a single blush of pink to all the green.

bb095d563c.alt: Tents pitched on a grassy riverbank: a beige tarp shelter, a grey tent and a purple and blue dome.
bb095d563c.story: Three shelters on the bank, each its own idea of home. A beige tarp pitched like a folded paper hat, a grey tent tucked beneath it, and a purple-and-blue dome sitting apart, zipped shut. Beyond them the river lies flat and brown against the trees. Nobody is in sight. By evening the dome will glow from inside like a television left on.

9d5334b471.alt: A young deer stands on a shaded lawn beside a tree trunk, with cars and campers in the background.
9d5334b471.story: Back near the tree line, a young deer has got to its feet and stands square on the lawn, ears forward, looking straight out of the shade. Just beyond it, cars come and go along the campground road and a blue tarp covers something on a roof. The deer seems untroubled by any of it. It is simply checking who has arrived.

2ff7209101.alt: Close view of a deer's head and neck in profile, resting in shade, with parked cars blurred behind.
2ff7209101.story: Up close, the deer is all neck and patience. It rests in the shade by a wooden post, head turned to the right, ear cocked back, muzzle slightly lifted as if reading the air. Across the lawn, bright sun falls on parked cars and yellow-green leaves. The contrast is sharp: cool where it lies, glaring out there. It knows which side to choose.

30b5771e8b.alt: Two people walk away along a campground road lined with pink flowering trees, tents and parked cars.
30b5771e8b.story: Two walkers head down the road, one in black, one in a floral top, a bag swinging between them. Along the left side, tents sit under pink flowering trees. A red-and-white kerb runs beside them like a measuring tape. A car is parked ahead with a spare wheel on its back. Their shadows are short; it is barely four o'clock.

3612b4db87.alt: A campground lawn behind a black and white kerb, with tents, trees and deer resting in the distant shade.
3612b4db87.story: Across a black-and-white striped kerb, the campground spreads out on a raised lawn: a few canopies, a white van, tall trees standing apart from one another. Look closely in the shade under them and there are deer lying down, brown shapes that could almost be logs. The asphalt in front is empty. It is the hour when even the animals take a break.

6feed0dea7.alt: An open field with a patch of bare earth, power lines running to the horizon and a tall cloud above hills.
6feed0dea7.story: Open country now, at quarter past four. A patch of bare earth, grass gone pale around it, a line of power poles marching off toward low hills. Above the far trees a big cloud is building, white and cauliflower-shaped. The wires hum, or seem to. Out here everything feels like it is waiting for a transmission that has not quite arrived.

0704466ddb.alt: A straight road between grassy verges and power poles, with a dark SUV approaching and walkers on a footpath.
0704466ddb.story: Straight ahead, the road runs between the poles and the grass, a single yellow line down its middle. A dark car comes toward it, small in the distance, unhurried.
