On the right a footpath curves away with a handful of walkers on it. A round sign stands at the verge. The afternoon light is flat and grey-gold, good for driving with the windows down.

21d88bbdd4.alt: A reservoir with grassy banks, two figures standing near the water and a dark line of forest beyond.
21d88bbdd4.story: A reservoir next, still and silvery, sitting in a shallow green bowl. Two figures stand on the bank near the water's edge, small against all that space. The trees on the far side form a dark, even hedge. A branch leans in from the top left corner. The day is cooling now, and the water has gone the colour of an unlit screen.

86361d0eef.alt: A wide lake with a dark object floating near the shore, grassy bank in front and forest behind.
86361d0eef.story: Out on the lake, just off the bank, a single dark shape sits in the water. A log, most likely, though from this distance it could be the back of some patient animal. The grass in front is worn into sandy patches. Forest closes the far shore like a curtain. The surface stays smooth around the shape, and the shape stays put.

0f7f211b4c.alt: A lake shoreline curving into the distance along a grassy slope, forest on the far side under grey sky.
0f7f211b4c.story: The shoreline curves away in a long slow arc, grass sliding down to meet the water. Farther along, a tiny figure stands near the edge. The forest on the opposite bank thins into a blue line where the lake narrows and disappears. Grey clouds sit low and even. It is the kind of view that makes a person walk a little further than intended.

9f72802f0d.alt: Rippled lake water glinting in light, a dark log floating mid-frame and reeds in the foreground.
9f72802f0d.story: Nearer the shore, the water is all ripples and small glints, silver on dark green. The log floats in the middle, a stubby brown shape riding low. A few reeds poke up at the bottom edge, crisp against the shimmer. Trees stand on the far bank without moving. The lake keeps flickering, like a channel just slightly out of tune.

205fd1ac77.alt: Two people sit together on the grass beside a lake, under a row of young trees and a cloudy sky.
205fd1ac77.story: Two people sit side by side on the grass near the water, knees drawn up, facing the lake. A row of young trees leads off to the right, each one roughly the same height. Clouds stack above in soft grey layers. Nobody else is close. Whatever they are talking about, the wind carries it off across the reservoir before it reaches anyone.

0dc03c668b.alt: A roadside with a motorbike rider, a white milestone, a small tree and power lines under a cloudy sky.
0dc03c668b.story: A rider in red has paused on a motorbike at the roadside, beside a low white milestone. Power lines cut across the sky in loose curves. A thin young tree stands at the right, propped up by a stake. In the distance a long, flat-topped mountain lies blue under a pile of white cloud. The tarmac in front is empty, waiting for the next engine.

8641844099.alt: A green lakeside lawn with a wooden viewing deck, a few visitors and trees along the water.
8641844099.story: The lawn rolls down to the lake in gentle waves, and on its far side a wooden deck juts out, a few visitors standing at the rail. Trees cluster on a low hill beyond. The water is pale, almost white, mirroring the overcast sky. A corner of something concrete sits at the bottom edge. It is quarter past four and the light has gone soft.

3c9a7fafab.alt: One person holds a pale blue umbrella by a lake while another in a white T-shirt takes a phone photo.
3c9a7fafab.story: Two figures share the shore. One strolls along the water's edge under a pale blue umbrella, small against the lake. The other stands planted on a patch of sand in a white T-shirt, phone raised, aiming at the view. A dark shape floats out on the water between them. Their shadows fall short and to the right. The afternoon has a lazy, holiday hum.

f6ed4cc86d.alt: The same lakeside scene seconds later, the umbrella-holder walking on as the other keeps photographing.
f6ed4cc86d.story: Two seconds later the umbrella has moved a step to the right, and the phone has not moved at all. It is a familiar division: one person wandering, the other recording. Out on the water the dark shape drifts slightly. The forest across the lake holds its line, unbothered. Somewhere in that phone there is now a picture of this exact same view.

4ae2d13545.alt: Upright view of a person with a blue umbrella standing alone at the lake edge, a floating log nearby.
4ae2d13545.story: Turned upright, the scene narrows to one figure at the edge of the lake, blue umbrella held high like a small private sky. The grass slopes down to them in a wide green apron. Just offshore, the log rests on the surface. The trees opposite are dark and tall. It looks like the opening shot of something, before anyone has said a word.

9eab6e58a0.alt: The umbrella-holder at the lake edge seen again, framed by sky, forest and a broad slope of grass.
9eab6e58a0.story: Five seconds on, a little further back, and the figure is smaller still. The umbrella tilts. The log has not moved. Most of the frame is grass now, bright and uneven, with the lake a band of green-grey and the trees a heavier band above. The person seems to be deciding whether to walk on or stay. The lake does not mind either way.

5bc23753bc.alt: Layered forested mountain ridges fading into haze beneath a pale, cloudy sky.
5bc23753bc.story: Higher now, at half past four, the land falls away into ridge after ridge. The nearest hills are dark green and sharp; the ones behind fade to grey, then to blue, then almost to nothing. Haze sits in the valleys. It looks like a picture with the contrast slowly being turned down, one layer at a time, until only the outlines remain.

51f76e8b5c.alt: A slightly different view of hazy mountain ridges and a forested valley under a wide pale sky.
51f76e8b5c.story: Thirty seconds later, a small turn to the right. The same ridges, rearranged. A cleared patch shows pale far down in the valley, maybe a field, maybe a roof. The sky takes up more than half the frame, white and soft-edged. Up here the air feels cooler. Whatever sound comes from below arrives late and thinned out, like a distant broadcast.

14e2dc7b71.alt: A road climbs steeply into forest, with red and white posts along a cracked verge and power poles.
14e2dc7b71.story: Up it goes: the road in one long straight pull, a ribbon of grey tipping into the forest. Along the cracked verge stand short posts, red and white, each throwing a long shadow in the late sun. Power poles follow the hill. Trees close in on both sides at the top. From here it looks less like a road than a ramp toward the sky.

ce596edbb4.alt: The same steep road with a car descending toward the posts and a person standing at the right edge.
ce596edbb4.story: Now there is a car on it, coming down from the crest, small and steady, and the climb is suddenly given scale. Someone stands at the right edge among the trees, watching it too. The red post in front keeps its place, its shadow stretched over the concrete. It takes a second to realise how steep the hill really is.

decaf7d807.alt: A valley of forested hills fading into haze, framed by a dark tree on the left under a white sky.
decaf7d807.story: A tree leans in from the left, branches spread like a hand held up against the light. Below it the valley drops away into rows of green hills, each paler than the last, until they blur into the sky. There is no road in sight, no roof, no wire. Just the slow gradient from dark to light, from near to far.

26e64e0b56.alt: A small roadside coffee kiosk under tall trees, with parked cars, visitors and an orange traffic cone.
26e64e0b56.story: A small coffee stand sits at the edge of the forest, its sign lettered in white, a few cars parked nose-in beside it. Visitors drift between the counter and the road. An orange cone stands alone on the tarmac, guarding nothing in particular. Tall trees lean over everything. It is twenty to five, and the queue for something cold is short.

6cdd3529ff.alt: A person stands at a wooden railing at a viewpoint, looking over layered mountains under a branch.
6cdd3529ff.story: At the viewpoint someone leans against the wooden rail, back turned, looking out over the hills. Beside them an information board lies tilted, faded by sun. Above, a dark branch hangs into the frame like the edge of a stage curtain. The mountains beyond go blue and grey. Nobody says anything. The view does most of the talking.

0448557ccb.alt: A wide view of dim, hazy mountain ridges and a forested valley in late afternoon.
0448557ccb.story: Twenty to five, and the colour is draining fast. The ridges are still there, layered and soft, but the green has turned dull and the sky has gone the shade of old paper. Down in the valley a faint pale patch hints at a settlement. Soon the hills will be just outlines, and then just dark, and then the signal ends.

b177cfda21.alt: A small snail with an orange spiral shell crosses wet gravel, the background soft and blurred.
b177cfda21.story: On the wet gravel path a snail is making its way across, shell an orange spiral, horns out. The ground around it glistens grey-green with recent water. Everything else is out of focus, a soft wash of stone. It is seven minutes to four. The snail is in no hurry; it has the whole afternoon and, by its standards, an enormous distance still to go.

6661dc68b0.alt: A person in a yellow top holds a phone near a misty koi pond, ferns and umbrellas in the background.
6661dc68b0.story: Closer now, and the yellow top is lit by a gap in the canopy. A hand holds a phone; the head tilts toward the pond, where mist rolls low across the water and orange shapes move beneath it. Behind, another visitor sits under a white umbrella. Giant leaves frame the scene on the right, split and glossy, dripping.

f537c1c573.alt: Someone crouches on a wooden deck dipping a net into a misty pond where orange koi swim.
f537c1c573.story: Someone crouches at the edge of the wooden deck with a long-handled net, dipping it gently toward the water. Orange koi slide just under the surface, half hidden by drifting mist. Empty chairs wait under the trees behind. The deck shines wet. Whatever the net is after, a leaf or a bit of debris, the fish seem entirely unconcerned.

d831794909.alt: A dim café interior with pendant lights and wicker sofas, a garden and a walking figure seen through glass.
d831794909.story: The other end of the café is darker, almost a cave. Small pendant lights glow in a row near the ceiling. Wicker sofas sit empty. Through the glass, the garden is bright and green, and someone in a grey T-shirt walks along the path outside, caught between two pillars. Inside and outside feel like two channels playing at once.

33941c3d78.alt: On a café table: an iced orange-layered drink in a domed cup, a slice of white cake and a small cup.
33941c3d78.story: The order arrives. A tall iced drink in a domed plastic cup, clear on top and orange at the bottom, beads of cold on its sides. Beside it a slice of white cake topped with a small flower, a fork resting on the plate, and a paper cup of something warm. In the soft background, two people lift their own cups.

12ce468705.alt: A café corner with dark walls and a glass door with a holiday greeting, people seated at tables.
12ce468705.story: A different crowd sits across the room: a cluster of diners leaning together around low tables, one in a patterned shirt with his back turned. The walls here are dark stone. On the glass door a festive greeting is painted in white, slightly out of season. Two cushioned sofas sit empty in front. The noise of the room is easy to imagine.

0417b7c62e.alt: A waterfall spills in two white cascades over dark mossy rocks into a pool, ferns all around.
0417b7c62e.story: Outside, the waterfall is running full at half past four. Two white streams break over a wall of dark, mossy rock, step down a ledge each, and crash into the pool below. Ferns crowd every gap. The sound must be constant, a soft roar like a radio tuned between stations, covering every other noise in the garden.

91bd200397.alt: The foot of a waterfall pouring around a mossy boulder, an orange koi faintly visible in dark water.
91bd200397.story: Down at the foot of the falls, the water hits the pool and goes white, then dark again. A mossy boulder sits in the middle of it all, refusing to move. In the shallows to the left, a faint orange shape hangs under the ripples: a koi, holding still against the current. Green shoots lean in from the bottom edge.

94523d9cd6.alt: Two tiers of waterfall falling over dark rock into a frothy pool, with ferns at the edges.
94523d9cd6.story: Twelve seconds later, the frame steps back. Now both tiers are visible: water sliding off the top ledge, catching on a lower one, then dropping into froth. The streams look almost frozen into threads, white against black rock. A single small plant stands up out of the spray at the bottom, perfectly upright, as if posing for its moment.

dd55c973f3.alt: Seen through blurred green leaves, a glimpse of a koi pond with an orange and white fish.
dd55c973f3.story: Through a screen of leaves, close and out of focus, the pond appears in pieces. A koi, white with an orange patch, slides past a gap in the green. Further back, ferns and a wooden chair. The leaves in front blur into large soft shapes. It is like watching through a keyhole, catching only the bits of the show that happen to pass the opening.

89270e709c.alt: Orange and white koi swim in a dark pond beneath a bank of ferns, small leaves floating on the surface.
89270e709c.story: The pond is so dark it looks like a sheet of black glass, and the koi stand out on it like paper cut-outs: orange and white, orange and white, one pale gold. Small leaves float on the surface. Ferns hang down from the bank, feathery and bright. The fish drift in different directions, each following some private schedule.

6c146e5b8e.alt: A group of koi, mostly orange and white with one pale gold fish, gather in dark water beneath ferns.
6c146e5b8e.story: Koi have gathered now, five or six of them nose to tail in a loose cluster near the centre. A pale gold one swims apart, closer to the near edge, where water plants stick up through the surface. The ferns above make a bright green ceiling. Someone, somewhere, may have dropped food. The fish certainly seem to think so.

acb4e2ff8b.alt: Upright view of a koi pond fed by a small cascade, ferns overhead, several koi near the surface.
acb4e2ff8b.story: Behind the koi, a small cascade spills softly from beneath the ferns, the pond's quiet source. Down in the dark water the fish scatter in a loose line, orange-white, orange-white, a lantern procession. Big leaves frame the top of the scene. The mist from earlier has thinned, and the garden looks freshly rinsed and very green.

c5ee780fc2.alt: Misty mountains with low cloud lying in the valleys, above a canopy of green treetops.
c5ee780fc2.story: Further up, the weather has the upper hand. Low cloud lies along the valley like cotton wool laid out to dry, and the mountains behind it are only shadows. The treetops in front are green and wet. The sky is the same grey as the cloud, so the horizon simply dissolves. It is twenty-five to five and the light is going grey.

7704a375cb.alt: An empty outdoor terrace with wicker chairs and dark tables beside a modern glass-fronted building.
7704a375cb.story: The terrace is empty, damp from earlier rain. Wicker chairs are pushed in around low dark tables, a few left slightly askew as if people just got up. The building beside it is all dark frame and tall glass under a long flat roof. Trees lean over the railing. A puddle sits in a dip in the concrete, holding a piece of sky.

0d40e4884b.alt: Upright view of a terrace lamp post with lantern tops, wicker chairs along the railing and trees beyond.
0d40e4884b.story: A lamp post stands sentry at the terrace corner, two old-fashioned lanterns on top, unlit in the grey afternoon. Along the railing the wicker chairs wait in a row, each tucked against its table. The glass building rises behind. Leaves press against the fence from the garden below. It is the hour between rain and dusk, when nobody sits outside.

491add467b.alt: A person in a yellow top stands at the top of a wet wooden staircase, hand on the wall, under leafy branches.
491add467b.story: Wet and shining from the rain, a wooden staircase drops away below someone in yellow, who pauses at the top with one hand on the white wall. Leafy branches crowd in from above. The steps are dark and slick, each one holding a thin sheet of water. A rail runs down the other side. It is the careful kind of descent, one step at a time.

ed55189aa1.alt: A tree-lined car park with a silver sedan, a black car and a white SUV on damp tarmac.
ed55189aa1.story: Last stop: the car park. A silver sedan sits neatly between the lines, a black car beyond it, a white SUV further off. The tarmac is patched and damp. Tall thin trees stand along the edge, their leaves still dripping. The day out is folding itself up. Soon these spaces will be empty and the garden will have the mist to itself.

e81634303a.alt: Calm grey-green sea stretching to the horizon, small white boats in the distance under light clouds.
e81634303a.story: Quarter past nine and the sea is calm, a soft grey-green that runs flat all the way to a line of small white boats on the horizon. A few clouds drift above, loose and unhurried. The water near the bottom shows a gentle swell, rising and falling. It is the moment just before departure, when the whole day is still out there.

acaef6f463.alt: Inside a boat cabin, a driver in a bright green printed shirt sits at the wheel, facing forward.
acaef6f463.story: The driver sits at the wheel in a bright green shirt printed with lettering and swirls of colour. A blue seat, a chrome rail, a water bottle on the dash. The cabin ceiling above is speckled with rust spots and a vent. Through the windscreen the sea is pale and bright. Everyone else sits behind, waiting to see where the morning goes.

18a6cc4202.alt: View past a boat's cabin frame to a long pier and a green hill, a jet ski on the water nearby.
18a6cc4202.story: Beyond the cabin's white frame, the shore is falling behind: a long pier on stilts, a hill rounded and green above it. A jet ski idles in the water halfway between. The boat's side curves in the foreground, a small vent cover and a coiled rope tucked into it. Light comes through the cabin window in a pink rectangle.

c7e72e0186.alt: The pier and hill seen past the boat's side and handrail, with slightly more open sea in view.
c7e72e0186.story: Nine seconds later the pier is a little smaller and a little further left. The handrail climbs diagonally across the frame. The hill behind has softened into blue-grey. Water slaps against the hull, small waves that the white boat shrugs off easily. Departures always seem to happen slowly at first, then all at once.

b05f9e3f6a.alt: A small painted fishing boat alone on open grey-green sea, with distant boats on the horizon.
b05f9e3f6a.story: A lone fishing boat sits in the middle of the sea, painted blue and red, small and bright against all that grey-green water. Further off, other boats are tiny marks on the horizon. Clouds pile up in the upper sky. There is no visible movement. The boat simply sits there like a pin holding the whole map in place.

773f9ee367.alt: The painted fishing boat closer, with a white boat further off on the calm sea.
773f9ee367.story: Detail arrives five seconds later: a tall mast, a cabin, a band of red along the fishing boat's hull. Behind it, a white boat waits further out. The sea between is quiet, wrinkled only slightly. The morning light is pale and flat, the kind that makes colours look as if they were printed a long time ago.

fd361ddcf5.alt: The boat's white hull cuts through water with foam, two fishing boats ahead on the sea.
fd361ddcf5.story: Speed picks up. The white hull leans into the water and throws a curl of foam off to the side. Ahead, two fishing boats sit on the sea, one small and blue, one larger and white with red trim. A dark seat back shows at the edge of the cabin. The wind must be loud now. Conversation shrinks to shouted single words.

9797810400.alt: A shoreline of low buildings with red and gold temple roofs, seen across choppy green water.
9797810400.story: Along the shore a row of buildings comes into view: low roofs, a jetty, and among them two pointed roofs in red and gold, catching the light. Above, clouds bank thick and creamy. The water in front is choppy and green, with a fleck of white spray. From out here the town looks like a strip of film, all its frames lined up.

f7ad56d6d7.alt: A wide sea with a fishing boat in the middle distance and a tall tower block on the shore to the right.
f7ad56d6d7.story: Sideways, the view widens. A fishing boat sits midway out, its cabin and mast dark against the water. To the right, on the far shore, a single tall tower rises well above everything else, pale and slender. The sea is grey-green and lightly ruffled. Everything feels slightly washed out, as if seen through a screen that has been on for hours.

66ff630ee1.alt: Foamy wake curling across green water, a shoreline with temple roofs and buildings behind.
66ff630ee1.story: Looking back now. The wake curls up in a white ridge, peeling off the side of the boat. Beyond it the shoreline stretches flat: buildings, trees, the red-gold roofs from earlier, all shrinking. Clouds take up most of the sky. The sound would be all engine and water, a steady roar that fills the ears completely.

74c4bb5319.alt: An outboard motor marked 140 at the stern, a wide white wake trailing back to the distant shore.
74c4bb5319.story: The outboard motor sits black and solid at the stern, '140' painted on its side in white and red. Behind it the wake opens into a wide white fan that runs all the way back toward the shore. A chrome rail crosses in front. The land is just a thin dark line now, and the sea between is pure movement.

9b6e4b136d.alt: The same outboard motor and wake, with a hand gripping the stern rail on the right.
9b6e4b136d.story: Six seconds later and a hand appears on the right, gripping the rail. Someone is holding on. The motor keeps churning, the wake keeps unspooling behind it in white braids. The shore has fallen back further still. It is eighteen minutes past nine and the boat is properly at speed now, the kind of speed that rearranges your hair.

fe57045057.alt: A broad white wake spreads across green sea toward a hazy shore with a single tall tower.
fe57045057.story: The wake spreads out like a wide road behind the boat, white churn fading into green. Far back on the hazy shore, the tall tower stands alone above the treeline, a single vertical mark in all that horizontal. The sky is cream and grey, low clouds hanging. Everything behind is getting smaller at the same rate, as if being slowly zoomed out.

4103474dc7.alt: A straight wake running back to a faint shoreline, the tall tower small and centred on the horizon.
4103474dc7.story: A minute later and the wake runs straight back to the tower, which has shrunk to a small pale stub in the haze. Low hills appear faintly behind the coast. The water churns white in the middle, smooth at the edges. It looks like a long white line drawn from the boat to the land, connecting them for a little while longer.

180c0d683d.alt: Spray and foam from the boat's wake, with green hills along a distant shoreline under blue sky.
180c0d683d.story: Spray kicks up in fine droplets, sun catching each one. Beyond the foam, a green hill rises from the shoreline, a soft dome against a patch of blue sky. The sea has turned from grey to a cleaner turquoise. The morning is opening up. Just at the bottom edge, a slice of the boat's wooden rail holds the frame steady.

fb510dd699.alt: A white wake churning behind the boat's motor, a distant boat and faint skyline on the horizon.
fb510dd699.story: The motor's black cowl sits low at the bottom of the frame, churning the water into a long white plume. Far out behind, a single small boat follows, or just happens to be heading the same way. The skyline on the horizon is faint now, a few pale towers in the haze. The sea between is restless and dark green.

7f3615b78b.alt: A green hill over a turquoise sea, a jet ski crossing in the distance, the boat's rail in the corner.
7f3615b78b.story: Nearly half past nine. A broad green hill rises over the water, its slopes catching the morning light. In front of it, a jet ski skims across the sea, small and quick, red against turquoise. The boat's rail and corner cut into the bottom of the frame. Clouds gather above in loose heaps. The day is getting louder.

e692da0bad.alt: Three jet skis cross foamy water toward a green mountain under a hazy, cloudy sky.
e692da0bad.story: Three jet skis cut across the water in a loose line, heading toward a pointed green mountain on the coast. The foreground is all foam, the boat's own wake breaking up into white lace. The sky is hazy and warm-toned, clouds stacking up like piled laundry. Everyone out here is moving; nothing stays in one place for long.

85fbd6e88f.alt: A jet ski towing a colourful inflatable banana pulls up to a rocky shore below green trees.
85fbd6e88f.story: A jet ski has pulled up to a rocky shore at the island's edge, towing a long inflatable in yellow, red and blue. A few people sit on it, or are climbing off. Behind them the trees grow thick and scruffy right up to the rocks. The water in front is green and clear. It looks like the end of a ride, everyone a little out of breath.

e575929e7f.alt: Several swimmers' heads bob in green water near a rocky shore with dense trees above.
e575929e7f.story: A handful of heads bob in the green water, swimmers taking a break between rides, floating in a loose cluster near the rocky shore. Above them, the island is all trees and dry grass. The water is calm here, gently rippled, a bright jade colour. It is half past nine and the sea is the right temperature, judging by how still they stay.

17422b9a2a.alt: Swimmers float in greenish water near a shore of rocks and orange earth below thick trees.
17422b9a2a.story: A little further along, the shore turns orange where the earth has crumbled away beneath the trees, exposing a band of rust-coloured soil above the rocks. More swimmers float below, small dark dots on the green. The edge of the boat shows white at the bottom corner. It is a quiet beach, reachable only like this, from the water.

c6e026f35a.alt: Green hills and a low headland across turquoise sea, with white clouds above.
c6e026f35a.story: Leaving again. The sea has gone fully turquoise, and the hills on the horizon stack up in soft green waves, one behind the other. A small structure, maybe a jetty, shows at their base. Clouds pile up white and thick above. A ripple of foam at the bottom edge says the boat is moving, though the view itself feels perfectly still.

c8fb8a54be.alt: Looking past a boat's cabin, blue seat and chrome rail to turquoise sea and blue sky.
c8fb8a54be.story: Blue seat, chrome rails, the white cabin frame with its tinted window. Outside, past all of it, the sea is a vivid turquoise and the sky has turned properly blue, with scattered clouds. The colours outside seem almost too strong for the dim interior, like a television turned up to maximum saturation and left that way.

3391cd01b8.alt: From the boat's stern corner, foamy turquoise water and a long green headland on the horizon.
3391cd01b8.story: From the stern corner the sea churns past in white and turquoise, foam swirling in circles. A long green headland lies on the horizon, low and wooded. The boat's white step and wooden rail cut across the bottom. A chrome bar runs up the right edge. Somewhere ahead is the next stop, and the water is getting clearer with every minute.

09dbafe461.alt: A large white motor yacht anchored on calm green sea beneath a pale sky with scattered clouds.
09dbafe461.story: Ten to ten, and a big white yacht sits at anchor, sleek and low, alone on the calm green water. A small flag shows at its stern. Clouds drift above in thin patches. The water here is still enough to look solid. Nobody is visible on deck. It looks less like a boat than a prop set down on the sea and left there.

92187ec039.alt: A wooded hillside above a strip of white sand and clear turquoise shallows.
92187ec039.story: The island shows its quiet side: a strip of pale sand at the foot of a wooded hill, the trees climbing steeply behind. In front, the shallows are a clear turquoise that gives way to darker patches further out. No people, no boats. The sky is soft and hazy. The water looks warm. Somewhere on that beach there might be footprints, or none at all.

0b6a8d7c65.alt: Looking down into clear green sea water, light rippling over darker shapes on the bottom.
0b6a8d7c65.story: Straight down, the water is so clear it hardly seems there. Light ripples across the surface in fine wavy lines, and below, darker shapes spread over the bottom: rock or coral, it is hard to say. The colour shifts from pale green to a deeper jade. It is like peering into an aquarium that someone forgot to put fish in.

c20b822efb.alt: Clear green water from above, sunlight rippling over a large dark patch on the seabed.
c20b822efb.story: A few seconds later, a darker patch slides into view beneath the surface, a large shadowy mass on the seabed. The ripples overhead keep moving, light breaking into a net of bright lines across it. Everything is a shade of green: lime, jade, bottle. The boat drifts slowly. Underneath, the floor of the sea passes like a slow scrolling screen.

dbb8bc4ba8.alt: A green headland sloping into turquoise sea under a blue sky with puffy white clouds.
dbb8bc4ba8.story: Lifting the eyes again: a green headland slopes down into the sea, a thin line of white sand at its foot. The sky has opened up into proper blue, with a few fat clouds sitting high. The water at the bottom is turquoise and calm. It looks like a postcard, the kind that gets bought, never written, and found years later in a drawer.

a95d836fa8.alt: A low, flat green island on the horizon with a small boat, calm green-grey sea and hazy sky.
a95d836fa8.story: Ahead, a low island lies flat on the horizon, like a strip of green felt laid on the water. A small boat sits beside it. The sky is hazy and pale, heavy with soft cloud. The sea in front shifts from grey to green as it gets closer. It is ten to ten. Everything in this direction seems to be waiting for the sun to break through.

9ac1e60b97.alt: A wooded headland with a boat moored at its tip, turquoise sea and a bright blue sky with clouds.
9ac1e60b97.story: The sky has cleared to blue at ten o'clock exactly. A wooded headland juts in from the left, and at its tip a white boat sits at anchor. Big clouds drift above like slow balloons. The water closer in is a bright turquoise, almost unreal. It is the kind of colour that looks retouched, though nothing here has been touched.

1a7b50f32e.alt: A white yacht anchored far off on pale green sea beneath a soft, cloud-filled sky.
1a7b50f32e.story: The white yacht again, further off now, sitting low on the water, its upper deck a neat stack of white. The sea in front is pale green, streaked with darker patches where something sits underneath. Clouds take up most of the sky, soft and broken. It seems to have stayed exactly where it was. Some boats exist only to be looked at.

090959e3bf.alt: A catamaran sailboat anchored on clear water, with small floats and a dinghy beside it.
090959e3bf.story: A catamaran sits at anchor, its tall mast a single thin line against the clouds. Beside it, small floats and an orange buoy bob in the water, and a little dinghy waits tied up. Someone may be swimming nearby. The water around it shifts from turquoise to darker patches. Sails are furled. There is nowhere it needs to be today.

3baeb35b13.alt: A white sand beach below a forested hill, with one tiny figure standing at the water's edge.
3baeb35b13.story: One person stands on the beach, a tiny dark mark at the water's edge, dwarfed by the forested hill rising behind. The sand is a pale, clean strip. The sea in front is clear green, shallow for a long way out. Clouds drift above. It looks like the opening frame of a castaway film, though there is probably a boat waiting just out of view.

932604d0b5.alt: A white motor yacht and a catamaran sailboat anchored side by side on calm sea.
932604d0b5.story: The two boats side by side now: the motor yacht on the left, squat and white, the catamaran on the right with its tall mast. Small craft cluster around the catamaran's stern. The sea between is calm and grey-green, the sky soft with cloud. It is two minutes past ten. They look like neighbours who have parked next to each other without saying hello.

e7a0d39bcd.alt: The outboard motor marked 140 churning a white wake toward a green island with a white boat.
e7a0d39bcd.story: Pulling away again, the motor churns and the wake opens in two white wings behind it. Through the gap, a green island and a white boat moored at its edge, the same ones that were so close a minute ago. '140' on the cowl, a chrome rail across it. Leaving anywhere by boat always has this look: two white lines stretching back.

9d4376b593.alt: A low, dark green island on the horizon over grey-green sea beneath heavy cloud.
9d4376b593.story: Dark and flat on the horizon, the low island returns, a long smudge of green. The sea in front has gone grey-green, darker than before, and the clouds are thicker overhead. The light has flattened. It is four minutes past ten, and the colours seem to have been turned down a notch, as if someone reached for the dial.

d4b614ca0c.alt: A dark island low on the horizon under a heavy, overcast sky above a grey sea.
d4b614ca0c.story: Twenty-eight seconds later, the island has slipped to the left and the sky has grown heavier, a grey ceiling with brighter patches pushing through. A small red dot floats on the water far off, maybe a buoy, maybe a kayak. The sea below is dark and choppy. For a moment the morning feels like evening, then the clouds shift again.

a08672d396.alt: Several speedboats gathered near a green island, with people in the water around them.
a08672d396.story: Near the island, a small fleet has gathered: speedboats and a canopied boat, parked close together, people in the water around them. Someone stands on a bow. The hill behind is green and rounded. This is clearly the spot, the place every boat seems to be heading. The sea here is busy with splashing and the sound of engines idling.

80b694847d.alt: Two green headlands across a turquoise sea, a small red boat between them under a blue sky.
80b694847d.story: Green headlands face each other across the bay, the hill on the left darker, the one on the right lit softly. Between them a small red boat sits on the water. The sky is a light blue with scattered white clouds. The sea is calm and turquoise. It is a wide, simple view, everything in it easy to name and nothing in a hurry.

894bde555c.alt: A low flat island under a pale, cloudy sky, with a small orange float on the grey-green sea.
894bde555c.story: As if the boat is circling, the flat island is back. It lies long and low under a pale, hazy sky, and close to its right a small orange float bobs on the water. The sea in front is grey-green, ruffled. Clouds fill the top two-thirds of the frame in soft heaps. The scene repeats, slightly changed, like a rerun with a new ending.

d7eed7e95d.alt: Green hills over a blue-green sea, small boats moored along the shore under a blue sky with clouds.
d7eed7e95d.story: Blue sky again, with big white clouds drifting over a line of green hills. Boats are moored along the shore below, tiny white and red shapes. The sea in front is a deep blue-green, rougher here, with small whitecaps. It is seven minutes past ten. From this distance the boats look like toys someone has left on a shelf.

0fc1e47ef1.alt: Striped yellow fish swimming just below the surface of clear green water.
0fc1e47ef1.story: Then the water fills with fish. Just below the surface, striped yellow shapes dart in all directions, their bodies flickering in and out of view through the ripples. The water is green and clear, the light rippling in tangles. At ten past ten, the boat has stopped, and below it a crowd has gathered, apparently expecting something.

0c35161893.alt: A crowd of yellow and black striped fish clustered in clear green water near the surface.
0c35161893.story: Dozens more arrive in the next twelve seconds, packed close and pointing every way, yellow and black stripes catching the light. Some swim up to the surface; others hang deeper, blurred. The water is a bright, clear green. It looks like a channel of pure static, every dot alive and moving, the picture never quite settling.

b41a96bf95.alt: Scattered striped fish swim through rippling green water, fewer and more spread out.
b41a96bf95.story: Fifteen seconds on, the crowd has thinned. A few striped fish drift through the frame, spread out, as if the rest have gone to find the next boat. The ripples on the surface turn the light into a moving net of pale lines. Near the bottom, one fish turns sideways, flashing its stripes, then is gone again.

1777666d4e.alt: A dense shoal of yellow and black striped fish crowding together in clear green sea water.
1777666d4e.story: And then they are back, all of them at once, a dense shoal pressing together just below the surface, yellow stripes overlapping until it is hard to tell one fish from the next. The water churns gently above them. Something has been thrown in, perhaps. Or perhaps they simply like company. The sea here never stays empty for long.

0cd051c242.alt: Thatched-roof huts on stilts beside a pond, linked by a wooden ramp, with green lawn and hills behind.
0cd051c242.story: Half past three, and the light is already turning gold over the farm. Three thatched huts stand on stilts beside a still pond, a long wooden ramp zig-zagging up to them. The lawn in front is clipped short and very green. Pink flowers peek in at the bottom left corner. Behind, the hills go blue under a soft, hazy sky.

94d300fd8e.alt: Grassy mounds lead down to a pond, with a wooden ramp climbing to thatched huts on the right.
94d300fd8e.story: Turning slightly, the lawn rises and falls in soft mounds like a rumpled green blanket, sloping down toward the pond. The wooden ramp climbs to the thatched huts on the right, railings catching the afternoon sun. The pond reflects a sliver of sky. Low hills and a line of trees close off the distance. Everything looks freshly tidied.

37caef6714.alt: A grassy hilltop with a dark, turreted structure and scattered visitors, mountains under a mottled sky.
37caef6714.story: Over the brow of the hill, a dark turreted structure rises, like a castle that has wandered in from a different story. Visitors move along the ridge in small groups, silhouetted against the light. In the foreground a dirt track curves across the grass. The sky above is rippled with thin cloud. The hills behind are blue. Something here does not quite add up, pleasantly.

7cb03b9e84.alt: A white, fluffy alpaca stands on a wooden deck beside a black feeding tub and a mesh fence.
7cb03b9e84.story: A white alpaca stands on the wooden deck with its neck stretched toward a black tub, fleece puffed out like a cloud that has learned to walk. A mesh fence runs behind it, tied with small blue ribbons. Beyond the fence, a green field and a thatched roof. The alpaca seems entirely unbothered by anyone looking. It has other priorities.

e806eef915.alt: Upright view of four alpacas on a wooden deck under a thatched shelter, two visitors behind them.
e806eef915.story: Thatch above, alpacas in the middle, planks below: upright, the scene stacks neatly. Four of them now, one lying, three standing, one with its nose in a tub. Two visitors stand by the rail at the back, quietly watching. The light comes in from the side, warm and low. The alpacas seem to be holding a meeting no one else is invited to.

9ec92cb422.alt: Close-up of a cream alpaca's face with half-closed eyes, other alpacas and visitors blurred behind.
9ec92cb422.story: One alpaca turns its face right into view: cream fleece, long ears, eyes half-closed in an expression somewhere between bliss and contempt. Behind it the deck is a blur of other alpacas and visitors' legs. The light is warm and soft. It holds the look for just long enough, then turns away, entirely unimpressed by the attention.

765eabf228.alt: An alpaca with cream fleece licks a white block hanging on a chain-link fence.
765eabf228.story: Against the chain-link fence, an alpaca has found the white block hanging there and is licking it with total devotion. Its eyes are half-shut, its long ears tilted back. Blue ribbons are tied along the wire. Grass glows green beyond the fence. Nothing else in the world matters right now, only this block, this taste, this afternoon.

25e71f9dfd.alt: Close upright view of an alpaca with eyes closed, licking the white block on the fence.
25e71f9dfd.story: The eyes have closed completely five seconds on. The alpaca leans in harder, mouth working against the white block, fleece fluffed up around its neck. A visitor's arm and jeans show at the edge. The blue ties on the fence flutter. It is clearly a long-standing arrangement between animal and block, and no one is about to interrupt it.

523906aa26.alt: An alpaca stands on a damp wooden deck while another lies behind it, two people near the fence.
523906aa26.story: Sideways on the deck, one alpaca stands, head turned to look across, a dark harness strap around its chest. Another lies just behind it, curled and still. Two people stand near the fence in the background, one in a white shirt with a bag. The planks shine damp in patches. The light is low and gold. Soon it will be feeding time, or perhaps it already was.

8744158737.alt: A wide lawn with a wooden boardwalk, a few visitors and an alpaca, thatched huts on the horizon.
8744158737.story: The whole field opens up: a wide green lawn, a long wooden boardwalk crossing it, a few visitors and an alpaca walking along it in the distance. Thatched huts sit on the horizon, and the sky above is streaked with fine cloud. A tree on the right leans into the frame. The lawn seems to curve, as if the whole farm sits on a small planet.

a21a1dc564.alt: A woolly sheep walks along a wooden boardwalk toward the viewer, visitors and other sheep behind.
a21a1dc564.story: A sheep comes down the boardwalk as if it owns it, which in a sense it does. Thick wool, pink inner ears, a slightly unimpressed look. Behind it visitors are scattered across the lawn, other sheep grazing among them. The boardwalk planks catch the warm light. The castle shapes sit far back on the ridge. It is twenty to four.

7ea55d54a1.alt: Upright view of the same sheep on the boardwalk, closer, with visitors at the far end.
7ea55d54a1.story: The sheep has kept coming, four seconds later, straight down the middle of the planks, hooves neat and deliberate. The boardwalk stretches back behind it to where three visitors stand at the top of the rise, silhouetted against a pale sky. On either side the grass is half sun, half shadow. Right of way, it seems, belongs to whoever has wool.

97d6101f9b.alt: A sloping green field with distant sheep grazing near a lone person and a thatched hut beyond.
97d6101f9b.story: Far off on the field, a small flock grazes near a line of bushes, white spots on green. A lone figure stands a little apart, watching them. A thatched roof peeks out at the right edge. A sprinkler sits in the foreground grass, waiting to switch on. The hills behind are pale and long. The whole scene is quiet, just grass and wool and sky.

f37be33ce8.alt: A person in a yellow shirt walks behind two grazing sheep on a sunlit green slope, thatched huts beyond.
f37be33ce8.story: Wool lit gold at the edges, two sheep graze on the slope, heads down. A person in a yellow shirt walks behind them, perhaps keeping an eye on them, perhaps just passing. Above, the thatched huts sit along the ridge. A blue sprinkler head pokes up out of the grass in front, like a small antenna tuned to the afternoon.

cd0db10051.alt: A sheep trots across a sunlit lawn past a sprinkler, with a pond and trees behind.
cd0db10051.story: A single sheep trots across the lawn, legs mid-stride, wool bouncing. Its shadow runs beside it on the grass. A blue sprinkler stands in front, unmoved. Behind, the pond lies still, and a line of trees and scrub marks the far bank. The light is low and warm. The sheep is going somewhere specific, and quickly, and will not explain.

9a0dd5d855.alt: A pond in a green valley framed by a tree on the left, with a hose curving across the lawn.
9a0dd5d855.story: Low in the valley, the pond sits, a flat strip of silver framed by grass and bushes. A tree leans in from the left. A black hose curves across the lawn in a long, lazy loop. In the distance, hills fade to blue. Nobody is in sight. It is the kind of view that seems to hum quietly, like a set left on between programmes.

c8bea68bba.alt: Upright view of a sheep lying in the grass beside a rock, with a pond and trees behind.
c8bea68bba.story: Next to a large rock, a sheep has lain down in the grass, legs folded under, chin up, looking straight ahead. Its shadow pools beside it. Behind, the pond glints, and the trees on the far bank are lit up green and gold. The sheep seems perfectly content. It has found the best seat in the house and intends to keep it.

70c0760bf2.alt: The resting sheep beside the rock again, slightly closer, with the pond glinting behind.
70c0760bf2.story: Not an inch of movement, thirty seconds on. The sheep sits by the rock with the dignity of a small monument, wool lit warm along the top, ear tag showing. The pond behind shines silver. The far trees blur into soft green. There is no reason to stand up, and so it does not. Afternoons like this were made for sitting still.

2c30d07483.alt: Thatched huts on stilts beside trees, beyond a rolling green mound under a pale blue sky.
2c30d07483.story: The thatched huts appear again from a new angle, three of them standing in a row on stilts, their pointed roofs dark against the trees. In front, a grassy mound rises gently, catching the light along its crest. A railing runs along the right. The sky is pale blue with fine streaks of cloud. It is quarter to four and the shadows are getting longer.

af03e16829.alt: Upright view of a sheep lying by a pile of rocks near a pond, a tree and hills behind.
af03e16829.story: Seen from further back, the resting sheep looks small among the rocks, a pale bundle lying by a jumbled pile of stones. The pond stretches behind, and a single person stands on the far bank. A tree leans in from the left, its leaves dark against the sky. Hills line the horizon. The light comes from behind, rimming everything in thin gold.

589db68293.alt: The sheep lying beside the rocks again, pond and hills behind, the sky pale and streaked.
589db68293.story: Ten seconds later, the same scene, slightly shifted. The sheep has turned its head. The person on the far bank has gone. The sky above is pale and streaked with fine clouds, and the hills have faded a little more. Everything is very calm. The rocks look as though they have been placed there purely for the sheep's convenience.

df2ffa8f8e.alt: A woolly sheep stands in profile on sunlit grass, another sheep's rear at the left edge.
df2ffa8f8e.story: In full sun, a sheep stands sideways, wool thick and shaggy, lit from behind so every curl glows. Its ear is pink and translucent. Another sheep's rear end pokes into the left of the frame. The field behind slopes up toward a pond and a few grazing shapes. It is quarter to four. The sheep looks off to the left, thinking sheep thoughts.

066bed249e.alt: A shaggy sheep stands on the grass looking toward the viewer, with a thatched hut and trees behind.
066bed249e.story: Another sheep, or the same one turned round, stands in the low sun looking straight out, head slightly tilted. The wool hangs long and uneven, lit up along its edges. Behind it the grass rolls back toward a thatched hut and a line of trees. Long shadows stretch across the field. There is a curious, patient look on its face.

ac2cda91af.alt: A person sits among a small flock of sheep on a grassy rise, mountains and a tree in the background.
ac2cda91af.story: Five or six sheep crowd round a person seated on a low rock in the middle of the flock, noses down in the grass. Other visitors stand nearby watching. Behind, the hills fall away in long blue folds, and a broad tree spreads its branches overhead. It looks like a scene from a children's book, slightly too perfect to be real.

d6c4f8b209.alt: A single sheep grazes on a sunlit slope, with a pond, trees and distant hills under a blue sky.
d6c4f8b209.story: Small and white against the green, a lone sheep grazes on the slope. A few people stand beyond it near the pond. Trees and scrub darken the far bank. The sky above is a deep blue with thin streaks of cloud, and the hills on the horizon are soft and blue. It is ten to four and it looks like any ordinary afternoon, which it is.

964045490e.alt: A castle-shaped structure covered in flowers and greenery, with white conical spires, visitors at its steps.
964045490e.story: The castle comes into full view: a tall structure covered in leaves and flowers, topped with white cone-shaped spires that point at the sky. Visitors gather at its steps, tiny against it. The ground in front is bare, packed earth, and the hills behind are blue and long. It looks absurd and wonderful at once, a fairy tale built from a garden centre.

867589609f.alt: A wide view of the flower-covered castle with white spires, visitors at its base and a sheep to the right.
867589609f.story: Wider now, the castle sits on its dusty plain like a set piece left behind after a show. White spires, green walls studded with flowers, a gateway at the centre. On the right a sheep grazes near a person sitting on the grass. Hills stretch out behind. The sky is pale, with thin cloud. It is like a channel that only broadcasts fairy tales.

a490bc093c.alt: Two sheep graze side by side on a sunny green field near a pond and a line of trees.
a490bc093c.story: Side by side, two sheep graze on the green, one facing away, one turned in profile, both lit gold on the sunny side. Beyond them the pond lies dark under the trees. The hills are faint on the horizon. It is ten to four. The sheep move slowly, in step, as if they have been doing this together for a very long time.

7baaf7a16d.alt: A sheep grazes on grass in front of the flower-covered castle, visitors standing near its gate.
7baaf7a16d.story: Right up in front of the castle, a sheep has wandered onto the strip of grass and is grazing calmly, completely indifferent to the towers rising behind it. Visitors stand at the gate, taking pictures, waiting their turn on the steps. The spires gleam white. The contrast is perfect: an extravagant fantasy, and a sheep that only cares about lunch.

c40024d652.alt: Upright view of a sheep grazing before the flower-covered castle with white spires and visitors.
c40024d652.story: Upright now, nine seconds later, the castle reaches its full height, spires stacked on spires against the pale sky. At the bottom, the sheep keeps eating, nose deep in the grass. People move around the gate. A rope fence runs along the left. Whatever is happening up at the castle, down here the important work continues.

6c16a50524.alt: A person stands with arms outstretched on the steps of the flower-covered castle, spires above.
6c16a50524.story: Framed by the archway at the castle gate, someone stands on the steps with both arms out, a tiny figure beneath all those towers. The spires rise in tiers, white tips catching the sun. Leaves and flowers cover every wall. Tall grass sways at the base. It looks like the end of a pageant, the moment before the curtain drops.

008d27592d.alt: Close view of the castle's flower-covered towers and archway, a person in a patterned dress on the steps.
008d27592d.story: Thousands of small flowers, it turns out, make up the castle, red and pink and white, packed into green walls. Someone in a patterned dress climbs the steps under the archway, looking up. The white spires overhead are almost too bright to look at. Grass sprouts at the foot of the walls. It is quietly ridiculous, and lovely.

5193d2e0b3.alt: Upright view of the flower-covered archway and steps, a person in a patterned dress standing on them.
5193d2e0b3.story: A step back, and the archway frames the figure on the stairs, small and still, as if waiting for a cue. Spires rise on both sides. The flowers on the towers glow pink and red in the low sun. A path of packed earth leads up to the steps. It is ten to four. Somewhere behind the walls, perhaps, there is nothing at all.

87e649c7e0.alt: Feathery grass plumes backlit by the sun in front of a pond, a field and distant hills.
87e649c7e0.story: Without people, the grass takes over: tall stems topped with pale feathery plumes, backlit by the sun, leaning gently to the right. Behind them the pond holds a flat sheet of light, and the fields roll back toward blue hills. Thin clouds streak the sky. It is the kind of scene that looks like a screensaver, slowly drifting.

a713606513.alt: The edge of the flower castle beside a golden field, a mountain behind and a person walking by a fence.
a713606513.story: Three minutes to four. The castle's edge fills the left side of the frame, white spires against the sky. Beyond it a golden field rolls down to a line of trees, and a long blue mountain lies on the horizon. A visitor walks along the fence at the bottom left, small and unhurried. The light has turned soft and warm, like honey poured over everything.

a8273e2c40.alt: A person walks across a sunlit green lawn toward the foreground, thatched huts on a low hill behind.
a8273e2c40.story: Alone in all that green, someone strolls forward across the lawn. Behind, the thatched huts sit along the low hill, trees clustered around them. The grass glows warm. Long shadows stretch out from every bump in the lawn. The sky is pale and clear. It is two minutes to four, and nothing about the afternoon is urgent.

e3de0f03b8.alt: A dense bed of pink and coral flowers among glossy green leaves, filling the frame.
e3de0f03b8.story: The flower bed fills everything: hundreds of small blossoms in pink, coral and pale white, five petals each, crowded among dark glossy leaves. A few are lit by sun, the rest in shade. There is no sky, no edge, no ground. Just flowers, as far as the frame goes, like a screen stuck on one colour.

71dfbfd197.alt: A glass café facade reflecting a tree and sky, a figure faintly visible through the door.
71dfbfd197.story: The café's glass front reflects the outside world back at itself: a tree, the sky, a strip of distant hills. Through the door, a faint figure stands inside, half-merged with the reflection. The floor in front is lit warm by the low sun. It is hard to say which side of the glass is the real one. Both look equally convincing.

a73c6a8880.alt: A café counter with an espresso machine, a vase of yellow flowers and a white butterfly ornament.
a73c6a8880.story: The espresso machine gleams behind the counter, its chrome catching the light. A vase of yellow flowers sits beside it, topped by a large white butterfly ornament perched as if it just landed. Someone works at the far end. The walls are warm wood. The smell of coffee is easy to imagine. It is two minutes past four.

58f3c24648.alt: A wooden café wall with an alpaca logo and the word ALPACA, coffee grinders and plush sheep toys below.
58f3c24648.story: A large alpaca logo stands on the wood-panelled wall over the word ALPACA in dark letters. Below, on the counter, two coffee grinders stand side by side, and next to them a row of plush toys, fluffy white sheep and a grey one, lined up like a small audience. A potted flower sits nearby. The café knows exactly what it is about.

3b4a54e62d.alt: A glass display case filled with rows of cakes, its surface catching reflections of the room.
3b4a54e62d.story: The cake case is lit from within, row after row of small round cakes arranged on glass shelves, cream-topped and pastel-coloured. Below, larger whole cakes sit cut into wedges. Reflections slide across the front of the glass, blurring the view in streaks. It looks like a screen showing a cooking channel, everything slightly too perfect, slightly out of reach.

35960b1ff8.alt: A wooden deck with a round bed of red and pink flowers, a thatched roof and mountains under blue sky.
35960b1ff8.story: Four minutes past four, and the deck stretches out under a wide blue sky. A round bed of flowers sits on it, bright red and pink, edged in wood. A thatched roof peeks in at the left. People stand at the far end, looking out at the mountains. Fine streaky clouds fan out overhead. The light is clean and sharp.

55130ecef3.alt: A ring of flowers with two flower-covered cone towers framing the castle and hills in the distance.
55130ecef3.story: Two cone-topped towers covered in flowers frame the view from the deck, standing like gateposts. Between them, far off, the castle sits on its hill. A round flower bed fills the foreground, red and pink and white. Someone walks by with an orange umbrella. The mountains behind are long and blue, the sky streaked with cloud.

c288dc19d2.alt: Upright view of the flower bed and twin cone towers framing the distant castle and mountains.
c288dc19d2.story: Symmetry takes over in the upright frame: two towers, one castle between them, a flower bed below, a sky above. The deck boards stretch forward in grey lines. Small figures move around the far hill. It is five past four. It looks like the title card for something, the moment before the music starts.

4fc051815f.alt: On a dark table, a green layered iced drink, an iced coffee with a straw, a cake slice and a white tulip.
4fc051815f.story: A quiet table indoors. A green iced drink in a cup printed with an alpaca, a dark iced coffee with a black straw laid across its lid, a slice of layered cake on a small dark plate. A white tulip leans in from the right. The table is glossy and black, mirroring everything. The wall behind glows soft and cream. Seven minutes past four.

7cb8dce88c.alt: The same table with the green drink, iced coffee, cake and tulip, all reflected in the dark surface.
7cb8dce88c.story: Twenty-four seconds later, the same arrangement, nothing touched yet. The reflections on the dark table are clearer now: the green cup doubled, the tulip upside down. At the left edge, the soft shape of a chair back. The light is warm and low. Everything waits in a perfect still life, just before the first sip ruins it.

212d249f71.alt: The café table with drinks, cake and tulip, now with a small printed card and a hand at the left edge.
212d249f71.story: Nineteen seconds later, a small card has appeared on the table, printed with a picture and some text, and a hand rests at the left edge with a watch on its wrist. The drinks are still untouched, the cake still whole. It is the moment the afternoon turns from looking to doing. Someone is about to pick up a straw.

010bb9658e.alt: People in camping chairs on a grassy hillside face a large outdoor stage and screen in hazy light.
010bb9658e.story: Eight minutes to five, and the hill is filling up. Camping chairs dot the grass in loose rows, each one facing the big screen at the bottom of the slope. A green glass bottle stands in the grass in front. Someone holds up a phone. The sun hangs low and hazy over the hills. Everything is waiting for the show to start.

4fa17a7916.alt: A wide grassy field with rows of chairs and umbrellas, green banners and a stage at the far end.
4fa17a7916.story: The scale shows itself from further back: a wide green field, rows of chairs and umbrellas, green banners on poles with the word Chang printed on them. At the far end the stage rigging stands tall and dark. The sky above is pale and soft. People in hats and caps sit waiting. It feels like the minutes before a broadcast goes live.

30b831156a.alt: A large crowd scattered across a grassy field with white tents, flags and trees under a cloudy sky.
30b831156a.story: Full of people, the field stretches back: groups on picnic mats, small clusters standing and chatting, white tents and coloured flags along the edges. Trees ring the ground. Clouds drift in soft heaps. Someone walks past at the right edge. The murmur of voices would be steady and warm, like static on a channel no one is watching yet.

6e33bd62f1.alt: Stacked towers of colourful cubes rise from a crowded grassy field with white tents and a green banner.
6e33bd62f1.story: Towers of brightly coloured cubes stand stacked across the field like giant children's blocks, red, green, yellow, blue. Around them, people sit in groups on the grass. White tents line the back of the field, their peaks in a neat row. Trees and a low hill close off the view. The colours look almost electric against the dimming green.

878f23db91.alt: Chairs and umbrellas on a grassy hillside facing a stage, a black umbrella at the centre.
878f23db91.story: A black umbrella now sits at the centre of the frame like a dark flower, seventeen seconds on. The orange one still glows at the right. The field stretches down to the stage, tiny figures moving at its base. A soft cloud drifts across the sky. The evening has not started yet, but it is getting close.

78762eebf6.alt: Upright view of chairs on a grassy slope facing a big screen, a green bottle in the foreground.
78762eebf6.story: The big screen sits small at the bottom of the valley, framed by the hills and the open sky. In front, rows of chairs and their occupants face it, backs turned. A green bottle leans in the grass at the bottom left. The sun is a bright blur above. It is three minutes to five, and nobody is moving now.

615a916bfb.alt: The sun breaks through clouds above a hill, with a silhouetted stage tower and crowd below.
615a916bfb.story: The sun breaks through a gap in the clouds, a white disc dropping toward the hill. Below it, the stage tower stands in silhouette, the crowd reduced to dark shapes. An orange umbrella glows faintly in the bottom corner. The sky is gold and grey. It is the moment when daylight hands over to the screen, and everyone can feel it.

0fc56e7f95.alt: Rows of white-wrapped bales set out as seats on a grassy field, a stage and crowd behind.
0fc56e7f95.story: Rows of white-wrapped bales sit on the grass, set out like the seats of a theatre without walls. They catch the low light along their tops. Behind, the crowd thickens near the stage, and strings of lights run overhead. A green banner glows at the right. The bales are empty for now. Soon they will be warm with people.

e3a1759849.alt: Closer view of the white-wrapped bales in rows on the grass, leading toward the stage.
e3a1759849.story: Thirteen seconds later, closer to the ground. The bales line up in front, their plastic wrapping glossy and wrinkled, catching the light like frosted glass. The rows lead the eye straight down toward the stage, where people mill about. Lights hang on poles overhead. The grass is long and tangled between the seats. Everyone is still finding their place.

f1df3b61ad.alt: White bales on grass with silhouetted people walking past, a large white balloon and a banner behind.
f1df3b61ad.story: Silhouettes walk between the bales, dark shapes against the low sun. A large white balloon floats on a pole beside a green banner, its surface glowing. Strings of lights run off into the distance. The stage sits at the left, small and far. The sky is a hazy mix of cream and grey. It feels like the countdown has begun.

706cc1fbdd.alt: A crowd on a grassy hillside at sunset, stacked colourful cube towers and a distant stage.
706cc1fbdd.story: Twelve past five, and the valley glows. The crowd has filled the slope, people standing and sitting in loose clusters. Stacked towers of coloured cubes rise among them like totems. Far away, the stage and screen wait at the bottom of the hill. The sun is a soft blur behind the clouds. Everyone is facing the same direction now.

970eec76f3.alt: Steel truss tower with spotlights holding a red food-stall banner in Thai script under a pale late-afternoon sky.
970eec76f3.story: Four spotlights perch on the truss like birds that have not yet decided to sing. Below them, the red banner in Thai script catches the last warm light of the afternoon, and a red canopy flaps at its feet. It is a quarter past five. Nothing is switched on yet. The lamps wait, aimed at nothing, for the hill to go dark enough to need them.

90ba8b7731.alt: Crowd walking past a gold-and-white carousel on a grassy field, backlit by a hazy evening sun.
90ba8b7731.story: The carousel turns slowly in the low sun, its gold crown glowing like a lamp left on in daylight. People drift past in black jackets and denim, some heading for the stage, some pausing at the painted horses. A green flag leans in the breeze. Somewhere a ticket is being torn, and the organ music, if there is any, is lost under a hundred overlapping conversations.

72acc99537.alt: Sun setting over wooded hills behind a grass field lined with metal barriers bearing Chang logos.
72acc99537.story: By ten past five the sun has slid down to the ridge and turned the whole sky to weak tea. A row of barriers stamped with Chang logos runs across the empty grass, keeping out no one yet. The hills go soft and brown at the edges. In an hour this stretch of field will be full; for now it belongs to the light and a few long shadows.

be78a336a0.alt: Wide field of green tables and folding chairs below forested hills, with white tents and a few people setting up.
be78a336a0.story: Green tables stand in loose rows across the lawn, most chairs still empty, one person bent double fixing something near the grass. Behind them, white tents line the base of the hills like a row of folded paper hats. Flags on tall poles hang still. The clouds have gone pink underneath. The audience is arriving a few at a time, picking seats as if choosing channels.

202ccecce1.alt: Large crowd seated on a green lawn at the foot of a steep forested hill, white tents behind.
202ccecce1.story: The hill rises straight up behind the crowd, dark green and close, as if it has come down to watch too. Hundreds have settled on the grass now, mats spread, bags piled, a few still wandering upright between them. Colourful inflatables bob near the tents. The sky has lost its warmth and gone a flat, patient blue. Everyone is facing the same way.

45346e4e1a.alt: Band on a stage in pale blue haze under giant white chevrons on the screen, crowd silhouettes below.
45346e4e1a.story: Ten past six, and the field has become a room with no walls. White chevrons glare from the screen, pointing at nothing, pointing at everyone. Haze rolls across the stage and swallows the drummer to the shoulders. The crowd is reduced to dark shapes and lifted phones in the foreground. Whatever the first song was, it has already started, and the hill behind has vanished entirely.

989363a83f.alt: Band on stage bathed in green light, a white bracket shape and small cross on the screen behind them.
989363a83f.story: Everything turns green at once, as though the whole stage has been dipped in pond water. A white bracket hangs across the screen with a tiny cross floating above it, like a test pattern waiting for a signal. Five musicians hold their positions. The singer stands in pale clothes at the centre, still for a moment. Below, the heads in the front row tilt upward together.

34703e9932.alt: Musicians on a dark stage under a screen filled with drifting turquoise shapes above a white bracket.
34703e9932.story: Turquoise flecks fill the screen four seconds later, scattering upward like leaves blown off a pond. The green wash is gone, replaced by near-darkness, so the band seems to play underneath a falling sky. The guitarist on the right leans into a chord. The shapes keep multiplying, crowding the white bracket, and the audience below is only a ridge of shadow.

491cf74414.alt: Band on stage beneath a dense cloud of turquoise graphic shapes on a large screen, crowd silhouetted in the foreground.
491cf74414.story: The flecks thicken into a swarm and rise past the top of the screen, as if the picture is draining upward. Under it the band keeps steady, each player lit by a small white lamp. The singer has moved to the left, microphone raised. Nobody in the crowd seems to be moving; the whole field is watching the shapes climb.

4d2cdf653a.alt: Stage with a screen showing turquoise shapes collapsing into a tilted plane, band performing below in green light.
4d2cdf653a.story: Now the swarm folds in on itself, sliding down into a tilted sheet like a deck of cards being gathered. The cross still floats in the dark centre, untouched. On stage the singer bends forward, one arm crooked overhead. A green spot burns at the drum riser. The screen seems to be telling a small story of its own, one that is nearly finished.

436f377e4e.alt: Vertical view of a stage with white light beams cutting through haze toward the crowd, a turquoise slab on screen.
436f377e4e.story: Turned on its side, the scene becomes tall and narrow: beams of white light fanning out from the stage floor, cutting the haze into slices. The turquoise sheet on the screen hangs at an angle, almost touching the bracket. Heads crowd the bottom of the frame, dark and close. The band is small up there, held between the light and the dark field.

a027d5cd37.alt: Singer at centre stage under a white spotlight beam, a few turquoise shapes drifting at the top of the screen.
a027d5cd37.story: The last of the shapes slip away to the upper corner and the screen is almost empty again: bracket, cross, black. A single white beam lands on the singer, who stands with the microphone close and one hand open. The rest of the band falls back into shadow. Someone in the crowd raises a phone, its small rectangle glowing like another, quieter screen.

6e9c22b675.alt: Tall view of a stage under a screen full of green shapes inside a white bracket, white light flaring across the crowd.
6e9c22b675.story: Green flecks pack the bracket twelve seconds on, a dense block like static on a dead channel. A white light flares low on the stage and smears across the front rows. The musicians stand spaced along the riser, small and steady. Above them the pattern holds, waiting for the next cue.

94e7e04c11.alt: Stage at night with a mostly black screen, a white bracket and a turquoise slab, spotlights burning overhead.
94e7e04c11.story: Almost nothing is left on the screen: a black field, the bracket, the small cross, and one turquoise slab sliding in from the left. A spotlight blooms at the top of the rig. The singer stands centre in pale trousers, half turned toward the drummer. It looks like the gap between two programmes, the moment the station has not decided what to show next.

803dd3243b.alt: Vertical view of the stage with a white bracket and cross on the screen, green streaks at left, band and crowd below.
803dd3243b.story: Diagrams return to the screen: an empty bracket, a floating cross, and a cluster of green streaks pinned to the left edge with a little bar chart beneath. Under it the band stands spread across the riser. A spotlight burns at the very top. In the crowd, one silhouette stands taller than the rest, shoulders squared, watching without moving.

36531db236.alt: Stage screen covered in a cloud of green dots inside a white bracket, band performing beneath in blue light.
36531db236.story: Like mould blooming on a slide under a microscope, the green dots return across the bracket. The cross sits in the middle of the bloom. A blue lamp hangs on the right like a small moon. Below, the singer stands at centre with head tipped down. Heads in the crowd crowd the lower third, dark and attentive.

a1a36dbd9f.alt: Band on stage below a screen of slanted blue and white stripes, the singer's arm visible on screen at right.
a1a36dbd9f.story: Four minutes pass and the palette changes completely. Blue and white diagonals sweep across the screen, leaning like rain in a strong wind, with one streak of orange near the right. The singer appears at the edge of the screen, arm lifted to the face. On the riser, the band has loosened up; one guitarist turns toward the drums. The crowd is a dark, unbroken shoreline.

1bcee47f34.alt: Wide stage view with blue and white diagonal stripes on the screen and the band spread across a lit platform.
1bcee47f34.story: The stripes hold steady, a rhythm in blue and white, like the test pattern of a station that broadcasts only weather. The close-up has slid off to the left, leaving a red box at the screen's edge. Across the platform the musicians stand far apart, each in a pool of light. Five seconds have passed. Nothing in the crowd has changed except the song.

addd08dd4e.alt: Band on a stage filled with teal haze, the singer holding a microphone at centre, a guitarist on each side.
addd08dd4e.story: Teal fog dims the screen, and smoke from the stage drifts up to meet it. Without the giant images, the band looks human-sized again: a guitarist on the left, the singer and another figure at centre, a bassist on the right. A microphone tilts at the edge of the frame. It is quieter-looking, though nothing about the volume has likely changed.

6a78d15dfd.alt: Screen showing the Movie on The Hill logo with Chang and Major branding over misty blue mountains, band in shadow below.
6a78d15dfd.story: Eleven seconds later the band drops into darkness and the screen shows a title card: MOVIE on The Hill, in ornate red letters, with Thai script beneath and a pair of sponsor logos at the top. Behind the words, painted mountains fade into pink mist. It looks exactly like an intermission slide. Below, the musicians wait as silhouettes, guitars still strapped on.

a0c734bb8a.alt: Stage with the Movie on The Hill logo on screen beside a temple-like silhouette and sparks, band in dim light below.
a0c734bb8a.story: The title card has moved to the left and the screen has filled with stone steps, sparks and a dark tree on the right. Below, the band is just visible: a guitarist, the singer, a figure at the keys, all still dark against the bright image. The screen seems to be telling a story about a ruin. The musicians are waiting for it to finish.

5958cafcc5.alt: Band performing on a stage under a plain blue screen, a soft green glow at the right, crowd silhouetted.
5958cafcc5.story: Plain blue fills the screen, like a channel between programmes, and the band steps back into view. Five figures line up across the riser: guitar on the left, the singer centre, a bassist right. A pale green glow swells low in the corner of the screen. The heads in the front of the crowd show only as a dim ridge, waiting for the count-in.

5e261ec253.alt: Band on stage in front of a deep blue backdrop, singers standing together at centre, crowd heads in shadow.
5e261ec253.story: Six seconds on, the blue is unchanged, though the green glow has spread wider. The singer and another vocalist now stand together at centre, close enough to share a glance. A guitarist on the right leans into the neck of the guitar. The scene looks almost like a rehearsal: no graphics, no close-ups, just a band and the colour of deep water.

11e3282958.alt: Band performing on a hazy blue stage, white smoke drifting at right, drum kit at centre.
11e3282958.story: Smoke starts to roll in from the right, white and thick, catching the blue and turning it pale. The two vocalists at centre have separated slightly. The drum kit glints behind them. It is twenty-six minutes past six and the hill is completely dark. Somewhere behind the stage, a fog machine is doing its quiet work, and the band plays on through the cloud.

bdd56fda59.alt: Band on a stage swallowed by blue and white smoke, the singer and guitarists visible at centre and right.
bdd56fda59.story: Sixteen seconds later, the fog has taken over. It billows from the right side of the stage in big white plumes, softening the drum kit and the guitarist into shapes. The singer stands at centre, arm raised, a pale outline in the haze. The screen has gone empty again. For a moment the whole set looks like a ship's deck on a misty night.

7a9a16c250.alt: Wide screen showing the Movie on The Hill logo on a stepped pyramid shape amid clouds and orange sparks.
7a9a16c250.story: Between songs, the screen fills with a stepped pyramid rising out of blue cloud, the festival title glowing red across its face. Orange sparks drift up the sides like embers from a fire nobody can see. The stage beneath is almost black; a single teal dot of light marks where someone is standing. It plays like a station ident, bright and brief.

8a7959a59c.alt: Band performing beneath a purple screen of concentric white arcs, smoke drifting across the stage.
8a7959a59c.story: When the lights return they are violet. White arcs curve across the screen in concentric rings, like the ripples from a stone dropped into a dark lake, or the bands of a radio dial. Smoke lies low over the riser. The band has spread out again, singer at centre, a guitarist on either flank, keys at the far left. Everything feels slower in purple.

3c5c75ad42.alt: Musicians on stage under glowing white arcs on a violet screen, two vocalists standing together at centre.
3c5c75ad42.story: Brighter arcs follow three seconds later, and a few white streaks flicker in from the screen's edges. Two vocalists stand together now, shoulder to shoulder at centre. The bassist on the right has stepped forward to the lip of the riser. It looks like a scene from a music programme recorded decades ago, the kind with a painted backdrop and a very serious host.

ed1a10c1e5.alt: Band on stage in front of a giant arc-patterned violet screen, the singer at centre in pale trousers.
ed1a10c1e5.story: The arcs fill the whole width now, ring inside ring, so the band seems to stand at the bottom of a vast lit tunnel. The singer in pale trousers holds the microphone steady at centre. A guitarist turns slightly to the left. Across the front of the stage, a row of small lamps points up into their faces. Two seconds have passed since the last frame.

fed301e7de.alt: Stage with a purple arc-patterned screen, the band lined up across the platform under white streaks of light.
fed301e7de.story: Another four seconds. The singer has turned toward the second vocalist, the guitarist has lifted the neck of the guitar a little higher. Small details shift; the arcs above do not. White streaks keep flashing in from the left like passing headlights. A moment later the song will change, but for now the whole picture holds as if someone has pressed pause.

235d06b641.alt: Crowd queuing at a lit popcorn stand under a white peaked tent at night, string lights at left.
235d06b641.story: Away from the stage, a white tent glows under a single floodlight and a blue sign spells out POPCORN in tall letters. A queue presses up to the counter, faces lit from one side. String lights sag from a pole on the left. It is half past six and the field has gone fully dark. Somewhere behind all this, the band is still playing.

66e5773d3a.alt: Band on a blue stage under a screen filled with drifting white specks like snow, lights glowing at their feet.
