66e5773d3a.story: Then the screen fills with white specks, scattered and falling, as if it is snowing on the other side of the glass. The whole stage goes blue. Five musicians stand in a line, the singer in white at centre, a guitarist at each end. For a hot November night on a grassy hill, it is a strange and lovely thing to watch snow.

1ec107fc08.alt: Band performing on stage beneath a screen of falling white flecks, blue haze and lights around them.
1ec107fc08.story: Five seconds into the snowfall, the flecks have gathered into a cloud near the top of the screen. Blue haze thickens on the right. The singer in white stands at centre with the microphone, while a guitarist leans back on the far right. Everything is cool, blue and slow. It looks like the closing scene of a winter film nobody had expected.

61d482175b.alt: Vertical view of the stage with white light beams rising into a screen of white flecks, crowd silhouettes below.
61d482175b.story: In the tall frame, two beams of white light rise from the stage floor and vanish into the falling flecks above. The band stands in a small row near the middle, dwarfed by the screen. Below them, heads and shoulders form a dark wall, one person's hair caught in a sliver of light. The snow keeps falling without ever reaching the ground.

fe32f652b0.alt: Stage at night with spotlights blazing from the truss into a screen of white flecks, band in a line below.
fe32f652b0.story: Nine seconds later the lamps on the truss flare hard, throwing white beams straight down through the haze. The flecks on the screen hang in a dense cloud. The singer stands at centre again, very still, arms down. The scene looks almost like a church, all vertical light and quiet attention, except that someone in the back is almost certainly singing along.

4834eaf2b7.alt: Stage screen split into panels of falling white specks and a cropped shoulder, band performing in blue light below.
4834eaf2b7.story: Half a minute later the screen breaks into panels: a field of white specks in the middle, a pale blue slab on the left, a tattooed shoulder cropped at the right edge. Down on the platform the singer has thrown one arm up toward the sky. A white lamp burns on the front edge of the stage. The crowd shows only as a band of darkness.

ba6b94e148.alt: Screen showing the singer's tattooed arm reaching out, a watch on the wrist, band in blue light on the stage below.
ba6b94e148.story: An arm stretches across the screen now, reaching out of frame, a watch on the wrist and a tattoo running from shoulder to elbow. The specks drift around it like dust in a projector beam. Below, the same arm is raised on stage, small and white against the dark drums. It is half past six on a Saturday, and the whole hill seems to lean toward that hand.

6525f367df.alt: Vertical view of a blue stage with a bright starburst light at lower left and a screen close-up of a singer above.
6525f367df.story: A hand-shaped blur hangs over the top of the rig, a lifted arm in the crowd too close to focus. Below it the screen shows a dim close-up among drifting specks, and further down, a white lamp bursts into an eight-pointed star at the edge of the stage. The singer stands in its glow. Everything else dissolves into blue.

8314895463.alt: Vertical stage view with the singer raising one arm under a screen of white specks, guitarist and drums nearby.
8314895463.story: Forty-seven seconds on, the singer stands centre with one arm held straight up, the pose of someone hailing a taxi or answering a question. The screen above is full of falling white specks and a large blurred face. A guitarist plays at the right. The heads in the crowd, at the bottom, are silent black shapes, but it is not hard to imagine the cheer.

91c7486c80.alt: Band performing under a screen showing orange waves, a white square and a date stamp reading JAN. 01 2000.
91c7486c80.story: The same date sits in the corner: JAN. 01 2000, midnight, as if the clock stopped there and decided to stay. Orange waves roll under the floating white square. On stage the band has spread across the full width, keys on the left, a guitarist on the right with a pale instrument. The light on the riser is soft and pink, the colour of a faded print.

127eaee10d.alt: Vertical view of a pink-and-white screen with PLAY text, a white square and a JAN. 01 2000 stamp, band below.
127eaee10d.story: PLAY, says the corner of the screen. The date beneath the square has not changed: AM 00:00, JAN. 01 2000. Pink bars glow on the truss above. On stage, two figures stand close together near the drum kit and a third stands apart on the right. It looks like the opening of a recording that has been rewound so many times the colours have softened.

d7d030638f.alt: Screen showing the Movie on The Hill title over a stepped pyramid and clouds, band performing on the dark stage below.
d7d030638f.story: Thirty seconds later, the stepped pyramid returns, the title written across it in looping red letters, clouds and sparks rising around the peak. It is the evening's recurring ident, the card that appears whenever the programme pauses. This time the band does not leave the stage. The singer stands at centre in a small pool of light while the screen announces where everyone already is.

684129ecc0.alt: Screen with the Movie on The Hill title over a pyramid and clouds, band members standing on the dim stage below.
684129ecc0.story: Three seconds after the ident appears, the band is still standing beneath it, shapes in the dark: a guitarist at the right, the singer in pale trousers left of centre, someone near the drums. Sparks float up the pyramid on the screen. The pause stretches. It is the kind of gap where everyone in the field reaches for a drink or checks the time.

a4cb5a9547.alt: Band on stage under a black screen patterned with large white X shapes and a thin streak of light.
a4cb5a9547.story: Eighteen seconds later the screen snaps into a hard black-and-white pattern: big hollow X shapes, overlapping like the cross-stitches on an old sweater. A single white streak darts through the middle like a shooting star. Two figures stand together at centre stage, one with a pale guitar. The colours from earlier are gone. Everything is graphic and sharp now.

47a589102a.alt: Vertical view of a screen with large white X outlines over black, a single performer standing on stage below.
47a589102a.story: In a tall frame, the X shapes look even bigger, a stack of hollow crosses filling the screen from edge to edge, a single white dot at the centre. The stage below is mostly dark. One performer stands near the middle, small and pale, one hand raised to the ear. A row of white lamps glows at the very top like the teeth of a comb.

8c76cd7a34.alt: Vertical view of tall scaffolding towers with spotlights beaming into haze, a screen of white X shapes at right.
8c76cd7a34.story: Turning away from the centre, the side of the rig comes into view: a tall steel tower stacked with lamps, one of them firing a beam down into the haze. White X shapes glow on a screen panel at the right. At the bottom, a few heads sit in a pale spill of light. It is quarter to seven. The structure looks taller in the dark than it did in daylight.

c2004bd80a.alt: Screen with a giant pale X shape over a close-up of a singer with a microphone, band on stage beneath.
c2004bd80a.story: A giant solid X slides across the screen, pale pink, half covering a close-up of the singer behind it, the microphone just visible at the edge. It is like a channel being blocked by a censor's mark. Below, the band carries on regardless, the singer at centre, a guitarist on the right. Fifteen seconds later, the X will probably be gone.

e9c0b2ecaa.alt: Band on stage below a screen showing a close-up of the singer lifting a microphone, blue light on screen.
e9c0b2ecaa.story: The X pattern is gone. In its place, the screen shows a blue close-up of the singer lifting the microphone with one hand, the other hand at the face. On the platform, six figures stand under small white lights, a drummer partly hidden behind cymbals. It is nearly ten to seven. The music must be building; the crowd below has gone very still in the dark.

1fc0f53df1.alt: Band on stage below a black screen with three tall orange-and-white vertical light bars, beams of light in the haze.
1fc0f53df1.story: Three bars of orange light stand upright on a black screen, glowing white at their cores, like the elements of an old electric heater. Beams of pale light rise from the stage and fan out into the haze. The singer stands at centre, a guitarist on each side. The whole picture is warm for the first time in an hour.

b32ba87536.alt: Musicians on stage in front of a screen filled with glowing orange and white vertical stripes.
b32ba87536.story: Multiplying fast, the bars spread until the whole screen glows orange, white stripes pulsing at regular intervals like the filament of a giant bulb. The band seems lit from behind by fire. The keyboard player on the left looks down at the keys. On the right, the singer leans toward a guitarist. Green lamps glint at the foot of the drums.

f8218e9ba7.alt: Stage with a screen of glowing orange vertical stripes, the band lined up in front, beams of light in the haze.
f8218e9ba7.story: Brighter still, the stripes turn the band into silhouettes against a wall of orange light. A guitarist on the left plays with head down. The singer at centre has lifted the microphone. It is the colour of the sun that set over the hill two hours ago, returned on a screen, much closer and somewhat louder.

d4f7d8a0e5.alt: Band performing in front of a red and orange screen of narrow vertical light stripes, white beams fanning upward.
d4f7d8a0e5.story: Two seconds, and the stripes have narrowed and turned redder, packed together like the slats of a lit blind. White beams fan up from the floor between the musicians. Someone at the far right stands beside the drums in a hat. The singer faces the crowd squarely. The heat of the colour makes the November night look like a summer one.

c574e53d28.alt: Band on a stage lit by an orange and red striped screen, singer and guitarist together at right, haze drifting.
c574e53d28.story: Crossing to the right, the singer stands shoulder to shoulder with the guitarist, sharing the same patch of light. The stripes behind soften into blurred orange columns. Haze curls across the drum kit. The crowd is reduced to the tops of a few heads at the bottom of the frame, quiet and dark against all that warmth.

c46dbf6363.alt: Vertical view of a stage with green vertical light bars and smoky green graphics on the screen, band below.
c46dbf6363.story: Spreading apart, the green bars make room for a cloud of green smoke billowing across the left side of the screen. White spotlights hang in a neat row at the top. On the stage, three musicians are visible: a guitarist at the left, the singer at centre, another guitarist on the right. The colour makes it look like a scene from an aquarium after hours.

b485a9c94a.alt: Stage at night with a screen showing blue streaked shapes, the band performing amid swirling smoke.
b485a9c94a.story: Pulling back to a smaller blue panel, the screen shows streaks like water on glass. Below it, the stage is wrapped in smoke curling up from the right, catching what light there is. The singer stands at centre with a microphone; a bassist leans into the haze. It is almost seven. The field beyond is silent black, as if everyone has disappeared into the dark.

54ecbecf9d.alt: Band performing beneath a green screen showing a blurred live view of the stage rig and a singer's shoulder.
54ecbecf9d.story: Looking back at itself, the screen shows a blurred green view of the rig and lights. A singer's shoulder slides into the right corner. Below, the singer in pale trousers strides across the platform while a guitarist plays on each side. It feels like a channel showing its own control room.

ca0e395d35.alt: Band on stage below a screen that is mostly bright white with a figure at the left and a singer at the right.
ca0e395d35.story: Eight seconds later the screen blows out to nearly pure white, a figure at the left edge and a singer at the right, both washed out like an overexposed tape. The band below is lit evenly for once, every musician clearly placed: keys, guitar, singer, drums, bass. In the crowd a green glow stick rises from the dark again, a little higher this time.

8595781656.alt: Band on a stage washed in pale cyan light, screen close-ups above, blurred heads of the crowd in the foreground.
8595781656.story: The light goes pale cyan and suddenly the crowd is visible: blurred heads and shoulders filling the bottom of the frame, hair lit at the edges. Above them the band stands in a bright row, and the screen shows a singer at the right with the microphone tilted up. It is ten to seven. For once the audience is as much in the picture as the stage.

7761474153.alt: Band on a stage bathed in deep green light, white smoke jets rising at right, crowd silhouetted below.
7761474153.story: Green again: a jet of white smoke shoots up from the right side of the stage, frozen mid-burst like a column of chalk. The singer stands at centre, one hand to the mouth. A guitarist beside leans back. In the crowd, a single teal light glows in someone's hand. The screen above has gone completely dark.

2eac4ea0b0.alt: Dark green stage with the band performing, a smoke jet fading at upper right, silhouettes of the crowd below.
2eac4ea0b0.story: Already the smoke column has thinned to a ghost at the top of the frame. The green has deepened almost to black. The singer stands centre, microphone lowered, with a guitarist close by. A figure on the far right steps into a small pool of light. The scene looks like an old film reel that has been tinted green by hand.

d61cd38207.alt: Band on stage below a dark screen with white dotted branching lines appearing from the edges.
d61cd38207.story: White branches begin to grow inward from the edges of the screen, built out of tiny dots like the pixels of an old scoreboard. The middle is still empty and black. Below, the band stands across the full width of the platform, the singer in pale trousers right of centre. It looks like frost forming on a window, one line at a time.

a0ff85453e.alt: Stage with a screen showing a white dotted pattern of branching lines meeting in an X, band performing below.
a0ff85453e.story: Meeting in the middle, the branches form a great white X, limbs spreading out to every corner like a frozen river delta. Bars of light flash at the corners. The singer stands below it with the microphone, a guitarist on each side. A phone screen glows in the bottom corner, someone in the crowd recording the pattern.

988ec52e5d.alt: Screen with dense white vertical stripes over a branching dotted pattern, band performing on stage below.
988ec52e5d.story: Seven seconds on, the pattern thickens: tall white stripes fill the centre of the screen, dotted and dense, while branches still reach out to the sides. It looks like an insect, or a circuit board, or the static on a set that has lost its antenna. The band plays on beneath it, the singer stepping forward with one hand outstretched.

e5b0dfe51e.alt: Band on a green stage below a screen of white dotted branching lines, the singer moving forward at centre.
e5b0dfe51e.story: Gone are the stripes, leaving just the branches, bright white against black, shaped like a giant snowflake or a cracked windscreen. Three seconds have passed. The singer has moved forward on the platform, knees bent, mid-step. Two band members stand close together at centre. Heads in the crowd crowd into the bottom, a few lit pale by the stage lights.

e24f023560.alt: Band performing beneath a green and blue screen covered in falling white flakes, crowd heads silhouetted.
e24f023560.story: Falling white flakes fill the screen on a blue-green ground, like a snow globe that has just been shaken. The band stands in a tidy row below. Smoke billows in from the right edge. In the crowd, one person's shoulders rise above the rest, perhaps standing, perhaps lifted, dark against the green glow.

0652fb3fe6.alt: Stage with a screen of falling flakes and a cyan panel showing a blurred figure, band performing below.
0652fb3fe6.story: Suddenly a bright cyan panel opens on the right side of the screen, like a window into another scene, with a pale shape blurred inside it. The flakes keep falling on the rest of the picture. The band below has shifted slightly: the singer now at centre, a guitarist at each side. The cyan rectangle is the brightest thing on the hill.

5c1a915ebc.alt: Vertical view of a green stage with white smoke jets bursting upward and the band performing below.
5c1a915ebc.story: Upright framing catches two jets of white smoke shooting from the stage, one in the middle, one on the right, hanging in the green air like ghosts climbing out of the floor. Beneath them the band plays on, three figures visible across the riser. The truss above is a cage of thin steel lines, lit faintly green.

450a2abd47.alt: Band performing beneath a blue-green screen of falling white flakes, a drummer visible high at right.
450a2abd47.story: Nearly a minute later the flakes on the screen have grown thicker and the blue at the centre has brightened, like a gap opening in a storm cloud. On the right, a drummer appears high up on the riser, half hidden by cymbals. The singer stands at centre, chin raised. The crowd below sits in near darkness, only the outlines of a few heads visible.

cac7c5a302.alt: Vertical view of the stage in green light with smoke jets and spotlight beams, singer and guitarists performing.
cac7c5a302.story: Green is everywhere: in the haze, in the smoke curling from the right, in the beams falling from the truss. The singer stands at centre in pale clothes, a guitarist close by. At the bottom, a few heads in the crowd are lit faintly from the front. It is nearly five to seven, and the show feels like it is underwater.

a0a1b87af3.alt: Screen showing a crowd's phone lights and a singer with arms outstretched, blurred raised hands in the foreground.
a0a1b87af3.story: Turned toward the audience, the screen makes the dark field into a sky full of small white lights, phones held up in their hundreds. A Chang sign glows green in the distance. In the middle of it all, the singer stands with arms spread wide. In the foreground, real hands rise up and blur into soft orange shapes, waving in front of the stage.

f9cbb9f4fb.alt: Screen showing the singer with arms outstretched before a sea of phone lights, blurred hands waving in the foreground.
f9cbb9f4fb.story: Both arms stay out on the screen, microphone in one hand, as if greeting every light in the field at once. The lights twinkle behind like a city seen from a plane. In front, a raised hand drifts across the frame, blurred into an orange cloud. On the stage below, the band plays on beneath its own wide shot of the crowd.

1d11fac3e8.alt: Screen showing a singer raising one arm toward a field of phone lights, band on stage below, blurred hands in front.
1d11fac3e8.story: One arm goes straight up on the screen, the singer pointing at the sky above the crowd. The phone lights glitter on, an entire field turned into stars. On the platform below, another vocalist stands in front of the drums with a hand lifted too. The foreground blurs out of focus. For a moment, the audience is the show.

c7f1356717.alt: Screen with the Movie on The Hill title over a pyramid and clouds, a single performer standing on the dim stage below.
c7f1356717.story: Nearly four minutes later the pyramid ident returns, sparks and clouds, the title across its face. This time the stage below is almost bare: one performer stands centre in a white shirt, the others half lost in darkness. It feels like the end of an episode, the screen filling time while the crew resets. The field waits, quieter now.

7c084df1b0.alt: Stage side with green lights and steel scaffolding, a screen showing a stone ruin and a tree under blue sky.
7c084df1b0.story: Seven o'clock exactly. The screen shows a ruin now, stone carved into blocky shapes, a tree growing from the top, blue mountains beyond. Steel scaffolding rises on the left, studded with green and blue lights. Smoke drifts across the empty stage below. It is the scenery between acts, a painted world that nobody stands in, broadcast to a field full of people waiting.

e2e5950de6.alt: Stage with a large triangular frame of carved patterns around blue and white swirling stripes, band in dim light below.
e2e5950de6.story: Nine minutes later the screen has become a triangle edged in carved gold patterns, and inside it blue and white stripes swirl like marbled paper or the grain of polished stone. Below, the stage sits in near darkness, a guitarist and a singer just visible as outlines. A phone glows in the crowd. The whole thing looks like a gate about to open.

cde62821f7.alt: Singer in a blue jacket and white trousers raising an arm below a gold-framed triangle of swirling blue stripes.
cde62821f7.story: The gate has its keeper two seconds later: a singer in a blue jacket and white trousers stands beneath the triangle with one arm lifted high. The swirls inside the gold frame curl like smoke trapped in glass. A guitarist plays to the left. Beside the triangle, more blue stripes pulse on side panels. Heads in the crowd form a dark, unbroken line.

1127d4ec78.alt: Singer in white trousers at centre stage beneath a gold triangular frame filled with white and blue swirls.
1127d4ec78.story: Thinning into long white threads, the swirls flow down the triangle like a waterfall seen from far off. The singer stands at centre, arms at the sides now, a soft white beam slanting from the right. Two guitarists flank the drums. The gold frame catches the light along its edges, carved patterns glinting in tiny ridges.

05fc6cf60a.alt: Band beneath a gold-framed triangle of blue and white swirling bands, white smoke rising beside the singer.
05fc6cf60a.story: Bold bands of blue and white thicken inside the triangle, bending around each other like the contour lines on a map. A jet of white smoke rises beside the singer and fades into the dark. On the left, a guitarist bends forward. The side panels flash bright blue. Everything has the polished calm of a stage set built for one song.

c34f0af569.alt: Stage with the singer in a blue jacket under a gold triangle of swirling lines, smoke jets on both sides.
c34f0af569.story: Long, wavering lines now stretch across the triangle, and two white smoke jets hiss upward on either side of the stage. The singer holds still at the centre, small and pale in the middle of it all. The blue panels on each side glow like a pair of windows. It is ten past seven and the night feels very deep.

430eba1217.alt: Vertical view of a singer with one arm raised under an empty gold-framed triangle, pink lights on the truss above.
430eba1217.story: Twenty-eight seconds on, the triangle has gone dark inside, leaving only its gold frame floating in the black like the outline of a roof. Pink lamps blaze along the truss above. The singer raises one arm toward the light, and beams fan down from the rig in pale spokes. A guitarist and bassist stand at the edges, waiting for the colour to return.

2b2083b54c.alt: Vertical view of a gold-framed triangle filled with pink clouds, the singer and guitarist on stage below.
2b2083b54c.story: Ten seconds later the colour returns as clouds. Inside the gold triangle, soft pink cloud banks drift across a pale sky, with a streak of red at the lower left. The singer stands at the right of the stage in white trousers, a guitarist on the left. Pink lights glow on the truss. It looks like flying above weather, seen through an attic window.

f1827de875.alt: Vertical view of a gold-framed triangle glowing pale pink, the singer in a blue jacket and a guitarist below.
f1827de875.story: The clouds inside the triangle have melted into a single blush of pink, smooth as the inside of a shell. Six seconds have passed. Pink lights still burn along the top of the rig. Below, the singer stands with both hands together near the chest, the guitarist on the left bent over the strings. The scene is quiet enough to hear, in imagination, the hum of the speakers.

f5e9bd50a2.alt: Wide screen of orange and pink clouds with sparkles, gold carved corners, the singer standing small on stage below.
f5e9bd50a2.story: Wide open now, the screen turns the pink into a full sky of orange cloud with a patch of blue at the top and four-pointed sparkles twinkling across it. Gold carved corners frame the edges like an old picture frame. The singer stands alone at centre stage, tiny against all that sky. It feels like the last minutes of a sunset that refuses to end.

4b4455c4b5.alt: Stage with a pale pink cloud screen sparkling with stars, the singer at a microphone stand and two guitarists below.
4b4455c4b5.story: Another forty seconds, and the cloud has paled to the colour of a peach. Small white stars sparkle on the screen. The singer stands at a microphone stand now, one hand lifted to it, with a guitarist on each side. The stage lights are low and violet. The crowd beneath is invisible, but the stillness of the frame suggests a slow song.

2797b41bf1.alt: Vertical view of a soft pink and peach screen above the dark stage where a singer and guitarist perform.
2797b41bf1.story: Peach and pink melt into a soft gradient across the whole screen, with no clouds left, just colour, like light through a closed eyelid. Pink lamps dot the truss above. The singer and a guitarist stand small at the bottom of the frame, nearly lost in the dark. Everything that matters seems to be happening up on the screen.

d4487ded41.alt: Vertical view of a screen showing a sky with a band of pink clouds below blue, the singer on stage in white trousers.
d4487ded41.story: The sky on the screen has cleared overhead: blue at the top, then a band of pink clouds piled up below like a view from an aeroplane window. Blue lights now run along the truss. The singer stands at the centre in white trousers, a guitarist on the left. It is quarter past seven. Somewhere, the real sky above the hill is completely black.

3e3a3c6fdd.alt: Vertical view of a dark stage, the singer in a blue jacket at centre, guitarists either side, a gold frame corner above.
3e3a3c6fdd.story: Black takes over the screen, and only a corner of the gold triangle catches light at the upper right. A row of blue lamps glows on the truss. The singer stands at centre, hands together, while the guitarists on either side bow their heads over their instruments. The silence of the image is heavy, like the pause after a station signs off.

02463c2d1a.alt: Vertical view of a screen with a white jagged shape in a framed box, the singer and guitarists performing below.
02463c2d1a.story: Jagged and white, a shape crawls diagonally across a box drawn on the screen, edges frayed like torn paper, with tiny symbols in the corners like a viewfinder display. Spotlights burn white overhead. The singer stands at centre in the blue jacket, two guitarists on either side. The crowd fills the bottom edge of the frame.

e00d8ba71f.alt: Vertical view of a screen of white plus signs and small squares, beams of light, the singer in a blue jacket on stage.
e00d8ba71f.story: Nearly two minutes later the screen is a grid of white plus signs and little hollow squares, like the crosshairs of a target finder or the markings on graph paper. Beams of light rake down through the haze. The singer stands at centre with the microphone, a guitarist on either side. The crowd is a dense, dark mass of heads.

81e2f620bf.alt: Band on stage below a screen showing a grid of white plus signs and squares, beams of light crossing the haze.
81e2f620bf.story: Widened into a horizontal frame, the same grid stretches wide. White crosses march across the screen in neat rows, and a blue glitch flickers at the right edge. Light beams cross and recross in the haze. The singer stands centre in white trousers, holding the microphone close. Across the stage, a guitarist leans into a chord.

a6c9a1fa38.alt: Stage with white plus signs and squares on screen, a blue panel showing a figure at right, band performing below.
a6c9a1fa38.story: Cutting in at the right edge, a blue panel appears with a blurred figure inside, as if another broadcast has interrupted. The crosses and squares fill the rest. Beams of white light rise from the floor of the stage in a fan. The singer and two guitarists hold their positions. The crowd remains dark and close at the bottom.

882a90fe43.alt: Vertical view of a screen of plus signs and hash shapes, white spotlights blazing, singer and guitarists on stage below.
882a90fe43.story: Twenty-four seconds later the grid begins to glitch: some crosses double up into hash marks, a few squares vanish. Bright lamps burn on the truss overhead. Below, the singer stands still at centre, a guitarist on the left and a bassist on the right. It looks like a screen trying to lock onto a signal, nearly there but not quite.

dbce638a2e.alt: Vertical view of a screen of white crosses and hash marks above the singer and guitarists, a dark head in the foreground.
dbce638a2e.story: Steadied now, the grid sets its crosses back in rows, two hash marks hanging on the right like a pair of tally counts. A dark head in the crowd rises into the lower corner, close enough to block a guitarist. The singer stands at centre in the blue jacket. Overhead, a line of white lamps burns as evenly as fluorescent tubes in an office.

15947775a1.alt: Band on stage under a screen grid of white plus signs, a blue panel at right showing part of the singer.
15947775a1.story: Perfect order settles over the grid, rows of white plus signs on black with a few squares scattered beneath. On the right panel, a blue sleeve fills the frame. The singer stands at centre with hands together, the guitarists placed symmetrically on either side. It looks like a broadcast schematic, every element precisely where it should be.

4fada93780.alt: Band on stage below a screen grid of plus signs and squares, a blue close-up of the singer at the right edge.
4fada93780.story: Twenty-three seconds on, the view widens again. The grid fills most of the screen; on the right panel, the singer in blue is cropped at the shoulder. Down on the stage, the real singer stands with one hand raised to the chest. Beams of light slant through the haze from both sides, crossing just above the guitarists' heads.

fe0d8787b1.alt: Stage screen showing horizontal white streaks fading into a V shape, the singer in a blue jacket on stage below.
fe0d8787b1.story: Dissolving, the crosses become horizontal white lines, streaking across the screen and narrowing into a V at the bottom, like a picture collapsing as an old set switches off. On the right, the singer's face appears in profile. Below, the real singer stands under a soft blue light, both guitarists half in shadow. The crowd is invisible.

698f7c0d21.alt: Vertical view of a screen of white horizontal streaks narrowing to a V, the singer standing on the dark stage below.
698f7c0d21.story: Vertically framed, the streaks on the screen form a great white funnel, wide at the top and closing to a point just above the singer's head. Blue lamps line the truss. The stage below is dim; the singer stands at centre in white trousers, a guitarist faint at the right. It looks as though the image above is pouring down into one person.

c90fd90c51.alt: Band on stage below a screen of white diamond patterns in rectangles, the crowd visible in the foreground.
c90fd90c51.story: Ten minutes before half past seven the screen becomes a quilt of white diamonds, some panels dense, some sparse, like a wall of lit tiles. For the first time in a while the front of the crowd is visible, heads and shoulders lit faintly by the stage. The singer stands at centre in white trousers, holding the microphone. Two guitarists play on either side.

9931936cf0.alt: Vertical view of a stage with a screen of white diamond patterns and a pink panel, crowd heads lit below.
9931936cf0.story: A pink panel appears at the right edge of the diamond quilt, glowing like a warm window in a cold building. White lamps blaze in a row at the top of the rig. The singer stands centre, microphone raised. Below, the crowd is visible as a bank of lit faces too small and too blurred to read, all turned toward the light.

bc92529938.alt: Vertical view of a screen with bands of white diamond patterns separated by black, singer and guitarist on stage below.
bc92529938.story: Stripes form next: a band of diamonds at the top, a block in the middle, another band below, with black gaps between, like the bars of a test card. The singer stands under it in blue and white. The crowd at the bottom has fallen back into shadow. White lamps still glow at the top.

3fcfe3bce9.alt: Vertical view of two columns of white diamond patterns on screen, the singer in a blue jacket and guitarist below.
3fcfe3bce9.story: Two tall columns of diamonds split the pattern, a sparse grid between them, like a pair of doors standing open. Spotlights flare overhead. The singer has moved slightly toward the right, a guitarist on the left. A lamp at the bottom of the stage sends a spray of white light across the floor. Heads in the crowd fill the lower edge.

6f2eccb05e.alt: Vertical view of a screen of soft pink and white diamond tiles, the singer at centre and a guitarist below.
6f2eccb05e.story: Pinker now, the diamonds shade from white to blush across the screen like light through frosted glass. The singer stands at centre, microphone up. At the bottom, the crowd's heads crowd into the frame, close and dark. Above, the lamps on the truss flare white. It is twenty-two minutes past seven.

eaf51c2d3d.alt: Stage with a bright starburst light at left, the singer at centre, screen panels with dotted grids and teal blocks.
eaf51c2d3d.story: Thirty-five seconds on, a lamp at the front of the stage flares straight out into the crowd and blooms into a huge white star, blurring the first rows into silhouettes. Above, the screen shows two teal blocks and two grids of white dots, set apart like a pair of eyes. The singer stands on the right, one arm raised, framed perfectly between them.

92ca92b620.alt: Band on stage below a large screen of white diamond tiles, the crowd in the foreground, a phone screen glowing.
92ca92b620.story: Fourteen seconds later the diamonds return across the whole screen, neat and bright, side panels glowing on each edge. The singer stands at centre in white trousers, a guitarist and a drummer visible. In the crowd, a phone screen glows pink, held up to record. It is the kind of frame that looks the same in every concert, and still nobody looks away.

aafe90dc3e.alt: Vertical view of a stage with a huge starburst lens flare at lower left, the singer small under a screen of diamonds.
aafe90dc3e.story: Another lamp fires and the flare is enormous now, a white star spilling across the lower left of the frame and washing half the crowd into haze. The singer stands small at centre under the diamond grid. Everything looks overexposed and pale, like a frame from a video tape that has been left too long in the sun.

329a464b01.alt: Vertical view of beams of light crossing over the stage, the singer at centre, pink glow on the screen at right.
329a464b01.story: Great diagonal sweeps of light now cross above the stage. A pink glow seeps from the right side of the screen. The singer stands at centre with the microphone. In the crowd, a few heads are lit from behind, outlined in soft white. The haze makes everything look like it is being seen through gauze.

3e99c6b6b0.alt: Vertical view of a screen of diamond grids above the singer standing in a white spotlight, crowd heads below.
3e99c6b6b0.story: A single bright spotlight finds the singer and pins them in a cone of white at centre stage. The diamond grids above have settled into an orderly checkerboard. Lamps burn in a row overhead. At the bottom of the frame a hand rises from the crowd, small and pale against the dark. The singer stands perfectly still.

c3acbb4671.alt: Band on stage under diamond-pattern screen panels, a close-up of the singer's blue sweatshirt at the right edge.
c3acbb4671.story: Neat panels of grid return, and two white dots glow on the right like headlamps. At the edge of the screen, the blue sweatshirt is cropped in close-up. The band stands in a row below: guitarist, singer, drums, bassist. The crowd fills the bottom in a dark wave, a few heads lit pink.

6a5436af64.alt: Band on stage below a screen of pink, orange and blue geometric diamonds, crowd silhouettes in front.
6a5436af64.story: Twenty-seven minutes past seven and the screen has burst into colour: pink and blue diamonds, thin orange lines slicing across them, like a kite caught in a lattice. The singer stands at centre in white trousers, a guitarist on each side. The crowd is close and dark in front, a phone screen here and there glowing like a small campfire.

6c6bac7732.alt: Band performing beneath bright blue and pink geometric graphics on screen, white beams lighting the stage edge.
6c6bac7732.story: Forty seconds later the diamonds have shifted, sliding over one another, blue and pink and orange slipping into new arrangements. White lamps flare at the stage's front edge and send beams over the crowd. The singer has moved closer to the front. In the audience, heads tilt up, outlined in blue. The whole picture has the cheer of a children's programme at half past seven.

98ce0831e0.alt: Crowd silhouettes and a raised hand in front of starburst stage lights and a screen showing a singer, hazy blue light.
98ce0831e0.story: The frame turns toward the crowd, and silhouettes fill it: a raised hand blurred mid-wave on the left, and at the top, the stage lamps burst into a cluster of white stars. The screen above shows the singer in close-up, small and distant. It is a picture made mostly of other people's shoulders, which is exactly how most of the field is seeing it.

ae24015387.alt: Band on stage below blue and pink geometric graphics with an orange diagonal streak, singer close-up at screen edge.
ae24015387.story: Twenty seconds later an orange streak slashes across the screen from upper left to lower right, like a comet passing through a pattern of tiles. On the right, the close-up of the singer in the white cap appears at the screen's edge. Below, the stage is lit softly pink. Guitarists play on both sides, and the crowd sways faintly in the darkness.

92c340d7b4.alt: Vertical view of a screen with the Movie on The Hill title over a pyramid, the singer standing alone on stage below.
92c340d7b4.story: Once more the pyramid ident appears, title glowing across the cloudy peak. The singer stands alone at centre stage, white trousers bright under the screen, the band behind fading into the dark. Blue lamps run along the top. It is the familiar station card, the one that keeps returning between segments, and this time it feels a little like a goodbye.

9995ea8d21.alt: Band performing below a screen showing a glowing red and orange sphere on a diamond background, purple stage light.
9995ea8d21.story: Purple takes the stage four minutes later, and a great glowing sphere hangs on the screen, red and orange swirling inside it like a planet seen through a telescope or a marble held to a lamp. A diamond of light frames it. Below, a singer with a red guitar stands at centre, flanked by two guitarists. The crowd is lit violet.

900c83114f.alt: Vertical view of a stage with a glowing red sphere on screen, a singer with a red guitar and bandmates below.
900c83114f.story: Stacked in the vertical frame is the whole column: pink lamps on the truss, the sphere glowing red and orange in the middle, and below it the band, the singer with the red guitar planted at centre. The crowd fills the bottom, a sea of heads lit purple. The sphere looks like it might roll off the screen and into the field.

0623c1fe5e.alt: Vertical view of a screen where the red sphere has dissolved into a faint blue outline, band performing below.
0623c1fe5e.story: Gone, or nearly: the sphere leaves only a thin outline, a crescent of red on the left and a few blue fragments scattered across where it was. Beams of white light slant through the haze. The band below hasn't moved. It is as though someone has turned the planet off and left only its ghost on the screen.

687357e867.alt: Band beneath a screen showing a glowing red and orange sphere framed by a diamond shape, crowd in the foreground.
687357e867.story: Whole and blazing, the sphere returns, red at the centre fading to orange and gold at the edges. The diamond frame glows around it. The band stands in a tidy line below, the red guitar catching the light. The crowd forms a long dark wave across the bottom of the frame, heads tilted up together.

01fc78c874.alt: Band on a purple stage under a screen showing the outline of a sphere and a bright red flare at left.
01fc78c874.story: Broken apart again, the sphere is traced in faint blue with a hot red-white flare bursting from the left edge. White beams shoot up from the stage. The singer at centre bends slightly over the red guitar. It looks like an eclipse, the bright edge of something round sliding behind something dark.

8f7e860a58.alt: Band performing on a purple stage beneath an empty violet screen, beams of white light rising through haze.
8f7e860a58.story: Eighty seconds later the screen is empty, just a wash of violet with a blue panel on the right. Beams of white light rise from the floor and cut through the haze in straight lines. The band stands in a row: guitarist, singer with the red guitar, drummer, bassist. Without any images to watch, the eye finally rests on the musicians.

884bc5a68f.alt: Stage and crowd bathed in deep red light, a band performing, white flecks drifting on the screen behind.
884bc5a68f.story: Thirty-six minutes later, the field has turned red. Everything is red: the stage, the haze, the hands raised in the crowd. White flecks drift across the dark screen like ash. A singer stands at centre, guitarists on each side. In the foreground, arms reach up holding phones. It is a quarter past eight, and the evening has changed channels entirely.

3ea0aa2031.alt: Stage with white light beams fanning upward through red haze, band performing, crowd with raised phones in front.
3ea0aa2031.story: White beams fan up from the stage floor through the red haze like searchlights over a city. On the left of the screen, a close-up of a guitarist flashes red. The singer stands at the centre microphone. In front, the crowd is on its feet, phones raised, one person in a white shirt standing out among the silhouettes.

b6ab6efecd.alt: Band on stage below a dark screen with white scratchy lines, crowd with raised arms in red light.
b6ab6efecd.story: Twenty-five seconds later the screen fills with scratchy white lines on black, like chalk on a slate or a film strip that has been scratched with a pin. The band stands under it in a dim red glow, the singer at centre. In the crowd, arms rise and phones glow. The images on the screen look handmade, almost childlike, against the polished lighting.

2dda4147dd.alt: Vertical view of a dark stage with orange lights along the truss, three musicians performing in dim light.
2dda4147dd.story: Everything dims at once. A line of orange lights burns along the top of the truss like a row of embers. The screen is dark, sprinkled faintly with white flecks. Three musicians stand far apart on the stage: a guitarist on the left, the singer in the middle, a bassist on the right. The crowd below is a black void.

6c22af8b94.alt: Vertical view of a stage glowing orange with a bright pale band of light across the screen, band and crowd below.
6c22af8b94.story: All at once the orange bursts into full light. A pale band blazes across the middle of the screen like a stripe of daylight, and the truss glows amber from end to end. Beams spray down onto the stage, where the singer stands with arm outstretched. In the crowd, hands rise up into the glow. The whole frame looks like it has caught fire.

b0c14c6450.alt: Vertical view of a stage in warm orange light, guitarists and singer performing, crowd with raised hands below.
b0c14c6450.story: Fading fast, the bright band on the screen leaves warm orange haze speckled with drifting white flecks. Amber lights glow on the truss. The guitarist on the left leans back with the instrument raised, while the singer stands at centre and a bassist plays on the right. In the crowd, hands remain raised, lit orange from above.

b47e9e221a.alt: Vertical view of a red-lit stage with spotlights fanning down, three musicians performing, crowd below.
b47e9e221a.story: Red lamps glare from the top of the truss and send thin white beams down onto the stage like the strings of a harp. Behind the band, the screen is dark and scattered with tiny flecks. Three musicians stand spaced across the front: two guitarists and the singer between them. The crowd below is a dark red sea, a few plastic chairs glinting among the heads.

3c0367a84d.alt: Band on stage below a screen of glitched red, pink and blue pixel blocks, singer gesturing with an arm out.
3c0367a84d.story: Thirty-seven seconds later the screen breaks into a glitch: red, pink and blue blocks smeared across the top as if the signal is being chewed by a faulty tape deck. The singer stands at centre with one arm extended to the side, pointing at someone in the crowd. Two guitarists flank the drums. Hands rise from the dark audience below.

48c128355a.alt: Band performing below a screen of glitched red and white pixel blocks, crowd with raised arms in the foreground.
48c128355a.story: Across the whole screen the glitch spreads, a mosaic of red squares and white flashes like a fire seen through a broken monitor. The singer stands still now, hands at the sides. The guitarists lean in. Below, the crowd is on its feet, some arms raised, a few plastic chairs visible between the bodies.

8826ad4e74.alt: Band on stage under a screen of red and white pixelated blocks, three musicians lit in white light.
8826ad4e74.story: Red blocks drift and rearrange, white light bleeding through them like sun through a torn curtain. The three musicians are lit cleanly now: the guitarist on the left bent over the strings, the singer at centre in dark clothes, the bassist on the right. The crowd below has faded into a black band across the bottom.

c3e9624d10.alt: Band on stage under a deep blue empty screen, crowd in the foreground lit blue.
c3e9624d10.story: Blue arrives, and the whole world goes with it. The screen is a flat, empty field of colour, the kind a set shows when there is no input. The band stands across the stage, each musician lit by a single lamp. The crowd fills the foreground, heads and raised hands washed the same cool blue. After all that red, it feels like stepping into water.

93d10e1c17.alt: Band on a blue-lit stage, the singer raising one arm, crowd with raised hands in the foreground.
93d10e1c17.story: Up goes one arm, the singer reaching toward the screen, and in the crowd below, a few hands rise in reply. The blue holds steady, filling everything. A guitarist on the left and a bassist on the right play on. The empty screen looks like a sky at dusk, a sky with nothing in it except whatever the music is making.

3683aff124.alt: Band performing beneath blue light beams and drifting orange sparks, crowd with raised arms in the foreground.
3683aff124.story: Beams of white light cut up through the blue, and small orange sparks float across the screen like embers rising from a campfire. The singer stands at centre with the microphone, a guitarist and a bassist on either side. In front, the crowd surges forward, arms up, faces turned to the light.

de59b0c85b.alt: Vertical view of a dark stage with a blurred blue screen showing a guitar neck and light streaks, band below.
de59b0c85b.story: Darkness and blue fragment the screen: a blurred guitar headstock on one side, white streaks on the other, a red dot glowing like a recording light. The truss above is ringed with blue lamps. Below, three figures play under the dim light. It is twenty past eight and the hill has been dark for two hours.

acb669ddca.alt: Vertical view of a screen with blue streaked panels above three musicians performing, blue lamps on the truss.
acb669ddca.story: Pale blue floods the right panel, a streak of light falling diagonally across it like a meteor. On the left, a guitarist in close-up is cropped at the edge. The band on stage stands evenly spaced, the singer at centre. Blue lamps glow along the top of the rig like a row of tuning lights.

4d389cfd66.alt: Vertical view of a stage with blue-lit screen panels, a singer at centre with one arm raised, two guitarists beside.
4d389cfd66.story: Panels shuffle again on the screen, a row of glinting lamps on one side, a pale blue cloud on the other. On stage, the singer lifts one arm to the head, as if pushing back hair or shading eyes from the lights. A guitarist on each side leans into the playing. Beams from the truss fall in thin blue lines.

f67cdabb91.alt: Vertical view of a stage under blue screen panels with a white cross shape of light, three musicians performing.
f67cdabb91.story: A pale cross of light appears on the right panel, a beam meeting a horizontal streak, like a crosshair waiting for something to line up. At its edge, a figure in a dark jacket slides into view. Below, the singer stands at centre, a guitarist on each side. The crowd is a dark, still mass at the bottom.

fe19218f16.alt: Screen split between a guitarist's hands on the strings and a blurred guitar headstock, band on stage below.
fe19218f16.story: Only parts appear on the screen now: a hand on the strings, a headstock in blur, cymbals, cables, steel. No faces at all. It looks like a documentary about the instruments rather than the people. Below, the real musicians stand in their pools of light, and the crowd sits in near-darkness, watching the close-ups of hands.

1223864e9c.alt: Screen showing the Movie on The Hill title over a pyramid and clouds, three musicians on the dim stage below.
1223864e9c.story: Sparks and clouds and the looping red title: the pyramid card returns. The three musicians below stand in near-darkness with instruments ready, shadows against the lit screen. The festival's station ident has appeared between every set tonight, faithful as a clock. The crowd is a dark field below, waiting for it to end.

113aa87210.alt: Band on a pink and purple stage beneath a screen showing a tilted glowing rectangle inside white corner brackets.
113aa87210.story: Inside a set of white corner brackets, a glowing shape tumbles across the screen, like an object caught in a focus frame. Pink and purple light floods the stage. A guitarist on the right raises an arm high. Small white crosses float along the bottom of the screen. The crowd is a soft, warm blur in the foreground.

9b6fb42355.alt: Screen showing the singer at a microphone, a spinning transparent ring and a guitarist close-up, band performing below.
9b6fb42355.story: Split into three, the screen shows the singer at a microphone on the left, a transparent ring spinning in the middle inside its focus brackets, and a light-haired guitarist on the right with one hand raised. Red streaks cut through the background. On the stage below, the musicians play in dim white light. The crowd is invisible in the dark.

a6012e9f6c.alt: Band on stage below a screen showing a glowing ring with an RGB glitch effect, a guitarist close-up at right.
a6012e9f6c.story: Two and a half minutes on, the ring has split into red, green and blue ghosts, the colour channels pulled apart like a badly tuned signal. A guitarist appears at the right of the screen, a white cross floating beside. Below, the stage is lit pink and the crowd is a dense dark mass, a few faces caught by the red glow at the front.

6a6532f352.alt: Vertical view of a glossy ring on screen with a PLAY label, pink lights above, three musicians performing below.
6a6532f352.story: Glossy silver and blue, the ring tilts toward the viewer like a bracelet catching light. The PLAY label sits in the corner. Pink lamps blaze across the truss. The guitarists play on either side of the singer, and the crowd presses up from the bottom of the frame in red-tinted shadow.

aab71f5b4d.alt: Vertical view of a screen with a fragmented ring and red streaks over a band close-up, pink lights above.
aab71f5b4d.story: Fragments are all that remain of the ring, blue and white shards floating across the screen with red streaks between. Close-ups of the guitarists sit in the corners. The pink lamps on the truss burn steadily. Below, the band holds its formation, three figures under white light. The screen seems to be taking something apart, slowly, one piece at a time.

1f93bdadab.alt: Band on a red-lit stage below a hazy red screen with a faint crosshair and AM 00:00 date stamp, crowd in red light.
1f93bdadab.story: Red covers everything. The screen is a hazy red wash with a thin circle at its centre like a viewfinder's crosshair, and in the corner the familiar date stamp: AM 00:00, Jan. 01 2000. The band plays beneath, and the crowd in front is lit red, arms raised. Midnight on the first day of a millennium, replayed one more time.

6e5ab13f7c.alt: Vertical view of a screen showing a blue sculpted head with a crosshair, PLAY label and timestamps, band below.
6e5ab13f7c.story: Three minutes on, a sculpted head fills the screen, rendered in shattered blue glass, a crosshair circle resting on its temple. PLAY glows in the corner, and the counter reads all zeros. Below, the band stands in a line under the rig. The crowd at the bottom has turned to dark silhouettes. The head stares off to the left, calm and enormous.

d928befe25.alt: Vertical view of a screen showing a pink and white sculpted head with a PLAY label, warm amber lights flaring.
d928befe25.story: Pink and white now, the head's surface shifts like crumpled foil. Warm amber lights flare at the top and bottom of the frame, spilling gold across the crowd's heads. The date stamp in the lower right is still there: Jan. 01 2000. The band plays beneath, three figures and a drummer, small in front of the giant face.

0a892bfb6e.alt: Vertical view of a screen showing a magenta sculpted head with a crosshair circle, red and pink lights above, band below.
0a892bfb6e.story: Deep magenta now, the head glows as if lit from inside. Red and pink lamps burn along the truss, and a single yellow star glints near the top. PLAY, says the corner, and the counter still says nothing has begun. Beneath the head, the band carries on, the singer at centre, guitars on either side.

5410bb43a4.alt: Vertical view of a screen showing a blue and white sculpted head with a PLAY label, band performing below.
5410bb43a4.story: Cooling back to blue and white, the head catches invisible light on its glass shards. The crosshair still rests on the temple. A pair of red lamps glow at the top of the rig like warning lights on a tower. Below, the band plays to a crowd that has dissolved into darkness. Somewhere, the tape keeps running from midnight, January first.

51512d7a93.alt: Band on an outdoor stage under a giant screen showing a chrome, glassy head in profile, crowd silhouetted below
51512d7a93.story: Half past eight, and the screen above the stage is wearing a face made of liquid chrome. A small clock in its corner reads AM 00:00, as if the show runs on a different night entirely. Below it, four musicians look tiny against the scaffold. The crowd is a dark field of heads, lit red at the edges, waiting for the first chord to land.

b971517760.alt: Same stage a moment later, the chrome head on the screen tinted pink and blue above the band and dark crowd
b971517760.story: Four seconds on, the metal head starts to blush. Pink seeps up through its neck while the blue drains from the brow, and the band below plays on as if nothing has changed. Haze drifts across the left speaker stack. Somewhere near the front a phone screen glows, small and white, a second broadcast inside the first.

7ca3b0c0dc.alt: Giant screen showing a red and magenta chrome head over a dimly lit band; the crowd has fallen into near darkness
7ca3b0c0dc.story: Now the face burns red, the whole sculpture gone magenta, and the floor lights drop away. The crowd disappears into black. Only the musicians remain, picked out in thin outlines against their amps and drum kit. It feels like the moment a channel switches over, the old picture still glowing while the new one has not arrived yet.

3967323d3d.alt: Band on a wide stage under pale searchlight beams and white haze, silhouetted crowd and chairs in front
3967323d3d.story: The screens go dark and the light turns to chalk. Two pale beams fan up from behind the scaffold, and the shadow of a rig spreads across the haze like a giant insect on the sky. Smoke rolls in from stage left. Plastic chairs sit empty near the front; everyone who owned them is standing now, watching three guitarists hold the line.

c4dab77a5b.alt: Band performing under two soft white light beams with a large lighting-rig shadow cast on the haze above
c4dab77a5b.story: Six seconds later the smoke has thinned and the stage sharpens. A guitarist leans into his instrument, a yellow body bright against the grey. The rig shadow still hangs overhead, enormous and patient. Up the hill, phones stay pocketed for once. The song has slowed, and the air carries that cool, damp smell that hillsides keep after dark.

7be9e13669.alt: Hazy blue stage washed in light, glittering particles on the screen and red light beams, heads of the crowd in soft focus
7be9e13669.story: By 8:38 the whole scene has gone blue and soft, as if seen through a frosted window. Sparks scatter across the screen like snow on a dead channel, crossed by two red beams. The band blurs into the glow. In the foreground, the backs of heads lean together, turned toward the light, close enough to feel the warmth off the stage.

73b6971e5b.alt: Band on stage beneath a large screen of red light beams and white sparkles on deep blue, crowd lit from the side
73b6971e5b.story: The picture snaps back into focus: red lines fall like rain down a blue screen, and a spray of white particles drifts across the top right corner. A floodlight flares at the edge of the crowd. Four players stand spaced along the stage, each in a private pool of light. Someone near the barrier raises a hand, then thinks better of it.

d619bd2733.alt: Angled view of the screen showing a raised arm and microphone stand, a strong starburst light flaring on the stage below
d619bd2733.story: The frame tilts and the singer is cut in half: a raised arm, a shoulder, the bend of a mic stand. A curved white line arcs across the screen like a scanline that forgot to finish. Down on the stage, one spotlight has turned straight into the crowd, a burst of rays sharp enough to leave an afterimage for a full song.

7b748f6178.alt: Stage washed in white haze and soft light, a singer in a white suit centre stage, band and keyboards around him
7b748f6178.story: White fog takes over as the screens fade. For a moment the stage looks like an old film reel left in the sun, washed out and grainy. The singer stands in the middle in a pale suit, arms at his sides, while the keyboard player and guitarists hold a single chord. Nobody in the crowd moves, as if motion might break the picture.

c51415d494.alt: Pink, glittering frame on the big screen around an empty dark centre, full band lit on stage beneath
c51415d494.story: Faces vanish, and the screen becomes a frame with nothing inside it. Pink sparkles crowd the border; magenta beams cross the empty black middle. Underneath, the whole band is finally visible at once, keyboards, drums, two guitars, the singer in white at the centre. It looks like a television waiting for its programme to begin.

8e10daf5ec.alt: Band on stage below a large screen framed by pink and white glitter around a black rectangle
8e10daf5ec.story: Half a minute on, the frame has cooled to violet. A small heap of something pale sits on the stage lip below the screen, maybe flowers. The guitarists angle their necks toward each other. With the giant face gone, the real people look larger somehow, lit warm against the black, and the crowd's phones rise in small grey squares.

a012ae298d.alt: Pink glitter border around a dark screen, the band playing in purple light below
a012ae298d.story: Eighteen seconds later, a hair closer. The glitter border has thickened, brighter on the right where a strip of pink light runs top to bottom. The singer has turned slightly toward the keyboards. Every musician wears pale trousers and dark shirts, as if a dress code went out by text that afternoon. The empty screen keeps humming above them.

88137462a4.alt: Big screen showing a wide shot of the band surrounded by blue and white sparkles, the same band lit on stage below
88137462a4.story: Here the screen shows the stage itself, sprinkled with blue and white confetti of light. The band appears twice: once up there, glittering and small, and once down here, lit purple and real. For a minute it is hard to tell which version is the live feed and which is the rerun. The singer stands in both, arms at his sides.

70ea488ce0.alt: Vertical frame of the stage with a screen of blue starbursts and sparkles, a smaller image of the stage within it
70ea488ce0.story: Blue stars fill the screen, and inside it sits another screen, and inside that the band again, shrinking toward a vanishing point. Purple bars glow at the top of the rig. The singer below raises a hand. It is twenty to ten and the hill has gone quiet in the way a room does just before a chorus comes back.

9916da7893.alt: Stage beneath a screen of blue starbursts and pink sparkles framing a smaller image of the band
9916da7893.story: The frame-inside-a-frame has settled. Pink flares bloom along the upper border, and a column of pink sparkle runs down the right side like a stuck pixel row. On the stage itself, the singer has stepped to centre and the keyboard player bends toward the keys. Someone in the crowd lifts a phone, adding a third copy of the scene.

a5415b1eac.alt: Wide view from the crowd: lighting towers, a blue screen showing a mountain silhouette, people standing in the dark
a5415b1eac.story: Step back and the machinery shows. Steel towers lean in from the left, each lamp throwing a cone of white down onto the field. The screen has gone to a blue mountain range, quiet as a screensaver. Between songs, people stand around in loose clumps, heads tipped toward the stage, waiting for the next transmission to come through.

ed1e24f0ce.alt: Vertical frame of the stage under pink and white truss lights, small band below a mostly dark screen
ed1e24f0ce.story: Up close the screens have gone dark, leaving only the steel truss and a row of pink and white lamps blazing like a motel sign. The band looks small down at the bottom of the frame: a hooded figure at the mic, a guitarist on a stool, desk fans spread along the boards. One glowing panel sits in the dark, showing just a sliver of someone's arm.

3470a5a950.alt: Green light beams fanning down from a steel truss into green haze, no performers visible
3470a5a950.story: Everything turns green. Lamps hang from the truss in a row, each shooting a beam down into a haze so thick it looks like water. No faces, no screens, no band, only light falling through smoke. It is twenty-five to eleven and for a few seconds the hill has become the bottom of an aquarium, quiet except for the bass.

da0c801113.alt: Vertical frame of the stage under green-tipped lights, a dim screen, two performers at the front of the stage
da0c801113.story: Ten seconds later, the view widens and tips upward. Green-tipped lamps sweep the dark sky above the truss. The screen holds a grey smear of static where a picture should be. Down at the front, the hooded performer and the guitarist face the crowd, small and steady, the fans at their feet still pointed inward.

01e6e14ce9.alt: Vertical frame of the stage with bright lamps above, a pale screen, two performers and a crowd raising phones
01e6e14ce9.story: Bright white lamps burn at the top of the frame, and a pale blank screen glows like a fridge door left open. On stage, the hooded performer lifts an arm toward the crowd. Behind the dark heads in front, a few phones go up. The song is ending, and everyone seems to know it at once.

d88a25b54c.alt: Big screen showing a Movie on The Hill logo over a blue sky with clouds and a stepped pyramid, stage dark below
d88a25b54c.story: Just after eleven, the show stops to say its own name. Movie on The Hill, spelled in red letters over a cartoon sky of blue and white clouds, sits above a stepped pyramid with Thai text across its face. A sponsor badge glows at the top. Underneath, the stage waits in the dark, a row of teal lamps marking the edge like runway lights.

78410d38c4.alt: Vertical frame of white light beams angling down from the truss over performers and a screen showing the crowd
78410d38c4.story: The lights tilt down in a row of white rods, each one striking the stage at the same angle like rain in a strong wind. Under them, performers jump and spread their arms. The screen shows the crowd again, a long glittering strip of faces and phone lights. Twenty past eleven, and the hill is still on its feet.

b8937bbb8f.alt: Café interior with a brick pillar, a person bending over a table of small toys near a window with Christmas decorations
b8937bbb8f.story: Across the room, past a brick pillar, someone bends over a table scattered with small coloured pieces, hands busy with something fiddly. The window behind is strung with paper Christmas trees, and a tinsel tree has been taped to the glass. Pendant lights hang low. The whole café has the feel of a long holiday afternoon with nowhere else to be.

6aea5de7c2.alt: Hands holding a phone showing a camera screen pointed at a person with a camera, colourful toy pieces on a wooden table
6aea5de7c2.story: A phone held in two hands is pointed across the table, and on its screen sits a person across the table, face hidden behind something held up to the eye. Coloured plastic pieces lie scattered on the wooden table below, some of them cubes. Two screens, one table, everyone aiming at everyone. It is a small loop of people watching each other watching, on a slow afternoon.

90fafe2447.alt: Silhouette of a person standing at the top of a white staircase beside a power pylon under a cloudy evening sky
90fafe2447.story: Seen from below, the staircase becomes a ramp into the clouds. Power lines run overhead, a steel pylon stands behind, and the figure at the top is only a black shape, head bent over a phone. The sky is turning peach at the edges. Sunflower leaves crowd the bottom of the frame, big and dark, like an audience in the stalls.

d3526c183a.alt: Silhouette on top of a white staircase framed by power lines and a pylon against a soft pink evening sky
d3526c183a.story: A step back, and the lines multiply. Cables cross the sky in long diagonals, pinned to the pylon like the strings of an instrument. The figure on top hasn't moved, still reading the phone. Pink clouds drift behind. A staircase to nowhere, a tower humming with power, and one person checking for signal at the highest point in the field.

00a5e0dcc5.alt: Person seen from behind sitting on a tree stump with a PUMA backpack, facing a field and a low setting sun
00a5e0dcc5.story: The day ends on a tree stump. Seen from behind, a figure sits with a black backpack marked PUMA, looking out over a field of grass gone gold and rust. The sun has dropped to the treeline, a soft white glare behind the leaves. Nothing happens. That seems to be the whole idea: sit, watch the light go, and say nothing.

15529a5c98.alt: Dim café interior looking toward a bright window with paper Christmas tree garland, a fan and a cat on the sill
15529a5c98.story: From the shadow of a brick pillar, the room opens onto a window full of afternoon. A row of paper Christmas trees, red and green, runs along the top of the glass, and a tinsel spiral hangs below. A grey fan stands guard by the wall. On the far sill, so small it is easy to miss, a ginger cat has claimed the best seat in the house.

289b406139.alt: Same café window from the shadows, Christmas garland and tinsel tree, a fan and a small cat on the sill
289b406139.story: Nothing has moved except the light. The fan stays still. The paper trees hang in their row. The cat on the sill has not shifted an inch, a small orange shape against the brightness of the street. In a dark room facing a bright window, everything outside looks like a screen showing a slow programme about a sunny day.

288041a606.alt: Ginger and white cat lying on a window ledge looking back, tinsel decoration and a blurred street outside
288041a606.story: Closer now, and the cat turns its head over one shoulder with a look of mild objection. It lies stretched on the stone ledge, white belly to the room, orange back to the street. Outside, shopfronts and parked motorbikes blur into pastel. A tinsel tree spirals down the glass, and a little white lantern sits at the end of the sill.

f29539798c.alt: Ginger and white cat on a window ledge, legs stretched out, looking straight ahead, tinsel above
f29539798c.story: Twenty-five seconds later, the cat has decided to face the room properly. Back legs stretched out long, front paws tucked, it stares straight ahead with the steady patience of a shopkeeper. Paper snowflakes cling to the window behind, though the street outside is clearly warm and bright. The tinsel above hangs like a green question mark.

72445f11ee.alt: Ginger and white cat on a window ledge with head tilted, tinsel decoration and blurred street behind
72445f11ee.story: A tilt of the head, ears up, as if it has heard its name from the kitchen. The pose is otherwise unchanged: one long leg out, tail curled behind, chin raised. Behind the glass a scooter sits parked in the blur. The lantern at the far end waits for evening. The cat waits for nothing in particular.

87830cdd0d.alt: Close profile of a ginger and white cat looking out a window at a blurred street, tinsel at the edge
87830cdd0d.story: In profile now, the cat has turned toward the street and gone very still, whiskers forward, the light catching the white of its chin. Something out there is worth watching: a bird, a scooter, a leaf. A loop of tinsel dangles in the top right corner. On the glass, a faint reflection of the room hangs over the street like a double exposure.

2dc7b4be5b.alt: Ginger and white cat lying on a ledge, looking straight at the viewer, blurred legs in the foreground
2dc7b4be5b.story: Once more it is looking back, straight across the afternoon. Its own tail and back legs drift across the foreground, soft and out of focus. The eyes are pale green and unbothered. Behind, a tinsel coil and a bright building wash out to white. The cat has been stared at before and seems to know how this works.

8e955cc45d.alt: Ginger and white cat sitting upright on a window sill, gazing out at a blurred street
8e955cc45d.story: Up on its haunches now, the cat sits tall at the glass, back to the room, gaze fixed on the street. The light is softer here, the buildings outside reduced to shapes of cream and rust. Its tail hangs down over the ledge. Twenty past three on a lazy afternoon, and this is the café's most dedicated window watcher.

fce04c22b5.alt: Black cat curled asleep in a round cardboard scratcher bed, wearing a red and white Santa hat, brick wall behind
fce04c22b5.story: In a corner by the brick, a black cat sleeps curled in a round cardboard bed, nose tucked into its own fur. Someone has fitted it with a red Santa hat, white pompom flopped to one side. The cat seems unaware of the costume, or past caring. A second scratcher pad leans against the wall, waiting for whoever wakes up first.

2b51e84cd2.alt: Black cat asleep in a Santa hat in a round cardboard bed, viewed slightly closer, brick wall behind
2b51e84cd2.story: Still the black cat has not moved, unless breathing counts. The Santa hat sits a little askew, the pompom resting on the edge of the cardboard ring. Pale light falls from the window to the right, warming the plaster where the bricks show through. It is the quietest frame of the afternoon: one hat, one cat, one long nap.

7b3567062b.alt: Ginger cat on a stool by a window in a café, blurred toys and a wooden train track in the foreground
7b3567062b.story: Elsewhere, the ginger cat has moved to a stool by the window, bending its head to sniff something on the seat. In the foreground, toys blur into colour: a blue tin, a wooden train track, a tiny red table. Paper trees and tinsel hang against the glass. It looks like a playroom that a cat has quietly taken over.

95e58ea84d.alt: Ginger cat on a stool in a café looking down, blurred blue tin and wooden toy track in front
95e58ea84d.story: The cat lifts its head, half turned toward the room, one paw braced on the stool. A sign shaped like a circle hangs on the brick column behind. The toy town in front stays out of focus, a blue tin standing like a skyscraper beside a curving wooden track. The cat surveys the scene, landlord of everything it can see.

67800a03e4.alt: Wooden table with two black skillet pans: a slab of toast with a fork, and fries with nuggets and ketchup
67800a03e4.story: Food arrives in cast-iron skillets, handles pointing the same way. One holds thick-cut toast, golden and crisp at the edges, a fork already resting against it. The other carries fries, a few breaded nuggets and a little bowl of ketchup. A phone lies face down at the corner of the table. Arms in black sleeves hover at the top, ready.

b914b33f2a.alt: View through an old wooden window frame of a sunflower field, with a white mascot statue on a pillar beyond
b914b33f2a.story: Twenty past five, and an old wooden window frame stands in a field with no wall around it. Through its panes: a crowd of sunflowers, most of them past their peak, and beyond them a white cartoon mascot grinning from the top of a pillar. The frame turns the view into a painting, or a television left switched on in the middle of nowhere.

b506d95c7f.alt: Field with a white staircase, a pile of white stones, sunflowers and a tall power pylon under a cloudy sky
b506d95c7f.story: The staircase from earlier stands at the edge of the field, empty now, its white steps leading to air. A ring of pale stones sits at its base. Behind, a steel pylon strings its wires across the evening, and clouds stretch thin above the trees. The sunflowers have bent their heads low. Everyone has climbed down, and the stairs simply wait.

09bf3369c4.alt: Three tall rough stone pillars in a garden ringed by hedges and white stones, cloudy sky and trees behind
09bf3369c4.story: Three rough pillars of pale stone rise from a ring of clipped hedges, the tallest one topped with a small floodlight. White pebbles mark the border of the path. The sky is a flat dove grey, the hills a faint blue line behind the trees. Without a sign, the stones could be anything: a monument, a joke, a set left over from a film.

f11e6f9e76.alt: Open dry grass field with a small colourful playground, trees and power lines under an overcast evening sky
f11e6f9e76.story: At the far end of a dry field, a playground sits by itself: a red frame, a blue slide, a yellow ramp, all small against the trees. Nobody is on it. Power lines cross the sky in thin bands, and a bare tree spreads its branches on the right. The light has gone soft and colourless, the hour when parks are emptiest.

dcb34411cf.alt: Field of drooping, dried sunflowers in rows, a sloped lawn, trees and a small orange hut behind
dcb34411cf.story: The sunflowers have given up looking at the sun. Row after row hangs its heads, petals gone to brown paper, stalks leaning like tired commuters. Beyond them a lawn slopes up to tall pale trees and a small orange hut. Late afternoon has flattened the colours to straw and moss. The field feels like the end of a long broadcast day.

b1c71bd353.alt: Rows of drooping sunflowers beside a grassy track, a pylon at the edge and trees on the horizon
b1c71bd353.story: A tractor track runs between two blocks of sunflowers, grass grown soft in the middle. The flowers on the left lean toward it in one long bowing line. At the far edge of the frame, a pylon leg rises into a cloudy sky. A few trees stand on the horizon like people waiting for a bus that comes once a day.

6c5988e486.alt: Flat field with a dirt clearing, sunflower rows in the distance and a mountain range under a pale sky
6c5988e486.story: Turn the other way and the land opens out. A dirt clearing, a strip of green grass, the dark line of the sunflower rows, and then the mountains, low and blue, laid across the horizon like a sleeping animal. The sky is one wide sheet of cream cloud. Twenty past five, and the only movement is a faint wind through the stalks.

bc25a35336.alt: Low mountain range on the horizon beneath a broad sky of pale grey and pink clouds, dark fields in front
bc25a35336.story: Thirteen seconds later the frame tips up, and the sky takes most of it. Long bands of grey and blush drift over the ridge. The hills beneath have gone almost black, their outline sharp as cut paper. The fields at the bottom are just a dark shelf. It is the kind of evening that looks like a test card before the night schedule begins.

1e700568f1.alt: Dirt path past dry sunflowers, a wooden bench and sign, playground and power lines in the distance under cloud
1e700568f1.story: A wooden bench sits alone beside the path, facing the dried sunflowers as if they might put on a show. A board on a post stands next to it, too far to read. Behind, the playground glows with tiny dots of colour, and power lines sweep across the sky toward a distant pylon. A heap of white stones marks the corner of the track.

9ceffc75b5.alt: White globe sculpture on a dark pillar beside large trees, a colourful mural wall and an open field under clouds
9ceffc75b5.story: The white mascot appears again, this time a globe-headed figure on a black pillar, a little sprout on top. Below it, a low wall is painted in bright murals. Two great trees spread their branches to the left, almost bare. A corner of white board pokes into the frame at the bottom, the edge of something unseen.

f65d38c98b.alt: Vertical view of a steel power pylon and sweeping cables against a pink and blue evening sky, dark shrubs below
f65d38c98b.story: Wires fan out across the sky in long, lazy curves, all of them gathered by one steel pylon standing in the dark scrub. The clouds behind are brushed pink and pale blue, the last of the day. From down here the tower looks less like infrastructure and more like an antenna, waiting to pick up whatever the evening is transmitting.

5b9d561d99.alt: Close-up of a drooping, dried sunflower head with wilted yellow petals and broad green leaves
5b9d561d99.story: Close enough to count the seeds. A single sunflower head hangs face down, heavy and brown, a few yellow petals still clinging on like the last of a fringe. A small green bug, or a curled leaf, sits on top. Big leaves fold around the stem, edges already curling. Behind it, more flowers bow in soft focus, all in the same direction.

47d617bd0f.alt: Garden of curving hedges and white stone borders, a rough stone pillar at the edge and mountains under evening cloud
