47d617bd0f.story: Nearly half past five, and white stones curl across the dry ground in loose spirals, edging small round hedges that look freshly trimmed. A stone pillar leans into the frame on the right. Electricity poles line the far side of the field, and beyond them the mountains sit faint and blue. The sun has slipped behind cloud, leaving a pale glow just above the trees.

c389b499f7.alt: Tall weathered stone pillars rising behind clipped hedges and white stone borders, evening sky behind
c389b499f7.story: Next, the stones step into the centre. Two of them stand together, tall and pitted, one with its top broken off into a sharp shoulder. They might be old, or made to look old; nothing nearby says. The low sun lights the cloud behind them. A line of white pebbles curls past their feet like a chalk mark.

d52d8d2972.alt: Soft-focus close-up of a single feathery grass plume arching over a blurred green and brown field
d52d8d2972.story: One stem of grass bends across the frame, its plume as fine as a strand of hair. Everything else melts away into green and rust. In the cool of the evening it barely moves, though a breeze must be passing somewhere. After all the big skies and towers, it is a small thing to stop for, and somehow the most precise.

545300bb22.alt: Open lawn at dusk with a long open-sided shelter, poles and mountains under a pale cloudy sky
545300bb22.story: Twenty-nine minutes past five, and the lawn has emptied. A long open-sided shelter stands at the far edge, roof flat, tables in shadow. Power poles run along the horizon. The mountains are a pale blue band under a sky gone the colour of milky tea. A few white stones curl in from the left corner, the end of a path.

e9c83afcbe.alt: Silhouetted power poles and wires against a sunset sky with dark clouds, trees and an open field below
e9c83afcbe.story: The poles have turned to silhouettes. Wires sag from one to the next, sketching black lines across a sky streaked with orange and slate. Under the trees the field is already dark, a small sign glowing white near the base of a pole. Half past five, and the light is leaving fast, pulling the colour out of everything below the horizon.

dcf3019908.alt: Vertical view of a long arch tunnel of climbing vines over a reddish dirt path, light at the far end
dcf3019908.story: The vine tunnel from earlier, now seen straight down its length. A red dirt path runs to a point, framed by metal hoops thick with leaves. Light gathers at the far end like the glow of a screen in a dark room. The ground is dry and bare in the middle, worn by feet. It invites a walk, and promises nothing about where it ends.

8e558b49d9.alt: Trees and young palms around a shallow pond with sandy banks, the setting sun glowing through the leaves
8e558b49d9.story: At twenty to six the sun slips down behind the trees, a single bright bead in the leaves. Below, a shallow pond sits in its sandy bank, nearly hidden by trunks and a young palm. The light comes in low and orange, catching the bark. It is the hour when the mosquitoes start to rise and the frogs clear their throats.

cb935eb467.alt: Shallow pond with a rock and what looks like a tortoise, a young palm and a tree trunk in the foreground
cb935eb467.story: Closer to the water now. A pale rock sits in the middle of the pond, and on it rests what looks like a tortoise, still as an ornament. A young palm spreads its fronds on the right, and a smooth trunk cuts down the left edge. Behind, the vegetable beds stretch away in neat rows. Nothing here is in a hurry.

9ae1eb243f.alt: Sun shining low through a grove of slender trees, warm light on reddish soil and leaves
9ae1eb243f.story: The last sun pushes straight through the grove, turning the gaps between trunks into windows of white gold. Everything it touches goes amber: the red soil, a twist of vine, the undersides of the leaves. A thin hose runs across the ground at the left. Fifteen minutes more, maybe less, and the whole scene will switch to grey.

7f9ca109f8.alt: Vertical view of a grassy path beside trees covered in orange-yellow blossoms, dusk sky above
7f9ca109f8.story: A row of trees blazes on the right, heavy with orange-yellow blossoms, and fallen flowers carpet the edge of the grass path below them. On the left, the field stretches to a few lone trees under a sky gone pale and quiet. It is nearly twenty to six. The colour of the blooms seems to hold the last of the day, long after the sun has gone.

e8a334b02f.alt: Field of grass at dusk with a tree of orange-yellow blossoms at the right edge and scattered trees on the horizon
e8a334b02f.story: The blossom tree leans into the right edge of the frame, its flowers lit like embers. Everything else has cooled: a pale lavender sky, a line of thin trees, the field going from green to dry gold in soft bands. A faint path of fallen petals runs along the grass. The evening is still deciding whether to stay pink or fade to grey.

c850bb19e9.alt: Sun setting between two silhouetted trees on a horizon, a wide dark field in front under pink and cream clouds
c850bb19e9.story: The sun drops into the gap between two trees, a single bright coin balanced on the horizon. The field in front has gone dark and furry, grass and weeds blurred together. A white car sits tiny on a far road. Above, clouds spread in long cream layers, warm underneath. Quarter to six, and the light is being switched off one row at a time.

b7c082a5bc.alt: Same sunset view a few seconds later, sun lower between silhouetted trees, field in shadow
b7c082a5bc.story: Lower still, the coin has slipped a little lower and the glow spreads sideways along the treeline. The far mountains show as a grey ridge on the left. The field gives back almost nothing now, a dark mat of green and rust. Seen frame after frame, the sunset begins to feel like a slow fade on an old set.

6f3fd98232.alt: Sunset glowing behind silhouetted trees on the horizon, wide pale sky with soft clouds, darkened field
6f3fd98232.story: Soon the sun is barely a point behind the trunks, a bead of orange caught between branches. The sky above has lifted into a wide wash of cream and pale violet. A few thin clouds drift low over the mountains. Down in the field, a strip of lighter grass marks where a path might cross.

29637735bf.alt: Vertical frame of a sunset behind trees, tall pale sky above and dark grassy field below
29637735bf.story: Turned on end, the same scene becomes mostly sky, tall and soft, with the sunset pressed into a thin band near the bottom. Two round trees frame the last of the light. The field below darkens toward the edge of the frame, grass heads catching a faint gold. Somewhere a dog barks, and the sound carries a long way.

60b4b554e4.alt: Mountains and silhouetted trees on the horizon after sunset, a wide sky of cream and grey clouds, dark field
60b4b554e4.story: No sun now. What remains is a soft orange smudge behind the trees and a long range of mountains turned to blue shadow on the left. Clouds hang in layers, lit faintly from below. The field is dark all the way to the treeline. It looks like the screen just after a programme ends, before the next one starts.

c01daed1bf.alt: Road lined with orange-blossomed trees beside a ploughed field, mountains and a pale sky in the distance
c01daed1bf.story: A narrow road runs off beside a line of blossom trees, all of them orange-gold and heavy. To the right, a field has been ploughed into neat furrows. A small figure walks far down the road, almost lost. The mountains sit low on the horizon. Fallen petals lie along the verge like a thin trail of paint.

a01d1a9645.alt: Pink and cream clouds over a silhouetted line of trees after sunset, with a dark field in front
a01d1a9645.story: The clouds catch fire after the fact. Pink spreads across the whole sky, warm at the bottom, fading to grey higher up. The trees stand in a dark row, a white car parked small beneath them. The field below has lost its colour entirely. Quarter to six, and the best light of the day has arrived just after everyone stopped expecting it.

429658f4a0.alt: Vertical frame of orange-blossomed trees along a path beside furrowed fields, pink sky and mountains beyond
429658f4a0.story: Upright now, the blossom trees curve away down the road, their colour deepening as the sky turns pink above them. A ploughed field runs in diagonal lines in the foreground, soil dark and soft. The mountains at the back look painted on. A small cluster of yellow flowers grows close by, catching the very last light on the ground.

64dfae1f32.alt: Straight paved road lined on both sides by trees with orange-yellow blossoms, power lines overhead
64dfae1f32.story: Straight down the middle of the road: a pale strip of asphalt between two rows of blossom trees, all of them bright orange-yellow against a fading sky. Fallen flowers drift onto the verges. Power lines hang overhead. Nobody is coming, nobody is going. It looks like a road built for exactly this frame, and then left for the trees.

94f47070a0.alt: Close-up of a cluster of trumpet-shaped yellow flowers on a branch, a blurred field and sky behind
94f47070a0.story: Close in, the blossoms turn out to be little trumpets, bright yellow and slightly ruffled at the lips, hanging in a loose bunch from a slender stem. The field behind has melted into soft green and orange. One flower points straight at the ground. Ten to six, and they are still the brightest thing for a mile.

6785fd0a67.alt: Vertical view of a narrow road between blossom trees and a power pole under a pale evening sky
6785fd0a67.story: The road again, now in blue-grey dusk. A concrete pole with a street lamp stands on the left, its wires running away overhead. The blossom trees have lost their glow and gone a muted olive, petals still scattered along the edges. The lamp is not on yet. In a few minutes it will be, and the road will look completely different.

16d6193e0d.alt: Close-up of a bright yellow cluster of trumpet-shaped flowers among green leaves, blurred blossoms behind
16d6193e0d.story: A last look at the flowers before the light goes. The cluster glows deep yellow against serrated green leaves, and more blooms blur behind it like distant lamps. A small bud points upward from the top, not yet open. The colours have a velvet quality now, as if turned down a notch on a dial.

a87e1d58d1.alt: Tall grasses with small yellow flowers growing beside a dark hedge, a blue pipe at the bottom, evening sky
a87e1d58d1.story: Wild stalks crowd the edge of the field, tall and pale green, dotted with tiny yellow flowers. Behind them, a dark wall of shrubs and the shape of a tree against a creamy sky. A blue pipe runs along the ground, half hidden in the grass. It is the kind of corner nobody plants on purpose, and it is doing very well.

62bcd78c6d.alt: Lone palm tree on the horizon of a dark field under a broad blue-grey evening sky with pink clouds
62bcd78c6d.story: One palm stands alone on the far horizon, its crown a small dark starburst against the sky. Everything below is shadow. The clouds above are blue-grey, with streaks of pink fading out at the edges. It feels like an image from a weather report, broadcast at the end of the night to a room nobody is watching.

9b5e52f516.alt: Dirt track leading between dark fields toward a lone palm tree, a blossom tree at the right under a dusk sky
9b5e52f516.story: A dirt track bends off between two dark fields toward that same lone palm. On the right, a blossom tree leans in, its yellow gone dull in the dusk. The sky is pale and bruised blue. The track looks freshly worn, two ruts and a hump of grass. It leads somewhere, presumably, though from here it seems to stop at the palm.

54632ba198.alt: Vertical view of a paved road leading between tall trees and green verges under a pale grey evening sky
54632ba198.story: Three minutes past six, and the colours have gone soft and grey. A paved road runs straight ahead between grassy verges, tall trees rising on either side. A pylon peeks out far in the distance. Somewhere along the road, two small figures walk toward the trees. The air has the stillness of early evening, when birds settle and the crickets begin.

e4c08d380c.alt: Two people seen from behind walking along a paved road between trees, one in a white shirt, one in black
e4c08d380c.story: Two people walk side by side down the middle of the road, backs turned, one in a white T-shirt and dark shorts, the other in black with lighter shorts. Their steps fall nearly in sync. Bare trees and a few late blossoms line the way. Nobody is in a hurry; the road has been theirs for the whole of the evening.

7e40f3f565.alt: Dark field of leafy crops under a pale pink and grey sky, a hill and a few trees on the horizon
7e40f3f565.story: Attention turns to the field. Leafy crops stand in a thick dark mass, a small green sign pushed into the soil at the left. A hill rises against the last pink at the horizon, a pylon visible on its shoulder. The sky above has gone milky. The day is very nearly over.

70b78b176a.alt: Silhouetted branches hung with long seed pods against a blue-grey sky, dark treetops below
70b78b176a.story: The final frame looks up. Branches cross the sky in thin black lines, and from them hang long, curved seed pods like strips of paper left to dry. The sky is blue-grey and even. A dark row of treetops fills the bottom edge. It is past six now, and the shapes are all that remain, the colour having signed off for the night.

a4f9cf9e28.alt: Small campfire smoking among logs and tree stumps on dry grass at dusk, a wooden bench behind
a4f9cf9e28.story: The fire is still deciding whether to catch. A few branches lean together between two stumps, red embers glowing underneath, and a pale column of smoke drifts off to the right. Dry grass spreads all around, flattened by feet. A low wooden bench waits in the background. Twenty-five past six, and the smell of woodsmoke has already reached everyone.

762f6243b5.alt: Person in jeans turning meat with tongs on a metal grill, foil packets on the grate, table of food behind
762f6243b5.story: Tongs flip a slab of meat on a mesh grill, a parcel of foil steaming beside it. The cook leans in, jeans and a pale pink tee, a shoulder caught in the warm light. At the back, someone in sandals reaches across a table laden with bowls and bags. A round stool stands empty nearby. Dinner is underway, more or less.

6cab76671c.alt: Two dogs wandering on dry grass between empty camping chairs, warm lamplight and trees at dusk
6cab76671c.story: The dogs have arrived to supervise. One pale, one dark, they wander between two empty camping chairs, noses down, checking whether anything has fallen yet. The ground glows amber under the lamps. Thin trees stand around like guests who came early. On the far hill, lights shine in a broken line across the dusk.

25c525a9da.alt: String lights between trees and a palm-like tree at dusk, a dark dog lying on the ground below
25c525a9da.story: Strings of bulbs swing between the trunks, small warm globes against a sky fading from peach to indigo. A feathery palm catches the light on its fronds. Down at the bottom of the frame, a dark dog has curled up on the ground, done for the evening. The far hills hold their scattered lights, a slow, quiet transmission from the valley.

7eba61df0b.alt: Group of people standing around a table and campfire on a dry lawn at dusk, smoke rising, trees behind
7eba61df0b.story: Smoke rises in a long column behind the group, white against the dark trees. Someone in a jacket printed with white lettering walks away toward the table; another stands with hands in pockets; two more sit near the fire. A blue tarp lies crumpled in the grass. The last orange hangs on the horizon. Twenty-seven past six, and dinner is not yet ready.

e740b6d5c3.alt: Vertical portrait of a person in a dark jacket and chain necklace, smoky golden haze and lights behind
e740b6d5c3.story: The smoke thickens, filling the background with golden fog. He has turned slightly, chin down, eyes still steady. A thin chain catches the light at his collar. The bulbs behind have melted into the haze, two or three left visible like distant headlights on a foggy road. It feels later than twenty to seven.

ef35c47010.alt: Brown dog standing on a dirt yard under string lights and drifting smoke, thin trees and distant lights behind
ef35c47010.story: The brown dog has taken the centre of the yard, standing square on all four legs, ears up, waiting to be noticed. Smoke drifts through the string lights above, turning the bulbs into small suns. Stones line a narrow path. A plastic jug lies on its side near the edge. Far off, the valley lights glitter like a switched-on dial.

dc5af1917b.alt: Vertical frame of a person in a dark hoodie and shorts standing barefoot on stones under smoky string lights
dc5af1917b.story: In the same patch of yard, a figure in a dark hoodie and shorts now stands where the dog was, barefoot on a flat stone, holding up a phone. The smoke has thickened into a golden cloud behind, and the bulbs glow through it. A thin tree stands to one side, almost leafless. It looks like a scene from a late film nobody remembers the name of.

68449eaead.alt: Grill with meat and foil packets beside a table of drinks and a tyre, a parked white car behind
68449eaead.story: Another round on the grill: pale slabs of meat, a foil packet at the end, the mesh stained dark from earlier batches. A table behind holds cups, a roll of paper, a red cooler. An old tyre leans against it, and a white car stands parked in the shadows. In the corner, a big green bowl waits for whatever comes off next.

c5c673df88.alt: Vertical close view of meat and foil packets on a charcoal grill, coals glowing orange beneath
c5c673df88.story: From above, the coals are fully awake, orange through the mesh. Three foil parcels sit in a row at the top, then thin slices of meat, curling at the edges as they cook. A blue tarp lies in the dirt beyond, and someone's arm hangs at the edge of the frame. It is quarter to seven, the hour when the food finally starts to look like dinner.

688c18ed22.alt: Wide night view of a smoky lawn under a single floodlight, people by a grill, a dog and hay bales nearby
688c18ed22.story: Pulled back to a distance, the whole camp sits in one pool of floodlight. Smoke rolls sideways from the grill, two people standing in it, a dog at their heels. Hay bales and a blue tarp lie scattered across the dry grass. A metal pole rises into the black sky with the lamp at its top. Beyond the light, there is nothing at all.

7bfe523f64.alt: Bright streetlamp glowing on a pole against a black night sky, bare branches and wires around it
7bfe523f64.story: Look up and the lamp is everything: a white burst of light on a thin pole, bright enough to blur at the edges. Wires cross underneath, and bare branches reach into the black around it like static on an empty channel. Quarter to seven. Moths are probably already circling, though from down here only the glow is visible.

2098c6d88a.alt: View from a hotel balcony of tall pine-like trees, a pavilion roof and lawn beside a calm grey sea
2098c6d88a.story: On the first afternoon, at half past two, the balcony rail leads the eye straight out to sea. Tall feathery trees stand in a row along the shore, a little pavilion roof tucked between them with a glass lantern on top. The water is flat and grey-green under a pale sky. Below, the lawn waits, freshly cut, not a footprint on it yet.

356c26e984.alt: Green lawn leading to a seawall lined with tall trees, a small white umbrella and two figures by the water
356c26e984.story: Below the balcony lies the lawn: a long carpet of green ending at the seawall, where a white umbrella shades an orange lounger. Two small figures stand by the water at the right, looking out. Trees lean gently in the breeze. The sea beyond is so still it could be a painted backdrop on a studio set.

2d6432a485.alt: Garden of lawns, palms and paths framed by dark leafy branches, the sea and a white building beyond
2d6432a485.story: Through a frame of dark leaves, the garden opens out: paths curving between beds of red flowers, small palms, a white villa at the right and the sea glinting through the gaps. A branch hangs low across the top as if pulling a curtain back. Nobody is out yet. The afternoon is hot and the grounds have the hush of a hotel at siesta.

df4499d882.alt: Vertical view of a hotel room hallway with beds, a cabinet, a white ottoman and a dark wooden door
df4499d882.story: A clean sweep of tiled floor runs from the bed to the dark wooden door. Towels sit folded into a little sculpture on the pillow. A white ottoman, a turquoise wall, an air-conditioner mounted high, a cabinet already cluttered with bags and bottles. Twenty-nine minutes past two. The room has the brief, perfect tidiness of a place nobody has properly unpacked into yet.

e740bf218b.alt: Calm blue-grey sea stretching to a flat horizon under a soft, cloudy evening sky
e740bf218b.story: Ten past five, and the sea gets a frame to itself. Nothing but water, steel blue and gently ruffled, meeting a pale sky along one perfectly straight line. A few clouds drift high and thin. No boats, no swimmers, no gulls. It looks like the picture a television shows between programmes, calm and endless, while the next one loads.

bf1ae8d058.alt: Vertical view of a lawn with a single dark sun lounger and towel, pool, hedges and hotel balconies behind
bf1ae8d058.story: A single lounger has been left in the middle of the sand, a white towel thrown over its back like a flag. Behind it, a pool glints between hedges, and two more people lie stretched out on chairs near the palms. The hotel's white balconies climb up the left edge. The grass in front is thick and very green, almost too green.

ad5b8022a7.alt: Seawall running along the water's edge toward distant hills and buildings, trees and lamps on the right
ad5b8022a7.story: The seawall draws a long grey line along the water, curving off toward a far shore where buildings and low hills rise out of the haze. Waves slap at the concrete, small and regular. On the right, trees and a lamp post stand in deep shadow. The sky is turning the colour of a peach left on a windowsill. Quarter past five.

c48e5f8b9e.alt: Vertical frame of a carved stone elephant sitting on a seawall above the beach, sea and pink sky behind
c48e5f8b9e.story: A stone elephant sits on the wall, trunk curled down, facing the sea as if waiting for something to come in on the tide. Its surface is pitted and sandy, soft at the edges. Below the wall, the waves break white on a narrow strip of beach. The sky above has gone pink and blue, pastel as a postcard left too long in the sun.

eb95ec0739.alt: Stone elephant sculpture in the foreground on a seawall, waves and palm trees along the shore under evening clouds
eb95ec0739.story: From a step away, the elephant fills the foreground, close enough to see the carved folds of its ears and the worn line of its back. A smaller figure seems tucked beneath its trunk. Beyond, the beach curves away to palms and white buildings, and the sea rolls in, grey and steady. The elephant does not turn to look.

f9c73bf717.alt: Dark silhouette of a multi-storey hotel building and palm tree against a soft evening sky
f9c73bf717.story: The hotel has gone into silhouette. Stacked balconies, a low glass-fronted wing, a palm tree flaring at the right, all of it dark against a sky of lavender and cream. One window at ground level shows a faint glow. Eighteen past five and the building looks like a cardboard cut-out propped against the clouds.

c9025c02d1.alt: Vertical view of calm sea with small waves breaking near the shore under a pale, softly clouded evening sky
c9025c02d1.story: Five twenty, and the view tips down to the waves themselves. Low swells come in one after another, grey-blue and unhurried, breaking into a thin line of white at the bottom of the frame. The sky above is cream fading to blue. The rhythm is so regular it could set a clock, or put a whole room to sleep.

32e3b66392.alt: Close-up of bright magenta bougainvillea flowers among green leaves, blurred blooms behind
32e3b66392.story: A bush of bougainvillea has caught the last of the light, every papery bract a hot magenta against the green. Tiny white flowers sit at the centre of each cluster, small as pinheads. Behind, more blooms blur into a pink haze. After so much grey sea and sky, it lands like someone turning the colour dial all the way up.

fdec1678db.alt: Seawall and grassy promenade along the shore, palms and colourful flags at the left, broken concrete in the water
fdec1678db.story: Along the promenade, a row of small coloured flags flutters beside the palms, red, blue and orange. The seawall runs off into the distance, and in the shallows, broken slabs of old concrete lie scattered like dominoes knocked over. The sky has a few dark clouds moving in. Twenty-three past five, and the wind is picking up off the water.

dc678740de.alt: White multi-storey hotel with rows of balconies, a pool area with loungers and a lawn in front
dc678740de.story: In full view, the hotel shows its face: five floors of white balconies in identical rows, each with a sliding door and a railing. Below, dark loungers line a pool, and a couple of small figures move across the lawn. A plumeria tree frames the left. It looks like the establishing shot of a sitcom that never got past the pilot.

5cb18b22fe.alt: Vertical frame of colourful wooden fishing boats moored in a narrow muddy creek, overhanging tree branches above
5cb18b22fe.story: Twenty-seven past five, round the back of everything, a narrow creek holds a row of wooden fishing boats, painted blue, orange and red, their masts strung with flags and rope. The water is low and the mud shows along the banks. Branches hang down from above like a theatre curtain. This is where the sea does its actual work.

c92aac943c.alt: Seawall path along a calm sea at dusk, a dark pine and small white gazebo on the right, distant figures
c92aac943c.story: Half past five, and the seawall is already handing its colour back to the sky. A dark pine leans over the path, a small white gazebo sits under it, and a few figures gather at the far end where the light is still warm. The sea keeps its slow rhythm against the concrete, rehearsing for a night it has done many times.

1fc7b299f3.alt: Pastel evening sky over the sea, an eroded sandy shore and concrete wall in the foreground
1fc7b299f3.story: Low tide has left the shore scored and uneven, with slabs of old concrete half buried in the sand. Above it the clouds stretch thin, peach underneath and blue on top. Nobody is walking here. A few trees hold the corner of the frame while the horizon goes soft, as if the evening were lowering its volume one notch at a time.

66d47253e1.alt: Low modern house with glass windows behind a wide green lawn, palm trees and a pale pink sky
66d47253e1.story: The lawn runs out flat and empty toward a low house with tall glass panes. Inside, curtains are half drawn and one lamp glows amber. Palms stand on either side like quiet attendants, and the sky above has turned the pink of a test card left on too long. Somebody will step out soon to call others in for dinner.

2289d2e8c6.alt: Blue sky with a white contrail and wispy clouds above the dark corner of a multi-storey building
2289d2e8c6.story: Look up from the hotel and the sky is busy. A contrail cuts a straight white line through clouds that are doing the opposite, curling and fraying in every direction. The building below has gone to silhouette, balconies stacked in shadow. Somewhere up there a plane is already far away, its message left behind for anyone who glances skyward before dark.

794c259207.alt: Woman in a sun hat and long white skirt standing on a lawn facing a white house with a parked car
794c259207.story: She stands alone in the middle of the grass, sun hat on, a bag at her hip, looking toward the white house as though checking whether it is the right one. Trees frame the scene from above. A car waits in the driveway, flowers sit in a tidy bed, and the evening air feels close and still enough to hear the sea behind.

23cccbd26f.alt: Empty green lawn in front of a white two-storey house with a parked car, framed by overhanging trees
23cccbd26f.story: A few seconds later the lawn is empty. Bare patches in the grass mark where people usually cut across. The white house holds its position, curtains drawn, a car parked out front, the flowerbed glowing faintly red. Only the branches overhead move. It looks like the same channel with the presenter gone, the set left running for whoever tunes in next.

09bfcc7439.alt: Lawn under tall trees leading to white seaside gazebos at dusk, small groups of people sitting by the water
09bfcc7439.story: Under the trees the grass is already dark, while the gazebos by the water still catch the last pale light. Small groups sit along the edge in twos and threes. One figure crouches on the lawn, maybe tying a shoe, maybe watching the horizon. A red bin stands to one side, the brightest object in sight, like a stray pixel in the dusk.

8e3b0a2059.alt: Silhouetted trees above white gazebos and benches by the sea, people sitting along the shore in evening light
8e3b0a2059.story: Shift a few steps along and the same shore offers a different arrangement. Two people sit on a low bench facing the water, close enough to talk quietly. The gazebos are mostly empty now. The trunks of the trees bend at odd angles, as though they too had leaned in to listen. The sea is flat and silver, giving nothing away.

5a60f2a59d.alt: Small white propeller plane parked on a lawn beside a paved seafront walkway at dusk
5a60f2a59d.story: A small white propeller plane sits on a square of lawn by the sea, wings level, going nowhere. The paving around it is stained and patched with moss. Behind it a house with a grey roof catches the soft evening light. It has the look of something that landed years ago, decided it liked the view, and simply never left again.

2751c465d7.alt: Warmly lit hotel corridor with a wall lamp, potted plant, white pebble seats and a small candle on a table
2751c465d7.story: The corridor runs away into a row of ceiling lights, each one a small moon. Near the entrance a lantern-shaped lamp glows on a pillar, a potted plant leans toward it, and two white pebble seats wait on the tiles. On a low round table a single candle burns in a glass. It feels like a set waiting for its next scene to begin.

6a36fb0bc3.alt: Orange and black golf cart parked on a driveway beside trimmed hedges and a pale pink building
6a36fb0bc3.story: Parked by the hedges, the orange golf cart looks ready for a short trip that never comes. Its rear bench faces backward, as if passengers should watch where they have been instead. Rounded shrubs crowd the pink wall, a white van rests in the corner, and a small sign stands in the grass. Evening light flattens everything into soft, quiet colour.

aa68f205d6.alt: Woman in a white dress standing on a lawn beneath a grey jet fighter mounted on a pedestal in front of an apartment block
aa68f205d6.story: Morning, a little after nine. A grey jet hangs nose-up above the lawn on its concrete stand, and she stands just beneath it in a loose white dress, arms at her sides. Her shadow falls short on the grass. Behind her, balconies and air-conditioning units stack up the building. The plane looks frozen mid-takeoff, the morning held perfectly still around it.

0690bb8416.alt: Side view of a grey jet fighter mounted on a pedestal, its pointed nose aimed across the frame toward trees
0690bb8416.story: Turned sideways, the jet shows its full profile: sharp nose cone, closed canopy, intake like an open mouth. Morning light slides along the grey fuselage and picks out faded numbers. Behind it the building is all horizontal lines and boxy air conditioners. A green bush crowds the corner. The plane looks almost patient, aimed at a horizon it will never cross.

aff374d985.alt: Woman in a white dress standing on a grassy verge by a road, facing away toward trees and a house
aff374d985.story: Across the road she stands on the verge with her back turned, looking at flowering trees and a house half hidden behind them. A yellow-striped crossing runs at her feet. Power lines loop overhead. It is still early, the light clean and green, and the street is empty enough that the whole scene feels like a pause between programmes.

6814b20df4.alt: Close view of a grey jet fighter cockpit and nose with the number 23125, yellow flowers in the corner
6814b20df4.story: Up close the jet shows its wear. Paint is scuffed along the nose, the canopy glass has gone slightly cloudy, and the number 23125 is stencilled in black beneath the cockpit. A branch of yellow flowers pushes in from the corner as if trying to claim it. The sky behind is white and blank, a pale screen awaiting a signal.

abd6a58d26.alt: Two jagged limestone cliffs with patches of green under a pale sky, a small red sign stand below
abd6a58d26.story: Past noon, and the day has moved inland. Two pale limestone walls rise on either side, streaked orange and mottled with shrubs clinging to every ledge. Between them the sky opens thin and bright. A small red sign stands at the bottom, too far to read. The rock looks carved by something patient that has since wandered off.

95981fd8bf.alt: Paved area beneath limestone cliffs, a red and white gateway tower and a few visitors walking toward it
95981fd8bf.story: The paved lot leads toward a red and white tower that marks the start of a bridge. A handful of visitors drift toward it in no particular order. Behind them the cliff fills almost the whole sky, grey and orange and green. Flowers spill along the low wall. Everything is waiting for the next coach to arrive and fill it.

a064935f4c.alt: Road leading between steep rock walls toward a spire of limestone, blue umbrellas and small groups of people
a064935f4c.story: The road narrows between rock faces, and at the far end a single spire of limestone stands up like a raised finger. Blue umbrellas cluster at its base, shading food stalls or tired walkers. Someone on the left carries an umbrella of their own against the flat white sky. The tarmac is damp and grey, and the distance feels longer than it is.

1824abfd6e.alt: Large rounded limestone mountain covered in greenery above a still green lake, rocks in the foreground
1824abfd6e.story: The mountain fills the frame, a great dome of pale rock patched with trees, its reflection laid down in green water. A few rocks at the bank sit close enough to touch. Far off, a small boat drifts near the shore. The lake is so still it seems to be holding a second, upside-down mountain just underneath the surface.

0e2ca1a9c4.alt: Limestone cliffs with dense trees reflected in a calm green lake, reeds on the left and a small pedal boat
0e2ca1a9c4.story: Reeds stand thick along one bank while the cliff runs across the top of the frame like a stage set. The water is an even, milky green. A lone pedal boat inches across the middle, small enough to miss. The sky is a flat white. Nothing urgent is happening anywhere in this picture, and that seems to suit everyone in it.

197441c7e3.alt: Limestone cliff above a landscaped garden with scattered rocks, shrubs and a tall lamp post
197441c7e3.story: On the dry side of the lake, a garden has been arranged in front of the cliff: scattered rocks, rounded shrubs, a narrow path where two visitors walk. A tall lamp post stands among the trees, waiting for evening. The cliff face shows rust-coloured streaks where water must run in the wet months. Heavy air, soft light, distant voices.

15a52dbc27.alt: Tall limestone peak above a lake, a wooden boardwalk with railings stretching across the water with people on it
15a52dbc27.story: A wooden boardwalk reaches out across the water toward the peak, and a few figures stand at its end leaning on the rails. Reeds rise in a dense green patch just beyond them. The mountain behind is all angles, ledges and stubborn trees. Its reflection breaks into soft ripples near the walkway, where someone's footsteps must have just passed by.

1cafaa2d5d.alt: Two dark, tree-covered cliff faces forming a V-shaped gap against an overcast sky
1cafaa2d5d.story: Look straight up between the two cliffs and the sky becomes a pale wedge. Trees cling along both edges, dark against the white. One lonely tree stands on the far rim, almost in silhouette. The rock in shadow takes on a cool grey. It is the kind of view that makes a neck ache and makes the ground feel quieter.

830c15258d.alt: Single steep limestone crag rising above dark green lake water, tiny yellow pedal boats near its base
830c15258d.story: Alone above the water, the crag rises like a ship's prow, pale stone streaked with lichen and topped with a small crown of trees. Near its foot, tiny yellow pedal boats sit motionless, their riders resting in the shade. The lake swallows the reflection whole. Overhead, clouds sit low and white, not threatening rain yet, just considering it.

7554629233.alt: Wide green lake with a pointed rock spire between cliffs, visitors gathered along a distant shoreline
7554629233.story: Here the whole set comes into view: two cliffs at the edges, a pointed spire in the middle, the lake stretching out in front. Along the far shore, visitors gather on a pale spit of land, too small to make out. A red umbrella marks one group. The water is calm enough that every rock appears twice, once up and once down.

a80669eae9.alt: Pale limestone cliffs and a rock spire reflected in dark green lake water, vertical frame
a80669eae9.story: Turned upright, the scene stacks itself into layers: water, trees, cliff, sky. The rock walls lean slightly inward and their reflections lean back out. Close to the bank the water is darker, almost black. Small specks of colour near the far shore hint at boats or people. It feels like a postcard printed slightly out of register, soft at the edges.

5abbdf57b5.alt: Arched suspension bridge with a red and white tower crossing a lake toward a limestone cliff, people on the bridge
5abbdf57b5.story: The suspension bridge arches over the water toward the cliff, its red and white tower standing at the near end like a gate. Cables slope down in long lines. A crowd waits at the foot of the bridge, some under umbrellas. The rock face behind is enormous and bright, making the whole structure look like a model someone set down carefully.

379ce4cb46.alt: Orange tiled boardwalk with wooden railings leading toward a lush limestone cliff, a few people walking
379ce4cb46.story: The boardwalk is a bright orange stripe through the green, its wooden railings running alongside like guide rails. A man in black walks away down the middle; two others stroll further ahead. The cliff above is dense with trees right up to its broken top. The tiles are slightly glossy, perhaps from an earlier shower, reflecting a dim white sky.

23850400c8.alt: Pointed limestone spire between two cliffs mirrored in a still green lake, vertical frame
23850400c8.story: The lake lies so flat here that the spire seems to pierce both the sky and the water. Cliffs close in from each side like curtains, leaving the pointed rock alone at the centre of the stage. Trees cluster at the waterline. There is no wind on the surface at all. The scene could be a still frame from a late broadcast.

472b1c6422.alt: Lake with tall reeds in the foreground, a pointed rock spire and cliffs reflected in the water
472b1c6422.story: Step back and tall reeds slide into the foreground, blurring the bottom edge. The spire still holds the centre, with cliffs to the left and right, and the reflection now stretches toward the reeds as a long pale smear. On the far shore people move around a picnic spot. Somewhere a pedal boat creaks, its bell rung once by restless hands.

a9d0240238.alt: Curving paved walkway with wooden railings, a woman in a sun hat walking ahead, green hill under blue sky
a9d0240238.story: Blue sky breaks through for a moment, and the walkway curves ahead in a fan of patterned bricks. A woman in a sun hat and long skirt walks away toward the trees, unhurried. The railings run beside her on both sides. The hill rises steep and green on the right, with bare rock showing at its crown. It is a fine stretch for wandering.

f3b925feed.alt: Wooden-railed walkway curving through tall grass toward two forested hills, a figure in a hat in the distance
f3b925feed.story: Tall grass crowds the railings here, gold at the tips, green at the roots. The walkway bends out of sight between the hills, and a small figure in a hat stands at the bend as if waiting for the others to catch up. A thatched shelter peeks from the trees. Clouds drift through the gap, white on blue, unhurried.

90787216df.alt: Dark green lake bordered by tall grass and trees, a swan-shaped pedal boat on the water, cliff above
90787216df.story: A swan-shaped pedal boat paddles slowly across the dark water, its white neck the only bright thing on the lake. Grass grows thick and wild in the foreground, nearly waist-high. Trees climb the slope behind, and the pale cliff breaks through at the top. Somewhere on that boat, legs are working harder than the swan's calm expression suggests.

63125d419f.alt: Top of a limestone crag with two small trees on its peak against a large cloudy sky
63125d419f.story: Most of the frame is cloud, soft and heaped like a pillow left in the sun. At the bottom a limestone peak pushes up, and right at its summit two small trees stand side by side. Nobody planted them there. They simply arrived and stayed, the way some signals reach a set when nothing should be broadcasting at all.

fb3faea51a.alt: Overgrown base of a rock face with shrubs, scattered rubble and bright tall grass in the foreground
fb3faea51a.story: Away from the water, the base of the cliff is a tangle. Shrubs push out from cracks in the rock, loose stones pile up where they have fallen, and a lighter rock sits in the middle of the clearing like something dropped. The grass in front is bright and tall, almost electric green. Insects are probably louder here than anything else.

7b39a77cd6.alt: Monkey sitting on a concrete ledge beside a wooden railing, looking out over green water
7b39a77cd6.story: A monkey has claimed the outside edge of the railing, crouched on the narrow concrete ledge with the green water just below. It is looking away, toward something only it can see across the lake. Its tail hangs loose. The wooden handrail cuts down the frame in a long diagonal, and the reflections in the water barely move.

0b8cd36c61.alt: Orange tiled walkway curving beside a metal railing under trees, a small monkey sitting far along the path
0b8cd36c61.story: The walkway curves under the trees, orange tiles bright in the shade, the railing running ahead in a long rusty line. Far down the path a small grey shape sits in the middle: one of the local monkeys, waiting. A white shoulder enters from the left edge. The next few minutes clearly belong to whoever reaches the bend first.

7f40d5b020.alt: Monkey sitting on the ground at the base of a metal railing next to a concrete pillar, green water behind
7f40d5b020.story: Up close, the monkey has wedged itself between the railing bars, one leg stretched out, one hand gripping the metal. It looks straight ahead with an expression somewhere between boredom and suspicion. The concrete pillar beside it is spotted with lichen. Dark green water fills the background. It seems to be deciding whether visitors are worth getting up for.

b56fa76340.alt: Monkey sitting on a patterned paved floor by a railing, eating something next to a torn plastic bag
b56fa76340.story: The decision has been made. The monkey sits on the patterned paving with a torn plastic bag at its side, holding something orange in both hands and eating with total focus. The railing behind it is thick with leaves. Whatever the snack was, it did not belong to the monkey a minute ago, and nobody nearby seems eager to argue.

421b22018a.alt: Monkey sitting on curved brick paving beside a railing, raising food to its mouth, tail stretched behind
421b22018a.story: Now it has moved a little to the left, closer to the pillar, tail laid out behind like a dropped rope. The food goes up to its mouth in small, careful bites. Leaves rustle on the far side of the railing. The brick paving fans out in circles around it, as though the whole walkway had been designed as a stage for exactly this.

31220c055c.alt: Monkey seated on circular brick paving facing forward, chewing, metal railing and dense leaves behind
31220c055c.story: It faces forward now, chewing, cheeks full, eyes half lidded. The railing stands neatly behind it, its rust and white paint flaking in even patches. The bricks under it form arcs that radiate outward. There is something almost formal about the pose, like a portrait sitter who agreed to hold still only as long as the snack lasts.

7c4f339356.alt: Monkey sitting on brick paving with hands on the ground, looking to the side, railing and greenery behind
7c4f339356.story: Snack finished. The monkey sits with both hands planted on the bricks, glancing sideways at someone passing just out of frame, perhaps judging their pockets. The railing and leaves behind it look exactly as they did a few minutes ago. Only the bag is gone. The show is over, though nobody has told the audience yet, and it seems in no hurry.

648c70ec84.alt: Green lake beneath tree-covered cliffs, a pale rock in the water and a small yellow pedal boat
648c70ec84.story: Back by the water, the lake spreads wide under the cliffs. A pale rock breaks the surface on the right, smooth as a loaf of bread. A small pedal boat with a yellow canopy idles near the far bank. The trees grow so thick along the shore that the cliffs only show at the very top, bleached and broken.

a036a733c8.alt: Woman in a white dress seen from behind, standing at a railing looking out over a green lake toward cliffs
a036a733c8.story: Turned away now, she looks out at the lake, one hand on the rail and the hem of her dress lifting slightly in the wind. Her hair falls straight down her back. The trees on the far shore lean over the water. The scene goes quiet in that way views do, when a person finally stops posing and simply looks for a while.

0feddea3b0.alt: Woman in a white dress from behind at a lakeside railing, a small pedal boat crossing the water ahead of her
0feddea3b0.story: The pedal boat has moved further into the middle, and she watches it from the railing, hands at her sides. The dress hangs loose and still. Green trees climb the bank opposite, rocks showing between them. Everything is in the same place as a moment ago except the boat, and the boat is in no hurry at all.

2717c898c9.alt: Green lake with a small pale rock island and a pedal boat beneath a limestone cliff and partly cloudy sky
2717c898c9.story: A rail edge from the boardwalk corner pokes into the bottom of the frame. Out on the lake a pale rock rises like a resting turtle, and a pedal boat floats beyond it. The cliff above has caught some sun and looks almost white. Patches of blue sky open overhead, the first in a while, quickly closing again.

781a1cc293.alt: Vertical view of a green lake with a pale rock and pedal boat, cliffs and trees under a cloudy blue sky
781a1cc293.story: Turned on its side, the lake becomes a long ribbon of green leading up to the cliff. The rock island sits in the lower middle, and the little boat has hardly moved. Reeds frame both edges. Clouds gather and part above the stone ridge. It is the kind of view that changes slowly enough to watch for an hour without noticing.

77ce27d5fe.alt: Monkey sitting with legs stretched out on patterned paving in front of a rusty railing, looking toward the viewer
77ce27d5fe.story: Another monkey, or perhaps the same one, sits on the paving with both legs splayed out in front of it like someone resting after a long walk. It looks straight ahead with a calm, heavy stare. The railing behind is rusty and peeling, green water shining through the bars. The bricks around it make a pattern of small squares and fans.

d6f21cd18c.alt: Lakeside boardwalk with visitors under umbrellas, a man in black walking, limestone cliffs and a rock spire behind
d6f21cd18c.story: Umbrellas come out along the boardwalk, pink and grey, more for the sun than the rain. A man in black walks toward the group, a cap pulled low. Tall grasses brush the railing. Behind them the cliffs rise steep and pale, and a narrow spire stands between them. The air feels heavy, the kind that makes everyone walk a little slower.

b7237517ae.alt: Wooden railed boardwalk curving across a marshy lake toward a tall limestone peak under a pale sky
b7237517ae.story: In a long curve across the marsh, the boardwalk swings out, its railing drawing a clean line through the reeds. At the end of the curve a few tiny figures stand under the cliff. The water between the boards and the peak is still and grassy. The sky is pale enough to blend into the rock, softening every edge.

cc86d6196d.alt: Grassy bank on a calm green lake, dense trees and a corner of cliff above, water reflecting greenery
cc86d6196d.story: At this end the lake goes shallow and soft at the edges. A grassy bank slides into the water, and some of the grass lies flattened as if something heavy rested there overnight. Trees close in tightly above, with a corner of cliff showing through. Reflections pool in the dark water below. It is quiet enough to hear the reeds tick.

36e5342802.alt: Red and white bridge tower rising from a lake, people with umbrellas standing on the walkway between its columns
36e5342802.story: Seen from below, the bridge tower is all thick white columns and red beams, rising out of the green water. On the deck between them, visitors gather at the rail, umbrellas open, looking down. Cables run off to the sides. The scene has a slightly theatrical feel, like a balcony waiting for an announcement that keeps getting delayed.

2610be4497.alt: Pointed rock spire rising above trees and a still lake, a small pavilion on the shore and an overcast sky
2610be4497.story: The spire stands tall above a low line of trees, like a spike placed on a cake. Beneath it a small pavilion with a red roof sits at the water's edge. The lake is grey-green and calm. A branch pokes into the right side of the frame. The overcast sky makes everything a little muted, quiet as the station after midnight.

1d4331e19b.alt: Flock of pigeons on a gravel shore by a lake, visitors with pink and white umbrellas standing nearby
1d4331e19b.story: Pigeons have gathered on the pale gravel shore, dozens of them, pecking at whatever visitors have tossed down. A few people stand at the water's edge under pink and white umbrellas. One crouches low with an outstretched hand. Behind them the lake runs to the cliffs. The birds keep a cautious distance, close enough to eat, far enough to flee.

2942b9fcb2.alt: Brown wading bird standing on a pale rock in a green lake, a second rock below it, cliff in the background
2942b9fcb2.story: People gone, the bird gets its moment. It stands on a pale rock in the lake, brown and hunched, neck tucked in, watching the water. A second rock sits just beneath it. The cliff behind is out of focus, a grey wall. Grass blades lean into the bottom corner. The bird does not move, and neither does anything else.

28e0f7d381.alt: Brown wading bird perched on a pale rock in a calm green lake, trees and limestone cliff behind
28e0f7d381.story: Wider now, the bird sits on its rock in the middle of a green lake, the cliff stretching across the top of the frame with trees bunched at its foot. Small ripples spread around the stones. The bird has turned its head slightly, aware of something nearby. It is a patient sort of standoff, the bird winning by doing absolutely nothing.

e161a0360a.alt: Brown wading bird standing on a rock in a green lake, looking to the left, cliff wall behind
e161a0360a.story: A little closer still. The bird has shifted its weight and now looks left, its beak pointing toward the bank. The rock beneath it is pale and smooth, and the second stone below is half sunk. Green water ripples outward in soft lines. Overhead the cliff waits in shadow. A fish must be somewhere nearby, unaware of how closely it is being watched.

35ac9e25d2.alt: Visitors with an umbrella feeding pigeons on a lakeshore, cliffs and a cloudy blue sky behind
35ac9e25d2.story: Back on the shore, a small group feeds the pigeons, one bent low with a handful of something, another holding a pink umbrella. Birds scatter around their feet in a grey crowd. The lake opens out behind them toward the cliffs, and white clouds billow up into a patch of blue. A small pavilion sits on the far side, empty.

5efb1ffa58.alt: Road between rocky cliffs leading toward two pointed limestone spires, groups of visitors walking
5efb1ffa58.story: Heading back, the road runs between rock walls, and at its end two pointed spires rise like a pair of teeth. Groups of visitors stroll in both directions, some with bags, one with a small child. Trees lean in from the right. The light is flat and warm. It is the slow return part of the day, when everyone walks a little looser.

d1d4b1e5b3.alt: Woman in a white dress standing in profile on a rock ledge, looking out, hill and red sign box behind
d1d4b1e5b3.story: A quarter turn, and now she stands in profile on the ledge, gazing out across the valley rather than toward the frame. The white dress catches what light there is. Her hands rest at her sides. Behind her the hill keeps its shape. The pose holds for a beat, then she will step down, and the rock will be empty again.

cd18100a51.alt: Wide parking area under an overcast sky, tall trees, cars and a small stall with umbrellas at the edge
cd18100a51.story: Back at the car park the sky has darkened to a heavy grey. Tall trees stand over the wide empty tarmac. At the far edge a small stall with a blue roof and a red umbrella does slow business. A few cars are parked in a line. The day's adventure is ending, and the air feels like rain might finally keep its promise.

a2ea0eaa9c.alt: Road junction with a white bus parked under an overcast sky, striped road markings, trees and power lines
a2ea0eaa9c.story: A white bus with blue stripes waits at the side of the road, engine perhaps idling. Striped markings fan out across the tarmac like a static pattern. Power lines cross the grey sky. A tall pole stands with a tangle of cables at its top. Palm trees and low roofs line the street. The ride home is about to begin.

7544cd4717.alt: High view over a lake with a suspension bridge and red and white towers, rounded limestone crags and flowering shrubs
7544cd4717.story: From higher ground, the whole place lays itself out like a model: the lake, the red and white bridge towers, the rounded crags with green caps. Visitors cluster on a sandy spit. A road winds in on the left. Red and yellow flowers bloom in the foreground, blurred. The clouds have settled low and pale, softening every outline below them.

939ff4b6ac.alt: Elevated view of a large green-capped crag above a lake, bridge towers on the left, flowering shrubs in front
939ff4b6ac.story: A slight turn to the right and the biggest crag takes centre stage, its top thick with trees like a head of hair. The bridge towers sit at the left edge now. The lake curves along the bottom of the cliffs, pale and still. Flowers in the foreground glow red and yellow. It looks like a painted backdrop from an old variety show.

bf06f393ee.alt: Lake with bridge towers and three limestone crags seen from above, flowering bushes in the foreground
bf06f393ee.story: A third look from the same vantage. The bridge, the crags, the lake, the people on the shore, all still in place. Small boats drift near the far bank. The flowers in front have shifted a little in the breeze. Repeating a view like this is how people try to keep it, frame after frame, before turning back.

22079c2372.alt: Wide view of a lake with a bridge, people on the shore, pedal boats, and three tree-capped limestone crags
22079c2372.story: A final wide look before leaving. The lake is dotted with pedal boats, the bridge stretches out from its red and white tower, and people are scattered along the shore like tiny marks. Three crags sit in a row behind them. Red flowers bloom at the bottom right. The whole valley is quiet in the afternoon haze, signing off for the day.

7cae7d655f.alt: Bright interior with a decorated Christmas tree, wooden pillars, glass walls and sunlit floor under a canvas ceiling
7cae7d655f.story: Late afternoon pours in sideways through the tall glass panels and lies across the floor in warm strips. A Christmas tree stands on a round wooden base, red baubles and wrapped boxes beneath. Wooden stools and a carved table sit in the light. The canvas ceiling glows above. Outside, trees wait in green. The room smells faintly of coffee.

4b81717a4a.alt: Sunlit room with a Christmas tree on a wooden plinth, glass walls, cushioned bench and wooden furniture
4b81717a4a.story: One small step to the side, and the ceiling lamp appears at the top, a woven shade catching the glow. The tree stands in the corner, its baubles turning gold in the sun. Cushions line the bench by the windows. Everything wooden seems to shine. It is the last week of November, and the decorations have clearly arrived early.

62b548ac41.alt: Tall leaning mirror reflecting a sunlit room, small Santa figurines at its base, white stools and a glass table
62b548ac41.story: A tall mirror leans against a pillar, holding a slice of the bright room inside it. At its base two small Santa figurines stand guard in red coats. White stools and a glass-topped table catch the light beyond. The windows show green hills. In the mirror the room seems slightly more golden than the real one, as mirrors often are.

13c95b4eb8.alt: Glass-topped table and cushioned sofa beside tall windows, wooden chairs on a sunlit terrace outside
13c95b4eb8.story: Through the glass wall the terrace glows, wooden chairs set out in the sun, a bamboo screen of trees behind them. Inside, a glass-topped table catches reflections and a sofa sits heaped with leafy cushions. The window frames divide the view into tall panels, like a row of screens all tuned to the same garden channel.

be15cae6e9.alt: Wooden deck in low sunlight with slatted lounge chairs and small tables, garden and wooded hill beyond
be15cae6e9.story: Deck chairs sit in a row, their slatted seats tipped back, each one lit gold by the low sun. Small round tables wait between them. Long shadows stretch across the boards. Beyond the railing a lawn runs out to a hedge and a wooded hill. It is just before four, and the day has turned soft.

aa2ac66529.alt: Small pond with reeds and lush plants, a dark driftwood sculpture on a lawn beyond, trees behind
aa2ac66529.story: Down by the pond, reeds poke through dark water and the bank is thick with low green leaves. Across the lawn, a black twisted log sits on the grass like a sleeping animal. Young trees are held up by wooden props. The light is clear and bright, and the water reflects a sky that has not yet begun to change colour.

0341fa9bed.alt: Garden with canvas shade sails, wooden lounge chairs on a lawn, a pond and young trees in sunlight
0341fa9bed.story: Canvas sails are strung between the trees, shading two wooden chairs that face the lawn. The pond in the corner holds a patch of blue. Thin young trees stand in the foreground, their leaves backlit. Rope lines run in all directions. It feels like a garden set up for a gathering that has not quite started yet.

0be653bf65.alt: Canvas-roofed pavilion across a sunny lawn, seen between tall slender tree trunks and young plants
0be653bf65.story: Between tall thin trunks, the pavilion sits across the lawn under its canvas roof, warm light inside, tables set. Young trees, each tied to a wooden support, stand in rows in front. A blue haze softens the hills behind. The scene is layered like a stage with wings, the main set waiting in the middle distance.

f741768496.alt: Wooden deck with white horse-shaped seats beneath dark angled poles and a canvas canopy, garden beyond
f741768496.story: Three white horse-shaped seats stand in a row on the deck, ears up, waiting for small riders. Dark poles cut diagonally across the frame, holding up the canvas roof. Beyond the boards a stone path winds through the garden. The horses look oddly patient, as if they have been told to stay and are taking it seriously.

c4062f54d9.alt: Narrow stream running between lush green banks toward a small wooden footbridge under trees
c4062f54d9.story: A narrow stream runs between two banks thick with green, its water dark and clear. White stones line the edges. Further along, a wooden footbridge crosses it under the trees. Sunlight lands on the far side of the bank. A small breeze moves the tops of the leaves, and the water barely ripples. It is a good place to stop.

3f8367b0f6.alt: Stream between grassy banks leading to a footbridge, a person in a red shirt crossing the bridge
3f8367b0f6.story: Someone in a red shirt crosses the footbridge just as the stream comes into view, a bright dot in a world of green. The banks on either side are mounded and lush. Stones line the water. Trees rise behind, sunlit on one side. The red shirt is gone a second later, and the stream returns to its quiet trickle.

aadfae7ea4.alt: Stream between green banks leading toward a canvas tent and garden, tall leafy trees overhead
aadfae7ea4.story: Looking the other way along the stream, a white canvas tent appears on the far bank, its point catching the sun. People move in the shade beyond it. The banks are lush and rounded, and the water shines dark between them. Tall trees spread overhead. It looks like a picnic just out of earshot, laughter carrying faintly over the water.

b9e96f8b4b.alt: Canvas-roofed pavilion on a sunlit lawn, striped poufs set out on the grass, tall trees behind
b9e96f8b4b.story: The sun has slipped lower, and it now shines straight into the frame from behind the trees, washing the sky out to white. The pavilion sits in a pool of warm light, its canvas roof glowing. Striped poufs dot the lawn in front. The grass looks like gold thread. Everything feels like late afternoon on a slow weekend.

3666690f1e.alt: Calm pond reflecting trees and sky, a long footbridge strung with lights in the distance
3666690f1e.story: The pond is perfectly still, holding a mirror image of every tree on the bank. In the distance a long footbridge stretches across, strung with small flags or lights. The sky is clear blue fading to white at the edges. Nothing moves except perhaps a dragonfly. It looks like a test pattern made entirely of leaves and water.

6fca2a0843.alt: Lawn with a circular stone fire pit, young trees on props and a forested hill beneath a blue sky
6fca2a0843.story: A circular fire pit sits on the lawn, cold for now, a bowl of iron on pale stone. Young trees stand around it on wooden props. A hedge runs along the back, and behind that a hill rises, green and rocky. The sky is clear blue. Later, someone will light it, and everyone will drag their chairs in close.

ec221a1367.alt: Stream winding between lush green banks toward a wooden footbridge, trees lit by low sun
ec221a1367.story: Back to the stream, now in deeper light. The banks are thick and bright, the water dark and slow, stones edging it in a neat white line. The footbridge crosses at the far end beneath trees lit gold on one side. The sky above is pale blue. Half an hour has passed, and nothing here has hurried.

daea7346d0.alt: Sunlit deck with white horse-shaped seats and wooden chairs beside tall glass doors, a dark pole slanting across
daea7346d0.story: Sunlight on the deck catches the white horse seats and turns them into glowing shapes. Wooden chairs sit against the glass doors. A thick dark pole slants across the middle of the frame, splitting it in two. Inside, through the glass, a bookshelf and cushions are visible. The horses stand facing away, as if listening for something.

32f991d825.alt: Rope swings hanging from a canvas canopy over a grassy path, leading toward a thatched hut
32f991d825.story: Long ropes hang down from the canvas canopy, swings waiting at their ends, empty. A worn path runs between a hedge and a row of young trees toward a thatched hut at the end. Sunlight comes through the leaves in patches. It is the kind of walk that invites a slower pace and a short detour on every swing.

f41388d042.alt: Woven baskets mounted on a warm yellow wall above a dark cabinet with dried branches, a mirror and vases
f41388d042.story: Woven baskets cover the wall in a loose cluster, patterned in rust, cream and brown. Below them a dark wooden cabinet holds dried branches, a small mirror and a pair of vases. A wicker chair waits at the corner. The wall is painted a warm yellow that makes everything feel sunlit, even though the light here is indirect.

1de131ec74.alt: Café corner with woven baskets on a yellow wall, a dark cabinet, wicker chairs and a small round table
1de131ec74.story: Wider, the corner turns into a room: wicker chairs gathered around a small round table, a tiny potted plant at its centre. The baskets hang above the cabinet like a collection of suns. A wall light glows on the pillar. The floor is smooth and grey. It is the kind of corner someone chooses on purpose and stays in.

8342d62b7d.alt: Round wooden table with a croissant, a small fruit-topped cake, matcha and milk drinks, and a small plant
8342d62b7d.story: The table fills up: a flaky croissant on a white plate, a small dark cake crowned with berries, two pale green matcha drinks, one tall milky glass, a glass of water and a tray of cutlery. A small potted plant sits on the edge. The receipt is tucked beneath it. The first bite has not happened yet.

846234659c.alt: Dark cabinet with dried branches and a small mirror beside an open glass door, woven basket on a yellow wall
846234659c.story: Next to the cabinet, the glass door stands open, letting in green and the faint sound of the garden. A poster in the doorway shows coffee drinks. The dried branches stand stiff in their vase, and the mirror reflects nothing but wall. A woven basket hangs above. The cabinet's drawers each have a small brass handle, all closed.

4d888ac124.alt: Dim lounge with wicker armchairs and round tables silhouetted against tall bright windows and garden
4d888ac124.story: The lounge falls into shadow while the windows glow. Wicker armchairs and round tables become silhouettes, a small vase set on each. Outside, palms and trees stand bright and green. The canvas ceiling droops slightly between its poles. The contrast is strong enough that the room could be a theatre just before the curtain rises.

b63f876faf.alt: Dark round table with a small vase in silhouette, tall bright windows and lounge chairs behind
b63f876faf.story: A single small vase sits on a dark table in silhouette, outlined by the light from the windows behind it. Chairs around it fade into shadow. Outside, palms and trees fill every pane. The canvas ceiling is barely visible at the top. The whole scene is quiet and dim, a pocket of shade before the sun drops further.

f739af39e9.alt: High-ceilinged café with woven pendant lamps, a Christmas tree by the windows, bar stools and sunlit floor
f739af39e9.story: Behind the bar stools, the whole room opens up: woven lamps hanging from a high canvas ceiling, sunlight across the floor, the Christmas tree glowing by the windows. A pair of bar stools stands empty in the foreground. White stools are scattered near the tree. The shadows of the window frames stretch long, drawing stripes across the polished concrete floor.

a5799ebf8e.alt: Glass table on a carved wooden base holding chess sets, white stools around it, sofa and windows behind
a5799ebf8e.story: Half an hour later the light has shifted lower and redder. On a glass table resting on a carved tree stump, two chess sets sit mid-game, pieces scattered on their boards. White stools wait around it. Behind, a sofa piled with cushions faces the windows. Nobody is playing right now. The next move hangs in the air.

7955c182de.alt: Vertical view of chess sets on a glass table with a carved wooden base, white stools and sunlit windows
7955c182de.story: From a different angle the glass table looks like it is floating above its knotted wooden base. The chessboards sit on top, small armies frozen. Two white stools stand at the front, their round tops catching the sun. The windows behind are full of green and gold. The game feels like one that might never be finished, and that seems fine.

0a0e0b3022.alt: Person in black reflected in a tall standing mirror, one hand raised to the face, Christmas tree behind
0a0e0b3022.story: Reflected in a tall mirror is a figure dressed all in black, one hand raised to their face, the other at their side. Behind them in the reflection, the Christmas tree and the canvas ceiling repeat themselves. At the edge of the frame, someone else in a printed tee walks past. The mirror turns the room into a second channel, slightly delayed.

d3395cc97e.alt: Orange canvas awning and glass wall of a building, sunlit garden and shrubs alongside
d3395cc97e.story: Outside, the orange awning glows like a lamp. The glass wall below reflects trees and sky. Shrubs crowd the corner, bright leaves catching the low sun. Beyond, a terrace with chairs and tables stretches into the garden. A dark tree trunk splits the frame at the left. It is half past four, and the light is turning amber.

d5bf395dba.alt: Tree-lined road with parked cars and long shadows, a forested hill rising at the end under clear sky
d5bf395dba.story: Leaving, the road is lined with tall trees, their shadows lying across the tarmac in long bands. Cars are parked along one side. At the end, a forested hill rises against a clean blue sky. Nobody is walking. The light is low and warm on the treetops. The afternoon is folding itself up and putting itself away.

5850ea8322.alt: Campsite at night in an open field, string lights and lamps glowing under palm trees, a pickup truck parked nearby
5850ea8322.story: Eight-thirty on the last night of the year. Out in the dark field, the campsite is a small island of light: string bulbs under palm trees, a lamp glowing green, a white pickup parked to one side. The grass in front stretches away in rusty darkness. Bare trees stand behind like a crowd that came to watch.

6f591d126a.alt: Dark field of dry plants lit red in the foreground, a distant line of lights along the horizon under a teal night sky
6f591d126a.story: Facing away from camp, the field becomes a strange place. Dry stalks in the foreground glow red, lit by something behind. Far off, a row of lights strings along the horizon, small and steady. The sky is a deep teal, with one faint orange spark. It looks like a broadcast from another planet, picked up just barely.

c402e46683.alt: Camp table loaded with food, bottles and a cooler under a bright lamp, a pickup truck and a blurred figure behind
c402e46683.story: Beneath the bright lamp, the camp table is crowded with plates, bottles, bags and a red cooler. A white pickup waits behind. A figure moves past in a blur, half transparent, more ghost than guest. Cables run across the ground. Folding chairs lean in. The night is cool, and everyone is busy with something only partly visible here.

1e2f12a7a6.alt: Large firework bursting over a dark field of leafy plants, smaller fireworks along the horizon
1e2f12a7a6.story: Midnight, almost to the second. A big firework blooms over the field in a burst of pink and gold, and smaller ones pop along the horizon like distant replies. The leafy crops in the foreground catch a faint glow. Smoke drifts to the right. For a moment the whole valley seems to be signalling to itself across the dark.

5a400fd1c2.alt: Small fireworks bursting low over the horizon above a dark field of leafy plants
5a400fd1c2.story: Three minutes into the new year, the big bursts have faded, and only smaller fireworks keep going, low over the tree line. They sparkle in pink and white, each one shorter than the last. The crop leaves in front stand still. The sky is a dark, quiet teal again, the transmission thinning out to a few last sparks.

cac4afb33d.alt: Dusk over a dry field with a few scattered trees on the horizon under a pale pink sky
cac4afb33d.story: Earlier, just after six, before any lights were switched on. The field lies flat and brown under a pale pink sky. A few small trees stand on the horizon, spaced apart like dots on a line. Dry grass runs to the edge of the frame. The year has a few hours left, and the evening is taking its time.

4bff3d64cb.alt: Campsite in a dry grassy clearing lit by string lights at dusk, palm trees and bare trees behind
4bff3d64cb.story: The camp waits in the clearing, string lights just switched on, glowing warm against the trees. A pickup, a few tables, some bags piled up. The dry grass in front turns orange in the last light. Palm fronds spread above, and bare branches fan out behind them. It looks ready for guests who have not yet arrived.

3e8dc334ac.alt: Darker view of a campsite with string lights in a dry grass clearing under bare trees at dusk
3e8dc334ac.story: Ten seconds later, the scene has darkened a stop. The string lights stand out more, a row of small dots under the palms. The grass has gone from orange to brown. Someone moves near the table. The bare trees behind are turning to silhouette. The evening is changing channels slowly, one shade at a time.

080bf3896b.alt: Pink dusk sky over a dark landscape, distant lights on the horizon, bamboo leaves framing the edges
080bf3896b.story: Through a gap in the bamboo, the sky has gone pink, and a thin line of lights is coming on along the horizon. The land below is already dark. Leaves droop in from both corners, outlined against the glow. Somewhere out there, other people are setting up their own tables, waiting for the same midnight.

00fe9dee96.alt: Dusk sky in pink and orange over a dark field, faint lights on the distant tree line, bamboo leaves at the edges
00fe9dee96.story: The colour deepens. Orange creeps in under the pink, and the bamboo leaves at the edges turn black. The distant lights are a little brighter now, scattered along the tree line. The field in front has almost disappeared. A few seconds of looking is enough to see it changing, like a slow dissolve between two programmes.

ecad25b5c1.alt: Wide pink sky fading over a dark horizon with a single tree silhouette and faint distant lights
ecad25b5c1.story: Free of the bamboo, the view opens wide. The sky is a single soft gradient, pink up high, warmer near the ground. A lone tree stands on the right of the horizon. Tiny lights glimmer in the distance. The ground is nearly black. The whole picture is mostly sky, and the sky is mostly quiet.

3d70ec2f7c.alt: Orange and pink sunset sky over a dark horizon, lights scattered along a distant line of houses
3d70ec2f7c.story: The orange has taken over now, a band of it lying just above the hills. The lights along the horizon are clearer, a little village of them strung out in a line. A tree stands on the right like a punctuation mark. The field below is dark and fuzzy. Night is maybe twenty minutes away.

dd9aac0ce1.alt: Deep orange sky streaked with clouds above a dark silhouetted horizon and a single tree
dd9aac0ce1.story: The final colour of the year's last sunset is a deep orange, streaked with thin clouds that look drawn with a soft pencil. The horizon is a black line with a single tree poking above it. Below that, nothing is visible at all. In a few minutes the lamps will go on at camp, and the night will start.

be56f1710e.alt: Night campsite with tables, lamps on poles, a tripod, a pickup truck and several people gathered
be56f1710e.story: Pulled wide, the camp becomes a small settlement: two lamps on tall poles, tables in the circle of light, people standing and sitting around. A tripod stands in the foreground. The pickup waits behind. Some smoke drifts up near the back. It looks like a film set that wandered out into the countryside to shoot its own party.

7e73ce878a.alt: Person in a dark jacket stirring food in a pot on a rice cooker at a camp table at night
7e73ce878a.story: Close in at the table, someone in a dark jacket leans over a rice cooker, stirring a pot of something steaming. Bowls and bags crowd the wooden surface. A small plug-in device glows nearby. The light comes from the side, warm and sharp. Whatever is in the pot is close to ready, and people are starting to drift over.

6eb882641f.alt: Group of people standing around a table at a night campsite, a lamp post, a speaker and cables on the ground
6eb882641f.story: The group gathers around the far table, some in coats, one in a white shirt, one in a cap. A speaker sits on the ground in front, cables running from it across the dirt. A tall lamp post lights them from above. Plastic bags lie nearby. It is twenty to nine. The night is long, and nobody is in a hurry.

c24b9268a9.alt: Pale dog standing on a dark path at night beside the leg of a tripod, lit from the side
c24b9268a9.story: A pale dog appears at the edge of the light, standing on the dark path with its head slightly turned. Its fur looks rough and dusty. The leg of a tripod cuts across the frame on the right. The dog seems unsure whether it was invited, and is waiting to see if anyone will object, or offer something.

ef496d6e26.alt: Pale dog standing at night with its head tilted, beside a tripod leg on a dark dirt path
ef496d6e26.story: Nearer now, the dog tilts its head, a gesture that looks a lot like a question. Its shadow falls sharply to the right. The tripod leg stands just beside it, metal gleaming. The background has gone fully black. Whatever the answer is, the dog is patient enough to stand there and wait for it for a while.

ca6a60cc45.alt: Pale dog standing in the middle of a dark path at night, lit by a lamp, its shadow cast behind
ca6a60cc45.story: The dog has moved into the middle of the lit area, standing on four thin legs, looking toward the camp. Its shadow stretches long behind it. Dry leaves cover the path. A blue cable runs across the ground. In the dark behind, a tree trunk is just visible. It is a guest who arrived without a ticket but intends to stay.

d9b8dcb0b0.alt: Pale dog standing beside a folding camp chair on a dark path at night, turning its head
d9b8dcb0b0.story: Next it stands beside a folding camp chair, head turned to look at something on the left. Its coat shows patches where the fur is thin. The chair's legs catch the light. A faint point of light glimmers in the dark sky above. The dog has settled into the scene as if it had been part of the plan all along.

7760a2d91c.alt: Pink wall painted with a cartoon creature and wavy coloured stripes, apartment towers behind trees
7760a2d91c.story: A long pink wall runs along the street, painted with a round-eyed creature holding a striped tail, surrounded by wavy bands of red, blue and yellow. Above it, apartment towers rise behind the trees. The paint is chipped at the edges. The figure looks like it was drawn quickly, with total confidence, and has been watching passers-by ever since.

035c936f4e.alt: Parking area with orange traffic cones and an orange car in front of tall residential towers
035c936f4e.story: Over the road, a paved lot holds a few parked cars and a scattering of orange cones. An orange car matches them almost exactly.
