Tall residential towers rise behind, rows of balconies and identical windows. Trees line the edge. The sky is a dull grey. It is half past three, and the neighbourhood feels quietly ordinary.

00ffda4cf8.alt: Vertical view of residential towers above a parking area with orange cones, a passing leg at the left edge
00ffda4cf8.story: Vertical, the towers dominate the frame, their many windows stacked like a grid of tiny screens. The orange car and cones sit at the bottom. At the left edge, a leg in motion, someone walking through the frame without noticing. The painted ground at the bottom hints at the colour waiting just around the corner.

6f67fc9706.alt: Path of round stepping stones through shaded dirt under trees, a street with parked cars beyond
6f67fc9706.story: Under a canopy of old trees, a path of round stepping stones crosses the bare dirt, leading toward the street. Parked cars and a few shops are visible beyond. The shade is deep and cool, the light outside flat and grey. The stones are worn smooth. The edge of a painted kerb shows at the bottom of the frame.

c79489f0e3.alt: Stepping-stone path curving through a shaded grove toward a street with parked cars and buildings
c79489f0e3.story: Shift sideways and the path curves more clearly, the stones leading in an S-shape toward the light. A red vehicle passes on the road beyond. The tree trunks lean slightly, roots pushing at the dirt. It is a short walk, a few seconds' worth, but the stones make it feel like it should be taken slowly.

431eb406ac.alt: Low view looking up at tall residential towers with white frames against an overcast sky, tree edges at the side
431eb406ac.story: Looking straight up, the towers become a wall of balconies and window frames, white lines running from top to bottom. The sky above is grey and textured, about to do something. A tree pokes in from the corner. The buildings have a monumental stillness, like a broadcast antenna array pointed at the clouds.

397ee4198b.alt: Playground structure painted with rainbow stripes and a house shape, behind a metal fence
397ee4198b.story: Behind a fence, a small structure is painted like a house in a children's book: a red triangle roof, blue walls, rainbow stripes running down the side of a stairway. Apartment blocks rise behind it. The paint is bright but slightly faded. It feels like a set piece from a programme that went off the air years ago.

dda7614acf.alt: Grey high-rise apartment building seen from below against a pale overcast sky
dda7614acf.story: One grey tower steps up into a pale grey sky, its balconies lined up in neat columns. The frame at the top looks like a crown or a cage. A second building edges in on the left, slightly blurred. The colours are drained out here, a quiet contrast to the riot of paint waiting just down the road.

5944e6dd17.alt: Low houses and walls covered in colourful painted patterns, painted courtyard ground, visitors walking
5944e6dd17.story: Then the colour arrives all at once. Low houses with tiled roofs are covered from ground to eaves in painted figures, swirls and dots. Even the courtyard floor is painted, red and blue and yellow in looping shapes. Visitors wander through, phones out. Apartment blocks loom behind. The contrast between the two worlds is almost comical.

f89a564e70.alt: Painted courtyard and low houses covered in colourful figures, visitors walking, apartment blocks behind
f89a564e70.story: Further in, the courtyard opens up, its painted floor running right to the door of a low house. Visitors stand at the doorway, some in jackets, one with a bag. The walls on either side are dense with small painted figures. Trees lean over the scene. The pattern is so busy that it almost hums, like a screen full of static.

afabd938cc.alt: Painted house gable covered in colourful figures, red and orange painted boulders on a lawn in front
afabd938cc.story: Three large boulders sit on the lawn, painted red-orange with faces and patterns of their own. Behind them, the gable of a house is covered in figures, birds and swirls. A wooden utility pole stands in the middle of it all, unpainted. The grass is dark green and slightly shaggy. It is a garden that refuses to be quiet.

f56682e261.alt: Painted house wall and gable with figures, three painted boulders on bright green grass
f56682e261.story: Same boulders, same wall, but the colours look richer, the grass brighter. The painted faces on the boulders seem to be watching the wall, as though the art is looking at itself. The pole still stands unpainted. Trees fill the top of the frame. Nobody is visible, which makes the faces feel even more alive.

20294e8f58.alt: Painted orange boulders with large face designs on a lawn, painted walls and trees behind
20294e8f58.story: Seen near, one boulder wears a huge round face, eyes and mouth drawn in white and red. Others lie nearby like sleeping companions. Behind them, a painted wall stretches along the path where two visitors stand chatting. Trees and a lamp post rise above. Even the stones here have been given personalities, and they seem content with them.

3144e82d99.alt: Painted house roof and wall behind a wooden utility pole, apartment buildings and blue sky above
3144e82d99.story: Wooden and bare, a tall pole stands in the foreground, cables running up into the sky. Behind it, the painted roofline of a house shows off its colourful figures. Higher up, apartment buildings rise against a patch of blue sky with thin clouds. The scene is a stack of eras: old wood, painted walls, modern towers.

7707fd5a04.alt: Door painted red and blue with whimsical figures with large eyes and patterned bodies
7707fd5a04.story: A door, painted top to bottom: three figures with big round eyes stand along the top, and below them a larger figure with outstretched arms covers most of the panel. Red and white dots fill every gap. The frame is blue and orange. It looks like an invitation, though it's unclear what's on the other side.

75487c30a1.alt: Mural of a white duck-like character with eyes closed, wearing a decorated blue headdress, on an orange background
75487c30a1.story: A painted duck-like character with closed eyes and a blissful smile wears an elaborate headdress of pearls, blue cloth and a sparkling jewel. Its hands are pressed together near its chest. The background swirls in red and orange. The figure looks entirely at peace, as if it has found the one quiet frequency in a noisy world.

9e02556963.alt: Glass door with an Office sign, a Breastfeeding Room sign, a taped child's drawing and gold painted characters
9e02556963.story: A glass door carries a white sign reading "Office" in English and Chinese, and a pink one below says "Breastfeeding Room." Between them, a child's drawing of a stick figure is taped to the glass. Gold characters run down both sides of the frame. Everything is practical and decorative at once, like a station ID painted by hand.

cb701cc5ad.alt: Mesh wall covered in hundreds of small colourful paper notes and cards
cb701cc5ad.story: Hundreds of small paper notes cover the mesh, layered so thickly that the wall behind is almost lost. White, red, blue, yellow, green, each one carrying a few handwritten words. Some are fresh, some curled and faded. It is like looking at a wall of messages from a radio call-in show, all broadcasting at the same moment.

291cfef005.alt: Large leafy tree beside a building eave, apartment blocks and grey sky behind
291cfef005.story: Above the painted ground, a large tree takes over, its leaves dense and dark against the pale sky. An eave of a painted roof pokes in from the left. In the distance, low apartment blocks line the street. At the bottom corner, a head passes through. The tree seems to be the only thing here left unpainted.

ef2e233674.alt: Street with an apartment block behind a construction fence, a cyclist riding past and parked cars
ef2e233674.story: Out on the street, an apartment block stands behind a grey construction fence, its windows uneven, balconies stuffed with things. A cyclist rides past in front, another bicycle leaning against the fence. Cars sit parked at the kerb. Clouds drift low. After the painted courtyard, the city looks almost black and white.

0be6792874.alt: Apartment block behind a construction fence with painted characters, scooters and a bicycle parked in front
0be6792874.story: The same block, closer now. Scooters stand in a row along the fence, a bicycle beside them. Hand-painted characters on the fence spell out something too faded to read clearly, and a small drawn face grins near the middle. A car's nose pokes in from the left. Pink clouds hover above. It is quarter to four.

38c15e2906.alt: Tall apartment building beside a utility pole with transformers, scooters parked along the street below
38c15e2906.story: Grey and white stripes climb a tall building, its roof edged in green tiles. Beside it, a utility pole carries a tangle of transformers and wires. Along the bottom, scooters are parked in a long line. A head enters at the bottom of the frame. The street is a wire-strung corridor of everyday noise.

e9d0ef949d.alt: Apartment building with green tiled roof edge, utility pole, scooters lining the street and pedestrians
e9d0ef949d.story: Stepping back, the street opens a little. The building is the same, but now two pedestrians walk along the pavement, and more scooters line the kerb. A road sign's back faces the frame, blank. The utility pole leans in from the right. Clouds have spread pink and grey above the roof. The neighbourhood carries on as usual.

f53ad85500.alt: Street with a yellow and red coach bus, a taxi at the kerb, a white car and a pedestrian crossing
f53ad85500.story: Along the main road a yellow coach glides past, its red stripes bright against the grey afternoon. A taxi waits at the kerb, a white car rolls behind it. White crossing stripes cut across the tarmac. A billboard rises above the buildings. It is the kind of street that feels busy even when only a few things are moving.

f50f5f32f5.alt: Yellow coach bus and a taxi on a city street beneath an overcast sky, crosswalk stripes in front
f50f5f32f5.story: Moments on, the coach has moved forward, the taxi still waiting. More buses appear in the distance. The crossing stripes lie empty. Trees lean over the pavement on the left. The sky has gone a shade darker. The scene repeats itself, slightly shifted, like a programme rerun from a slightly different seat.

ae919770bd.alt: Two people with a pushchair crossing a city street on a crosswalk, a yellow coach bus and taxi nearby
ae919770bd.story: Two figures push a cart over the crossing, one of them shielding something with a hand. The yellow coach is stopped behind them, waiting. A taxi idles at the corner. The billboard still looms overhead. Trees lean in. For a few seconds the whole street seems to pause and let them through.

cb26864652.alt: Side street with tall buildings, a utility pole with transformers, metal barriers and a parked scooter
cb26864652.story: Off the main road, a side street crowds in at the edges. A utility pole holds up transformers and a red sign. Metal barriers run along the bottom. A scooter leans by the kerb. At the far end, an ornate gate roof peeks out between buildings. The sky is grey and still. It is just before ten to four.

550da7694b.alt: Narrow painted alley with an anime-style angel portrait on a red wall, high-rise apartments rising behind
550da7694b.story: A painted angel with a halo and long blonde hair looks out from the end of a narrow passage, framed by walls covered in brushed patterns. Above the low roofs, a grey apartment tower fills the sky, rows of windows stacked like a test card. Two worlds share the same square of air, and neither seems to notice the other.

d39605021b.alt: Red door painted with a white wide-eyed figure, masks, a bear shape and the letters OK beside striped bricks
d39605021b.story: The door carries a whole cast: a round-eyed figure with arms flung wide, a bear in white outline, masks staring from the top corners, and a casual OK in the margin. The latch sits right through the figure's shoulder. Whoever opens it next will split the little crowd in half, then close it again, and the faces will line back up.

710cc5069b.alt: Man and woman seen from behind on a stepping-stone path under a tree, a yellow bus and street beyond
710cc5069b.story: Round stepping stones lead out from under the tree toward the road, and they have stopped halfway along them. A yellow bus idles at the kerb ahead. Her pink cap and patterned top, his black shirt and khakis, both facing the traffic, deciding something without words. The leaves overhead hang heavy and dark under a white sky.

8780af6250.alt: Thick banyan-like trunk wrapped in pale hanging aerial roots, a painted wall visible in the background
8780af6250.story: The trunk is less a trunk than a braid, dozens of pale roots dropping from above and fusing into the ground. Some are thick as arms, some thin as cords. Off to the right, a painted wall peeks out from behind it, all colour, while the tree keeps to its grey and brown, slowly growing downward, one strand at a time.

5f9888ebb3.alt: Two people seen from behind on a paved plaza, one filming a street where a yellow tour bus is parked
5f9888ebb3.story: One hand holds a phone up to the street, recording the crossing, the cones, the yellow bus nosed against the kerb. The other figure just watches, shoulders square in a black T-shirt. Late afternoon has flattened the light to grey. The plaza tiles stretch out in a pattern that nobody is looking at but everyone is standing on.

06f64e107c.alt: Empty city street with dashed centre line, parked scooters and apartment blocks leading to an ornate tiled roof
06f64e107c.story: The road runs straight down the middle, its dashed line pointing at a gate with a curved, ornate roof at the far end. Scooters crowd both kerbs. A lone figure with a backpack walks the right side, the only thing moving. Wires sag between poles, and the buildings lean in on either side like an audience waiting for the next segment.

7dfe750c4a.alt: Rear of a dark Toyota sedan parked beside a grassy verge, a yellow bollard and a person walking past a fence
7dfe750c4a.story: The old sedan sits with its back to the lens, Toyota lettered across the boot and a scuff on the bumper. A yellow concrete marker leans in the grass beside it. Further up the path, someone in an orange top walks away past a metal fence and a warehouse with a tin roof. Nothing here is waiting for anyone.

54f1dbf10f.alt: White mini delivery truck parked on a street below tall residential towers and green trees
54f1dbf10f.story: A small white box truck is parked at an angle, cab tilted toward the kerb, its cargo door blank. Behind it the apartment towers go up and up, balconies stacked in neat columns, trees softening only the bottom floors. Shortly before four, the street is quiet. The truck looks like it has been waiting all afternoon for a job.

776be92444.alt: Wall poster of terraced tea fields and a map of Taiwan with red text reading 台灣高山茶園 under hanging lamps
776be92444.story: Morning, and the first thing inside is a poster: green terraces folding over hills, a map of the island set into the corner, and red characters along the bottom reading 台灣高山茶園. Two pendant lamps hang above it, already lit. Below, slatted blinds filter the daylight into soft bars. The room smells, perhaps, of dry leaves.

211dacccbd.alt: Display wall spelling TAIWAN TOURISM COMMEMORATION in round white plaques with red characters below
211dacccbd.story: Round white plaques spell out TAIWAN TOURISM COMMEMORATION across a slatted wooden wall, one letter per disc, with red circles of characters arranged beneath. Certificates are pinned at the right edge. Above it all, a banner promises quality and fair prices. It reads like a station ident for a channel that broadcasts only tea, all day.

67859cd692.alt: Green metal tea-rolling machine with a round tray and wooden pegs, roped off beside a poster reading 乾燥
67859cd692.story: Painted machine green, the rolling press stands on castors behind a white rope, its round tray studded with wooden pegs and its control box dotted with red and orange buttons. A poster beside it carries the characters 乾燥 in bold brushstrokes. Switched off, it looks patient, like a set piece waiting for the cameras to roll.

52e1ae678a.alt: Same green tea-rolling machine seen slightly wider, rope barrier curving in front, posters on both sides
52e1ae678a.story: Step back a pace and the machine gains a little context: posters on either side, a rope that sags in a lazy curve, a bare concrete wall above with a single green exit sign. The springs on its frame are coiled tight. Somewhere in the room, a voice is explaining how it works, and the machine keeps its own counsel.

5c0ff068ab.alt: Green bags of tea leaning against a wooden counter with a red 福 diamond, a teapot and potted flowers on top
5c0ff068ab.story: Two plump green bags lean against the counter like tired travellers, each printed with a map outline in gold. On the wooden chest above, a red diamond carries the character 福, and a small teapot sits beside a pot of pink flowers. The letters COMME peek in from the top of the frame, a fragment of a word cut off mid-broadcast.

072ef3e7fc.alt: Counter draped in blue patterned cloth with green tea bags, red character cards and a white planter marked 祿
072ef3e7fc.story: Blue cloth printed with white rings hangs over the counter, and three green bags of tea slump in front of it. Above, red squares of paper carry single characters, and a white planter wears 祿 like a badge. The arrangement is generous and slightly crowded, as if every lucky thing in the building had been brought to one table.

6d34a11eb6.alt: White bowl planter marked with a red 祿 card, holding a green plant on pebbles, set on driftwood beside a red tin
6d34a11eb6.story: Inside a white bowl, a leafy plant rises over a bed of white pebbles, and a red card stuck to its side reads 祿. It sits on a twist of driftwood, with a tiny gold ingot tucked below. A red tin waits to the left. Behind, the wall of round plaques blurs into soft red and white dots, like a test pattern out of focus.

8a425c9591.alt: Wooden shelves stocked with teapots, red gift boxes, tins and a large round tea cake in a shop
8a425c9591.story: Pale wooden shelves climb the wall, loaded with teapots in clay and white porcelain, red boxes with gold edges, tins and jars and one big round cake of pressed leaves. A blue cloth runs along the bottom shelf. The light is even and bright, the kind that makes everything look ready to be wrapped. Nobody is shopping yet.

708dbbff37.alt: Hand resting on the rim of a large woven bamboo basket filled with dark rolled tea leaves
708dbbff37.story: A hand rests on the edge of a woven basket heaped with dark, tightly rolled leaves. The weave runs in neat diagonal bands around its side. Someone in a pink blouse stands just beyond, the rest of her out of frame. The next thing that happens, probably, is an invitation: lean in, breathe, notice how it changes from the dry leaf.

f0f17c3760.alt: Printed sheets of text in Thai lying on a dark wooden table beside small white teacups
f0f17c3760.story: Two printed sheets lie on the dark table, dense paragraphs in Thai script, the nearest one glossed by a reflection of the ceiling lights. Small white cups sit at the edges, waiting. A translation, maybe, of everything that has just been said aloud, handed out so the words can be read again later, at a slower speed.

9e7f1608e7.alt: Close view of a forearm in a rust-red sleeve resting on a glossy table, the shop blurred behind
9e7f1608e7.story: A rust-red sleeve pushed up, a forearm resting on the glossy table, a cheek propped on a hand just out of frame. Everything behind dissolves into warm blurs of tins and blue cloth. Twenty minutes into the talk, attention comes and goes like a weak signal, and the table is cool under the elbow.

8c77aaf490.alt: Four decorated tea tins in green, orange, dark green and red on a reflective table with white cups
8c77aaf490.story: Four tins line up on the glass-topped table: one green with flowers, one orange, one dark green labelled Matcha, one tall and red with a silver lid. White cups and a small bowl wait in front. Behind them, guests in red tops and sun hats sit blurred, half-listening. The tins hold the pose better than anyone in the room.

b161c9b9d2.alt: Row of four tea tins and white cups on a table, guests blurred in the background of a tasting room
b161c9b9d2.story: Same four tins, slightly lower, slightly wider. Their reflections run down into the glossy table like a second row underneath. One guest in the back leans forward on an elbow; another in a white cap sits very still. The cups are still empty. The pour, when it comes, will break the stillness all at once.

4e7fc2c23b.alt: Small white bowl of pale yellow tea on a dark glossy table, a white tasting cup behind it
4e7fc2c23b.story: A white bowl, a pool of pale yellow tea, and a narrow cup standing behind it like a chaperone. Ceiling lights stretch across the polished wood in long white bars. Everything else is out of focus. The first sip has not happened yet, and the surface of the tea is perfectly level, holding a dim reflection of the room.

d37ee81ff6.alt: Bowl of light yellow tea and a white tasting cup on a polished dark table, another cup blurred behind
d37ee81ff6.story: Fourteen seconds on, the bowl sits slightly lower in the frame and another one has appeared at the top, already half-drunk. The tall cup waits empty. Reflections of the lights slide across the table between them. Down the row, someone is sniffing the empty cup, as instructed, and trying to decide what they are meant to notice.

7ce49e2638.alt: Shop shelf stacked with green and red tea tins in two rows, gift boxes and bags on either side
7ce49e2638.story: Two rows of tins in green and red stand to attention on a wooden shelf, labels turned outward, a small white price card at the front. Gift boxes and paper bags wait on either side. After the tasting, the room has rearranged itself into a shop, and the tins, once props, are now very plainly for sale.

5528de128c.alt: Display of red tea gift boxes with gold and black tins on shelves above a blue patterned cloth
5528de128c.story: Red boxes open like books, each cradling a pair of tins in gold or black on cream satin. On the shelf above, more tins stand beside a teapot and a small gold ingot. Little white cards name each set. The blue cloth with white rings appears again underneath, as if one bolt of fabric has been stretched to cover the entire building.

e76919a73e.alt: Same red tea gift display with tins on satin and a small blue pot on the cloth, viewed slightly to the right
e76919a73e.story: Eleven seconds on, a small shuffle to the right. The boxes are the same, the satin still gleams, the tiny blue jar and the round clay pot sit at the front of the cloth. A power socket on the wall gives the display away as a real room rather than a catalogue page. Decision time, for anyone holding a basket.

24ba9706c0.alt: Wooden shelf with clay teapots, a round tea cake in a gold box, a large lingzhi-shaped object and red boxes
24ba9706c0.story: Clay teapots sit in a row on the upper shelf beneath a gold box holding two round pressed cakes. Below, a large dark, ridged disc rests on its edge, flanked by red boxes, small pots and a gold ingot. One last look at the shop shelves before leaving. The blue curtain under the counter hangs perfectly still.

b9e75eccd3.alt: Stone steps climbing a wooded slope above a rock retaining wall beside a quiet road with a painted arrow
b9e75eccd3.story: Half an hour later, outside. A white arrow on the asphalt points ahead, but the eye goes left, up a flight of stone steps disappearing into trees. A rock wall holds the slope back. Broad leaves spill over the edge. The air is damp, the sky barely visible through the canopy, and the stairs lead somewhere nobody explains.

1b0ff00e75.alt: Busy narrow street with hanging shop signs and a HOTEL sign, people walking away, umbrellas and lanterns
1b0ff00e75.story: The street funnels between tall buildings stacked with vertical signs, one reading HOTEL in plain letters. People walk away in a loose stream: a grey hoodie, a black T-shirt, a patterned umbrella opened against no visible rain. Trees cover the hill at the end of the road. Everyone seems to be heading the same way.

6c4e76bb48.alt: Lake with moored white boats below green mountains under heavy cloud, a paved plaza and heads in the foreground
6c4e76bb48.story: The plaza opens onto water, and the mountains stand behind it shouldering a low ceiling of cloud. White boats with red trim tie up along a long pier. A few heads at the bottom of the frame face the same view. The lake is flat and pewter-grey, and for a second it looks like a painted backdrop rather than anything wet.

71f1dc1592.alt: Empty tiled plaza leading to a pier with white boats on a lake, mountains under bright cumulus clouds
71f1dc1592.story: Thirty-five seconds later, the people are gone from the frame and the sky has opened a little: tall white clouds heaped over the ridge, a sliver of blue at the top. The boats sit in a row, a flag lifting on one stern. The tiled plaza is empty, a broad grey stage waiting for the next group to arrive.

93b0ec9c95.alt: Railed lakeside pier with white tour boats and red flags, forested mountains beneath big white clouds
93b0ec9c95.story: Along the railing, the pier stretches out to a cluster of white boats, small red flags snapping on their bows. The mountains on the far shore wear clouds down to their shoulders, and a lamppost stands alone on the deck. The water between is calm and slate blue. Departure times are posted somewhere, but nobody here seems to be reading them.

9c15e4b88a.alt: Close view of rippling teal water with bright reflections across its surface
9c15e4b88a.story: Looking straight down from the edge, the lake becomes pure texture: teal folds and silver creases, light caught and dropped and caught again. No horizon, no boats, nothing to measure it by. It could be a metre deep or a hundred. It looks like the screen between channels, if static were blue and wet.

ec7538ee18.alt: White building with arched windows and curved white balconies above a tiled plaza and planters
ec7538ee18.story: Every window on the white facade is an arch, every balcony a little curved railing with two chairs and a table set out behind it. Most of the chairs are empty. At ground level, the glass doors stand open onto a tiled forecourt and a pair of low planters. It looks like a building drawn by someone who only ever drew arches.

fcc3d287ac.alt: Turquoise lake water beside a wooded hillside, a boardwalk leading to boats moored at a small pier
fcc3d287ac.story: Turquoise water fills the bottom half of the frame, startlingly bright against the dark green slope. A boardwalk curves along the shore toward a cluster of red and white boats. Two small figures walk the path at the left. The hill is so densely planted that its trees look less like a forest and more like a single living cloud.

55f366d4b5.alt: Long concrete jetty lined with black bollards, a person in red standing midway, white boats on either side
55f366d4b5.story: Black bollards march down both edges of the concrete jetty, and halfway along someone in red has stopped, arm raised, phone pointed at the far side. A white boat flying a blue banner waits on the left, others float further out. The clouds have thickened over the mountains, and the light has gone soft and even, like a long held note.

229d8d277b.alt: Still green water in a walled harbour basin below a wooded hill topped by a tall modern building
229d8d277b.story: In the little basin, the water lies still and green, boxed in by grey walls and a black railing. A white post stands at the corner like a sentry. Up the hill, the trees gather around a tall building with a flat face, one window lit. Nothing moves here. The lake proper is somewhere to the left, out of view.

c1d302cbe7.alt: Tour boats with gold figurines and red flags moored at a pier on a calm lake, wooded hills behind
c1d302cbe7.story: The boats line up nose to tail along the pier, each wearing a small gold figure on its roof and a red flag at the stern. One carries a dark horse statue rearing toward the sky. Hills sit low along the shore, and the water slaps gently against white hulls. Any minute now one of them will start its engine and pull away.

72670d1cd5.alt: Wide calm lake under scattered clouds with low forested hills and two distant boats
72670d1cd5.story: Out on the water, the shore falls away and the view simplifies: grey-blue lake, a ribbon of green hills, a broad sky with clouds drifting in from the right. Two white boats sit far off, one at each side of the frame, like punctuation. A small structure stands on one of the hilltops. The engine hum is the only steady sound.

0dddda2ae3.alt: Bright turquoise lake in front of a forested shore with moored boats and a tall hotel tower behind
0dddda2ae3.story: Back toward shore, the water turns a vivid turquoise and a row of small white boats lines the bank beneath the trees. Above the canopy a tall tower rises with a tall curved arch beside it, glass and concrete over the green. The colours are almost too clean, like a picture postcard tuned a little too far on the saturation dial.

e800af57bd.alt: Same turquoise lakeshore, forest and tower, framed slightly lower with boats along the waterline
e800af57bd.story: Nine seconds later, the boat has drifted and the frame has slid a fraction. The tower sits a little further right, the line of moored boats a little closer to centre. Small changes, the kind only noticed when two frames sit side by side. The water keeps its colour; the clouds keep their grey; the shore slides gently past.

da0fce40d1.alt: Expanse of teal lake water under a pale overcast sky, a wooded headland and buildings at the right
da0fce40d1.story: Most of the frame is sky, white and quiet, and most of the rest is water. Only a thin band of hills separates them, with a wooded headland and a low building at the right. The lake is lightly ruffled, teal and grey. The boat seems to be heading nowhere in particular, and nobody on board minds.

7be057d838.alt: Man in a red striped shirt and cap seen from behind at a boat cabin doorway, windows showing the lake
7be057d838.story: Inside the cabin, a man in a red striped shirt stands at the open door with his back turned, hands on the frame, watching the lake slide past. On the console, a small fan, a black backpack, a clay cup. The windscreen frames the view in rounded rectangles, as if the whole trip were being shown on a set of old monitors.

1f4664b65c.alt: Rounded forested hill rising from a grey-green lake beneath a thick bank of cloud
1f4664b65c.story: One hill, rounded like a sleeping animal, rises from the grey-green water and fills the centre of the frame. Clouds press down from above, soft and heavy. The surface of the lake carries small ridges of wind. There is nothing else to look at, and for a few seconds that is exactly enough, the shape and the water and the weight of sky.

5a1f865a16.alt: Green hills and lake seen through a boat window, the dark window frame filling the lower half
5a1f865a16.story: Seen through the window, the hills sit in the top half and the dark ledge of the boat in the bottom, a sharp horizontal line cutting the view. The glass adds a faint haze. The lake shows only as a band of blue between frame and shore. Watching the scenery from inside starts to feel like watching it on a screen.

5b9a2190d0.alt: Vertical view of a wooded hill and lake framed by a boat window ledge, overcast sky above
5b9a2190d0.story: Two seconds later, turned upright, the same window holds a different slice: more sky, a steeper hill, the ledge now a heavy black bar at the bottom. The forest is uniform and dense, a single dark green from the waterline to the ridge. It is the same view, rotated, like a channel briefly displayed in the wrong aspect ratio.

240d8c86e3.alt: Low grassy islet with shrubs on a lake, forested shoreline behind under a cloudy white sky
240d8c86e3.story: A low island slides into view, all reeds and scrub and a few round-headed trees, so flat it barely clears the waterline. Behind it the forested shore runs unbroken across the frame. A tiny red speck floats near the islet's tip. The clouds have lost all shape now, one even white lid over everything.

e012f0a854.alt: Channel of calm water between green shores with a white boat approaching and blue mountains beyond
e012f0a854.story: The lake narrows into a channel between two green banks, and a white boat comes down the middle toward the lens. Beyond, blue mountains stack up in layers, paler the further they go. The water is smooth enough to hold their faint reflection. Two boats passing in a channel, each one a brief visitor in the other's view.

555338997e.alt: White boat crossing a calm grey-green lake toward a gap between forested hills and distant mountains
555338997e.story: The white boat from the channel is further off now, crossing the open lake toward the gap between hills. The wooded point at the right has drawn closer. Distant mountains fade into a blue haze at the back. The water's surface is crinkled like foil, catching very little light under the even cloud, and the wake has already smoothed away.

20adedbb33.alt: Small white boat on an open lake in front of a long low forested ridge under a pale sky
20adedbb33.story: Centred, small, alone: the white boat sits in the middle of the frame against the long dark ridge, like a cursor blinking on an empty page. Half the picture is sky, half is water, and the hills draw a single line between. It is the kind of view where you wait to see which way the boat will turn.

de4c7f149a.alt: Floating wooden walkways and small planted rafts on a lake, a pavilion among trees and hills beyond
de4c7f149a.story: Wooden walkways float across the water toward a pavilion half-hidden in trees, and small rafts of green plants sit along the rail like potted islands. The hills behind have gone flat and dark under the cloud. Rippled water fills the foreground. The pier is coming up, and the engine note drops to a lower, slower hum.

91d8eca0e4.alt: Wooden pier pavilion with a dark tiled roof beside turquoise water, dense bamboo and trees behind
91d8eca0e4.story: The pavilion comes into view properly: a dark tiled roof, wooden posts, a small plaque under the eaves, people gathered in its shade. Behind it the bamboo and broadleaf trees pile up in a single wall of green. In front, the water is a startling turquoise, bright as a swimming pool, lapping at a line of wooden posts.

14595f635e.alt: Closer view of the wooden pier pavilion and its railings, figures waiting under the roof, turquoise water
14595f635e.story: Seven seconds closer. Now the figures under the roof are distinct, a row of them standing at the rail, waiting for the boat or watching it arrive. Ropes swag between the posts along the edge of the jetty. The bamboo leans over the roofline as if listening in. A gentle bump, and the hull meets the dock.

62223dabc3.alt: Carved wooden gateway with a plaque reading 玄光碼頭, beams and pillars framing a covered walkway
62223dabc3.story: Beneath the pier's wooden gate, a pale plaque reads 玄光碼頭 in carved characters, held up by brown pillars and a lattice of beams. The covered walkway runs back into shade, toward another gate and green beyond. Lanterns hang in a line along one side. The wood looks freshly oiled. Arrivals walk straight through without looking up.

bd995d4d53.alt: Wide paved lakeside path under trees and a pavilion roof, railings and water visible in the distance
bd995d4d53.story: Away from the crowd for a moment: a broad stone path, grey and slightly damp, running between railings toward the lake. A pavilion's roof edge pokes in from the right, and trees crowd the left side, bamboo leaning toward the sky. The far shore shows through the gap. Footsteps here would echo very slightly off the stone.

a582d437da.alt: Broad stone stairs leading up through trees, several visitors climbing, a pink cap and red cardigan at right
a582d437da.story: Up the stairs go a line of climbers, backpacks and white trousers and a red top, getting smaller with each flight. The trees close over the steps in a soft tunnel. At the right edge, the pink cap and red sleeves appear again, half in frame, a companion keeping pace. The first landing is behind; the second is still a long way up.

f7a1b91404.alt: Long flight of grey stone steps rising into a tree tunnel, two people near the top looking back
f7a1b91404.story: The steps keep going, grey and even, rising into a tunnel of leaves. Near the top two figures in black and white pause, one turning back to look down. The rest of the stairs are empty. From the bottom, it looks less like a path and more like a ladder leaning into the canopy, with sky somewhere above.

0f216f7996.alt: Fuzzy caterpillar crawling on a pebble-textured stone post, foliage blurred in green and brown behind
0f216f7996.story: On top of a pebbled stone post, a small caterpillar bristling with pale spines inches toward the edge. The world behind it melts into green and rust-coloured blur. Out of all the hillside, it has chosen this one rough grey summit, the highest point it knows. The climbers passing by never notice, and it never notices them.

8ee34148a1.alt: Caterpillar with spiky hairs on a pebbly stone post, closer view with soft green background
8ee34148a1.story: Twelve seconds later it has moved a centimetre, perhaps less, and lifted the front of its body, feeling for whatever comes next. The pebbles in the concrete look like boulders at this scale. Light catches the tips of its hairs and turns them silver. Up close, the hike becomes this: one small creature and one long ascent.

f82fba0d21.alt: Elevated view over treetops and a rooftop to a wide lake and layered green mountains under cloud
f82fba0d21.story: From higher up, the trees part and the lake appears below, wide and still, held in a bowl of green mountains. A rooftop sits in the foreground among the leaves. Far off, faint blue peaks rise above the nearer ridges. Climbing has paid off, and the breath that left on the stairs comes back slowly.

673deea1ee.alt: Curving road with a turnaround and roadside signs above a lake, forested hills on the far shore
673deea1ee.story: Below the lookout, a road sweeps in a long curve around a turnaround lined with white flowers, a few signposts standing at its edge. Past it, the lake, and past that the forest. A wooden shed sits at the right. Everything is quiet, the road empty, as if traffic were a thing that only happened on the other side of the hill.

ab16c045a2.alt: Single white car rounding a curved road beside a lake, wooded hills and a distant peak beyond
ab16c045a2.story: Twenty-seven seconds later, a single white car rounds the bend, small and deliberate, the only moving thing on the road. A distant peak has emerged above the ridge. The lake has not changed. The car will be gone in another few seconds, and the curve will go back to holding nobody, framed in green.

2e2e226055.alt: Visitors at a stone railing on a hillside landing look out toward a lake and a tall building on the far shore
2e2e226055.story: At a stone landing, three people stand by the rail: a red cardigan, a black T-shirt with a shoulder bag, an orange shirt with a backpack, all facing the lake. Across the water a tall white building rises from the wooded shore. A branch hangs down into the top of the frame. They have stopped, briefly, to look at where they came from.

a9ce69fedc.alt: View down to a curving road beside a lake, a white boat crossing toward forested hills
a9ce69fedc.story: At this same height, the road below bends in a long yellow-lined curve, and out on the lake a white boat draws a pale line across the water. The forested shore opposite wraps around in a deep green crescent. A sign on a pole turns its back to the view. The boat seems to be retracing the morning's route in reverse.

3464513ac0.alt: Broad lake panorama framed by treetops, a small structure on the far shore and a distant blue peak
3464513ac0.story: Wider still: the lake opens out to its full width, the far shore low and wooded, a small white structure standing at the water's edge. A blue peak lifts above the ridge on the right. Treetops fringe the bottom of the frame. The clouds have smoothed into a flat, bright ceiling that makes everything look slightly washed, like an old broadcast.

d918a98bb1.alt: Red buds on a small green plant in focus, blurred visitors and a golden urn on a temple courtyard behind
d918a98bb1.story: Two red buds, firm and shiny, hold up at the end of their stems, the only sharp thing in the frame. Behind them the temple courtyard dissolves into blur: trouser legs mid-step, a white sneaker, a gold urn glowing at the left. A thin white lantern frame hangs down at the right. The visitors keep moving; the buds keep still.

df10377e12.alt: Lake viewed through overhanging leaves, a small island and hotel towers on a forested far shore
df10377e12.story: Branches dip into the top of the frame, and below them the lake spreads out toward a far shore dotted with towers. A small wooded island floats close to the middle. Clouds stack in soft grey layers above the mountains. The view is framed like a window, the kind every lookout seems designed to offer at exactly this angle.

4b21a5e650.alt: Green cast-metal dragon coiled on a golden urn beside temple steps, a visitor in white at a doorway
4b21a5e650.story: A green metal dragon winds up the side of a golden urn, claws gripping, scales sharp, mouth open on something unsaid. Red characters glow on the gold below it. Beyond, a visitor in a white cap and skirt stands at the top of the temple steps, peering in through the doorway. The dragon faces the other way, keeping watch over the courtyard.

7d26675a34.alt: Two men walk away down a narrow paved path with stone railings, leafy trees and red-leaved plants
7d26675a34.story: Down a narrow stone path go two men, one in a white shirt, one in black with a leather satchel, walking away without hurry. Red-leaved shrubs line the right side, and a stone railing runs along the left. Leaves hang low enough to brush a head. The path bends a little further on, and they will be out of sight in a few steps.

a3f5de179a.alt: Dense tangle of slender tree trunks, ferns and leaf litter on a forested slope
a3f5de179a.story: Off the path, the forest goes its own way: slender trunks leaning in different directions, ferns pushing up from a floor of brown leaves, vines looped from branch to branch. No path, no sign, no rail. The light is green and dim and slightly damp. It is the kind of place that looks the same in every direction once you are in it.

d01e585873.alt: Tall grey stone carved with red characters standing alone on a lakeside terrace with a green railing
d01e585873.story: Thirty seconds later, the stone stands alone. Its three red characters run top to bottom, chiselled deep into the grey granite, and the green railing behind it frames the water. A tower stands across the lake. The terrace is empty for once, and the stone holds its pose for nobody, same as it does at night.

ba2fc0d793.alt: Temple courtyard with dark stone statues on plinths, a red and gold pavilion at left, cloud-covered mountains
ba2fc0d793.story: An hour on, a different kind of courtyard: broad paving, a row of dark stone statues on plinths, a white balustrade, and a red and gold pavilion at the left edge. Behind it all, mountains vanish into a low wall of cloud. One topiary shrub is clipped into a neat dome. The statues face out at the weather as if waiting for it to clear.

d7afb4fee9.alt: Inscribed stone tablet mounted on a carved turtle-like creature at the foot of a long staircase
d7afb4fee9.story: Dense with carved columns of characters, a tall stone tablet rests on the back of a carved creature with a turtle's shell and a dragon's grinning head. Swirling waves are cut into the base. Behind, a long staircase climbs toward a red building half-hidden in trees. The creature looks patient, as if it has carried the text this way for a long time.

171cd4a93f.alt: Front of an ornate temple with red roof eaves, carved stone columns and a bronze incense burner atop wide steps
171cd4a93f.story: Wide pale steps climb toward a temple front so elaborate it seems to vibrate: red eaves crowded with painted figures, carved stone columns, panels of relief, and at the centre a bronze incense burner with gold trim. The steps are empty. Every surface above them has something to say, and the steps say nothing, which feels like a choice.

d71e470ea5.alt: Close detail of a grey stone relief with painted gold accents and a small papery nest built into a hollow
d71e470ea5.story: Grey stone again: a carved figure in flowing robes sits above carved waves, picked out in gold paint. And in a hollow right at its centre, something has built a small, papery nest, grey on grey, almost invisible. The carving and the nest have different makers and different timescales. Both look carefully done.

7afa8bf2c9.alt: Tall ornamental gateway with golden tiled roofs over a stone plaza, lake and trees visible through the arches
7afa8bf2c9.story: The gateway stands on its own at the end of the plaza, three roofs of golden tiles stacked on dark green pillars, a framed plaque at its centre. Through the arches, blue umbrellas, a bonsai-shaped tree, and a glimpse of the lake. Two tiny figures walk through. The paving in front is huge and empty, a stage with no one on it.

2e10caca39.alt: Wider view of the golden-roofed gateway with small figures walking beneath it, lake and mountains behind
2e10caca39.story: Wider still, a few breaths on: the whole gate now, and mountains rising behind it on both sides, the lake glinting through the left arch. The two figures have walked forward into the plaza, small enough to be the scale bar on a map. Clouds hang low. The gate looks less like an entrance than a frame for the view behind it.

9cd33a060d.alt: Grey stone relief of two robed figures under a flowering tree, accented with gold, red and white paint
9cd33a060d.story: Two robed figures stand side by side in the grey stone, one holding a golden staff, the other with a hand raised toward a tree heavy with blossoms. Gold paint highlights their crowns, belts and the fruit in the branches; thin red lines pick out their hems. The carving has been washed by many rains, and the paint is holding on.

eed791951a.alt: Same stone relief of two robed figures beneath a blossoming tree, framed slightly lower and closer
eed791951a.story: Ten seconds later, from slightly lower, the figures seem taller, their gold crowns nearer the top edge. The texture of the granite shows more clearly now, tiny speckles everywhere, white lines scratched in to draw robes and folds. The blossom above them is painted pale pink at the petal tips. They look as though mid-conversation.

4c9a35f74e.alt: Tight crop of the carved stone figures in robes and gold crowns beneath the flowering branch
4c9a35f74e.story: Closer again, and the faces come into reach: narrow eyes, long beards cut into the stone, one figure looking sideways at the other. The gold on the staff has worn thin at the grip. The balustrade carved behind them has its own tiny patterns. It is the third look at the same panel, and it keeps offering something new.

7a21c01162.alt: Stone relief of a guardian lion with a red ball beside a vase of feathers, gold-painted inscription at left
7a21c01162.story: On this panel a guardian lion stands with one paw on a red patterned ball, mouth open, mane curled. Beside it, a vase sprouts a tall plume of feathers and a dish of fruit sits on a stand. Gold characters run down the left edge, listing names. The lion looks pleased with itself, as though it has just been told a good joke.

74ce141718.alt: Stone relief of a striped tiger crouching down a slope through grass, gold characters on the side
74ce141718.story: The tiger comes down the slope head first, stripes painted in faint gold and green, tail curled up behind it like a question mark. Grass pokes up beneath its paws. A column of gold characters stands along the left margin. Of all the creatures on the wall, it looks the most likely to step off the panel when nobody is watching.

7250a188c9.alt: Tall stone relief panel of flowering branches above two robed figures, with gold inscriptions at the base
7250a188c9.story: This panel stretches tall: flowering branches tangle all the way up, and two small robed figures stand at the bottom by a carved railing, gold touching their crowns and sleeves. Gold characters run in tidy columns along the lower left. Shot from a low angle, the panel looks like a narrow window into a garden that grows upward forever.

f2795fd99d.alt: Stone relief of a spotted deer with gold antlers in a carved frame, gold characters along one side
f2795fd99d.story: A spotted deer turns its head back over its shoulder, its body covered in little painted dots of gold and red, antlers lifted. The carved frame around it twists like an old scroll. Gold characters run down the right edge. It stands perfectly still in the stone, alert, as if it heard a footstep in the courtyard and is deciding whether to run.

3a26f423d2.alt: Stone relief of two large blossoms on a branch over a rock, with green leaves and gold inscription
3a26f423d2.story: Two full blossoms open on a single branch, their petals cut in layered ridges, leaves tipped in green. The stem rises from a smooth carved rock. Gold characters stand to the right in two columns. Of all the panels, this one is the quietest: no heroes, no beasts, only flowers holding their pose in grey stone and a little bit of paint.

52e7d3df0a.alt: Carved stone panel of figures, a chariot and trees with gold detail, a small nest lodged in the lower carving
52e7d3df0a.story: Up top, a figure rides a golden chariot through clouds; below, two robed figures meet beside a stream of carved waves. Gold paint lines a bridge and the folds of a sleeve. And tucked into a hollow near the bottom, another small papery nest has been built straight into the stonework, like an unscheduled addition to the programme.

8c34da2b3b.alt: Deeply carved grey stone panel of dragons or qilin twisting among clouds and waves, flecked with red
8c34da2b3b.story: In this square the stone is cut so deep it becomes lace: two beasts coil through clouds and waves, horns and claws and curling tails, flecked with faint red and gold. A painted orb hangs between them. Daylight falls flat across the relief and still finds a hundred tiny shadows. Looking for too long, everything starts to move.

773b6e5a11.alt: Painted statue of a bearded figure with gold crown and armour, blue ribbons, against a red pillar
773b6e5a11.story: Huge and gilded, the bearded guardian looms against a red pillar: gold crown studded with ornaments, a long black beard flowing past his chest, blue ribbons swirling out behind his head like smoke. His eyes look down and slightly away. Seen from below, he fills the whole frame, and the visitors underneath him become, briefly, very small.

408eea44bd.alt: Carved wooden throne-like chair on a table in a dim temple hall, red pillars and white stairs behind
408eea44bd.story: Shade fills the hall where a carved wooden seat sits on a small table between red pillars, its back ornate and dark, two glass cases on either side. Beyond the doorway, white stone stairs rise into bright daylight. The contrast is sharp: cool shadow in here, glare out there. The chair is empty, and seems to prefer it that way.

57baffa928.alt: Altar of painted figures seated before a carved screen with orchids, red pillars and a courtyard beyond
57baffa928.story: A row of carved and painted figures sit before an ornate screen, robed in red and gold, one small pale figure standing among them. White orchids bloom at the left. Red pillars frame the scene, and through the open sides a pine tree and further roofs appear. A card in the corner explains something in small type.

51afdf6ffc.alt: Temple hall altar with seated figures in front of a carved screen, a bright courtyard and pavilion beyond
51afdf6ffc.story: Seen from the rear of the hall, the altar becomes a silhouette: carved figures and screen backlit against the bright courtyard. Beyond them, a white balustrade, a staircase, and a small ornate pavilion at the top, all lined in red. The hall's shadow wraps the frame like a dark border around a lit screen, a picture inside a picture.

ee088186f2.alt: Red lacquered panel inscribed with gold names in columns above a gilded carving of flowers and birds
ee088186f2.story: Close in on the altar's base: a red lacquered board carries column after column of gold characters, names set in tidy rows. Below it, gilded flowers and leaves spread across the panel in relief. A painted figure blurs above. Every name is equally small and equally gold, a quiet roll call that nobody reads aloud.

546c63acb7.alt: Large stone relief of dragons coiling around a golden orb set in a courtyard, white balustrades around it
546c63acb7.story: Set into the courtyard and ringed with white balustrade, a great slab of carved stone writhes with dragons, scales and whiskers and claws, all circling a small golden orb at the centre. Coins and offerings glint in the hollows. Behind the railing, the red and gold of the hall's eaves runs in a long strip. Rain has darkened the stone to a green-grey.

be6131950d.alt: Wide view of a dark stone dragon relief set into a courtyard, ringed by white balustrades and red eaves
be6131950d.story: Pulling back, more dragons appear at the edges, five or six of them in all, coiling around the single golden orb that sits in a little burst of red. The white balustrade frames the slab like a screen bezel. A few coins glint where they landed. Up on the terrace, red tassels hang in rows from the railings.

221ffd6630.alt: Red temple door with gilded carved panels of flowers and birds, gold characters on its frame, green marble beside
221ffd6630.story: Lacquered a deep, glossy red, the door has its central panel filled with gilded carving: flowers, branches and birds, all openwork, light showing through the gaps. Gold characters descend the frame on the left. Beside it, a slab of green marble veined like smoke. The hinges are hidden. It would make a satisfying, heavy sound if it closed.

149c3dcb0b.alt: Brightly painted relief of dragons among white and blue clouds and waves below a temple balustrade and red pillars
149c3dcb0b.story: Down the steps, another dragon slab, this one in full colour: green and bronze dragons swimming through white curls of cloud and blue waves, a single gold pearl at the centre. Above it, the white balustrade, a strip of red tassels, the red pillars of the hall. A black iron railing guards the bottom edge, keeping feet off the sky.

153db1d0c8.alt: Painted dragon relief in blue and white clouds rising toward a temple hall with red pillars and gold eaves
153db1d0c8.story: Upright, the composition becomes a staircase of colour: the painted dragons fill the bottom, the white balustrade cuts across the middle, and the hall's red pillars and golden lattice rise above. The pearl in the dragons' midst sits almost exactly in line with the hall's central door. Someone planned the view to line up just like this.

9d9ae1fc93.alt: Nearly identical view of the painted dragon slab and the red-pillared hall above, framed slightly wider
9d9ae1fc93.story: One more try. The frame is a whisker wider, and the clouds in the relief have a little more room to swirl. The red pillars stand slightly closer to the edges. A careful double check, the way a broadcaster runs the same clip twice to be sure the signal reached everyone.

d0708ce6b3.alt: Black stone shaped like a turtle shell on a wooden plinth with a framed picture, a shop rack behind
d0708ce6b3.story: A round black stone sits on a wooden plinth, its surface scratched with pale marks, shaped very much like a turtle shell. A framed picture of it is propped on the front, as if it needed a portrait of its own. Behind, carved stone chairs and a rack of red charms. It looks less like an exhibit and more like a guest waiting to be called.

9f8787ef22.alt: Row of red tassels and golden bells hanging along a white stone railing beside a bronze urn and tall pine trees
9f8787ef22.story: Hundreds of red tassels and small gold charms hang in a dense row along the white railing, each one left by someone, all of them stirring in the breeze. A bronze urn rises at the left, wrapped in a carved dragon. Tall dark pines stand behind. The row runs out of the frame and keeps going, a long hush of red.

4a8987ecf8.alt: Old bronze bell with red characters hanging in a red wooden frame inside a temple hall
4a8987ecf8.story: A heavy bronze bell hangs from a red wooden frame, its flared lip scalloped, its sides cast with red-painted characters. The metal has dulled to brown and grey, the surface softly pitted. Gold carvings glimmer in the hall behind. It hangs perfectly still. A single strike would probably carry all the way down to the water.

422c23f131.alt: Closer upright view of the bronze bell with red characters in its red frame, gilded carvings behind
422c23f131.story: Closer by a step, the bell fills more of the frame and its cast details sharpen: the hanging loop shaped like a creature, the rough seam around its shoulder, the red characters standing out against the bronze. A wooden step sits below. It waits the way bells wait, which is to say entirely.

ef2939fa45.alt: Ornate gilded temple altar with a seated bearded figure in red and gold robes, flowers and offerings below
ef2939fa45.story: Everything in the main hall is gold. Carved columns and panels rise in tiers around a seated, bearded figure in red and gold robes, framed by a painted backdrop of clouds. Vases of flowers and dishes of offerings line the black lacquered altar below. A small white card stands to one side. The light is warm and low and very quiet.

4da45fa860.alt: Altar with two seated figures in red and gold flanked by standing statues, magenta orchids in vases
4da45fa860.story: Another altar, wider still: two seated figures in the centre, standing guardians on each side holding weapons, and arrangements of magenta orchids spilling over the edges. Fruit and offerings crowd the table below. A tall column of small gold plaques glints on the left. The colours are so dense that the eye has trouble deciding where to settle.

dc5f147757.alt: Large wooden drum with a glossy grain mounted on a tall red stand against a marble wall, a no-touch sign below
dc5f147757.story: The drum sits high on its red stand, its body polished wood with swirling grain, studs running around the rim. A sign below it shows a hand crossed out in red, a polite instruction. Behind it, marble walls in grey and white. Opposite, across the hall, the bell hangs in its own frame. Neither one is making a sound.

81d2e2e7d1.alt: Gilded altar with a seated golden figure, pink orchids on either side, a visitor in a blue cap in the foreground
81d2e2e7d1.story: A visitor in a teal cap stands in the foreground, back turned, facing the gilded altar where a golden figure sits wrapped in robes beneath a crown of carved eaves. Pink orchids flank the shrine. The visitor is close enough to blur, which only makes the altar look further away, like the end of a long corridor of gold.

5d6c45e453.alt: Miniature red shrine with a curved roof and a small crowned figure, set on gravel behind a red railing
5d6c45e453.story: A miniature shrine, waist high: a curved roof, red posts, blue strips of characters on either side, and inside a small crowned figure with a calm painted face. A red offering box sits in front, gravel spread around it. A tiny red fence encloses the whole scene. Everything about it is scaled down except the care that went into it.

c388f87d98.alt: Miniature red shrine with a curved golden roof and a small crowned figure, painted sky backdrop behind
c388f87d98.story: Turned upright, the little shrine shows its full roof, golden tiles curling up at each corner, and a painted sky of blue and white behind it. The crowned figure sits small and serene under the eaves, a scroll laid in front. The red railings run off to either side. It looks like a stage set for a play with one actor.

f15cb7232f.alt: Wide view of a gilded altar with two seated figures, standing guardians and banks of magenta orchids
f15cb7232f.story: Back to the big altar, wider and straighter this time: the gilded carving runs edge to edge, the two seated figures sit at the centre, the guardians stand at attention, and the orchids burst magenta from both sides. A brass basin waits on the table in front. Everything is symmetrical except the flowers, which have their own ideas.

bf14a79e46.alt: Gilded shrine with a seated figure with a long white beard in gold robes, pink orchids and offerings in front
bf14a79e46.story: A seated figure with a long pale beard sits in gold robes against a backdrop of painted clouds and carved dragons, hands resting in his lap. Pink orchids bloom in two pots on the step below, and a few offerings sit on small dishes. The lacquered table beneath is black and gold, its curved front gleaming under the lights.

cab423c47c.alt: Three grey stone statues, a horse and two armoured figures, on plinths before misty mountains
cab423c47c.story: Outside again, three stone statues stand on plinths along the terrace: a horse, a smaller armoured figure, and a tall one in full armour with a long beard and a weapon. Behind them, mountains roll into mist. A car park and white railings sit just below. The statues face forward like a welcoming committee that has been waiting a very long time.

61317c606e.alt: Potted topiary trees in white planters along a terrace, mountains and lake behind under an overcast sky
61317c606e.story: Three topiary trees stand in square white planters along the terrace, their foliage clipped into cloudy round tufts. A brown bin and a broom lean in the corner. Through the branches of a larger tree, the mountains and the lake appear one last time. The trees look as if they're also waiting for the bus, in their tidy pots.

9d0e2528af.alt: Street with a shop sign reading YURI SAYS, closed blue shutters, a pedestrian on the pavement, apartments behind
9d0e2528af.story: Next morning, a few minutes before seven. A low shop with its shutters down carries a sign that reads YURI SAYS, beside a blue sign with JC in white. Apartment blocks rise behind. One person walks along the pavement past orange cones, the street otherwise empty. Whatever Yuri says, it will have to wait until opening time.

e6fc22e4d9.alt: Closer view of YURI SAYS shop and neighbouring signs, blue shutters closed, a pedestrian walking past
e6fc22e4d9.story: The walker has moved a few steps further along, and the frame has shifted to show a red-and-white sign next door and a round clock on a pole. The blue shutters stay shut. A tree leans into the top left corner. The city has not quite switched on yet; it is still running the early-morning test card.

ae8971cd84.alt: Tall brown brick apartment tower with air conditioners and signs beside a glass building, overcast sky
ae8971cd84.story: Looking up: a narrow tower of brown brick, every window fitted with an air conditioning unit, a few blue and red banners hung across its middle floors. A glass building rises behind it, reflecting the grey sky. At the base, a corrugated roof. The tower looks slightly too tall for its width, like it stretched overnight.

e293999253.alt: Rainy street seen from a vehicle, a white and a black car parked by a hedge under a rusted corrugated roof
e293999253.story: Late morning, and it is raining. From a window, a white car and a black one sit parked beside a dense green hedge, a rust-streaked corrugated roof sagging above. The wet road reflects the cars in long smears. Yellow and black stripes run along the asphalt, and the edge of a yellow vehicle intrudes at the corner.

df5c8a1cb8.alt: Same rainy roadside with parked white and black cars and a rust-red roof, framed slightly differently
df5c8a1cb8.story: Nineteen seconds later, the rain is still coming down and the view barely shifts: the rusty roof, the hedge, the two parked cars, the shine on the tarmac. A scooter waits under cover at the left. Everything stays where it is, as if the whole street has decided to wait out the weather together.

243b9bc057.alt: Rainy roadside with a red-roofed shed, hedge, and white and black cars, a yellow car hood at lower right
243b9bc057.story: Eight seconds more. The rust-red roof, the hedge with a tree poking through, the white car with its black roof, the black SUV behind. A pair of cones lean at the kerb. The yellow bonnet of the vehicle in the corner shows the view is still from inside, dry and slightly fogged, listening to the drumming overhead.

c33520a4ac.alt: Rain-soaked street with parked cars beside a hedge and rusted roof, a yellow bonnet and wiper in the corner
c33520a4ac.story: A fourth look at the same scene, a windscreen wiper's edge now visible at the bottom right. The colours have gone deep and saturated in the wet: red roof, green hedge, black asphalt. It feels like holding on one channel because nothing else is on, and finding it oddly watchable.

8b99d3b3d7.alt: Rainy curving street with umbrellas, a yellow taxi and shopfronts, a FamilyMart sign at the right edge
8b99d3b3d7.story: Umbrellas have opened now, a red one and a pale one under the shop's edge, and a car's dark roof slides into the bottom left. The yellow taxi waits at the bend; the double yellow lines curve after it. The FamilyMart sign stands guard on the right. Everyone is calculating the distance to the next dry spot.

5253e85692.alt: White-helmeted honour guards in dark uniforms stand on a wide plaza before a crowd behind red rope
5253e85692.story: A vast grey plaza, the following morning. Guards in white helmets and dark uniforms stand apart at precise intervals, rifles at their sides, and a dense crowd presses behind a red rope at the edge. Tall apartment blocks rise above the trees beyond. The air is heavy and green-grey. Everyone holds still, waiting for the first step.

22dd6b402e.alt: Honour guards in white helmets marching in formation across a plaza, spectators watching behind a rope
22dd6b402e.story: Then they move. Boots strike the paving in unison, white gloves swinging, the line of guards turning together like parts of one mechanism. The crowd leans forward behind the rope, phones up, umbrellas furled. A tree trimmed into a cone stands at the centre of the trees beyond, as precise as the march itself.

c3ae1b2580.alt: Four honour guards mid-stride with legs raised in a slow high step, crowd lined up along a red rope
c3ae1b2580.story: Mid-stride, one leg lifted, held, lowered: the guards march in slow motion, almost a dance, every helmet at the same angle. Eight seconds and the formation has shifted left. The spectators have gone very quiet; even the children in the crowd seem to know not to talk. Only the click of heels, carrying across the open stone.

6eaeca00cf.alt: Brass plaque with Chinese and English text set before a scale model of a large memorial complex under glass
6eaeca00cf.story: A brass plaque glows under the case's lights, two columns of Chinese characters on the left and English on the right, describing the construction of the hall and park and its later role as a public space. Behind it, beyond the glass, a model of the whole site stretches out in miniature, gardens and gates and tiny trees.

1b8ffb0ebe.alt: Scale model of a large orange-roofed hall with gardens and gates under glass, reflections of visitors above
1b8ffb0ebe.story: Glass covers a model hall with orange roofs sits among tiny gardens, plazas and toy cars, everything rendered in careful miniature. Reflections of visitors drift across the top of the case like ghosts on an old screen. The brass plaque intrudes at the bottom right. From this height, it is easy to imagine walking every path in a minute.

38b967cc3b.alt: Closer view of the model orange-roofed hall with its tiered roof, steps and surrounding miniature trees
38b967cc3b.story: A minute later, closer and sharper. The hall's tiered orange roofs and red columns come into focus, a curving ramp leading up to the doors, a row of miniature trees standing to attention along the drive. A tiny blue car waits at the side. The plaque is still there in the foreground, reflecting a sheen of gold.

a0392e91af.alt: Scale model of a white memorial hall with a blue roof among green lawns, visitor reflections in the glass
a0392e91af.story: Another model, this one of a white hall with a deep blue octagonal roof, standing alone at the end of a long green lawn. In the glass above it, visitors' reflections overlap: a pink backpack, a striped sleeve, a hand on a hip. Two layers, one real and one tiny, folded onto the same pane of glass like a double exposure.

67f5747756.alt: Large black-and-white photograph of a man waving to a vast crowd before an ornate gate, hung on a gallery wall
67f5747756.story: Hanging on the gallery wall is a huge black-and-white print: a man seen from behind at a lectern, one arm raised, facing an ocean of heads that fills the square all the way to a grand white gate. A small flag stands beside him. In the corner of the room, a living visitor stands next to the frame, roughly the size of one of the crowd.

4450edbc2a.alt: Close view of the black-and-white photograph of a man with a raised arm addressing an enormous crowd
4450edbc2a.story: Closer, the print fills the frame and the crowd becomes texture: thousands of grainy heads, a few banners, the gate rising white at the far end. The raised hand and the back of the jacket sit at the centre. The image is old and enormous and silent. It looks, more than anything, like a single frame paused from a broadcast.

ddbc8d87cf.alt: Arched doorway with a fanlight of square panes and double doors, a red carpet runner in a polished hall
ddbc8d87cf.story: An arched doorway glows at the end of the hall, its fanlight divided into small square panes, its double doors open onto a red carpet runner. The floor reflects the light in a long pale streak. A sign on the left wall half-fades into shadow. It looks like the entrance to the next scene, lit and waiting.

a01af5bb25.alt: Polished black vintage car with chrome grille and whitewall tyres on display behind a red rope
a01af5bb25.story: A long black car gleams under the gallery lights, its chrome grille wide as a grin, whitewall tyres spotless, a white information card propped at its front wheel. Behind it, another black car sits in the shadow. Brass posts and red rope hold visitors at a respectful distance. It looks freshly waxed, though it has not gone anywhere in years.

b7ee874d6f.alt: Front of a black vintage car with plate 0888 behind red ropes, a framed historical poster on the wall above
b7ee874d6f.story: Head on, the car's twin headlights and heavy chrome bumper face the room, a plate reading 0888 tucked beneath the grille. A second black car parks beside it. On the wall above hangs a framed poster with an old photograph and a line of English text. The red rope dips between brass posts. A visitor slips past at the left.

f16730c369.alt: Rear of a black vintage car with chrome fins and plate 0888, visitors walking past along a roped path
f16730c369.story: From behind, the same car shows its chrome fins, a V-shaped emblem on the boot, and the 0888 plate again. A no-touching sign sits on the floor below the bumper. Visitors stream past on the right: denim shorts, a backpack, a white shirt. One of them glances at the car. The rest are looking ahead to the next room.

94694869c2.alt: Glass display case with a dark robe, a black-and-white photograph of a seated man reading, a hat and small objects
94694869c2.story: Behind glass, a dark long robe hangs beside a black-and-white photograph of a man seated, reading, a hat on his knee. On the plinth below lie a black hat, a pair of spectacles, a small case, a few folded items, each placed with care. The lights inside are cool and soft. Objects that once had daily uses, now only looked at.

845d4df803.alt: Recreated office with a seated figure at a wooden desk, maps and scroll paintings on the wall, a flag in the corner
845d4df803.story: Through the glass, a reconstructed study: a wooden desk, armchairs in pale upholstery, a large globe, tall vases, scroll paintings and two framed maps on the wall, a flag at the centre. A figure sits behind the desk, very still. The red carpet runs to the barrier. It is a room stopped mid-afternoon, its clock removed.

3eef2c9127.alt: Bronze bust on a stone pedestal at the end of a narrow cream-walled alcove with a red carpet
3eef2c9127.story: At the end of a narrow alcove, a bronze bust sits on a pale stone pedestal, lit from above, a soft shadow cast on the wall behind. Red carpet covers the floor up to its base. Two tall wooden windows flank the space, closed. There is nothing else here. The quiet is total, the kind that makes footsteps sound too loud.

b655653f2f.alt: Black vintage limousine with quad headlights behind red ropes, a visitor in white facing a flag display
b655653f2f.story: Another black car, longer and squarer, its quad headlights and wide grille polished to a mirror. Red ropes swing between brass posts around it. Further back, a visitor in a white T-shirt stands studying a flag in a glass case. The car's whitewall tyre catches a curl of light. It looks heavy enough to have its own gravity.

ea281556a4.alt: Exhibition hall with large collage panels of photos and artworks, a painted pond illusion on the floor
ea281556a4.story: Twenty minutes later, a brighter room: freestanding panels covered in collages of photographs, paintings, calligraphy, a red fish, a pink pig, a temple roof. On the floor, someone has painted a pond with a white bird and a stone step, a trick of perspective meant to be stood in. The colours are loud after so much dark wood and bronze.

252d494fcc.alt: White stone hall with blue-tiled roof edge, arched doorway and broad stairs with white balustrades
252d494fcc.story: Outside, the hall rises in white stone, its walls slanting inward, its roof edge just visible at the top in dark blue tile. Broad stairs climb the right side between carved balustrades, a few visitors halfway up. An arched doorway opens at the bottom left. Under the flat grey sky, the white looks almost luminous.

a9fb1cf870.alt: Upward view of a white stone hall with a dark octagonal roof, wide stairs climbing at the right
a9fb1cf870.story: Tilt the head back and the whole structure appears: the white stone body narrowing slightly to the top, the dark roof flaring out in two tiers, a bronze finial on its peak. A long staircase runs up the right side, two small figures climbing it. An arched door sits at the bottom left. It is hard not to feel tilted.

5ca30ba2c8.alt: Formal garden with orange and yellow marigolds and clipped hedges, a white gate with blue roofs and towers behind
5ca30ba2c8.story: A formal garden blazes below the hall with orange and yellow flowers set in clipped green borders, spiky red-leaved plants in the corners. Beyond it, a white gate with deep blue tiled roofs, and behind that, the city: an office block with blue glass, apartments, grey sky. A few visitors drift along the path.

0c42359262.alt: Symmetrical view of a white hall with a dark two-tiered roof and bronze finial atop a central staircase
0c42359262.story: Dead centre now, from the bottom of the stairs: the hall is perfectly symmetrical, two-tiered roof balanced above white walls, balustrades fanning out on either side, the staircase disappearing into its middle. The sky is a single grey tone. It looks like a station logo, held still on the screen before the programming starts.

b3d083f5d3.alt: Nearly identical centred view of the white hall and dark roof against a grey sky, slightly further back
b3d083f5d3.story: Forty-five seconds later, a few steps back, the hall sits slightly lower in the frame and a touch more of the sky shows above it. The balustrades stretch wider. Nothing else has changed, except that the clouds behind have darkened a shade. A second attempt at the same symmetry, adjusted by a breath.

58647c3f76.alt: White hall with a dark tiered roof against a greenish stormy sky, viewed from below
58647c3f76.story: The sky turns strange, a greenish grey, and the hall's white stone takes on the same tint. The roof sits darker than ever, its finial just touching the clouds. The balustrades in front are dim. In this light, it could be a transmission arriving from very far away, colours drifting before the signal locks.

dd2511bc18.alt: Broad paved avenue between lawns and pine trees leading toward a distant gate and orange-roofed building
dd2511bc18.story: Turning around, the view runs back down a long paved avenue between lawns and tall dark pines, orange cones dotted along its edge. At the far end, a white gate and an orange-roofed building sit small on the horizon. A handful of people walk the distance. A figure in black is half in frame at the right.

bdbe4b56ad.alt: Same long avenue toward a distant gate, a person walking at right, cones on the paving
bdbe4b56ad.story: One second later, the walker at the right has moved into the frame properly, a dark shape heading away along the avenue. The cones haven't moved, nor have the pines. The gate at the end looks no closer. The distance is the point, perhaps; it takes a long time to cross, and that gives the eyes something to do.

bb45752f06.alt: Corner of the white stone hall with dark tiered roof and an arched doorway at the bottom left
bb45752f06.story: A last angle on the hall: one corner, the slanting white wall, the edge of the roof tiers dark against a pale sky, an arched doorway carved with patterns at the bottom left. The balustrade runs across the middle like a line of text. Everything is very still, and very large, and very quiet.

9763eaeee8.alt: Long bright gallery with a polished floor, two visitors photographing a panel, another walking away with a backpack
9763eaeee8.story: Inside, a long bright corridor with a polished floor that reflects the ceiling lights in a row. Two visitors stop by the wall, one holding a phone up to a panel. Someone in a red shirt with a backpack walks away toward an orange wall and a wide landscape print. The gallery is cool and calm after the grey outside.

9d638fef36.alt: Visitors with phones raised before a seated bronze statue flanked by two flags in a marble hall
9d638fef36.story: Nine in the morning and the hall is already full of raised phones. A visitor in a dark shirt holds his screen up like a small offering, and the bronze figure on the throne answers with nothing. Two flags stand at attention on either side. Up on the pale marble, the characters for ethics, democracy and science wait above everyone's heads, older than the crowd and patient with it.

0fb6fdb80d.alt: Crowd in white and black clothing behind a red rope, facing a seated bronze statue between two flags
0fb6fdb80d.story: Twenty seconds later the frame turns sideways and the crowd thickens. Backs in white shirts, backs in black shirts, a shoulder bag, a face mask. Brass posts hold a red rope that nobody tests.
