Behind it the statue sits exactly as it did a moment ago, hands on the armrests, as if it has been asked to hold still for a very long exposure and agreed.

f9fca1617c.alt: Seated bronze statue on a stone plinth against pale marble wall with carved characters and two flags
f9fca1617c.story: Somehow the heads drop out of the frame. Only the tops of a few hairlines remain along the bottom edge, like a broadcast cutting off the studio audience. Now it is just the bronze, the plinth with its engraved panel, two flags and the long lines of gold characters on the marble. The hall is not empty, only quieter for the length of a breath.

c99cfee9b9.alt: Bronze seated statue centred between two flags below marble wall inscriptions, lit warm from above
c99cfee9b9.story: Step back a little and the wall takes over. The inscriptions spread wider, three blocks of text, the middle one titled with two large characters. Warm light falls from somewhere high and pools on the statue's knees and folded robe. The flags lean in slightly, as if leaning to listen. A low hum of footsteps fills the space that the frame leaves out.

8fe88f29f2.alt: Darker view of the bronze statue between flags under a marble wall of carved text
8fe88f29f2.story: The light shifts, or the eye does. Everything goes a shade greener and dimmer, like a late-night rerun of the same scene. The statue keeps its posture, the flags keep their stripes of red and blue, and the carved columns of text keep saying the same three words. Only the colour has changed its mind.

09d1df3152.alt: Bronze statue on throne between two flags, carved inscriptions above, warm evenly lit marble
09d1df3152.story: Final take of the morning. The marble glows almost cream, the bronze reads clearly down to the folds at the sleeves, and the plinth's engraved panel shows a faint landscape. Flags on either side, inscriptions overhead, no one in the way. Two minutes have passed since the crowd. Outside, the day is getting warm and the next group is already climbing the steps.

1174594a6a.alt: Elevated view over a plaza with white market tents and umbrellas between two orange-roofed halls, grey sky
1174594a6a.story: From the top of the steps, the plaza becomes a diagram. Rows of white tents run down the middle, hedges curl in green patterns on both sides, and dozens of umbrellas bloom among the crowd though the rain is barely there. Two orange-roofed halls face each other across the space. Far off, a gate and a grey line of towers close the view.

5cd7f8aaf3.alt: Same plaza view, white tents and umbrella-carrying crowd between two traditional halls under overcast sky
5cd7f8aaf3.story: Two seconds later, nothing and everything has moved. An umbrella near the tents has turned a different way. A figure in white has stepped off the stone balustrade's shadow. The sky stays the colour of dishwater, the roofs stay orange, the hedges keep their knots. A festival is happening down there, quietly, at the volume of a radio left on in another room.

e294685794.alt: Brighter view of the plaza with white festival tents, crowds and umbrellas between two orange-roofed halls
e294685794.story: The clouds thin enough to lift the colour. Now the tent roofs show red stripes, the distant gate shines white, and the crowd resolves into separate people with separate umbrellas. Someone near the left balustrade is pointing at something. Across the plaza a flagpole stands over the gate, its flag hanging still. The air smells of wet stone and fried snacks drifting up the stairs.

efe7e22562.alt: Looking up into an ornate octagonal ceiling with lit coffers, carved rings and a dark blue centre
efe7e22562.story: Inside, look straight up. The ceiling folds inward in octagons, each ring more carved than the last, until it opens on a disc of deep blue edged with gold points like a sun drawn by a child. Lamps hidden in the coffers throw warm light along the beams. It is the kind of pattern that seems to rotate if you stare at it too long.

8e8a22b0a9.alt: Ornate octagonal ceiling with gold coffers and a deep blue centre, viewed directly from below
8e8a22b0a9.story: Ten seconds more of staring and the pattern does start to turn. The blue centre becomes a tunnel. The gold points around it look like teeth, or rays, or the iris of an enormous eye looking back down at the floor. Around the edges the grid of small square panels hums like a screen between channels. Then a voice somewhere below breaks the spell.

1929f5d939.alt: Wide hall with a long red carpet leading to a seated statue; a crouching man photographs two children
1929f5d939.story: Back down at floor level, a long red carpet runs toward the statue like a runway for something important. Halfway along, a man in a white cap crouches low, phone up, while two small figures pose by the rope near the flags. One of them stands very straight, arms by the sides. Behind them the bronze sits, larger than all of them, and does not mind being background.

b101eaabd4.alt: Night view over an aircraft wing toward another airliner on a lit apron, lettering 'STAR' on its fuselage
b101eaabd4.story: Evening on the apron, just after six. Through the window the wing stretches out pale and flat, a small yellow mark on its surface catching the floodlights. Across the tarmac another jet waits with letters starting STAR on its side, lights blazing behind its tail. Somewhere a ground crew member waves a wand. The engines rise in pitch, and the island begins to step backward into the dark.

4341670edb.alt: Muddy fatigues and black boots lying empty on dry leaves and weeds beside a rusty red structure
4341670edb.story: Someone left a whole outfit on the ground. Trousers caked in dried mud, a jacket bunched at the waist, black boots still pointing toes-down as if the wearer simply dissolved mid-crawl. Leaves have started to settle in the folds. A stick lies across the grass above it like a marker. The red edge of a metal stair cuts into the corner, and the afternoon carries on around the empty clothes.

5937f8cab8.alt: Wide, sunny lawn under large trees with a gravel road, white containers and a metal frame structure
5937f8cab8.story: Pull back and the set appears. A gravel road curves through dry grass, big shade trees hold the whole sky in their branches, and a scaffold of metal pipes stands beside a white box with a ladder. Two tiny figures sit on the grass in the far shade. The light is long and gold. Somewhere among these props, the next shot is being chosen.

55f9232e31.alt: Small white dog standing on a sunny lawn, trees and red containers with a staircase in the background
55f9232e31.story: Intermission. A small white dog wanders onto the lawn and stops in the middle of the frame, ears up, studying something only it can see. Behind it, the red containers and their staircase wait among the trees, out of focus and out of work. Sun lies across the grass in a long bright band. The dog decides it is not interested and trots off.

abae6d43dc.alt: Figure in a white shirt and blue shorts walking away down a tree-lined lane beside tall grass
abae6d43dc.story: Shirt still on, but the shorts have changed to blue with a yellow stripe, and he is walking away down a cracked lane under big trees. Tall grass leans in from the left. A faded sign hangs on a shed up ahead. The shoot is over, or on a break, and the road has become the subject, with him just passing through it.

37bb758780.alt: Small grey roadside building with dark windows under tangled trees and a lamppost
37bb758780.story: No one in the frame this time. A small grey block of a building sits at the roadside, its dark windows reflecting nothing, its lower wall of brick going green at the base. Vines and branches climb over the roof as if trying to take it back. Sunlight hits the upper wall in a clean rectangle. It looks like a booth for broadcasting to no audience.

56ae687fb9.alt: Overgrown hillside of weeds and shrubs in hazy golden light, a metal roof and power lines behind
56ae687fb9.story: Turn away from the road and there is only overgrowth: weeds taller than a person, a tangle of shrubs, a corrugated roof sinking into the green. Power lines draw thin diagonals across the trees. Haze softens the hills behind. The light comes in low and golden, making every seed head glow, and the air seems thick enough to hear.

79305574b0.alt: White dog standing in roadside grass beside wooden sign posts, a road curving behind
79305574b0.story: Whatever he was watching for turns out to be a dog. White, a little scruffy, it stands in the long roadside grass by two weathered posts holding up a sign turned the other way. Its tail curls up and its mouth hangs open in the heat. The road bends away behind it, empty. For now, the dog owns this corner.

54ce7e958c.alt: Quiet curving road with a yellow centre line under tall trees, houses and power poles ahead
54ce7e958c.story: Late afternoon and the road is empty. A yellow line swings around a gentle bend, shadows from the trees lying across the asphalt in long bands. Houses with pitched roofs sit back among the gardens, and power poles carry their wires off toward the sky. No traffic, no voices, only the feeling of having walked a little further than planned.

5979160e83.alt: White dog trotting down the middle of a rural road with dashed yellow lines, green hills behind
5979160e83.story: The dog has decided to lead. It trots right down the centre of the lane, between the dashed yellow lines, toward a row of green hills. Power poles step along the right side like a line of spaced-out sentries. Tall grass crowds both edges. It never looks back, which is how you know it expects to be followed.

60b6dd53ff.alt: Two-storey house half hidden behind tall grass and trees, with a forested hill and pale sky behind
60b6dd53ff.story: Over the tall grass, a two-storey house with a brown tiled roof peers from behind the trees, its windows dark. A long low wall runs along the field. The forested hill rises soft and rounded behind everything, and the sky above it has gone pale. It is a quiet view, the kind that plays behind the credits while nobody is watching.

9cdbb52ba3.alt: Tall grass and seed heads glowing in hazy backlight, trees and a rooftop softened behind
9cdbb52ba3.story: Turn toward the sun and the grass catches fire without burning. Seed heads glow on thin stalks, the trees behind blur into gold and green fog, and a roof edge barely holds its shape at the right. It is all haze and brightness, the picture losing its detail the way a weak signal does, beautifully, on purpose.

03d03f062a.alt: White dog standing on a cracked, patched lane between grassy verges, trees and power poles ahead
03d03f062a.story: The dog is back, standing on a patched and cracked stretch of lane, looking further up the road toward something small and orange in the distance. Grass grows along both edges, a pale wall runs down the right, and trees close in at the far end. It waits, tail up, as if deciding whether the next part of the walk is worth it.

4e76501c15.alt: Low view of a grey wall and trees under a pale sky crossed by power lines, a white roof on the left
4e76501c15.story: Tilt up. The ground falls away and the sky takes most of the frame: pale blue, soft clouds, a thin bundle of power lines cutting diagonally across. Below, the top of a long grey wall, a round lamp, dark trees and a white roof corner. It is the kind of view you see while lying on your back on warm concrete, waiting for nothing in particular.

14a8a87c47.alt: White two-storey building with tall openings and a gabled end, a red sign by the fence, a white bird by the road
14a8a87c47.story: A white building with tall rectangular openings stands on the far side of the road, unfinished or abandoned, its windows showing sky straight through. A red and white sign leans by the fence. At the bottom edge something white is crossing, a bird, its neck stretched forward. The sky is clear, and the building looks like a set nobody came back to finish.

e4263624b7.alt: Distant figure in a white shirt and blue shorts walking along a curving road under tall trees
e4263624b7.story: Further now. He walks away up the road, small in the frame, white shirt and blue shorts against the grey asphalt. Tall pale-trunked trees lean over the left side, a red-roofed house sits on the bend, and the yellow centre line curls ahead. The sun comes low through the branches. It looks like the end of a broadcast day, someone heading home.

c9c48cbe71.alt: Close view of a foot in a black slide sandal with white logo on grey asphalt
c9c48cbe71.story: Look down. One foot in a black slide with a white logo, planted on rough grey asphalt, a blue-and-white sleeve edging into the corner. After a whole afternoon of faces and roads, this is the most ordinary detail possible, and somehow it feels like proof: someone stood here, on this exact patch of road, at the end of the walk.

394f8dd49c.alt: Silhouetted bird perched on a metal lattice tower under a pale sky, a dark wire and leaves crossing
394f8dd49c.story: Final frame: a bird perched on top of a thin metal tower, black against a pale sky, with a heavy wire slicing through the frame and leaves dark at the edges. The tower looks like a small transmitter. The bird sits on it as if waiting for a signal, or sending one. Then the light drops, and the afternoon signs off.

cd7461e96a.alt: Wooden gate and red fence in deep shade, sunlit trees and a white house with a peaked roof behind
cd7461e96a.story: Outside the front door, the light hits like a switch. Sun pours through the leaves onto a white house with a steep brown roof across the way, while the near side stays in deep shade. A wooden gate and a red slatted fence close the yard. On a gatepost, a small white figure stands guard, catching a single spark of sun.

9a1fda15bb.alt: Porch railing lined with small potted cacti, a stone pillar, a tree stump and bottles in shade
9a1fda15bb.story: Along the porch railing, a row of small potted cacti takes the sun like a waiting audience. A tall one leans on a tree-stump stand among watering bottles and a yellow tub. The stone pillar holds the shade on the left. Through the turned balusters, the garden flickers green. It looks like a collection someone tends every morning, one pot at a time.

607257fd9b.alt: Dog figurine and pink artificial flowers on a stump planter beside a stone wall and window on a porch
607257fd9b.story: A ceramic dog sits on a stump planter by the window, ears up, wearing a crown of pink plastic roses. It stares out at the garden with the patience of something that has never once been fed. Behind it, the stone wall glows warm and the window reflects a curtain of green. A cardboard box peeks out at the bottom, mid-unpacking.

fb75f8ed4f.alt: Garden path of square stepping stones in white gravel, clothes on a rack and statues among palms
fb75f8ed4f.story: Ten minutes later, the garden. Square stepping stones march across white gravel toward a rack of shirts drying in the shade. Small statues stand among the plants, a stone figure here, a pagoda lantern there. Palms and a big tree make a ceiling of leaves. Every object seems to have been placed, then forgotten, then placed again.

323508e67e.alt: Blue bicycle with towels hung over it parked on a tiled patio by a stone pillar and potted plants
323508e67e.story: A blue bicycle leans on its kickstand against a stone pillar, two towels draped over the frame and seat like it has also just come back from a swim. The patio tiles are a pattern of teal squares. Snake plants stand tall in the corner, and a ladder of tools hangs in the background. Nobody is riding anywhere for a while.

32935436fd.alt: Dirt lane with tyre tracks under trees beside a parked dark car, power lines overhead
32935436fd.story: Out on the lane, a dark car waits half in shade at the edge of a dirt road. Twin tyre ruts run away from it under a tunnel of trees, power lines stretched above them. The sky is clean blue with one smudge of cloud. Someone is probably looking for keys. The road, at least, already knows where it is going.

9b76e0483a.alt: View from the back seat of a car interior, a driver's hand in a red sleeve on the steering wheel
9b76e0483a.story: Back seat, engine on. A red sleeve reaches for the wheel, the dashboard screens glow blue, and through the windscreen the house is still there, warm wood and green. The headrest blocks half the view. It is the in-between minute of every trip, after the doors shut and before the gear goes in, when the air conditioning hasn't caught up yet.

6c0f8b355b.alt: Car interior on a highway, a hand in a red sleeve on the wheel, open road and green verge ahead
6c0f8b355b.story: Sixteen minutes later the house is gone and the highway has taken over. A hand in a red sleeve rests at the top of the wheel. Through the glass, a long verge of green, a transmission pylon, a few cars far ahead. The rear-view mirror shows only bright sky. The radio, if it is on, is playing something nobody is listening to.

c7765bb3e1.alt: Driver's hand on the steering wheel, multi-lane road with cars and roadside trees through the windscreen
c7765bb3e1.story: Same hand, same wheel, a different stretch of road. Trees press in on the right now and the lanes fill with a few more cars. Light floods the windscreen, washing the dashboard pale. A mountain shape hangs faint on the horizon. The drive settles into that steady hum where conversation drifts and comes back, like a station fading in and out.

9eb02f91ac.alt: Windscreen view of a highway with roadside signs, hills ahead, the dashboard and a red sleeve in frame
9eb02f91ac.story: Signs start to appear along the shoulder, red numbers and arrows flicking past. The hills ahead get closer, greener. A red sleeve on the wheel at the edge of the frame, the mirror catching a white glare of sky. Then the indicator clicks on. Twenty minutes later, there will be a car park, and the engine will finally go quiet.

3003598dec.alt: Person in a beige bucket hat and red top looking at a leafy arch, a Thai rules sign in the corner
3003598dec.story: At the entrance, a figure in a beige bucket hat and red top pauses by a sign headed with a list of rules, red letters on white. Ahead stands a tall green arch made of vines, a doorway into whatever comes next. Small figures move on the far lawn. The shade under the roof is cool. One more step and the outing really begins.

1996933a06.alt: Two visitors at a white kiosk window under a big tree, a red cross on a building behind them
1996933a06.story: Before anything else, the ticket window. Two visitors stand at a small white kiosk under a heavy-limbed tree, one in a black shirt with gold print, the other in red with a white hat. A building with a red cross waits behind them in the shade. A green hose lies coiled on the pavement. The afternoon is bright, slow, and properly started.

b430dbd2ef.alt: Two ponies with halters behind a white metal rail, one cream-coloured, drinking from a blue tub
b430dbd2ef.story: Behind the white rail, two ponies wait in the shade, their manes falling over their eyes. One leans its pale nose toward the blue water tub; the other stands half outside the frame, eyeing the rail. Chipped red paint spots the metal bars. Beyond them the paddock is bright sand, and the first real residents of the afternoon have been found.

7eebcdecd9.alt: Cream pony with a teal halter looking over a white rail, a hay net hanging and another pony behind
7eebcdecd9.story: The pale pony comes to the rail and looks straight out, teal halter bright against its fringe. A net of hay hangs from a post above like a lantern nobody lit. Behind, a darker pony noses the sand. The white bars are scratched with red, and the whole pen smells of dust and dry grass in the early afternoon heat.

c4d57c54e4.alt: Shaded road through a park lined with tall trees, a thatched shelter and distant walkers
c4d57c54e4.story: Further in, the road curves away under tall trees. A thatched shelter stands at the right with figures moving beneath it, and a lone visitor in a cap waits at the edge of the shade. The sun lays a bright patch across the asphalt, and the far path shrinks toward a few small walkers. The whole place hums with leaves.

db5a17c598.alt: Antlered deer reaching for food held by a visitor's hand through a chain-link fence and white rail
db5a17c598.story: Through the chain-link, a stag stretches its neck toward a hand holding a paper cup of something orange. Its antlers branch against the wire in the dappled light. A white rail keeps the human side honest. The animal's mouth is already open, tongue out, a little rude and entirely sure of itself. Behind it, spotted shapes rest in the shade.

640e72d707.alt: Close view of a deer with antlers behind a chain-link fence, mouth open, spotted deer lying behind
640e72d707.story: Up close, the stag is all ears and patience. It leans on the white rail with its chin, mouth open as if mid-word, eyes half-lidded. The fence draws a fine diamond grid across its face. Behind, two spotted deer lie in the dust and ignore the whole performance. The afternoon light falls in pieces through the trees above.

6a1da9dae7.alt: Pack of black-and-white piglets crowding together on a dirt floor, seen from above over a wall
6a1da9dae7.story: Look over the wall and there they are: a dozen black-and-white piglets, packed together in a squirming knot, snouts up, tails curled. One in front trots toward the wall as if expecting someone. Their patches look painted on, each a different map. The ground is dusty and hoof-printed. It is the loudest frame of the day without a single sound.

ac3dc7d0ae.alt: Black-and-white piglets running across a wet concrete floor toward a hand reaching down into the pen
ac3dc7d0ae.story: A hand reaches down into the pen and the piglets come running, one in front with its snout raised and mouth open, the rest stampeding behind across damp concrete. Water streaks the floor in a dark trail. A smaller one wanders off at the back, uninterested. Everything moves at once, and none of it is entirely in focus, which is exactly right.

ecde07484b.alt: Three black-and-white piglets near a mesh fence and post on a sunlit concrete floor
ecde07484b.story: Seven seconds later the crowd has thinned to three. One sniffs at a patch of sunlight on the floor, the other two stand near the mesh fence and post, looking up with mild suspicion. The light falls in leafy fragments across the concrete. It feels like the moment after the commercial break, when the audience has wandered off to the kitchen.

a01454617d.alt: Empty paved road curving through a tree-shaded park with grassy verges and red blossoms above
a01454617d.story: Back on the road, nobody else in sight. It curves gently between lawns, leaves knotted overhead, a few red blossoms catching light in the upper branches. Steps lead up from the left verge toward a dark building half hidden in the trees. The shade is generous, and every footstep on the asphalt sounds louder than it should.

44d5ce4dfd.alt: Stone table and stools in front of a dark mesh enclosure with a small sign, a visitor standing at left
44d5ce4dfd.story: Beside a dark enclosure, a stone table and stone stools sit on a path of flat slabs, all of it streaked with leaf shadow. A small blue-green sign hangs on the mesh. At the far left, a visitor in a black shirt looks in. Inside, nothing obvious moves. Somewhere in that shadow, something might be looking back.

c5d28e443c.alt: Visitor in red with a white hat facing a dark mesh enclosure along a shaded path, others walking behind
c5d28e443c.story: A figure in red and a white bucket hat stops at the enclosure sign, phone raised toward the mesh. Further down the dappled path, two more visitors walk away under the trees. A thick trunk splits the frame on the left. The light here is a patchwork of glare and shadow, the kind that makes every cage look like a dim screen.

04d76e19bb.alt: Pale monkey crouching on a perch inside a wire mesh cage, seen through the grid
04d76e19bb.story: Behind two layers of wire, a pale monkey hunches on its perch, fur glowing in a shaft of light. A thin tail hangs down beside it. The mesh turns the whole scene into a coarse grid, as if the image were being transmitted in blocks. The monkey stays busy with something in its hands and gives the visitors nothing.

e80b0f8ef3.alt: Small golden monkey sitting behind wire mesh, tail curled around, a picture card at lower left
e80b0f8ef3.story: Another cage, another monkey, smaller and golden, sitting upright with both hands to its mouth. Its long tail loops around its feet like a coiled cable. A picture card on the lower left shows a bird and something red. Fluorescent tubes glow behind it. It looks out through the mesh with the air of someone who has seen this audience before.

53435d0036.alt: Same golden monkey behind the mesh, looking out with hands near its face, tail curled below
53435d0036.story: Thirty seconds later it hasn't moved much. A hand drifts from its mouth to its chin, eyes now fixed straight through the wire. The tail stays curled like a question mark that has been put away. The light from the tubes behind it flattens everything into green-black. Two viewers on two sides of a grid, each deciding who is the show.

ed411baa7e.alt: Small monkey with a white crest of fur perched on a branch in a shaft of light inside a dark enclosure
ed411baa7e.story: Inside a darker enclosure, a tiny monkey with a wild white crest perches on a branch, caught in one shaft of sunlight. Its fur flares orange at the back, almost electric. The background is deep green-black, with stray bars of light from the roof. It looks like a creature from a late-night nature programme, startled to find the camera crew already there.

de993a8736.alt: Two small grey monkeys with white ear tufts clinging to a rope inside a netted enclosure
de993a8736.story: Two small grey monkeys cling together on a rope, one staring out over the other's shoulder with white tufts around its face and a serious, almost offended expression. Netting fills the background in soft haze. Their striped tails hang below. The light is coming from behind, giving their fur a halo, like old television figures glowing at the edge of the screen.

a50d8b734a.alt: Large pale lizard resting on sunlit rocks under a log in a dim enclosure
a50d8b734a.story: In a dim terrarium, a large pale lizard lies across a sunlit rock, head lifted slightly, tail trailing off the frame. A log arches above it like a bridge. Dust and heat hang in the air, and the glass softens everything into sepia. Of all the animals today, this one moves the least, and seems the most completely at home.

96b9a5287f.alt: Slender green snake with a patterned head resting on wood chips behind glass, a pot and branch above
96b9a5287f.story: In a glass box, almost lost among wood chips, a slender green snake lifts its patterned head. A bare branch crosses overhead, and a black pot sits in the corner. The glass picks up reflections of the bright world outside, softening everything. The snake does nothing, and doing nothing is clearly what it does best.

1ebf8075b2.alt: Green snake's head barely visible among bark chips through reflective glass, a branch overhead
1ebf8075b2.story: Move a step and the glass fills with reflections: pale tiles, green blurs, a white bar of light. Through all that, the snake's head is just visible, a small checkered shape pointing left at the edge of the chips. It is like trying to find one face in a crowd on a weak broadcast, the signal breaking up around it.

a46d3fdd60.alt: Same terrarium through glass, the small snake's head at right among bark chips under a branch
a46d3fdd60.story: Four seconds later, the snake has slid a little to the right. Same branch, same pot, same pale ledge reflected in the glass. Its head rests at the edge of the bark like a comma. Visitors move on behind, their colours ghosting across the pane. The snake waits for them to go, the way it waits for everything.

faa254ec24.alt: Group of tortoises clustered on red soil in warm red light in the corner of a concrete enclosure
faa254ec24.story: A heap of tortoises piles into the corner of a concrete pen, all of them washed red by a heat lamp. Shells overlap like roof tiles, heads tucked or barely raised. A stripe of real sunlight falls across the wall above them. Nothing moves except, very slowly, one leg. It looks like a still from a broadcast that has drifted to the red end of the dial.

1f7893db17.alt: Tortoises piled together under red lamp light, sunlight streaking the concrete wall behind
1f7893db17.story: Thirty seconds later, the stack has rearranged itself by a few centimetres. One tortoise near the top stretches its neck toward the wall where sunlight slants in through a gap. The red glow makes their shells look warm to the touch. Somewhere near the bottom of the pile, someone is definitely regretting the seating arrangement.

1581cec3f8.alt: Spiny lizard perched on a rock with eyes half closed, blurred green background behind glass
1581cec3f8.story: A spiny lizard rests its chin on a warm stone, eyes nearly closed, a fringe of spikes along its jaw. The world behind it dissolves into green and white blur, the bars of the enclosure softened to smudges. It looks completely relaxed, like someone dozing in a deck chair in front of a television nobody switched off.

fe6c70771d.alt: Same spiny lizard on a rock, head turned slightly, bright green bokeh behind the glass
fe6c70771d.story: Six seconds later the head tilts a fraction. One eye opens to a slit, registers the visitors, decides they are not interesting and drifts closed again. The spines around its throat catch the light in fine points. The background stays soft and green. The heat of the rock is the only thing in this tank that matters.

7463be5f96.alt: Pale bearded lizard lifting its head on a sandy rock, a yellow lizard blurred behind
7463be5f96.story: In the next tank, a paler lizard lifts its head high off a sandy rock, mouth slightly open, looking up at something just off frame. Its back is dense with small spikes. In the blurred distance, a yellow shape that might be another lizard sits motionless. The whole tank glows like old film left too long in the sun.

0efade63a5.alt: Pale spiny lizard on a rock, head raised, warm sandy tones and blurred greenery behind
0efade63a5.story: Four seconds later it holds the same pose, chin high, front legs braced, as if listening to a distant announcement. The yellow blur behind has not moved either. Two lizards, two rocks, one long warm afternoon. It is a picture of complete patience, the kind that makes a human visitor suddenly aware of how much they fidget.

596c1b6964.alt: Bearded lizard on a rock seen in profile, head raised, blurred enclosure and greenery behind
596c1b6964.story: Three seconds on, the angle shifts and the lizard looks more like a small dragon: crest of spikes, wide flat head, a single glinting eye. A blurred ledge and some green bokeh fill the back. Its claws grip the stone. Either it is posing on purpose, or it has always looked like a statue of itself.

519b3eb66b.alt: Small bright green lizard standing on sand among pale driftwood under warm light
519b3eb66b.story: Further along, a bright green lizard stands among bleached driftwood in a pool of warm lamp light. It is smaller, quicker, and looks ready to bolt. The pale branches twist over it like bones. The rest of the tank sinks into shadow. Green against orange sand, it reads like a colour test pattern before the programme starts.

1d4cd60f85.alt: Dark silhouette of a coiled snake on a mound behind glass, a bright garden reflected around it
1d4cd60f85.story: Here the glass gives up most of its secrets to reflection. Behind it, a dark coiled shape sits on a mound of shredded bark, its patterned scales just readable at the top edge. The bright garden outside overlays everything in pale green. A thin rod runs down the pane. It takes a moment to notice the snake at all, which is likely the point.

fe763fd387.alt: Coiled yellow-and-black patterned snake resting on chunks of coconut husk in a glass terrarium
fe763fd387.story: Lower down, another snake has curled itself into a neat stack of yellow and black, the pattern looking almost printed. It rests beside chunks of coconut husk, head hidden in its own coils. A rock cave looms behind. The glass gives everything a slight green cast. It sleeps the deep, unarguable sleep of something that has eaten recently.

5a0136a7eb.alt: Same yellow-and-black snake coiled beside coconut husk, the rock cave and window light behind
5a0136a7eb.story: Twenty-four seconds later, nothing has changed except the light. A brighter strip from the window now falls across the cave rock, and drips of condensation show on the inside of the glass. The snake stays in its coil. Watching it is a little like watching a channel after closing, the same image held, waiting for morning.

078e26f7bb.alt: Snake's head barely visible at the base of a dim terrarium, a pale tiled ledge in front
078e26f7bb.story: Low against the base of a dim tank, a single reddish snake head slides out from the substrate, the rest of its body hidden. A pale tiled ledge fills the front of the frame. Shadow swallows everything above. It is the smallest appearance yet, just a nose and an eye, and then, a breath later, maybe not even that.

c07848c624.alt: Reddish snake sliding along a pale ledge beside a black pot behind hazy terrarium glass
c07848c624.story: And then it shows itself. The reddish snake slides out along the pale ledge, its whole length now visible beside a black plant pot. The glass is hazy with reflections, giving the scene a washed, overexposed look. It moves with no hurry at all, smooth as a cursor dragged across a screen, and the afternoon pauses to watch.

232795afee.alt: Large walk-in aviary with trees, a lawn, birdhouses on poles and a mesh roof, seen past a dark post
232795afee.story: Out of the reptile house and into air. A huge mesh aviary stretches over trees and lawn, with wooden birdhouses perched on tall poles. A dark post and a rail cut across the near edge of the frame. Everything is green and dappled, and somewhere in the trees there are wings, though none are showing yet.

90a1477963.alt: Inside a large aviary: lawn, a birdhouse on a pole, a round shrub and tall trees under mesh
90a1477963.story: Inside, the space opens up. A neat round shrub sits on a sunny lawn, a little birdhouse on its post stands beside it like a mailbox, and paths curve away between the trees. The mesh roof is so high it almost disappears. A quiet place built for flight, holding its breath until something takes off.

26b79a8ae1.alt: Shaded aviary lawn with a birdhouse post and a group of pale long-legged birds near the back
26b79a8ae1.story: Thirty seconds later, the residents appear: a group of pale, long-legged birds gathered near the far edge of the lawn, heads down, picking at the grass in the shade. The birdhouse post stands alone in the foreground. Sunlight falls in patches on the green. From here they look like small paper cut-outs arranged on a stage.

8d1642d3a6.alt: Two red parrots clinging to a chain curtain on a post, a hand holding a small cup of nectar nearby
8d1642d3a6.story: Red parrots, two of them, cling sideways to a curtain of metal chain, beaks pointed at a small cup held up in a hand from the left. Behind them the aviary roof stretches overhead in a pattern of light and shadow, and a few warm lamps glow at the bottom. One bird has already committed. The other is still calculating.

f9efe4611d.alt: Three red parrots climbing a chain curtain on a metal post, aviary roof and lamps blurred behind
f9efe4611d.story: Nine seconds later there are three. They hang one above another on the chain, wings showing blue and purple at the edges, all leaning toward the same unseen cup. The lamps behind glow softly in the dim. It looks like a queue, very polite, very red, everyone pretending not to notice who arrived first.

862963a637.alt: Two red parrots clinging to chains, one reaching toward a cup held by a visitor's hand at lower left
862963a637.story: Four seconds more, and the hand with the cup has edged closer at the bottom left. One parrot stretches nearly upside down toward it, the other hangs above, wings spread just enough to show a flash of blue. The chain links shine. It is a small bargain being struck, a sip of nectar in exchange for a photograph.

a9b27376be.alt: Pale long-legged birds in the shade on a lawn inside an aviary, birdhouse post on left
a9b27376be.story: Back on the lawn, the pale birds have spread out a little, some standing on one leg, some picking at the ground. One has wandered close to the middle, a dark mark on its back. A tall birdhouse stands on its post at the left. The mesh roof lets light fall in a soft grid. A slow, gentle broadcast of nothing much happening.

e5c1ac606b.alt: Wooden snack kiosk with red pendant lamps, a drinks fridge and a person seated at the counter
e5c1ac606b.story: A wooden kiosk offers a pause: red pendant lamps hanging low, a glowing drinks fridge full of red cans, a freezer chest in front. Someone in a cream hoodie sits at the counter, waiting for customers. A fan stands still on the wall. The light is warm and amber inside, like a corner of a late-night diner dropped into the middle of the afternoon.

38ce5b1add.alt: Pale lion lying behind a wire grid fence and a stone wall, only its head and shoulders visible
38ce5b1add.story: Behind a stone wall and a tall grid of wire, a pale lion lies low, just its head and shoulders rising over the rocks. Its eyes are half shut. The wall itself is built of grey slabs with dark seams, cracked here and there. For the first time today, the animal on the other side of the fence looks capable of real trouble, and completely unwilling to start any.

49015b2d0c.alt: Pale lion's head visible over a stone wall behind a wire fence, rocks and trees behind
49015b2d0c.story: Five seconds later, the head turns slightly and the ears come up. It is looking somewhere off to the right now, past the visitors, at something more interesting. The wire draws a neat grid over its face. Up close the wall looks almost cardboard, painted rock with clean seams. The lion, though, is entirely real.

e8394f8303.alt: Pale lion standing in a cage-like corner of wire panels and bars, a stone wall in front
e8394f8303.story: Now the lion is up, standing in a corner where wire panels meet at sharp angles. Its body is pale against the shaded rock, head turned away. The structure looks like a cage inside a cage, every edge built from grids. Light enters through the mesh overhead and scatters into small bright squares across the scene.

b136a82ae4.alt: Pale lion standing behind bars in a corner, a dark blurred bar in the foreground
b136a82ae4.story: Eight seconds later, a dark blurred bar sweeps across the foreground as the angle shifts. The lion has turned its head further, looking through the grid toward the green outside. The corner of mesh and bars looms above it. It resembles an interrupted transmission, a shape on the far side of interference, perfectly still behind the noise.

b1ae973405.alt: Young pale lion walking forward across shaded dirt in front of a crate, sun and grass around it
b1ae973405.story: In another enclosure, a young pale lion comes walking out of the shade, head low, big paws placed carefully on the dirt. A wooden crate with mesh windows sits behind it. Sunlight cuts across the ground in bright slices between shadows of leaves. It looks curious and slightly clumsy, like it is still getting used to the size of its own feet.

fd3bc21b7b.alt: Young pale lion lying on dirt in dappled shade, a mesh crate and grass behind
fd3bc21b7b.story: Four seconds later it flops down in the dirt, front paws stretched out, head up and turned to the left. The crate behind sits empty, its door open. Patches of sun fall on the ground around it like spilled light from a projector. It has stopped exploring and started watching, which for a lion is almost the same thing.

c874e667c5.alt: Young pale lion lying on dirt, head turned to the side, sun and leaf shadows on the ground
c874e667c5.story: Three seconds on, the head swings toward the left, ears forward, nose pointing at something beyond the frame. Its tail curls out behind. The shadows of leaves play across its back, shifting with the breeze. The whole scene is quiet except for that small, alert turn of the head, a radio briefly picking up a far-off signal.

c7a6c7f5c0.alt: Young pale lion resting on dirt with mouth slightly open, dappled light and a crate behind
c7a6c7f5c0.story: Two seconds later, the mouth opens slightly, a small yawn or pant in the heat. It sits in exactly the same patch of shade, paws crossed, tail still curled. Behind it, the crate waits with its orange panel. The light has not changed at all. In four frames, a whole small story: walk out, lie down, look, breathe.

c125788bbd.alt: Young pale lion lying on shaded dirt by grass, a mesh crate in the background
c125788bbd.story: Half a minute later, still there. The young lion has settled further into the dirt, paws tucked, eyes narrowing in the heat. The leaf shadows have shifted a few centimetres along the ground. The crate behind hasn't moved, and neither has anyone watching. It is the long, comfortable middle of an afternoon programme where nothing needs to happen.

1f709049f7.alt: Pale lion cub walking beside a green-framed chain-link fence on shaded grass, blurred foreground post
1f709049f7.story: Set down again, the cub pads along the inside of a green-framed fence, head low, paws heavy. A fat blurred post fills the foreground. The light comes down in soft patches on grass and dirt. From up here, it looks very much like a large, serious housecat on its regular patrol, inspecting the perimeter for anything new.

49c9deda58.alt: Pale lion cub walking toward the viewer along a fence, dappled sunlight on the ground
49c9deda58.story: Nine seconds later it turns and walks straight toward the fence, eyes up for the first time, meeting whoever is standing there. The tail flicks behind. Sunlight pools across its back. There is a strange intimacy in that look, a small wild animal deciding, for just a moment, to acknowledge the humans and their curious attention.

31979cefe3.alt: Wide shaded enclosure with a pale lion cub walking across dirt, a dome-shaped cage and benches behind
31979cefe3.story: Step back and the cub becomes a small pale shape crossing a wide dirt yard, trees all around, a dome-shaped metal cage standing like an empty gazebo on the left. A few visitors sit on benches under the far trees. The whole space is laced with shadows of leaves. Its world is bigger than it looked from the fence.

744ecf0a9e.alt: Close view through chain-link fence of a pale lion cub nosing the ground among green plants
744ecf0a9e.story: Pressed right up against the chain-link, a cub's head fills the frame, ear glowing pink in the backlight, nose buried in the dirt among green plants. The fence wire cuts diagonal lines across everything. It is so close and so focused on the ground that it seems to have forgotten anyone could be watching at all.

7c9dfba861.alt: Adult pale lioness standing behind a chain-link fence, a maned lion resting in the background
7c9dfba861.story: Next enclosure, and the scale changes. A full-grown pale lioness stands broadside behind the wire, head turned slightly, while a maned lion lies resting behind her, his face hidden in shadow. The fence is old and its frame is rusted brown. It feels like turning from a children's show onto the evening news.

6b25239939.alt: Pale lioness and maned lion behind a fence, a blurred shape in the foreground and a blue hose below
6b25239939.story: Fifteen seconds later, the view tilts and a pale blur sweeps into the left side of the frame, maybe a hand or a sleeve. Through the fence, the lioness has turned toward the lion, who lifts his heavy head. A blue hose coils on the concrete below. It is an interrupted glance, two worlds caught overlapping in the same instant.

60d044fa05.alt: Maned lion and pale lioness facing each other through a fenced enclosure, trees beyond
60d044fa05.story: Wider now. The maned lion lies on the left, the pale lioness stands on the right, the two facing each other across a gap of grey concrete. Behind them, trees glow green through the far fence. A stained wall runs across the bottom of the frame. They look like two actors waiting for the other to deliver the next line.

2d553264f9.alt: Lioness lowering her head toward a resting maned lion inside a fenced concrete enclosure
2d553264f9.story: Twelve seconds later, the lioness lowers her head toward him, almost nose to nose, as if offering a question. The lion stays lying down, mane bristling in the shade. The fence repeats itself in layers across the frame. The tension is gentle. Neither of them seems to care that there is an audience outside the bars.

5618a14825.alt: Lioness standing close to a resting maned lion behind layered fencing, a dark blur at right edge
5618a14825.story: Thirteen seconds more, and the scene softens into a stillness. The lioness stands close, the lion settled, both of them washed in pale light. A dark blur intrudes on the right edge of the frame. The wall below is blotched with damp. Whatever conversation happened, it seems to have ended in agreement.

047abc7231.alt: Pale lion cub walking along a concrete wall beside a green-framed fence, stepping stones below
047abc7231.story: Around the corner, another cub pads along the base of a bare concrete wall, head low, a stepping-stone path lining the bottom of the frame. A green fence post cuts the left edge. The cub looks small against the plain grey, like a figure drawn on a blank page before the background has been coloured in.

cc8d688205.alt: Pale lion cub walking with its tail raised high beside a green fence post and a concrete wall
cc8d688205.story: Fifteen seconds on, the tail swings up into a high, curved hook, the cub's whole attitude brightening as it trots past the fence post. One paw lifts mid-step. The concrete wall behind stays blank and patient. It is the kind of small, cheerful movement that no one asks for and everyone remembers on the drive home.

993ab63b05.alt: Pale lion cub pressing up against a green-framed chain-link gate, grass and concrete slabs behind
993ab63b05.story: Now it presses its whole body against the fence, paws gripping the bottom rail of a green-framed gate, face pushed right up to the wire. The chain-link softens its features into a pale smudge. Behind, sunlight falls across grass and long concrete slabs. It is staring straight out, as interested in the visitors as they are in it.

dcfce12337.alt: Pale lioness standing in a fenced enclosure, a maned lion lying in the shade, green trees behind
dcfce12337.story: The adult enclosure again. The lioness stands upright, head raised, staring past the frame toward the trees, while the maned lion lies sprawled in the shadow to her left. The bars across the foreground are rusted and blurred. Her stillness has a different weight than the cubs', a patience that has done this many times before.

13cb26c9d7.alt: Close view of a maned lion's head and back behind a chain-link fence and bars
13cb26c9d7.story: Thirty seconds after the cub, the big one fills the frame. Through chain-link and a dark bar, a heavy mane in shades of gold and cream fills half the picture, the face turned away. Below, a wall stained with damp. Up close, the mane looks less like hair and more like weather, a whole season of wind gathered around one head.

8b202dbff6.alt: Pale lion resting among rocks in a dry enclosure, seen through tall vertical bars, trees behind
8b202dbff6.story: Further along, a different enclosure: a sloped yard of dry dirt and scattered rocks, a pale lion lying among them with its head raised. Tall vertical bars stripe the whole frame like a test pattern. Trees crowd the hillside behind. It is far away and perfectly still, so still that for a second it could be another rock.

f1dd9d732f.alt: Same pale lion lying among rocks behind vertical bars, a wooden platform and hillside trees behind
f1dd9d732f.story: Eight seconds later the head turns toward the left and the illusion breaks; the rock is a lion after all. The bars stay exactly where they were, steady vertical lines. A low wooden platform sits empty in the shade at the back. The afternoon is hot, and the lion seems to have decided the best response is to do as little as possible.

c6225049d2.alt: Small meerkat standing in a patch of sun before a red painted log-shaped shelter on sand
c6225049d2.story: Different scale entirely. In a pen of pale sand, a small meerkat stands upright in a spotlight of sun, in front of a big red-painted log shelter. Its shadow stretches long across the ground behind it. Everything else falls into soft shade. It looks like a tiny presenter who has just stepped onto the stage and is waiting for the cue.

8389349f83.alt: Two meerkats lying on sand, one stretched out and one curled up, a stone and a small bowl nearby
8389349f83.story: Two meerkats have given up on standing. One lies flat on its belly in the sand, legs out, head up; the other is curled into a tight ball beside it. A rock and an empty dark bowl wait nearby. Paw prints cover the ground in every direction. The heat has won this round, and the meerkats seem fine with that.

610e38a9fd.alt: Single meerkat lying on sand near rocks and a pipe, a red painted wall and window behind
610e38a9fd.story: Ten seconds later and a few paces over, a single meerkat stretches out on the sand by a grey pipe and a pale rock. A red-painted wall rises behind, and a dark window reflects the room. The light falls in from the right in a slanted slab. A small creature, a big empty floor, and a long afternoon still ahead.

4bb1da6d77.alt: Two meerkats on sunlit sand beside a pipe and a stone burrow with a mesh door
4bb1da6d77.story: In a pen with a round stone burrow and a mesh door, two meerkats rest in the leaf-dappled sand. One lies flat, one sits up by a grey pipe, alert. Sunlight spills in coins and patches across the ground. It is a set designed for a small life: tunnel, door, sand, shade, and enough sky above to keep an eye on.

a08edb9a1b.alt: Meerkat sitting upright on sand looking to the side, a pipe and stone burrow behind
a08edb9a1b.story: Eleven seconds later, the sitting one has moved forward and turned its head to the side, eyes wide, every whisker on alert. The other still lounges by the pipe behind. The mesh door of the burrow hangs open. Somewhere off frame, something has caught its attention, and for this small animal, that is the whole world for a moment.

ae8e2f8272.alt: Pale furry animal curled up on straw behind a chain-link fence in a dim cage
ae8e2f8272.story: Behind rusty chain-link in a dim cage, a pale furry animal lies curled on a bed of straw, face hidden, body rising and falling slowly. A green metal frame edges the scene. The light inside is low and warm. Whatever it is, it has chosen sleep over spectators, and there is no arguing with that choice.

42625bcbde.alt: Brown pheasant-like bird perched on a log in a shaded aviary, white birds on the ground behind
42625bcbde.story: In a shady aviary, a brown speckled bird perches on a low log, head turned in profile. Behind it, white birds peck around the ground, slightly out of focus. A bare branch arcs across the frame. The light is muted, filtered through layers of mesh and leaves, like an image coming through a screen slightly out of tune.

5c9db85107.alt: Brown speckled bird perched on a log, white birds and branches blurred behind in an aviary
5c9db85107.story: Eight seconds later it holds the same pose, one foot gripping the log, eye sharp. The white birds behind have rearranged themselves, a few now closer, one lifting its head. Dust hangs in the shafts of light. It is the same scene with the volume turned down a notch, everyone settling into the afternoon heat.

5041e61b7e.alt: Black crow standing on sandy ground in dappled light, a tree trunk and wall behind
5041e61b7e.story: Out on the path, a crow strides into a patch of sun, glossy black, thick bill pointed to the right. Its shadow stretches out behind it on the sand. Tree roots and a low wall frame the scene. Unlike the caged animals, it has nowhere it needs to be, and it walks like it knows that.

a9e5ccfdb0.alt: Crow on sandy ground near a dropped snack, two people's legs in jeans and sneakers nearby
a9e5ccfdb0.story: The crow has found the crowd. It hops close to a pair of legs in wide blue jeans and white sneakers, eyeing a small orange crumb on the ground. A patterned skirt hem shows in the corner. Sunlight falls between the trees. The bird looks less like a visitor and more like the one who actually runs the place.

c30c417dc3.alt: Crow with beak raised standing near a dropped snack beside people's sneakers on sandy ground
c30c417dc3.story: Twenty-five seconds on, the crow tilts its head back, beak up, as if issuing a complaint about the service. The crumb still lies there, a few steps away. The sneakers shift their weight. It is a standoff in miniature, the humans unsure whether to feed it, the crow unsure whether to wait for permission.

420e488967.alt: Crow standing in dappled light on a dirt path, a human shadow and a paper bag at the edges
420e488967.story: Now the crow stands in a pool of light alone, a long human shadow reaching toward it from the left. At the right edge, a hand holds a white paper bag. The path behind stretches off, bright with sun. The bird watches the bag, the bag watches the bird, and the rest of the day can wait a second.

fe81a26847.alt: Crow with ruffled feathers standing in shade near a human shadow and a paper bag at right
fe81a26847.story: Seven seconds later, the crow's feathers are ruffled up, head raised, shape suddenly bigger. The human shadow shifts across the ground. The paper bag hovers in the corner. It looks almost theatrical, a bird inflating itself at the edge of the light, demanding to be taken seriously, or at least fed.

3a0f0820fa.alt: Two guineafowl with spotted grey feathers and pale faces walking on sand in front of a pink wall
3a0f0820fa.story: Two spotted guineafowl waddle along a pink-painted wall, their grey feathers dotted with white, bare faces pale with red and blue touches. One turns its head toward the lens, the other leans forward as if to begin a sprint. Leaf shadows play across the wall behind them. They look like they are rushing to an appointment they forgot about.

ad5f49d1d9.alt: Two guineafowl walking side by side on sand by a pink wall and fence, sunlit lawn beyond
ad5f49d1d9.story: Seven seconds later they are almost overlapping, two round bodies moving in tandem toward the right, toward the sunlit lawn and the gap in the fence. The pink wall glows in the afternoon. Their little heads bob as they go. It is the closing shot of the bird segment, two characters walking off together into the light.

7629eac51f.alt: Crow walking across sunlit sandy ground holding a small scrap in its beak, tree roots behind
7629eac51f.story: The crow got what it wanted. It strides across a bright patch of sand with a small white scrap held in its beak, shadow trailing long behind. Tree roots and stumps sit in the shade. It walks with a certain swagger, the satisfied gait of someone leaving a negotiation with the better deal.

3eef33f10a.alt: Crow on sandy ground in a patch of sun, head turned, roots and a tree trunk in the background
3eef33f10a.story: Eight seconds later, the scrap is gone, swallowed or stashed, and the crow pauses in the sunlight, head cocked to the left. Its feathers shine with hints of blue and purple. Behind it, a pale wall and tree trunk glow softly. The deal is done, and now it is simply enjoying the sun like any other visitor.

0213b4544d.alt: Crow standing on a shaded path facing the viewer, a crouching person's jeans and sneakers behind
0213b4544d.story: A minute and a half later, it has come back for more. The crow stands square on the path, facing forward, while behind it someone crouches low in wide jeans and white sneakers, perhaps holding out an offer. The light is cooler here, filtered through leaves. Its eye is bright, unblinking. This bird has learned the routine better than the humans have.

ee54c1c959.alt: White cockatoo perched on a wooden post inside a chain-link enclosure under a thatched roof
ee54c1c959.story: Under a thatched roof and behind chain-link, a white cockatoo sits on a wooden post, a single pale shape in the green. The mesh blurs everything into a soft grid. Light from outside floods the trees behind it. It sits in perfect profile, motionless, like a cut-out held up to the window to see if anyone notices.

344307a340.alt: Shaded dirt road through tall trees in a park, a few visitors walking far ahead
344307a340.story: The road widens under huge old trees, light splintering down onto dirt and gravel. Far ahead, a few visitors walk in pairs, one in red. A thin sapling stands at the centre, propped by a stake. The heat has eased a little in the shade. The path is quiet enough to hear the gravel crunch with each step.

99be8a8820.alt: Visitors in shade watching a giraffe lean over a fence, a thatched umbrella and blue sky beyond
99be8a8820.story: At the giraffe enclosure, a giraffe bends its long neck over the fence toward a small crowd standing in the shade of a big tree. One visitor in a bucket hat leans closer. Beyond, a thatched umbrella stands in a sunny paddock under a clear blue sky. It is the tallest guest of the day, and also the politest.

2abc3dc38e.alt: Giraffe in shadow lowering its head over a fence toward a hand, a thatched umbrella in the paddock
2abc3dc38e.story: Thirty seconds later, the giraffe dips its head further, nearly in silhouette now, nose reaching for a hand extended over the wire. The thatched umbrella stands in the bright paddock behind, like a small lighthouse on a sea of sand. A prohibition sign hangs at the bottom right. The tree overhead throws its branches into the sky.

0caa03282c.alt: Close view of dark green leaves with clusters of small red flowers in deep shade
0caa03282c.story: A short break from the animals. A shrub by the path holds small clusters of red flowers among dark glossy leaves, lit by a narrow slice of sun. Everything else falls into soft green shadow. It is a frame that could belong anywhere, a quiet detail between the louder scenes of the day, like a station ident between programmes.

b04fa05c23.alt: Shaded shrub with glossy green leaves and small bright red flower clusters, dark background
b04fa05c23.story: Twelve seconds on and a step closer, the red flowers shine even brighter, little sparks scattered through the leaves. The light catches the edge of every leaf and leaves the centres dark. It is nearly abstract now, just red and green and shadow. Somewhere behind, the giraffes are still waiting for their next visitor.

8223d87767.alt: Two giraffes bending to eat hay over a fence, a sandy paddock with thatched umbrellas behind
8223d87767.story: Back at the fence, two giraffes lower their necks to a pile of hay, their patterned bodies forming a long arch over the barrier. Behind them, the paddock stretches out in pale sand, dotted with thatched umbrellas on poles. The shade falls heavily on the near side. Their necks move in slow parallel, two pendulums swinging in time.

1783347e1a.alt: Giraffe's neck and head rising among tall trees and a fenced enclosure, seen from behind
1783347e1a.story: Thirty seconds later, a single giraffe raises its head among the treetops, its long neck rising out of the bottom of the frame like a periscope. Trees and branches crowd around it, a fenced yard of boulders below. It looks less like an animal and more like part of the landscape, as if the trees grew one with spots.

844fe3c7d1.alt: Giraffe head in silhouette against blue sky, another giraffe and thatched umbrellas behind
844fe3c7d1.story: Against a clean blue sky, a giraffe's head turns in near silhouette, small horns and ears sharp against the clouds. Behind it, another giraffe's neck rises, and thatched umbrellas stand in a row across the sandy paddock. Trees line the far fence. The scale is strange from here, a head larger than the whole horizon.

a6f71365ba.alt: Two giraffes feeding from a hanging tub under a green-roofed shelter, an info sign on the fence
a6f71365ba.story: Under a green metal roof, two giraffes eat from a tub hanging at the fence, one bending low and one reaching across. A small info sign tilts on the rail. The structure behind is part barn, part tree house, with a bright blue sky above. It feels like lunch hour at the tallest cafeteria in the world.

d40cb076ec.alt: Young giraffe walking across a wide sandy paddock, a thatched umbrella and trees behind
d40cb076ec.story: Far across the sandy paddock, a young giraffe walks alone, long legs placed with careful wobble. A thatched umbrella stands behind it, and a line of trees closes the yard. At the right edge, the side of an adult giraffe looms close. The young one seems to be crossing the open space just to see what is on the other side.

5a1f90d953.alt: White cockatoos perched along a fence inside a large mesh aviary, white nest boxes on posts
5a1f90d953.story: A long mesh enclosure holds a row of white cockatoos, perched along a rail and on top of a rocky ledge. White nest boxes stand on posts. A tree trunk cuts down the right side of the frame. The light is flat and cool. The birds sit like a row of lightbulbs, some glowing, some slightly turned away.

590b624d29.alt: Horned wild goat behind a chain-link fence, head lowered, rocky ground behind
590b624d29.story: Behind the chain-link, a wild goat with long backswept horns lowers its head, a fringe of shaggy hair hanging under its chin. The rocks behind are pale and dusty. A dark post fills the left edge. The fence pattern draws diamonds across its face, but the animal hardly seems to care that it is being watched.

ad9fc182cc.alt: Close view of a curved-horned goat behind a chain-link fence, facing the viewer, rocks behind
ad9fc182cc.story: Eight seconds later it turns to face the fence, horns curving back in thick ridged arcs, eyes half closed. The shaggy fringe sways at its throat. Through the wire, the whole head fills the frame. It is the closest anyone has come all afternoon to an animal looking back without wanting food.

35ba1791ab.alt: Large horned goat with a shaggy chest standing behind chain-link fence, another goat behind
35ba1791ab.story: A larger goat steps up to the chain-link, horns sweeping back in a great ridged curve, chest hair hanging long and shaggy. Its eyes are half closed, unimpressed. Another, smaller goat stands behind it among the pale rocks. The fence's horizontal bar cuts straight across its face like a line of interference on an old screen.

d8f3d5ee7a.alt: Horned goat standing on rocky ground beside a wooden post, head lowered, seen without fence
d8f3d5ee7a.story: Somehow the fence has fallen away, and the goat stands clear on dusty ground among broken white stones, a weathered wooden post at the right. Its head is lowered, horns arcing over its back, ears flicked forward. The light is soft and even. It looks like it might step right out of the frame and keep walking.

1fcea326a1.alt: Close profile of a horned goat's head, another goat's back in the corner, rocks behind
1fcea326a1.story: Nine seconds later, close enough to count the ridges on the horns. The goat stands in profile, chin raised slightly, nostrils flared, eye calm and gold. In the corner, another goat's brown back drifts past. The rocks behind blur to grey. It has the dignified, slightly bored face of a news anchor between headlines.

62543610be.alt: Close view of a horned goat's head and neck, eyes half closed, blurred rocks behind
62543610be.story: Three seconds on, it tips its head down, eyes half shut, as if dozing on its feet. The horns curve up and out of the top of the frame. Every hair on its neck shows, sand-coloured and slightly matted. Behind, the rocks have melted into a soft grey haze. For a second the whole enclosure goes quiet.

5a88671bd4.alt: Horned goat in close profile looking down and to the right, blurred pale rocks behind
5a88671bd4.story: Four seconds more, and the head swings to the right, eyes now open, looking down at something on the ground. The horns arc in a single heavy curve. The fur at its jaw is lit softly from the side. It is a study in slowness, a creature that moves only when there is a good reason to.

3d6295eeb6.alt: Horned goat facing straight ahead with curved horns, other goats blurred behind on rocky ground
3d6295eeb6.story: Eleven seconds later it finally turns to face forward, staring straight down the lens with pale eyes and a wet black nose. The horns spread in a wide symmetrical crown. Behind it, other goats wander out of focus. It is the full-frontal portrait, the shot everyone waits for, delivered with complete indifference.

a827884181.alt: Horned goat in profile leaning against a metal railing, trees and a brick wall behind
a827884181.story: At the railing now, a goat leans its chest on the metal bar, horns arcing back, gaze fixed off to the right. Trees and a brick wall fill the background, sunlight filtering through. The black posts of the fence lean at an angle. It looks like a regular at a bar, elbows on the counter, waiting for service.

06c4e0b386.alt: Horned goat behind a blurred metal rail, head lowered, eyes looking toward the viewer
06c4e0b386.story: Ten seconds on, another goat appears behind a blurred bar, head tilted down, eyes rolled up to look over the rail. Its horns curve away above the frame. The pale stones behind are out of focus. The gaze is curious and wary in equal measure, like someone checking who is at the door before deciding whether to open it.

22dd1970da.alt: Horned goat behind metal rail looking to the right, pale rocks and trees behind it
22dd1970da.story: Nineteen seconds later, it lifts its head above the rail and looks off to the right, ears pricked. The bars cross its chest. Behind, the rocky slope rises, white stones piled against a strip of trees. Its expression is softer now, almost thoughtful, as if listening to a far-off voice on a radio nobody else can hear.

cb83a7524a.alt: Horned goat in profile behind a metal rail and a dark post, shaggy chest hair, rocks behind
cb83a7524a.story: Twenty seconds later, seen from a new angle, the goat stands in profile at the rail, chin raised, lips slightly open. A thick dark post blocks the right side of the frame. Long hair hangs from its chest like a curtain. The posture is patient and a little proud, a figure posing for its own official portrait.

33d6354199.alt: Small horned goat standing among white rocks on a slope, a wall and green bushes behind
33d6354199.story: Step back, and one goat stands alone on the rocky slope, small in the frame, head bent toward the ground among scattered white stones. A pale wall rises behind, and a dark green bush crowds the right. Sticks and dust lie everywhere. From here, the enclosure looks like a stage set waiting for the next act to begin.

900d5cd6cf.alt: Horned goat with mouth open behind a metal rail, another goat walking on rocks behind it
900d5cd6cf.story: The last frame catches a goat mid-call, mouth open, head stretched forward over the rail, horns sweeping back in a heavy arc. Behind it, another goat strolls across the rocks without looking. Whatever it said, nobody answered. The afternoon has been full of animals watching people, and this is the one that finally talks back.

e385bd1fa7.alt: Sandy-coated horned animal with long curved horns, eyes half closed, standing among pale rocks
e385bd1fa7.story: Mid-afternoon, and the ram has decided nothing is worth opening its eyes for. The horns sweep back in heavy ridged arcs, too grand for the sleepy face beneath them. Behind it the rocks lie scattered like a dropped bag of chalk, and another animal wanders out of frame on the left. A fly circles once and gives up. The enclosure smells of dust and dry grass.

644c23c4c2.alt: Close view of a horned animal's head and curved ridged horns, eyes nearly shut, rocky ground behind
644c23c4c2.story: Three seconds later the head has turned only slightly, as if the ram is listening to a station nobody else can pick up. Each ridge on the horns catches a little of the flat afternoon light. The eyelids stay low. A pebble rolls somewhere behind it on the slope, and the animal does not bother to look. Patience, here, is the whole programme.

f23400e677.alt: Horned animal seen through a green chain-link fence and metal rail, rocks blurred behind
f23400e677.story: Through the wire the same animal looks smaller, softened into the diamond pattern of the fence. It has walked down to the rail, close enough that its breath might fog the metal if the day were colder. One eye watches steadily. On this side, the fence is a frame; on that side, it is simply the edge of the world, and the ram leans against it without complaint.

6a76e3d036.alt: Shaded enclosure with a tortoise on dry earth, a curved concrete path, a small shelter and dense trees
6a76e3d036.story: A tortoise crosses the bare ground in the shade at roughly the speed of the afternoon. Another one rests further back by the low wall, near a slatted shelter half swallowed by trees. The concrete path curves away, empty. Fifteen minutes past three, and nothing in the enclosure is in a hurry. Somewhere a leaf falls and takes longer to land than the tortoise takes to move.

46d7f4bb95.alt: Wide grassy enclosure dotted with white rabbits, a few seated visitors, trees and a small sign on a post
46d7f4bb95.story: From a distance the lawn looks scattered with white stones until the stones start to move. Rabbits graze in every direction, and visitors sit low on the grass among them, patient as fishermen. A small sign stands on its post near the fence. The trees lean in from the edges, and the light is beginning to turn the green a deeper shade toward evening.

15aa81fb85.alt: Black and white long-haired guinea pig pressed against a chain-link fence above a weathered wooden ledge
15aa81fb85.story: The guinea pig has found the one spot along the fence where visitors tend to stop. It presses its tufted face to the wire, black and white fur spilling in every direction like a bad haircut. A worn wooden ledge runs across the foreground, grey and smooth from hands. Beyond, the lawn glows green and empty. It waits there as though expecting a delivery.

8c6707dea8.alt: Long-haired black and white guinea pig sniffing at a green chain-link fence behind a wooden ledge
8c6707dea8.story: Still there. The nose twitches against the wire, testing the air on the other side, and the whiskers catch a small edge of light. Its body is a mop of dark fur with a white patch at the head. Nobody has produced anything to eat yet. The guinea pig does not leave. Some audiences know that the broadcast always comes back after the break.

14c63291f2.alt: Tan rabbit sitting upright on a sunlit lawn, ears raised, other rabbits blurred in the background
14c63291f2.story: Upright on its haunches, the tan rabbit holds its ears high and turns one eye toward the edge of the lawn. The grass is lit in long stripes where the sun gets through the trees. Behind it, out of focus, other rabbits graze in small white blurs. Then a rustle somewhere, and the whole body tightens, ready to bolt or ready to stay.

2d04a5b010.alt: Shaded lawn with a few rabbits grazing near a small conifer, wooden fence and trees in the background
2d04a5b010.story: Long shadows have pulled most of the lawn into shade. A tan rabbit grazes beside a small conifer, and a white one sits further back near the fence. A dry leaf lies alone in the foreground. Behind the railings, trees stand in rows, and a pale figure moves between them. The afternoon here moves at grazing speed, one mouthful at a time.

0c9cf85331.alt: White rabbit with brown patches on grass as a hand reaches down toward it, a sneaker visible behind
0c9cf85331.story: A hand comes down from above, fingers open, and the white rabbit holds its ground. Brown patches mark its back like spilled tea. A sneaker sits at the top of the frame, its owner crouched just out of view. The rabbit's ears tilt forward, half curious, half deciding. In the next second it will either lean into the touch or vanish across the grass.

51d63b53dd.alt: Cream rabbit standing beside an old stone trough on a grassy slope, people and rabbits blurred behind
51d63b53dd.story: Beside a worn stone trough, a cream rabbit pauses mid-hop, ears straight up. The ground around the trough is bare and dark where many paws have gathered. Up the slope, visitors drift along a sunlit path, and another rabbit rests in the light. The trough stands empty for now. Everyone in this enclosure seems to be waiting for the same thing: the next handful of food.

558e1c4c7a.alt: Fluffy ginger rabbit on a sloping lawn, the edge of a bag at left and people sitting in the distance
558e1c4c7a.story: The ginger rabbit has wandered away from the crowd, low to the grass, round as a loaf of bread. At the left edge of the frame a bag hangs from someone's arm. Far up the slope, people sit in pairs on the lawn, blurred to soft shapes. The light falls on the rabbit's back and turns its fur the colour of toasted rice.

fe019f6c65.alt: White rabbit with dark ears close up on grass, a second black and white rabbit blurred behind it
fe019f6c65.story: Close to the ground, the white rabbit nibbles with its head down and its dark-tipped ears pointing two ways at once. A second rabbit, black around the eyes, sits blurred behind it like a reflection that has lost focus. Every blade of grass in front is sharp. Every visitor behind is a smear of colour. Down here, the world is mostly grass and noise.

e1b08fd9b7.alt: Brown and white rabbit grazing on grass while a hand with a ring gently touches its back
e1b08fd9b7.story: Gently, a hand rests on the rabbit's back, light as a coat placed on a chair. A ring catches the afternoon sun on one finger. The rabbit keeps grazing, brown and white, unbothered, its ears folded back in something like contentment. The grass is short and bright here. For a few seconds, the arrangement suits everyone, and nobody needs to move at all.

7e1708b480.alt: Dark brown long-necked woolly animal lying on concrete in dappled shade, a small white animal beside it
7e1708b480.story: On the warm concrete, a dark woolly animal lies folded with its long neck upright, and a small white head pokes up beside it. Shadows from a fence stripe the ground in long diagonals. The pen is quiet, the light low and gold at the far edge. They look like two pieces of furniture left out after a party, waiting for someone to collect them.

54e1eb923e.alt: Dark woolly animal resting on concrete next to a small white animal, light falling across the pen
54e1eb923e.story: Five seconds and nothing has changed except perhaps a blink. The dark one keeps its head high, ears forward, gazing at something beyond the bars. The white one sits pressed to its side, ears out flat like wings. A bright stripe of sun crosses the concrete in front of them. Companionship, here, looks a lot like sitting very still in the same place.

496ea25c4c.alt: White woolly animal's face peering between dark metal bars, soft blurred background
496ea25c4c.story: Between two dark rails, a white face appears, nose pink, one ear sticking out sideways. The eyes are calm and dark. Everything around it softens into a warm blur of beige and cream. It has pushed its head forward as far as the bars allow, and holds there, looking out. On the other side of the rails, visitors are just another channel to watch.

901d5c240f.alt: Shaggy cream and grey animal with a dark eye patch looking out between horizontal metal bars
901d5c240f.story: This one is shaggier, cream and grey with a dark smudge around the eye, as if it has been rubbing against something dusty. Its head rests just behind the lowest bar. The light behind it is sandy and diffuse. It watches with a sideways gaze, unimpressed, lips closed. The bars cut the frame into neat stripes, like scan lines across an old screen.

2b8fb7b2e5.alt: Small white goat with a green ear tag standing in a dirt pen beside a chain-link fence
2b8fb7b2e5.story: Behind the chain-link, a small white goat stands square on the dirt, a green tag clipped to one ear. Its head tilts with a look of mild suspicion. Another face presses against the mesh to the left, half hidden. A wooden structure rises in the background, dark and shaded. The goat holds its pose long enough to suggest it has done this before.

7541c0f8c7.alt: Two white kangaroo-like animals in a shaded dirt enclosure beside a low building with a red-brown roof
7541c0f8c7.story: Two pale shapes in the shade: white kangaroo-like animals, one standing upright on the dirt, the other resting on a reddish mat near the building. Tree trunks rise between them, and patches of sun fall through the leaves onto the rocks. The building's slatted walls are brown and white, quiet. For a moment the enclosure looks like a scene from a half-remembered dream.

e0e22d62a0.alt: Overgrown green clearing with tall trees, a dirt path, and rows of green netting in the distance
e0e22d62a0.story: Away from the enclosures, the park opens into a rough clearing. Tall trees lean over the path, and a dirt track curves off toward rows of green netting strung low across the vegetation. The sky is pale, nearly white. No animals in sight, no people either, just the hum of the afternoon and the sound of something small moving in the undergrowth.

38b4215ffd.alt: Overgrown field with green netting shelters beyond a large tree trunk, pale sky and distant buildings
38b4215ffd.story: Past the thick trunk of a tree, the land falls away into a field of low green netting, set out in loose rows like tents for something very small. Beyond that, a line of trees and a few rooftops under a washed-out sky. The foreground is all shadow and tangled grass. A breeze moves through the leaves overhead, then stops.

f6670914b2.alt: Pale concrete path forking under a tunnel of shady trees, patches of sunlight on the ground
f6670914b2.story: The path splits under the trees, two pale arms of concrete curving off in different directions. Shadows lie across it in long, soft stripes. Nobody is walking here. On one side the trees are dark and close; on the other they open toward a white sky. Either way leads somewhere in the park. Neither offers a sign.

1e6a7ba7d7.alt: Red and white wooden wagon with spoked wheels parked on a grassy slope among tall thin trees
1e6a7ba7d7.story: A red wagon sits on the slope with no horse and no driver, its white trim bright against the shade. The spoked wheels rest in the grass as if it stopped here mid-journey and decided to stay. Thin trees crowd around it, their trunks leaning in. Inside, the barred window shows nothing at all. It looks like a set left over from another show.

c9a5b8008b.alt: Curving path through dappled shade beside long fenced enclosures, two people walking in the distance
c9a5b8008b.story: Downhill, the path bends along the length of the enclosures, a long fence on one side and wild grass on the other. Two small figures walk far ahead, nearly swallowed by the shade. The leaves overhead break the sunlight into scattered patches on the gravel. Late afternoon, and the park feels larger than it did an hour ago, and quieter too.
