22bfb83066.alt: Shaded woodland of thin trees with dry leaves on the ground and a fenced enclosure at the right
22bfb83066.story: A pocket of woodland beside the aviary fence, thin trunks crowded together, the ground covered in dry leaves. A blue hose snakes along the gravel at the bottom of the frame. The light comes from far back, pale and diffuse, as though the trees were filtering it twice. It is the kind of corner nobody stops at, and so it holds onto its quiet.

e59cd48a9f.alt: Two blue and yellow macaws perched side by side inside a tall chain-link aviary
e59cd48a9f.story: Two macaws sit side by side on a branch inside the tall wire cage, blue backs and golden chests turned toward the fence. Their long tails hang down like folded flags. Behind them the aviary rises in layers of mesh and timber, catching a flat white light. One bird turns its head slightly. The other looks straight ahead, as if waiting for its cue.

a8b7a40937.alt: Woman in a bucket hat and red cardigan reaching up to two macaws on the wire of an aviary
a8b7a40937.story: She has stepped up onto the edge of the planting and reached toward the wire, where the two macaws now cling side by side, close enough to touch. Her back is turned, her hat pale against the mesh. Green leaves crowd her ankles. The birds lean in, curious or hungry, it is hard to say which. Neither side of the fence seems in a rush.

528cc8098c.alt: Gravel road through a sunny park with two people walking away under trees, grass and shade at right
528cc8098c.story: The road runs downhill between the grass and the trees, gravel glinting where sun reaches it. Two people walk slowly away in the middle distance, close together, their shadows short. On the right, the lawn is bright and newly mown. The aviary fence follows the far side. It is quarter to four, and the park seems to be leaning toward evening.

4aa7ebd4d2.alt: Sunlit lawn with a single young tree casting a long shadow beside a dark fenced enclosure
4aa7ebd4d2.story: A young tree stands alone on the lawn, its shadow already longer than it is tall. The grass glows almost yellow in the slanting light. Beyond it, a dark enclosure sits behind a low hedge, its wire roof catching a few bright lines. A small round marker sits in the grass near the trunk. Everything here is waiting for the sun to go a little lower.

018b2fb46a.alt: Woman in a red cardigan reaching toward two macaws perched on an aviary rail, pink flowers below
018b2fb46a.story: Back to the birds she turns. Both macaws now perch along the rail, heads tilted down toward her hand. Her bag hangs from her wrist, half full. The flowers below are bright pink against the leaves. Through the wire, the inside of the aviary is a jumble of branches and pale light, like a room after the lights come up.

ea11b1aa30.alt: Hand in a red sleeve offering food to a blue and yellow macaw clinging to chain-link mesh
ea11b1aa30.story: Close in: a hand rises from the bottom of the frame in a red sleeve, fingers pinched around something small. The macaw has climbed down the mesh head first, tail fanned above it in blue and gold, beak meeting the offering through the wire. Above, the cage roof lets in a pale glare. The whole exchange takes perhaps a second, and the bird does not waste it.

80658fc0e6.alt: Woman in a bucket hat reaching toward a red macaw and a blue and yellow macaw inside an aviary
80658fc0e6.story: Suddenly there is a red macaw too, perched on the rail right where her hand reaches. The blue and yellow one hangs further along, watching. She leans close, back turned, cardigan almost the same red as the bird. Inside the aviary, tree trunks stand like pillars and the far wall glows white. Two reds, one face to face with the other.

3f1f5aafee.alt: Three macaws, two red and one blue and yellow, perched along a rail inside a large aviary
3f1f5aafee.story: Nobody in front of the fence now; the birds have the frame to themselves. Two red macaws and one blue and yellow sit spaced along the rail like presenters on a panel. The scarlet ones lean forward. The yellow one stands more upright, tail hanging long. Pink flowers dot the planting below. They seem to be waiting for the next visitor to step into the light.

37729ee19b.alt: Sandy paddock with a white rail fence, a dark animal lying in the dirt, a grey-roofed building behind
37729ee19b.story: A dark animal lies curled in the sand of an empty paddock, small against all that open ground. The white rail fence runs in two lines across the frame, one near, one far. Behind it, a building with a heavy grey roof sits half hidden in trees. The light is flat and warm. Whatever the animal was doing earlier, it has decided it is done for the day.

c2c3351ff5.alt: Brown animal lying in a sandy paddock behind white rail fencing, a grey-roofed white building behind
c2c3351ff5.story: Eleven seconds later, the animal has lifted its head and is looking back across the sand. Its coat is the colour of dry tea. The white rails divide the paddock into neat bands: fence, sand, fence again. Behind, the grey roof slopes down over a white wall, and a tangle of trees leans over it. The paddock is warm, the animal unhurried.

1ec7bdd87a.alt: Wide park plaza with visitors near a thatched shelter, a white animal statue and dappled shade
1ec7bdd87a.story: The plaza fills with small knots of visitors near a thatched shelter, some sitting, some reading a board, one child pointing. A white animal statue stands guard on the lawn's edge, pale and blank. The trees throw broken shade across the asphalt. Nobody is in a hurry. It looks like the half hour before closing, when everyone pretends they are not leaving yet.

69efef160b.alt: Small dark shaggy pony with a halter standing on a paved path near a shelter and green trees
69efef160b.story: A small dark pony stands on the paving, mane falling over its eyes, a purple halter around its nose. Orange scraps of something edible lie scattered on the ground nearby. Behind it, a long open shelter and a parked cart wait in the shade of trees. The pony looks neither curious nor bored, simply present, as if it owns this corner of the path.

a5a3fe585f.alt: Small dark pony lowering its head toward food on a paved path, a shelter and trees behind
a5a3fe585f.story: Decision made, the pony has made its decision: head down, nose to the ground, it goes for the orange piece nearest its hoof. The dark mane swings forward. The shelter behind is half in shade, half in light, and the trees beyond glow green-gold. A small, single-minded animal on a broad, empty path, doing exactly what it came here to do.

66a9955c27.alt: Man and a boy walking a small dark pony along a park path, sunlit lawn and trees behind
66a9955c27.story: A boy has joined the walk, striding alongside the pony with his shoulders back, as though trusted with an important job. The man walks ahead, the lead loose in his hand. The path is striped with long tree shadows. On the lawn, far behind, more visitors linger. The pony keeps its head low and its pace exact, ignoring all of them.

1541813ede.alt: Man in a black shirt walking through a leafy archway tunnel toward a bright open entrance
1541813ede.story: Under the archway the leaves close overhead into a green tunnel, dark at the edges. A man in a black shirt with gold lettering walks away toward the bright opening at the far end, where a few figures stand in the glare. The floor is laid in pale, irregular stone. Each step takes him out of the shade and closer to the end of the day.

b0b5f5353d.alt: Silhouetted man walking toward camera through a vine-covered tunnel, bright entrance behind him
b0b5f5353d.story: Fourteen seconds later, he has turned around and comes back through the tunnel, a dark silhouette against the light. Behind him, at the bright end, people move past signboards and parked cars. The vines on either side hang thick and black-green. For a moment he looks like someone stepping out of the screen and back into the room.

d4db093623.alt: Parking area with a white hatchback and a dark sedan near a tiled-roof building, a man walking in at right
d4db093623.story: The car park is nearly empty: a white hatchback and a dark sedan sit side by side in front of a low building with a tiled roof. One rear door stands open, someone leaning in. At the right edge, a man in a black shirt with gold letters walks into the frame. The sun is low and bright behind the trees. Time to go.

0e94b6b3a4.alt: Black and white image of a figure in a dark shirt with a blurred face standing on a bare open ground
0e94b6b3a4.story: The figure stands in the middle of a bleached, empty yard, one hand raised to the chest. The face dissolves into blur, as if the signal could not quite resolve it. Behind, a low fence and pale trees blur into white. A small dark dog crosses the ground far back. Everything is grey, flat, washed out, like a programme broadcast on a frequency nobody tunes to anymore.

453890864d.alt: Black and white full-length figure in dark clothes with a blurred face standing on bare cracked ground
453890864d.story: Further back now, the whole body is visible: dark shirt, dark trousers, one hand still at the chest. The face remains a smudge of grey motion. The cracked ground spreads out in every direction. Behind, the trees have gone white, almost transparent. It is less a portrait than a transmission, a shape that appears on the screen without ever fully arriving.

764d58d34f.alt: Black and white ghostly translucent figure fading into a bare yard, fence and pale trees behind
764d58d34f.story: And now the figure is almost gone, a translucent shape layered over the ground like a double exposure, legs and shadow faint against the cracked earth. The fence and trees show straight through it. A small animal walks along the back of the yard, unconcerned. Whatever was standing here has been switched off mid-broadcast, leaving just the outline in the static.

46cecba586.alt: Covered concrete walkway alongside a white building, a man standing at the far end, hazy trees beyond
46cecba586.story: A long covered walkway runs along a white building, its concrete edge stepping down toward the grass. At the far end, a single figure stands by the rail, small and dark. Beyond, the hills are hazy with dry-season dust, and bare trees hold their branches up against a white sky. The metal roof overhead ticks in the heat.

6042e438b5.alt: Man walking away across a dusty open yard toward wrecked cars and trees, a large tree trunk at right
6042e438b5.story: He walks out across the dusty yard toward a row of old cars at the edge of the trees, his back turned, shoulders easy. A thick trunk rises on the right. The ground is pale, raked with gravel and dry leaves. Something like a playground frame stands in the distance. The air looks thick and warm, the light diffused through a high haze.

7b8f2ed853.alt: Back of a man's shaved head and shoulders in a grey t-shirt, hand at his ear, hazy trees and light
7b8f2ed853.story: From behind, all that shows is the back of his shaved head and his hand raised to his ear, listening. The world beyond him has dissolved into blurred trunks and a glow of late light. A car's edge hovers at the right, out of focus. Whoever is on the other end, the call has his full attention.

833f2476d8.alt: Open-sided shed with corrugated roof sheltering two red trucks, a small car and wooden crates, palm behind
833f2476d8.story: Under a long corrugated roof, two red trucks and a small dark car wait in the shade beside a stack of wooden crates. A palm rises behind the shed, fronds still. The yard in front is bare and sandy, dotted with dry leaves. The corners of the frame darken like an old monitor. It is a picture of things parked, things waiting, things that might never move again.

6cac342c22.alt: Man standing in a gravel yard holding a phone up in front of his face, metal structures and trees behind
6cac342c22.story: Out in the open yard, he stands square to the lens with a phone raised in front of his face, filming back. Behind him, a tangle of metal stairs and frames stands among the trees. The hood of a car curves into the bottom of the frame. One recording points at another, and for a moment nobody can say who is watching whom.

65e57969d7.alt: Man hanging by both hands from a horizontal metal bar under a tree, sunlight through the leaves
65e57969d7.story: He hangs from a rusted bar between two posts, arms straight above his head, white sneakers dangling off the ground. Sunlight pours through the tree behind him and turns the leaves to bright smudges. Old equipment and a white trailer sit in the background. The ground is covered in wood chips. He holds on a moment longer than necessary, just to see.

a5e53cf6fe.alt: Rusted metal frame and an old trailer under dark trees in fading light, pale sky behind
a5e53cf6fe.story: The light is going. Under dark trees, an old metal frame and a long grey trailer sit in silhouette, edges blurring into shadow. The sky behind is pale and empty. Something orange glows faintly at the centre of the frame. No people now, only the shapes of what they left behind, like the last image held on screen after the signal drops.

465206ee87.alt: Row of red utility vehicles with hose reels parked along a gravel road under green trees
465206ee87.story: A row of red vehicles lines the gravel road, each one fitted with coiled hoses and metal fittings on the back. They are parked nose to tail, paint faded, tyres dusty. Trees lean over them, and the light comes through soft and white. The road beyond curves out of sight. It looks like a fleet waiting for an emergency that has not yet been scheduled.

c70c7c41eb.alt: Man in a grey t-shirt standing on a gravel road among trees, his face smeared by motion blur
c70c7c41eb.story: Facing forward, he stands on the gravel road, arms at his sides, but the face refuses to hold still, smeared sideways in a soft grey blur. The rest of him is sharp: the creased t-shirt, the watch on his wrist. Trees behind him stand in a pale dry haze. It is as if the picture caught the body but missed the signal.

9da1f1e5d6.alt: Man in a grey t-shirt turning his head sharply, face blurred, red fire vehicles parked behind on the road
9da1f1e5d6.story: A quick turn of the head, and the features stretch into a ghost trail. Over his shoulder, the red vehicles sit parked along the road, hose reels and all. The ground is scattered with dry leaves. His body stays planted while his face goes somewhere else, a half-second ahead of the rest of him, like a channel caught switching.

0f9d4d650a.alt: Man in a grey t-shirt with motion-blurred face turning to the right, trees and red vehicle behind
0f9d4d650a.story: Another turn, the other way this time, and the blur follows. The red fire vehicle has slipped to the edge of the frame. Light comes from somewhere behind the trees, white and diffuse, softening every edge. He keeps his hands loose at his sides. Three frames in a row, and the face has never once arrived in focus.

aca68f7dae.alt: Man seen from behind on a road overlooking a field with football goals and scattered trees
aca68f7dae.story: Facing away, he looks out over a broad field with a pair of white football goals, a small figure running across it. A pile of cut branches lies by the road. The trees are thin and dry, the sky washed almost white. He holds his phone loosely at his side. Whatever he is waiting for is out there somewhere, still too far away to see.

037a513174.alt: Man in a grey t-shirt seen from behind standing on a cracked road, trees and a distant field ahead
037a513174.story: Same back, same grey shirt, but the road has turned and the field has slid to the left. Cracks run through the asphalt at his feet. The trees ahead are dusty and leaning. He stands with his weight on one leg, phone in hand, unhurried. It is late in the dry afternoon and the light has gone soft and colourless.

8cba7bf9fd.alt: Man walking away down a cracked road toward dry trees and a field, holding a phone at his side
8cba7bf9fd.story: Slowly he starts walking down the cracked grey road toward the dry trees. A pale wall and some buildings sit far off between the trunks. The frame darkens toward its corners. His shadow is faint, barely there. It is the last daytime shot before everything changes: lights, music, crowd, night.

880d88e125.alt: Night festival seating area with red tables and chairs, string lights and a glowing stage screen
880d88e125.story: A taller view of the same crowd: rows of red tables packed with people eating and talking, bulbs strung overhead like a second set of stars. On the stage, a screen shows a performer in close-up, glowing white and blue. The dark sky takes up the top of the frame. Everyone is lit warm from above, faces turned in every direction.

1fdeb723b1.alt: Carved eagle above a round Highland Bike Festival 2024 emblem in front of a decorative banner at night
1fdeb723b1.story: No one in front of it now. The carved eagle spreads its wings over a round emblem that reads Highland Bike Festival 2024, painted in reds, golds and greens. Behind, the ornate banner glows on its metal truss, and a blue Michelin flag stands tall at the left. The black sky presses down from above. A stage set waiting for the next face.

1f2e2d8144.alt: Starburst light tower above festival stalls with clothing racks, folding chairs and a Test Ride sign
1f2e2d8144.story: The starburst tower lights the whole corner, its white rays bright against the night. Beneath it, racks of jackets and shirts hang in a row of stalls, and a sign partly reads Test Ri. A man sits on a red folding chair, legs crossed, apparently in no rush to buy anything. A white dome tent glows at the far left. The market hums along.

96ec539942.alt: Groups of people in dark clothes standing near flags at a night festival, tables and string lights behind
96ec539942.story: People stand around in small clusters near the flags, most in black, some with patches on their backs. A woman in a denim skirt walks past with her bag. Beyond them, the tables stretch out under looping string lights toward a glowing screen. It is the middle of the night, and the festival is at the point where nobody is sitting still.

7b8005ca71.alt: Man behind a sound mixing desk on a road case at a night festival, crowded tables and string lights behind
7b8005ca71.story: Far behind the crowd, a man in black leans over a mixing desk set on a scuffed road case, its little screen glowing. Cables run off into the dark. Beyond him, the tables stretch out under strings of bulbs, packed with people. A canopy shades his corner. Every sound the field is hearing tonight passes through his hands first.

1a1d35dec2.alt: Small green light hovering in a dark hazy night sky
1a1d35dec2.story: Above the festival, almost nothing: a dark, grainy sky, a faint haze, and one small green light hanging in the middle of it. It does not seem to move. Below, out of frame, the music and the crowd carry on. Up here, there is only the light and the grain, like a single pixel left burning on a screen after the broadcast ends.

d4252654f4.alt: Night festival edge with a glowing light structure, red tables and chairs and a few people on dry grass
d4252654f4.story: Out at the edge of the grounds, a scaffold covered in white lights rises into the dark beside a tall screen. Red folding tables sit half empty on dry grass. A few people stand around, small and lit from above. An orange traffic cone marks something only it understands. The festival is still going, but here it has thinned out into a quieter, more private hour.

8a54f17798.alt: Glossy red vintage car with tall chrome-trimmed tail fins parked on a dark roadside at night
8a54f17798.story: Parked on a dark roadside, a long red car waits, its tail fins sweeping up like the back of a rocket. Chrome trim catches the light in thin silver lines. White-wall tyres glow against the asphalt. Behind it, dry grasses and thin trees vanish into black. The car looks like it drove straight out of an old film and decided to stay a while.

baf0395028.alt: Man standing beside the front of a red vintage car on a dark road under an arched sign, flowers in foreground
baf0395028.story: Out front of the car, he stands in a pool of hard light, tiny against the long chrome grille. Above the road, an arched sign spans the dark, its letters too faint to read. Pink flowers crowd the bottom corner. Further down the lane, a single lamp glows. The night road feels like a set that has been lit for only one scene.

9dfa18b115.alt: Pale dog standing on a dark road in a patch of light, a parked motorcycle in shadow behind
9dfa18b115.story: A pale dog has walked into the light and stopped right on the yellow centre line, casting a long black shadow across the asphalt. It looks off to the left, ears soft, tail out. Behind it, a motorcycle sits parked in the shadows. The rest of the road is black. For a moment, the dog is the only thing on the programme.

4f48b2207c.alt: Pale dog on a dark road turning to look toward the light, motorcycle parked in shadow behind
4f48b2207c.story: Then it turns, head swinging round toward the light, one ear lifted, as if it has finally noticed it is the centre of attention. The yellow line runs under its feet. The motorcycle behind is still dark, still waiting. The dog does not move closer and does not leave. It just stands there, considering, the way dogs do on quiet roads at night.

26b141bf2f.alt: Rear of a red vintage car with tall tail fins and twin round lights parked by trees on a dark roadside
26b141bf2f.story: Rear view: the red car is all fins and chrome, twin round lights set into the bumper like a pair of eyes. A painted gold design sits on the boot lid. Dry branches lean over it from the roadside, and a single streetlamp glows far off in the dark. The exhaust pipe pokes out low. It looks ready to leave, any second.

307b0dc7e3.alt: View from a dark doorway onto a bright tiled courtyard where two pale dogs stand near a metal gate
307b0dc7e3.story: From inside the dark doorway, the courtyard is a bright rectangle of tiles and dust, two pale dogs standing in the middle of it like they own the place. Beyond them, an arched metal gate and a tiled roof. Dry leaves lie scattered across the floor. Half past three in the dry season, and the house stays cool while the yard bakes.

32d2f0eafd.alt: Dark doorway framing an empty sunlit tiled courtyard with an arched metal gate beyond
32d2f0eafd.story: Thirty seconds later the dogs have gone. Only the empty courtyard remains, framed by the dark door, its tile pattern running out toward the gate in neat glowing squares. A pair of sandals sits by the step. The light outside is almost white. The scene has gone quiet, like a set held on screen after the actors walk off.

d00b694b17.alt: Pale dog sitting on a tiled courtyard scratching itself, an ornate metal gate and trees behind
d00b694b17.story: One of them has come back and sat down right in the middle of the tiles to scratch, back leg lifted, head tipped up toward the sky in concentration. The gate behind stands half open, its curling metalwork bright in the sun. Leaves and grit cover the floor. Some problems in the dry season require complete attention, and the dog gives it.

abda81c066.alt: Pale dog lying on a dusty tiled courtyard, ornate metal gate and green trees behind
abda81c066.story: Problem solved, the dog has flopped down on the tiles, front legs stretched forward, head lowered. A second dog stands out by the gate, small and pale, keeping watch or just standing. The afternoon heat lies over everything. The courtyard floor is speckled with dry leaves, and the light from outside floods in across the patterned squares.

5f550fd901.alt: White pickup truck seen through ornate silver metal gate bars with circular details
5f550fd901.story: Between the silver bars of the gate, a white pickup sits parked on the other side, sliced into narrow strips by the metalwork. Rings and spikes decorate the gate in a neat row. Behind the truck, trees and a red rail. It is late afternoon, twelve days after the dogs, and the gate stays closed. The truck is going nowhere for now.

89257448e3.alt: Small brown and white birds gathered on the rim of a large glazed water pot against a stone wall
89257448e3.story: Around the rim of a big glazed pot, a handful of small birds gather to drink, brown backs and pale bellies, some leaning right down to the water. The stone wall behind is stacked in sandy, uneven blocks. A blue hose curls at the base. Something soft and blurred sits in the foreground. In the dry season, a pot of water is a small public square.

eae768394f.alt: Three small birds on the rim of a large ornate water pot beside a stone wall, leaves in foreground
eae768394f.story: Four seconds on, the birds have rearranged themselves: one perched up high on the rim, two dipping down to drink. Their heads are crested and pale. Green leaves cut into the left of the frame, out of focus. The pot is etched with a curling pattern, its glaze worn. It is a quick visit; nobody lingers at the edge for long.

dacf451139.alt: Two white-headed birds with dark eye stripes perched on the rim of a large glazed pot by a stone wall
dacf451139.story: Now just two remain, perched on the rim like bookends, white heads, dark eye stripes, brown wings folded neatly. One faces right, one faces left. A small ceramic figure sits on the wall behind them, green and lumpy. The light is soft and late. They look as though they have been placed there on purpose, the way objects are arranged on a shelf.

fd1167c7f2.alt: Two small white-headed birds standing on the rim of a large water pot, stone wall behind
fd1167c7f2.story: Barely anything changes for the pair, though the left one has turned its head to check the wall. The right one stands tall, chest puffed, staring past the frame. A clump of something pale lies on the ledge below the pot. The stone blocks behind carry faint stains of old water. Very little happens here, slowly and with conviction.

123b997c7d.alt: Two birds on the rim of a glazed pot, one turned away, one facing forward, stone wall and small statues
123b997c7d.story: The left bird has turned fully away now, tail toward the wall, while the right one leans forward as though about to dive for the water. Small ceramic figures watch from the ledge behind. The pot's rim curls outward in a wavy edge. Everything is warm stone, glaze and feathers, and the late sun keeps it all the same soft colour.

8318275c54.alt: Single bird bending to drink from a large glazed pot beside a stone wall, small statue and flowerpot behind
8318275c54.story: Only one bird is left, head bowed to the water, its body tucked low on the rim. The ceramic frog figure and a clay flowerpot sit on the ledge behind, patient spectators. Twelve seconds after the last frame, the crowd has cleared out, and this one has the whole pot to itself. It drinks quickly, as if someone might still come back.

426e56acc1.alt: Dusty lane between dry trees with a dark car parked beside blue barrels, leaves in the foreground
426e56acc1.story: Past a blurred leaf in the foreground, a dusty lane runs uphill between dry trees, and a dark car sits parked beside a pair of blue barrels. The verge is crisp and brown. Branches hang bare overhead. Nothing moves on the road. This is what the dry season looks like at ten to five: dust, shade, and very little traffic.

35287f5c71.alt: Narrow lane lined with banana plants and hedges, blue and yellow barrels and gate pillars on the right
35287f5c71.story: Further along, the lane narrows between banana plants on one side and a neat hedge on the other. A blue barrel and a yellow one stand together at the verge like two people waiting for a bus. Gate pillars line the right. The road surface is cracked and pale with dust. Somewhere beyond the trees, a dog barks once and stops.

53d2eaa959.alt: Soft white cumulus clouds rising against a pale blue-grey sky
53d2eaa959.story: Look up, and the lane disappears. Above it, a bank of cumulus rises soft and white, its top edge lit warm against a sky that has gone blue-grey. Nothing else in the frame: no wires, no trees, no rooftops. In the dry season, clouds like these come and go without rain, building up all afternoon and promising nothing.

fd38518c67.alt: Rounded white cumulus cloud tops against a pale blue sky in a vertical frame
fd38518c67.story: Moments later the cloud has shifted, its top now rounded into soft domes like heaped cotton. The sky above it has darkened half a shade. The edges glow faintly pink where the low sun reaches them. Staring up long enough, the whole frame starts to feel like a screen tuned to a channel showing nothing but weather.

2215fd4b10.alt: Wide band of cumulus clouds along the bottom of a pale blue-grey sky
2215fd4b10.story: Turned sideways now, the cloud stretches across the bottom of the frame in a long low wall of puffs. The sky above is smooth and empty, cool blue-grey. A small tear of blue sits in the cloud near the right edge. It could be any afternoon, anywhere, except for the dry warmth that seems to hang even in the colour.

7acd86fafb.alt: Black and white dog with a collar rolling on its back on gravel, mouth open, among dry leaves
7acd86fafb.story: Down on the gravel, a black and white dog flips onto its back and wriggles, paws in the air, mouth open in what looks a lot like a grin. Its collar has slipped around its neck. Dry leaves stick to its fur. Whatever the itch was, the gravel is taking care of it, and the dog is enjoying every second of the job.

8dfdb76670.alt: Black and white dog with a collar seen from behind, ears up, standing on gravel with dry leaves
8dfdb76670.story: Back on its feet, it has turned away, tail up, ears pricked, as though something more interesting has just appeared on the far side of the yard. The black patch across its back looks like a map of somewhere. Gravel and fallen leaves fill the ground. A second ago it was rolling; now it is all business, alert and still.

7aed4c766b.alt: Cream and tan dog with a curled tail looking back over its shoulder beside a leaf-strewn lane
7aed4c766b.story: A cream dog with tan ears pauses at the edge of the lane and looks back over its shoulder, tongue just showing, tail curled up high like a question mark. The verge beside it is a drift of crisp brown leaves. Its fur is dusty from the road. It seems to be checking whether anyone is following, and deciding whether that would be good or bad.

53984f7be3.alt: Two pale dogs on a quiet lane, one near in the foreground, one far off by a white fence and blue barrel
53984f7be3.story: Two dogs now, one close at the bottom of the frame, head turned, the other far down the lane near a white fence and a blue barrel. They seem to be in conversation across the distance. Dry grass lines both sides of the road. The house behind the fence sits shaded under heavy trees. Nobody else is out; the lane belongs to them.

d8bc1ed0b4.alt: White dog with a curled tail standing on a pale road in front of a long white concrete fence
d8bc1ed0b4.story: The far dog has come closer and now stands side-on in the middle of the road, tail curled over its back, head turned toward something on the left. Behind it, a long white concrete fence runs the width of the frame. The grass at the edges is straw-coloured. It is five in the afternoon, and even the dogs are moving in slow motion.

688aff87b5.alt: Tiled gable roof of a pale house framed by leafy trees and a tall conifer against a hazy sky
688aff87b5.story: Over the fence line, the roof of a house rises in two steep tiled gables, brown and weathered. Trees crowd in around it, a tall conifer pressing close on the right. The sky behind is hazy and pale. A little blue shows at the bottom where a window catches light. Ordinary houses in the dry season look like they are holding their breath.

033ab06c05.alt: Round orange-framed convex mirror on a white wall reflecting a road, trees and a small figure
033ab06c05.story: A round traffic mirror, ringed in orange, hangs against the white wall and shows a second, curved world: a bent road, a line of trees, and one tiny figure in blue standing in the middle of it. Palm fronds hang over the top. The mirror makes everything small and round and far away, like a picture on an old fishbowl screen.

20b5a65fef.alt: Cumulus cloud against a pale sky framed by dark silhouetted branches and drooping leaves
20b5a65fef.story: Branches fringe the frame in silhouette: a bare twig at the top, drooping leaves along the bottom. In between, a soft heap of cloud floats in the pale sky, its edges catching a faint warm light. It is just after five. The heat is easing, slightly, and the sky has started its slow fade from blue to something paler.

90fac8a60a.alt: Person in a teal shirt carrying a red bag walking away down a dusty lane between dry bushes
90fac8a60a.story: Down the long dusty lane, a figure in a teal shirt walks away with a red bag swinging from one hand. The verges are thick with dry grass and tangled bushes. A roof peeks out from the trees at the far end. The light is flat and pale, and the road ahead runs gently uphill. It is the walk home, or the walk to somewhere, unhurried.

e82e7ceb55.alt: Person in a teal shirt and shorts carrying a red bag walking up a pale lane toward a house among trees
e82e7ceb55.story: Further along now. The red bag still swings, the steps still steady. A white bag hangs in the other hand. The lane narrows as it climbs, and the bushes close in on both sides. Ahead, the house roof is nearer now. Every afternoon probably looks like this here: one walker, one road, one bright bag.

5401518f08.alt: Forested hillside under a pale hazy sky with white letters on the slope, a tree silhouette at left
5401518f08.story: A hillside rises from the right, covered in dry, olive-brown trees, and near its crest a row of white letters stands on the slope, too far and too hazy to read clearly. The sky is pale pink-grey with dust. A dark shrub fills the bottom-left corner. Even from this distance, the air looks thick enough to taste.

de62c2ef5f.alt: Bare lone tree with a thin trunk silhouetted against a pale pink sky, blue hills and dark trees below
de62c2ef5f.story: One bare tree stands alone on the slope, thin trunk rising to a spray of branches tipped with small dark knobs. Behind it, a line of blue hills fades into a pale pink sky. The grass at the bottom is dry and dark. The tree looks less like a plant than a diagram of one, drawn carefully against the haze.

d32a64deba.alt: Lone bare tree with a slender trunk against a hazy pink sky, dark treetops and blue hill behind
d32a64deba.story: Slightly closer, the tree has grown taller in the frame. Its branches spread wider, fine as cracks in glass. Dark treetops cluster around its base, and the hill behind is a soft wedge of blue. Nothing in the picture moves except perhaps a bird somewhere in those top branches, too small to see.

67fc67c7e3.alt: Bare slender tree silhouetted against a hazy pale sky with a blue hill and dark trees below
67fc67c7e3.story: Another frame. The tree has shifted right, the hill dipped lower behind it. The sky is the same pale pink, unchanging. Repeated three times, the tree becomes something like a station ident, the same shape returning at the start of each programme, steady and familiar, holding the frame together while the light slowly changes.

722a81765f.alt: Lone bare tree on the left against a pale hazy sky, blue hill and dark trees along the bottom
722a81765f.story: Turned horizontal, the frame gives the tree room to breathe. It stands left of centre now, with the blue hill rolling away behind it and a band of dark treetops along the base. Another bare branch reaches in from the far left edge. The sky takes up most of the picture, empty and soft, the colour of weak tea with milk.

d7fb8a1239.alt: Bare tree silhouetted against a pale sky, a blue hill and dark tree line behind
d7fb8a1239.story: Ten seconds later, the tree has moved to the centre, and the hill slopes up behind it like a shoulder. The branches seem denser from this angle, knotted with dark buds. The light has dimmed a little. The dry season haze softens everything at the horizon until the hills look painted on, a backdrop rolled down for the evening.

1d36797de9.alt: Small dog trotting down a pale lane toward the camera, a gate and house among dry trees behind
1d36797de9.story: Trotting down the middle of the lane, a small dog comes with its ears back, heading straight toward the frame. Behind it, a second dog waits at a metal gate in front of a house half hidden by trees. Dry grass spills over both edges of the road. The lane is quiet and pale. Whatever brought the dog out, it is coming with purpose.

49d2cafa9c.alt: Rust-red structure built from shipping containers with a lookout platform, bare pale trees behind
49d2cafa9c.story: A structure made of rust-red shipping containers sits stacked against the hillside, with a small lookout platform perched on top under a peaked roof. Railings run along its upper deck. Behind it, bare pale trees twist upward against a hazy green slope. Nobody is on the platform. It looks like a watchtower built for a programme that was never commissioned.

c65a4b302e.alt: Low white building with tall columns and a metal roof behind a dry grass field and leaning trees
c65a4b302e.story: Across a field of dry grass, a long low building stands behind a row of white columns, its dark glass windows reflecting nothing. A red railing and a fallen log lie out front. Thin trees lean in on the left. The roof is pale metal. It looks freshly built and not yet used, like a set dressed and waiting for its cast.

97855908f5.alt: Close-up of dry, papery leaves hanging from a thin branch against a soft green blurred background
97855908f5.story: Hanging close, a thin branch carries a cluster of leaves gone papery and pale, curled at the edges, translucent where the light passes through. The background melts into soft greens and creams. It is ten past five, and the light has turned gentle. The dry season leaves everything brittle, even the leaves still holding on.

5faab6aa66.alt: Close-up of a brown and white dog with large upright ears and a white blaze, looking straight ahead
5faab6aa66.story: Ears up, eyes level, the dog fills the frame from edge to edge. A white stripe runs down its forehead to a black wet nose, and its brown fur is flecked grey around the muzzle. The background is a plain pale wash. It holds the gaze completely, unblinking, the way a presenter looks down the lens before the first line of the night.

fd33b32d60.alt: Brown and white dog with tall ears looking forward, mouth slightly open showing teeth
fd33b32d60.story: Then the mouth has opened a little, a flash of teeth and pink tongue, not quite a smile, not quite a pant. The ears have swivelled forward, catching some sound behind the lens. The eyes stay fixed. Every whisker is sharp. It feels less like being looked at than being assessed, kindly, by someone with very good hearing.

5c64929d54.alt: Close portrait of a dog with large ears and a white blaze, another dog blurred at the right edge
5c64929d54.story: Two seconds more, and another dog's shoulder has crept into the right edge, a brown blur. The first dog keeps its post, mouth relaxed, eyes calm. The light is flat and soft, the season's haze flattening every shadow. Three frames, three nearly identical faces, each one a little more patient than the last, like reruns of the same short programme.

891591d4cc.alt: Red, white and blue striped flag flying on a pole beside bare branches and another pole against a grey sky
891591d4cc.story: High over the yard, a striped flag of red, white and blue flaps on its pole, the cloth caught mid-ripple. A second, bare pole stands to the left, and a dark wire post runs up the right. Bare branches reach in from the corner, and a few leaves cling at the bottom. The sky is grey and flat. The wind is the only thing moving.

f691206b85.alt: Dusty yard with wrecked cars, a white cylindrical tank, tyres and pallets under tall trees
f691206b85.story: A wide dusty yard spreads out under tall trees, scattered with wreckage: two burned-out cars, a long white tank lying on its side, old tyres, stacked pallets, a pipe running along the ground. A ring of black marks a fire pit. The trees behind are thick and green. It looks like a training ground or a scrapyard, a place where things are broken on purpose.

2be1ddb84f.alt: Dusty yard with a white tank, wrecked cars and tyres, a dog standing at right under tall trees
2be1ddb84f.story: Enter a dog: it has walked into the scene and stopped by the white tank, looking off to the right. Everything else is the same: the wrecks, the tyres, the pallets, the dry leaves on the ground. The dog, though, changes the picture. Now the yard has an inhabitant, and the wreckage looks like furniture in its living room.

04983c9044.alt: Black and white dog with a curled tail walking across a dusty gravel yard, tongue out, trees behind
04983c9044.story: A black and white dog trots across the gravel with its tail curled over its back and tongue lolling, head turned toward something off to the right. Dry leaves cover the ground. Thick tree trunks lean behind it. The patches on its coat look painted on in a hurry. It is mid-stride, intent on reaching wherever it is going before the light changes.

26b5497c77.alt: Large tree shading a dusty yard with a small white building and an empty signboard on posts
26b5497c77.story: A huge tree throws its branches across the top of the frame, shading the edge of the yard. Beneath it, a small white structure and a blank signboard on two posts stand in front of thick green. The ground is a broad sweep of pale dust. No dogs now, no people. The signboard says nothing at all, which might be the point.

3ec8b091b8.alt: Rusty metal scaffold and pipe structure with a valve on top, under green trees beside a red wall
3ec8b091b8.story: Rust has claimed a frame of pipes and scaffolding under the trees, a tangle of metal with a yellow valve perched on top like a small crown. A red wall and a parked red vehicle hide behind it. The pipes are bent at right angles and run nowhere in particular. It looks like a machine built to do one job and then forgotten.

70fd237027.alt: Two burned and rusted car wrecks with smashed windows sitting on dry grass under trees
70fd237027.story: Two cars sit in the grass, burned down to bare metal and rust, one with its roof peeled back and crumpled, the other with its windows gone and its paint blistered into maps. Grass grows up through the gaps around the tyres. Trees press in from behind. Whatever happened to them happened a while ago. They have settled in now, part of the landscape.

90812bbde0.alt: Close-up of rough grey-brown tree bark with deep cracks and ridges
90812bbde0.story: Bark, seen this close, is a landscape of its own: cracked plates of grey and tan, deep fissures running down between them, a dry crust that flakes at the edges. Light falls flat across the surface. In the dry season, everything seems to crack the same way, the mud, the bark, the road. Nothing here is soft.

6e60410412.alt: Close-up texture of cracked grey tree bark with a small dark mark near the centre
6e60410412.story: A few steps closer, or a few inches to the left. The plates of bark look larger now, and near the centre a small dark shape sits in one of the cracks, maybe an insect, maybe just a knot. The pattern runs edge to edge without a break. Stare long enough and it starts to look like static frozen on a screen.

6cd2862c92.alt: Burned, rusted car wreck in the grass with a red vehicle and trees behind
6cd2862c92.story: Another look at the wrecks, closer and from the front. The nearer car's bonnet has rusted in patches of orange and black, the headlight smashed, the wheel still bright silver. Its neighbour's roof is peeled open like a tin. Behind, red vehicles sit parked under trees. Grass grows thick around the tyres. Nobody is coming to fix them.

c8bc68b5a8.alt: Shaded woodland with pale tree trunks, a stone picnic table and benches, and leafy branches in front
c8bc68b5a8.story: Among pale trunks, a stone picnic table and its benches sit empty in the shade. Leafy branches hang down across the foreground, out of focus. Dry sticks lie scattered over the brown ground. A dirt track curves away behind the trees. It is the kind of spot built for lunch breaks, and at twenty past five, nobody needs it.

247d291666.alt: Stone picnic table under pale tree trunks with dry branches on the ground and leaves in the foreground
247d291666.story: Nineteen seconds on, a slight shift to the right. The table stays put, of course, and the bench beside it, and the white branches lying on the ground like dropped bones. The leaves in front sway a little closer to the lens. The shade feels cool compared to the yard. The pale tree trunks stand around it like guests who have forgotten why they came.

124c86156b.alt: Close-up of thin branches with green and brown leaves against a soft blurred background
124c86156b.story: A thin branch dangles in the foreground, leaves green and brown, some curling at their tips. Behind it, everything blurs into soft beige and green: a trunk, a path, a smudge of blue at the bottom. The light comes in low and even. In this season, even the shade looks dusty, and every leaf shows a little wear.

e2562b367a.alt: Leaning palm tree above a pile of dry fronds, blue pipes on the ground and dense green trees behind
e2562b367a.story: A palm leans at an angle over a heap of its own dead fronds, as though it has been looking down at them for some time. Blue pipes run across the ground at the bottom of the frame. Dense green trees close in on the right. The light is tired and soft. Everything here looks like it has been waiting a long time for rain.

462651f54d.alt: Small tan dog sitting under an open metal shed beside a wall with faded writing, concrete pad in front
462651f54d.story: In the shade of an open metal shed, a small tan dog sits upright and still, facing out over a bare concrete slab. Faded letters on the wall behind it are too worn to read. Another dark shape lies further off near the fence. The steel post of a canopy cuts the right side of the frame. The dog seems to be on duty, guarding nothing in particular.

1ef6be7938.alt: Row of orange-red fire and rescue trucks parked along a leafy dirt road under trees
1ef6be7938.story: Orange-red trucks line the edge of the dirt road, nose to tail, hoses coiled and equipment racked on their backs. A brown pickup leads the column. Trees arch over them, dropping leaves on the bonnets. They sit in the shade, washed and ready, the way emergency vehicles wait between calls: perfectly still, never quite off duty.

5cf6ae6284.alt: Two dogs standing among rusty pipes and a metal column on a concrete pad, wall with faded writing behind
5cf6ae6284.story: Among rusty pipes and a thick red column, two dogs stand on the concrete, one tan, one black and white, both facing forward. They look like they were mid-errand and have just been interrupted. Behind them, a chain-link fence and a wall with faded painted letters. The pipes bend overhead in grey loops, part of some system that seems to have stopped.

a323ae1863.alt: Empty dirt road curving between dry bushes, spiky plants and pale trees under a hazy sky
a323ae1863.story: Curving off between pale trees, the road is quiet, its surface dry and crumbling at the edges. A spiky green plant rises from a clump of brown bushes on the left. Power lines sag across the top of the frame. No traffic, no walkers. The dry season air hangs thick and still, turning the far trees into faint grey outlines.

c080fe09a2.alt: Dirt road lined with dry shrubs, a spiky palm-like plant and tall pale trees under hazy light
c080fe09a2.story: A step or two further on, the same road widens out. The spiky plant has moved toward the centre, a burst of green above the dried-out shrubs. Tall trees lean across from both sides, their leaves dusty. The light flattens everything into soft greens and greys. It is half past five, and the road is still empty.

a7117386be.alt: Green sports field with a white goal frame, cars parked by a fence and a pale building among trees
a7117386be.story: Suddenly green: a wide field opens out, startlingly lush after all the dry dirt. A white goal frame stands at the left, net-less. Cars sit parked along the fence, and a pale multi-storey building rises behind the trees. A small shelter shades a few benches. No game today. The grass looks freshly cut and waiting.

02920c9555.alt: Peach and white multi-storey building on a hillside behind trees, a white sign with Thai lettering by a field
02920c9555.story: Beyond the field, a peach and white building climbs the hillside in balconies and windows, half hidden behind dry trees. Below it, a long white sign with green Thai lettering stands at the field's edge, facing the empty grass. The hill behind is brown with the season. Everything faces the field, as if waiting for a match to start.

ccf6c407cd.alt: Vertical view of a peach and white hillside building behind trees, a white sign with Thai lettering below
ccf6c407cd.story: Six seconds later and tighter, the building fills the top of the frame, its balconies stacked in neat peach rows. The sign below reads in green Thai letters, white board on dark posts. A low fence runs across the bottom. The dry hill rises at the back, brushed with a few green trees. Everything is quiet, the field still empty.

ad3f87ab00.alt: Green field in front of a fence and white sign with Thai lettering, a building and parked car behind
ad3f87ab00.story: Turned wide, the sign sits on its own along the fence line, white with green letters, a parked car tucked behind it. The building looms over the trees in the background, and a shelter sits to the left. The grass in front is a flat, even green, the brightest thing for miles. It looks like a stage waiting for the opening ceremony.

0664d18e2e.alt: Dog lying alone in the middle of a green sports field, white goal and parked cars in the background
0664d18e2e.story: Right in the middle of all that grass, a single dog lies down with its head up and ears pointed, guarding the centre of the pitch. The goal stands empty behind it. Cars wait in the car park beyond the fence. The dog has picked the best seat in the place and does not plan to give it up for anyone, match or no match.

e75411b7b4.alt: Dirt road lined with dry shrubs, a spiky green plant and bare pale trees under overhead wires
e75411b7b4.story: Returning to the road, the shrubs at the left have gone mostly brown, and the spiky plant stands above them like a firework. Pale trunks lean in from the edge of the frame, branches crossing with the sagging wires. The surface is scattered with leaves. The haze softens everything into the same quiet palette, pale green and dust.

7646f660d6.alt: Shaded dirt path leading between dense trees and clipped hedges toward a bright opening
7646f660d6.story: A path runs between dense dark trees and spiky shrubs toward a pale opening at the far end. A low hedge has been trimmed into a neat line across the gap. Wires hang overhead. The trees on either side are thick and green, unlike the bare ones elsewhere. It is like walking into a tunnel at the end of the day, light only at the far end.

7d6f6d1a2f.alt: Dark green wooden bleachers with three tiers standing alone on a grassy field
7d6f6d1a2f.story: A set of dark green wooden bleachers stands alone on the grass, three tiers of seats and a railing along the top, the whole frame tilted slightly on its metal legs. Nobody sits on it. The grass around it is patchy, green and straw. It is just after half past five. The audience, whoever they were, has long since gone home, and the field has signed off for the night.

2c092940b7.alt: Green wooden bleachers standing alone on a dry grass field, a yellow corner flag and trees behind
2c092940b7.story: Four rows of green planks wait at the edge of the field with nobody on them. The grass has gone straw-coloured in the dry season, and a yellow corner flag leans in the still air. Half past five, and the match, if there ever was one, finished long ago. The bleachers keep facing the pitch anyway, patient as an audience that missed the last bus.

a7424bfff4.alt: Dark silhouette of a broad tree crown with the low sun glowing through its leaves, blurred branches above
a7424bfff4.story: The sun has slipped down into the crown of the big tree and caught there, a small hot coin among the leaves. Bare twigs hang out of focus across the top of the sky. The haze turns everything the colour of weak tea. For a minute the whole tree reads like a lamp somebody switched on from the inside.

d8bad020c0.alt: Tree silhouette against a hazy peach sky, the setting sun burning through the right side of its canopy
d8bad020c0.story: Three seconds later the glow has drifted right, finding a new gap between branches. Nothing else moves. The canopy is a black cut-out pasted on a pale sheet, and the light leaks through wherever the scissors slipped. Somewhere below, the field is already cooling, but up here the last of the day is still trying every opening.

9f9afeb43e.alt: Rounded tree silhouette lower in the frame, the sun a faint orange spot near its top, branches overhead
9f9afeb43e.story: Lower now, and dimmer. The sun is only an ember tucked into the top of the canopy, and the branches overhead seem closer, as if leaning in to watch it go. The sky behind is flat and milky. Late afternoon in the dry months often ends like this, without drama, just a gradual turning down of the dial.

3656e54671.alt: Black silhouette of a wide tree canopy against a pale hazy sky, the sun no longer visible
3656e54671.story: Gone. The tree has swallowed the light completely, and what remains is pure outline: hundreds of small leaves pressed flat against a sky the colour of paper. The broadcast ended without a sign-off. Someone walking past would see only a tree, and they would be right, but a minute ago it had a sun inside it.

c04efe9069.alt: White football goal with net on a green pitch, a tall green pole beside it and trees beyond
c04efe9069.story: The goal stands empty on the grass, its white net hanging slack. Behind it the trees are dense and dark, and a green pole rises out of frame like a post that forgot what it was holding. The pitch is greener here than by the bleachers, watered or simply luckier. No ball, no players, only the frame waiting for a shot.

39af404a23.alt: Concrete lane climbing between trees, a small brown animal standing far up the road
39af404a23.story: A pale concrete lane climbs between the trees, and far up the slope a small brown animal stands in the middle of it, as if waiting for traffic that never comes. Fallen leaves gather along the edges. The air has that dry-season dust in it, softening the green. Nobody else is on the road, so the animal keeps the right of way.

b78541c8cf.alt: White classical colonnade with pillars and an arch in a garden of cypress trees and green lawn
b78541c8cf.story: White columns and a curved arch rise out of the garden, borrowed from some other century and set down beside cypress trees and a mown lawn. A floodlight is clipped to the top, ready for evenings that need more glamour. Behind, an ordinary building shows through the trees. The effect is a stage set waiting for actors who are running late.

d58d75e87c.alt: Orange sun glowing through dark leaves and branches, with soft round spots of light
d58d75e87c.story: Through a screen of leaves the sun breaks into dozens of small round lights, each one a blurred copy of itself. A dark trunk cuts down the right side. The colour is pure late afternoon, amber edging toward rust. It looks less like a sunset than a signal coming through on a weak frequency, broken up, but unmistakably there.

2f81a871fb.alt: Low sun glowing behind drooping silhouetted leaves beside a dark tree trunk
2f81a871fb.story: Long narrow leaves droop across the light, and the sun sits right behind them, flaring orange where they thin out. A trunk stands dark at the right. The leaves look almost like hair hanging over a face. In a few minutes the sun will be lower than the branches, and this particular arrangement of shadow will never line up again.

aa6ed415eb.alt: White arched colonnade with string lights, framing stone steps and garden beyond, in vertical format
aa6ed415eb.story: Seen straight on, the colonnade becomes a doorway: two white pillars, an arch, and a sagging line of unlit bulbs strung beneath it. Through the opening, worn steps lead up into green shade. Vines are working their way up the left column. At night those bulbs would make it a set for a slow dance. For now it simply frames the path.

61f210bbb4.alt: Pink two-storey building with a tiled roof and satellite dishes, surrounded by palms and trees, dry hill behind
61f210bbb4.story: Two satellite dishes on the roof tilt toward the same patch of sky, listening for the evening programmes. The building below is a faded pink, its windows shut, its balcony empty. Palms crowd the right side, and the hillside behind has gone brown with the season. Somewhere inside, maybe, a television is already warming up.

53900281c3.alt: White dog with a curled tail facing away at the edge of tall grass beside a green post
53900281c3.story: A white dog stands where the bare dirt meets a strip of tall grass, tail curled up like a question mark. Its nose is somewhere in the green, following a scent nobody else can read. A green post rises behind it at the edge of the field. The dog is entirely busy and entirely uninterested in being watched.

fd738140c9.alt: White dog nosing into tall grass at the edge of a field, dry leaves and dirt in the foreground
fd738140c9.story: Still at it. The dog has pushed its head further into the grass, the curled tail the only part that stays upright. Dry leaves and a fallen stick lie on the slope in front. The field beyond is empty, the goalposts unattended. Whatever is in that grass, a lizard, a smell, a dropped snack, it has the whole evening of attention.

27116327be.alt: White dog standing on a slope looking left, a goal net behind it and a tree trunk in the foreground
27116327be.story: Finally the dog lifts its head and turns to look at something off to the left, ears forward, tail still curled high. Behind it the goal net catches the late light. A thin tree trunk cuts through the foreground. The pose is pure watchfulness, the kind that happens a second before a dog decides to trot off somewhere else.

a2aee2971c.alt: White house with a grey metal roof and a white picket fence, a mound of earth and bare trees around it
a2aee2971c.story: The house is white and low, with a grey roof and a picket fence that looks newly painted. A mound of earth sits in front, as if someone started digging and paused for the season. Bare trunks stand around it, leafless in the dry months. Wall lamps by the door are off. It is the hour before anyone thinks to switch them on.

0bd21a4809.alt: White house with brick pillars, an arched window and a green-railed balcony under a peaked roof, trees behind
0bd21a4809.story: A deep porch shades the front of the house, held up by two brick pillars, with a green lattice railing running between them. Arched windows sit back in the shadow. A single pendant lamp hangs from the ceiling, waiting for dark. The forest behind is a mix of palms and bare branches. Everything about it says late afternoon, nobody home.

80657e22a3.alt: White building with arched windows behind a low wall where a small dark animal sits, green slope in front
80657e22a3.story: On the low wall in front of the house, a small dark animal sits and surveys the garden, unbothered. Arched windows, a tiled roof and a brick pillar make up the rest of the scene. A flowering shrub grows in the middle of the lawn. The animal has clearly claimed this spot before and will claim it again tomorrow.

c52048be0b.alt: Old rust-streaked bus parked behind a blue sign with an arrow pointing to a resort and spa
c52048be0b.story: The bus has not gone anywhere in a long time. Rust bleeds through its red and white stripes, the curtains are drawn, and a blue sign propped in front points up the hill toward a resort and spa. The arrow is confident. The bus is not. Together they look like an advertisement and its quiet rebuttal.

df2d78a1d7.alt: Shallow green river under trees, with a weathered concrete pillar and a rusted metal platform on the bank
df2d78a1d7.story: A concrete pillar stands on the riverbank with a rusted metal platform perched on top, its purpose long forgotten. The water below runs low and green, barely moving over pale sand. Trees close in from both sides. In the wet season this would be louder, faster. Now it is a pool of reflected leaves and a structure that waits.

a3ee58da7b.alt: Closer view of a mossy concrete pillar with a rusted platform beside a low green river and trees
a3ee58da7b.story: A step closer and the pillar shows its age: moss on the concrete, rust on the railings, a cable running up the trunk beside it. The river is a wide shallow sheet, a few sticks resting on the sand bars. It looks like a lookout point for something that stopped coming by. The trees, at least, still keep watch.

a4c59a6cc9.alt: Hazy orange sun low in the sky behind bare branches, dark blurred leaves in the foreground
a4c59a6cc9.story: Bare branches scratch across the sky like lines on an old map, and the sun sits among them, soft and orange, its edges blurred by dust. A dark leaf crosses the bottom corner, out of focus. The hills below have almost disappeared into the haze. It is the moment the day turns the volume down to a hum.

f2f089c8b8.alt: Ornate red and orange spirit house beside a wooden shrine on a concrete platform among trees
f2f089c8b8.story: On a concrete platform under the trees stand two small houses that are not for people: one tall and ornate in red and gold, the other carved dark wood. Tiny chairs and offerings crowd their verandas. Behind them, palm fronds and a broad trunk. The light is low, and they glow a little warmer than everything around them.

081b8b7d62.alt: Grey concrete gabled building wrapped in metal scaffolding against a peach sky and distant hills
081b8b7d62.story: A grey concrete roofline rises in sharp triangles, still raw, wrapped in a cage of scaffolding. A single power line crosses the peach sky above. The hills behind are faint, almost erased by haze. Construction has paused for the evening, and without workers the building looks less like progress and more like a strange monument that arrived overnight.

daeedcf1d9.alt: Orange light leak washing over a roadside with trimmed round shrubs, a wooden fence and power poles
daeedcf1d9.story: A streak of orange flare washes down the frame, as though the scene briefly overloaded. Underneath it, a quiet roadside: rows of trimmed round shrubs, a fence, a street sign on a pole, a pile of dirt waiting by the curb. Power lines run toward a white building. It looks like a channel slightly out of tune, colours bleeding at the edge.

e4ec7516e5.alt: Tan dog standing in the middle of an asphalt road staring ahead, a white dog walking behind it
e4ec7516e5.story: The tan dog plants itself in the middle of the road and stares straight ahead, ears up, tail raised, every inch the gatekeeper. Behind it the white dog wanders up, less committed. A crack runs across the asphalt like a river on a map. Nobody is getting past without first being thoroughly assessed.

5efd6e1af0.alt: Silhouetted power pole and tangled wires against a peach evening sky above a dark tree line
5efd6e1af0.story: Wires spray out from the pole in every direction, crossing and sagging, a diagram nobody could follow. The pole and the trees below are black against a sky gone peach and dusty. Somewhere along those lines, televisions are switching on in kitchens for the evening news. Up here it is all silence and silhouette.

a3eaa02391.alt: Bright red bougainvillea flowers on a bush under tree branches, a white wall in the background
a3eaa02391.story: The bougainvillea is the loudest thing on the street, a burst of red spilling over a white wall. Above, a heavy branch bends low with small leaves. Everything else is muted by the haze, so the flowers seem almost to hum. Dry season or not, this bush has decided to keep the colour turned all the way up.

d1415b1456.alt: Person in a blue top pushing a loaded cart with a closed red umbrella along a quiet roadside
d1415b1456.story: A cart rolls along the edge of the road, loaded high, a red umbrella folded upright like a mast. The person pushing it wears blue and walks steadily past green netting and round clipped shrubs. Late afternoon, the shift either starting or ending. The road is empty enough that the wheels must be the only sound for a while.

b06ed07c1e.alt: Unfinished concrete gable with a blue tarp roof, power lines and an X-braced scaffold against a peach sky
b06ed07c1e.story: A blue tarp covers half of a new roof, ribbed and taut, and the bare concrete gable rises above it in a hard triangle. Off to the right, a crossed brace of scaffolding marks the spot like an X on a map. Wires cut across the sky. It is a building halfway to being somewhere people live.

c2f0ab1501.alt: Two dogs walking up a hill road with a dashed yellow centre line, trees and hazy hills ahead
c2f0ab1501.story: Two dogs set off uphill along the dashed yellow line, one brown, one black, keeping a polite distance from each other. Tall trees line the road, and the hills ahead are soft with haze. They walk with purpose, clearly on their regular evening round, following a route only dogs know the reason for.

49f6db2ea6.alt: Pink-roofed house behind a tall concrete wall with round lamps, power poles and leafy trees
49f6db2ea6.story: A tall concrete wall runs along the lane with small white globe lamps perched on top like eggs. Behind it, a pink tiled roof peeks out. Utility poles lean at slightly different angles, and the trees beyond fade into haze. Dry grass grows at the foot of the wall. The house is visible, but only just, and seems to prefer it that way.

c950f23eaa.alt: Large white Thai letters standing on a hillside above dry brown trees, under a pale sky
c950f23eaa.story: Giant white letters stand on the hill above a slope of brown, leafless trees, announcing a name to the whole valley. A wisp of cloud floats over them. In the dry season the forest has gone the colour of rust, which makes the letters look even brighter, like a title card held up at the start of a programme.

d4fafee674.alt: Quiet road with a white dog, an orange pickup, blue direction signs, pink flowering shrubs and a house
d4fafee674.story: An orange pickup idles at the far end of the road while a white dog crosses in front of it, unhurried. Blue signs stacked on a post point to places off frame. A pink flowering shrub brightens the front of a wooden house. A small bird hops on the asphalt. Everyone here seems to know whose turn it is to move.

30a3750343.alt: Billowing white cumulus cloud against a blue-grey sky
30a3750343.story: One big cloud, lit cream on its upper edge and shading to grey underneath, piles up into a blue sky that has gone slightly dusty. Another smaller cloud drifts at the corner. For a moment it is the only thing worth looking at. Clouds like this in the dry season promise nothing, but they make good company.

4229df8645.alt: Orange pickup parked on a driveway beside blue direction signs and a pink bougainvillea bush
4229df8645.story: Closer now, the orange pickup has pulled up beside the stacked blue signs, its headlights bright. A pink bougainvillea sprawls over the corner in front of a balcony. Lavender flowers grow along the kerb. The road curves away under tall trees. It feels like the moment just after arriving, engine ticking, deciding where to park.

b8f3697288.alt: White building with a brown panel reading HAUS 173 and a metal frame on the roof, leaves overhead
b8f3697288.story: A brown panel on the white wall reads HAUS 173, with a downward arrow beneath, as though pointing to the door below. On the roof, a bare metal frame curves into an unfinished dome. A branch with red flowers leans in from the top. The windows are small and dark. It looks like a building that tunes in only after dusk.

a68c5bd64f.alt: Pink-lit cloud tops rising above a grey band of haze in a blue-grey evening sky
a68c5bd64f.story: Twenty minutes after the sun sets, the clouds are still catching it. Their tops glow soft pink above a band of grey haze, while the sky around them cools to slate. Below, the town has already gone dim. Up here the light lingers, like a test pattern left on after the programmes end.

427dba0400.alt: Rounded pink-tinted cloud above a layer of grey haze against a blue-grey sky
427dba0400.story: The cloud has gathered itself into one rounded heap, its edges blushing where the last light touches them. Underneath, grey haze rolls flat like a second horizon. Nothing moves fast. The colour fades a little every few breaths, the way a room dims when someone slowly turns the lamp down.

35edd39d2d.alt: Pale pink cloud drifting low over a grey haze layer in a darkening blue sky
35edd39d2d.story: Thirty seconds on, the pink is fainter, and the cloud has slid toward the left, low over the haze. The blue above has deepened. This is the last frame of the evening, the final beat of a day of trees and dogs and empty fields, closing on something soft and slowly going grey.

6c6cabccff.alt: Dirt track under arching dry trees, a line of white concrete fence posts along one side
6c6cabccff.story: The track dips and curves under a tunnel of leaning trees, their trunks bent as if pushed by a wind that stopped long ago. White concrete posts mark one edge in a neat row. Dead leaves cover the ground. It is the kind of path that seems to lead somewhere important and probably leads to a gate.

8f191f7bbc.alt: Leaf-covered dirt track rising toward a line of white fence posts under bent, dry trees
8f191f7bbc.story: A little lower and the track rises to meet the trees, the posts climbing alongside like a slow staircase. Brown leaves are scattered thick across the dirt. Green appears only in patches, low and stubborn. The arch of branches overhead frames the road like a proscenium, though the only performer due is the wind.

46e18143f9.alt: Dry dirt track with fallen leaves under an arch of leaning trees, white posts on the right
46e18143f9.story: Nearly the same view again, with a fraction more of the right-hand posts showing. Nothing has changed except the angle, which is the point of standing still on a quiet track. Dry leaves, bent trunks, a pale sky through the gaps. The scene waits patiently for something, anything, to walk into it.

4175f6b84a.alt: Dirt track between bamboo and fence posts leading to a house with a peaked roof, a white dog edge at bottom
4175f6b84a.story: At the end of the track a house appears, tall-roofed and half hidden by bamboo, with a white gate across its yard. Fence posts lead toward it in two straight lines. At the bottom corner, a patch of white fur has slipped into the frame, a dog arriving uninvited. The next frame will belong to it.

dd245eed5a.alt: Blurred white dog with an open mouth in the foreground of a dirt track leading to a house among bamboo
dd245eed5a.story: And here it is: a big white dog bursts into the foreground, mouth open mid-pant, a soft blur against the sharp house behind. The track, the fence posts and the gate stay perfectly still. The dog has no interest in composition. It simply wanted to be the subject, and now it is.

45374d6f48.alt: Soft-focus white dog turning away on a dirt track, a house and white gate visible behind
45374d6f48.story: The dog turns, already losing interest, its fluffy shape dissolving in the blur. Behind, the house holds steady with its white gate and bamboo walls. A moment ago it filled the frame with noise. Now it is drifting out, back toward the yard, leaving the track exactly as quiet as it found it.

e4f4d20a78.alt: Blurred white dog walking away down a dirt track toward a house with a white gate and bamboo
e4f4d20a78.story: One last glimpse of the dog, its back turned, walking toward home in a cloud of soft focus. The fence posts line the way. The house with its pointed roof sits behind bamboo, the gate open just enough. Dogs on back tracks keep their own schedule, and this one has clearly finished its patrol.

598f40fca7.alt: Dark road at night lit by streetlamps, two dogs on a pedestrian crossing, red signs on a wooden post
598f40fca7.story: Down the hill the road curves into darkness, lit only by a pair of cold streetlamps. Two dogs stand on the zebra crossing, waiting, while red signs with white Thai lettering are nailed to a wooden post. A white railing gleams at the left. The scene has the stillness of a station between programmes, just signals and silence.

6cb4e7550b.alt: Night road curving under streetlights with dogs on a crossing, white railing and signs on a pole
6cb4e7550b.story: From a step to the left, the view tightens. The railing is sharper now, the signs on the post brighter, the dogs still loitering on the crossing as if it belongs to them. Streetlights glare white through the leaves. The road goes somewhere, but at this hour nobody is in a hurry to find out where.

9f0528d3dc.alt: White dog walking toward the viewer down an empty paved road at night, lit by a streetlamp
9f0528d3dc.story: A white dog trots down the middle of the empty road, coming straight toward the light. The lamp at the far end turns everything a cold blue-white. Fallen leaves scatter across the asphalt. Trees press in from both sides. The dog seems to be the only one with a reason to be out, and it knows exactly where it is heading.

a0dfe91ce5.alt: Bright white streetlamp glaring through dark leaves at night, power lines and a pole at the right
a0dfe91ce5.story: Looking up, the streetlamp has become a bright white bar, glaring through the leaves like a fluorescent tube in an empty studio. Power lines slant down to a dark pole. The leaves closest to the light glow green, the rest disappear into black. Moths are surely circling it, unseen at this distance.

cae46496bf.alt: Empty road at night under bright white streetlamps, dark trees lining both sides
cae46496bf.story: The road stretches away under a chain of white lamps, each one glaring hard enough to bleach the leaves around it. Nobody is walking. The centre line is dashed, then disappears into the far glow. Dark trees close in at the sides. It looks like the end of a broadcast day, picture still on, nobody watching.

adc05f12de.alt: Two men seen from behind walking down a night road under streetlamps, a white dog ahead
adc05f12de.story: Two figures walk away down the lit road, one with a backpack, one with a shirt in hand, a white dog trotting ahead of them. Their shadows stretch backward toward the viewer. Streetlamps glow at the far end, and a building rises pale behind the trees. The evening has turned into the walk home.

7e999aced8.alt: Narrow path at night beside a white balustrade, a single streetlamp shining among dark trees
7e999aced8.story: A single lamp burns white over a narrow path, its light falling on a balustrade and a sloping wall of leaves. The path bends away into darkness. Dry leaves gather in the corners. It is the kind of corner where a story would begin, but tonight nothing happens, which is its own small mercy.

c1da19718e.alt: Building with a lattice balcony and outdoor stairs lit by a bright streetlamp at night, leafy plants
c1da19718e.story: A tall streetlamp throws a blue-white cone over the side of a building, catching a lattice balcony and a set of steep stairs. Broad leaves crowd the bottom corner. Windows above are dark. The light is so bright it seems to hum, as if the whole scene is being broadcast from the lamp itself.

a9941f5a46.alt: Dark night scene with a single lit garage or room glowing white in the distance
a9941f5a46.story: Across a black yard, one room is lit, a white box glowing at the edge of the dark. Inside, a few shapes: a machine, a chair, a lamp burning hard. The rest of the world has gone to sleep. It looks like a small studio keeping the last show on air, long after the audience has gone home.

d85b05fa0e.alt: Distant field at night with parked cars and a covered shelter lit by a single lamp, dark trees around
d85b05fa0e.story: Far across a dark field, a lamp throws light over a cluster of parked cars and a long covered shelter. Trees rise black around the edges. Nothing moves. It could be any small gathering place on any night, but tonight it is the last thing visible before the sky closes completely over the day.

02a2e8a29d.alt: Gravel lane with a black-and-white dog walking ahead, a dark parked car at left and potted plants at right
02a2e8a29d.story: A gravel lane stretches between gardens, a dark car parked at the left, potted plants lined up on the right. Halfway down, a black-and-white dog walks toward the viewer with the confidence of a local. Trees close overhead. The light is soft, the shadows long, the hour quiet.

922afa0738.alt: Black-and-white dog approaching down a gravel lane past a parked car and potted plants
922afa0738.story: Still the dog comes on, closer now, its pace unchanged. The parked car is still there, the plants still in their pots. A palm frond hangs over the right side. It is a lane where everyone knows each other, the dog included, and a stranger with a camera is the most interesting event of the evening.

f17144a7ef.alt: Narrow dirt lane between a fenced concrete wall and thick green vegetation, a lamp post above
f17144a7ef.story: The paving gives up and the lane becomes two dirt tracks with grass between, running past a wall topped with wire fencing. A street lamp leans in from above. On the right, the jungle simply keeps going. A blue bucket sits by the roadside. This is where the back roads really start.

5fe883f1ee.alt: Paved lane curving through dense green trees and grass in soft late-afternoon light
5fe883f1ee.story: The paved lane curves gently into the trees and out of sight. Grass grows tall on both sides, the verges unmown. Banana leaves hang heavy at the right. The light is fading toward evening, and the road holds that late-afternoon softness that makes it feel like it leads somewhere better than it probably does.

9a84a6585c.alt: Black puppy in a striped shirt and red collar peering through the bars of an ornate iron gate
9a84a6585c.story: Behind a curling iron gate, a black puppy in a striped shirt and a red collar with a bell peers out, ears up, eyes worried. The tiled courtyard behind it is clean and empty. It is not sure whether the stranger outside is a friend or a threat, and so it has decided to stare until it finds out.

9ca7f65f1e.alt: Black puppy with red collar pushing its head between gate bars, front paws stretched under the bar
9ca7f65f1e.story: Decision made: the puppy shoves its head between the bars, mouth open, tongue showing, front paws stretched out under the gate as far as they will go. A white car is parked behind. All suspicion has dissolved into sheer greeting. The gate is the only thing between the puppy and its new best friend.

cd6c9b4a2d.alt: Empty paved road curving through thick green trees and roadside grass
cd6c9b4a2d.story: A wide bend in the road, empty, framed by tall trees and banks of uncut grass. The asphalt is patched and grey. A single power pole stands among the leaves. It is the kind of corner a car takes slowly, not because it is dangerous but because the evening feels like it deserves the pace.
