62edaaa752.story: Deeper in, the track narrows and the trees close ranks. Light still finds its way through, scattering bright coins across the dirt. A stack of wood sits by the right edge. The grove is quiet and warm. This is the second look at the same path, and it feels exactly like walking into it rather than standing at its edge.

08ea9cf724.alt: A long shade-net structure with a white plastic roof and dark mesh walls, surrounded by greenery.
08ea9cf724.story: Stretching across the frame, a shade house across the frame, its roof white and slightly sagging, its walls made of dark mesh. Strips of plastic hang loose here and there. Inside, the shadows suggest rows of something growing. Trees press in from behind and above. It looks like a building made of fog, half solid, half see-through, holding the light gently inside.

907d8c95c1.alt: A large tree base with thick spreading buttress roots, a chain-link fence and green hillside behind.
907d8c95c1.story: The tree's roots spread out like a skirt, great curved fins of wood gripping the ground. Fallen leaves gather in the gaps between them. Behind, a chain-link fence runs across the frame and a green hill glows in the sun. Another trunk leans in on the left. The roots look like they have been holding this patch of earth together for a very long time.

84df9b985b.alt: A young sapling with fern-like leaves on a grassy slope beside a dark, gnarled tree trunk.
84df9b985b.story: A young sapling stands on the slope, its fern-like leaves bright green and evenly spaced, like a drawing of a tree. Behind it, an old trunk twists darkly up into the canopy. Grass and fallen leaves cover the ground. A fence line shows faintly beyond. Old and new stand side by side in the same patch of light, neither paying the other much attention.

177b78d8f2.alt: Old concrete stairs climbing a slope toward a chain-link fence, a tree trunk at right and a green hill beyond.
177b78d8f2.story: Worn concrete steps climb toward a chain-link fence and stop there, with nowhere obvious left to go. Moss and leaves have settled in the corners. A tree trunk rises on the right, and beyond the fence a green hill catches the sun. The stairs must have led somewhere once. Now they lead up to a view, which might be the better destination.

e04bf24748.alt: A green football field with metal bleachers and a goal, seen through backlit trees beside a dirt path.
e04bf24748.story: A football pitch opens beyond the trees, its grass lit almost neon by the low sun. Metal bleachers sit empty at the edge, a white goal waiting further back. Floodlight poles rise along the perimeter, unlit. The dirt path in front curves into shade. No game today, or not yet. The field glows like a screen left on in an empty room.

3c09d90e2b.alt: Empty metal bleachers and a white goal on a sunlit football field, framed by tree trunks and branches.
3c09d90e2b.story: Moving along the path, the bleachers shift to the centre, rows of green metal benches with nobody on them. A goal stands behind, nets slack. Tree trunks frame the scene on both sides, branches drooping low. The light comes in long and sideways, laying stripes across the grass. Somewhere a whistle might blow later. For now, only the trees are watching.

360b356372.alt: A sloping bank of grass and roots beneath several big tree trunks, a red signboard partly hidden behind.
360b356372.story: The ground rises in a steep bank, roots knotting through the dry grass. Big trunks stand along the top, pale and twisting. Between them, a red signboard peeks out, its message turned away. Shadows fall in dark streaks down the slope. Leaves crowd the top of the frame. Everything here leans slightly, as if the hill is slowly settling under the weight of the trees.

b0219c5775.alt: A gravel road curving past slender trees and a lawn, a small blue bin at the left edge.
b0219c5775.story: A gravel road curves around a wide lawn dotted with slender, leaning trees. Their trunks twist in different directions, like dancers caught at the end of a song. A small blue bin stands at the left edge. A gazebo hides far back among the green. The light is soft and level. Nobody is walking here, but the road looks recently used.

530c130d70.alt: A white pergola with arches and columns among cypress trees and hedges, a broad tree trunk on the right.
530c130d70.story: White columns and arches appear through the trees, a pergola running along the edge of a lawn. Narrow cypress trees stand between the posts like guests waiting for an event. Hedges are clipped neatly. A thick trunk cuts down the right side of the frame. It feels a little out of place here, a slice of somewhere else set down carefully among tropical trees.

fc7552bfd1.alt: A curved white colonnade topped with flowers, cypress trees and a green lawn under spreading branches.
fc7552bfd1.story: The colonnade curves away to the right, its top edged with small pink flowers. Pointed cypresses line up in front of it. The lawn is bright and freshly trimmed. A parked car hides behind the columns. Overhead branches dip into the frame like a dark fringe. It looks like a wedding venue on the day after, tidy and quiet, the music already packed away.

4a2bd6c8d9.alt: A road sloping away past white columns, ornate lamp posts and green trees, hills and a tower in the distance.
4a2bd6c8d9.story: The edge of a white column fills the left side, cool and smooth. Beyond it, a road slopes downhill past ornate lamp posts and a strip of lawn. A small tower stands far off, and the hills behind are soft and blue. The light has dimmed into early evening. The road looks like it leads somewhere important, or used to.

e319d2cb5e.alt: A small white dog standing in a road beside a house with a wooden balcony, trees and hills behind.
e319d2cb5e.story: Facing away up the road, a small white dog stands, guarding nothing in particular. To the right, a house rises with a wooden balcony and a hand-painted sign. Neat hedges line the path. The hills beyond are hazy and green. The dog doesn't move. It has decided this spot is its post for the evening, and nobody argues.

bba6bed349.alt: A cluster of pink oleander flowers with narrow green leaves, background softly blurred.
bba6bed349.story: Pink flowers open in a loose cluster, five-petalled and slightly crumpled at the edges. Narrow leaves fan out around them like green blades. A few buds are still curled tight, waiting their turn. The background melts into soft greens. Under the evening light, the pink glows quietly, the brightest colour for some distance in any direction.

87c994dc92.alt: A paved path between tall grass and trees leading toward rust-red container buildings and a brick tower.
87c994dc92.story: A narrow path leads toward a cluster of rust-red containers and a tall brick tower, all half buried in greenery. Tall grass rises on the right, its tips catching light. Trees close in on the left. A shelter roof shows near the end. The scene has the look of a hidden compound, built for practice or training, now humming quietly in the early evening.

ac2913c5ed.alt: Red fire engines parked under an open-sided shelter, with steel posts in front and an emblem on a truck door.
ac2913c5ed.story: Under a long shelter, red fire engines wait in a row, their noses pointed out. One door carries a round emblem and letters partly hidden by a steel post. Beacons sit on the roof, dark for now. Dust lies on the concrete. They look patient, the way only emergency vehicles do: completely still, completely ready, and secretly hoping for a quiet night.

9df059bdc7.alt: A still green pond reflecting surrounding trees and bushes under a pale sky.
9df059bdc7.story: The pond lies flat and dark green, mirroring every tree on its far bank. Reeds rise along the edge, and a few bare branches poke up through the leaves. Power lines cross the pale sky at the top. The reflection is so clean that the bottom half looks like a second, slightly darker world. A single ripple would erase it, but none comes.

c436c581b3.alt: Round concrete tables and benches under large trees, a white dog and a pale building in the background.
c436c581b3.story: Concrete tables sit in a ring of trees, round and solid, their benches curving around them. A white dog rests near the building in the background, barely noticeable. The trunks are thick and weathered, shading the ground with patches of dark. Leaves cover everything. It is a place for gathering, eating, talking, but for now it hosts only the dog and the shade.

d8394c5255.alt: A paved road curving past a white cottage with a grey roof and white picket fence, trees and power poles around.
d8394c5255.story: Gently, the road bends past a white cottage with a grey roof. A picket fence runs along its front, and a hedge borders the turn. Power poles lean slightly, wires strung between them. Trees arch overhead. A bicycle leans against the wall. The light is low and even, the kind that makes everything look like an illustration in a children's book.

d6c947aab6.alt: A figure in a black T-shirt and grey shorts walks along a road past a white cottage with a picket fence.
d6c947aab6.story: A figure in a black T-shirt and grey shorts walks up the road, past the white cottage and its picket fence. Arms swing loosely; the pace is easy. An air-conditioning unit hums beside the wall. Trees lean over the path. It is the walk of someone who knows exactly where they are going, and is in no rush to arrive.

fdd2eec9ad.alt: Pale houses with wooden balconies and tiled roofs beside a hedge and stone wall, dense trees behind.
fdd2eec9ad.story: Two pale houses sit at different heights, one long and low with arched windows, the other taller with a wooden balcony. A neat hedge runs along a stone wall in front. Behind them, dense trees climb the hill. A light glows faintly on a post. The scene feels settled, lived in, a place where evenings run on the same quiet schedule.

989472e4e2.alt: A smooth pale palm trunk in front of dark leafy trees, a white building and garden visible through the gap.
989472e4e2.story: A smooth palm trunk splits the frame, pale against a backdrop of dark leaves. Through the gap, a white building and a small garden come into view, tiny and far away. Shrubs and grass fill the lower half. The light is fading into evening green. It is like looking through a keyhole into another scene, one that hasn't noticed it is being watched.

fa9172b6de.alt: A figure in dark clothes walks away along a curving paved road lined with greenery, a hill behind.
fa9172b6de.story: Curving away to the right, the road shows its centre line dashed white. A figure in a black T-shirt walks it alone, back turned, heading toward the hill. Bushes crowd the left side. Power lines cross a pale sky. The evening is settling in, and the walk has the steady rhythm of a routine: the same loop, the same hill, the same quiet end to the day.

e1d950bc68.alt: A narrow paved road with a yellow centre line running between grass and trees, a dog far ahead and a power pole.
e1d950bc68.story: The yellow centre line runs straight up the middle like a fuse. Far ahead, a dog stands on the road, a tiny dark mark against the grey. Power poles lean along the left edge, wires sagging toward the hills. Tall grass crowds both sides. The sky is pale and flat, and the road feels very long, as if it were stretched out especially for this evening.

d7e840f5df.alt: An orange Thai road-closed banner on a wooden stand across a road, a white dog beside it and a figure walking beyond.
d7e840f5df.story: An orange banner blocks the road, propped on a wooden frame. Its Thai letters announce that the way is closed and machinery is at work. A white dog stands beside it, unbothered by the warning. Beyond, a figure in black walks on regardless, past the bushes and the leaning poles. Rules for vehicles, it seems, are suggestions for pedestrians and dogs.

db01fd5c6e.alt: Mounds of freshly dug red earth beside broken white rubble and debris, with green trees behind.
db01fd5c6e.story: Fresh mounds of red earth rise behind a scatter of white rubble, broken boards and dry branches. Grass is already creeping over the edges of the dig. Behind, trees stand thick and green, untouched. The machinery from the banner must have been here. It has moved the earth, broken something down, and left the rest for the rain to decide.

6d9bb48a91.alt: A person in a black T-shirt walks along a shaded road toward an excavator and a roadside arch sign.
6d9bb48a91.story: Further along, the walker draws closer to the work site, where a yellow excavator idles in front of an arch sign over the road. Rounded shrubs line the grass on the left. Big trees close overhead. The walk continues at the same easy pace. The machine is still for the moment, its arm folded, as if waiting for its own shift to begin.

3a1069effd.alt: A wooden utility pole with a transformer box and looping cables against a pale sky, leaves around it.
3a1069effd.story: Up on the pole, a grey transformer box sits bolted in place, cables looping out of it in lazy curves. Leaves press in from behind. The sky is the colour of old paper. Every wire here is humming with something, though from the ground it looks completely still. It is the quiet machinery of the evening, invisible until you think to look up.

735b921ed1.alt: A collapsed concrete bridge slab sloping down into murky brown river water, dirt and debris on the bank.
735b921ed1.story: A concrete slab slants down into brown water, one end resting on the riverbed. It used to be a bridge, or part of one. Dry branches are caught against its side, and the bank in front is raw dirt, freshly moved. The water is still and opaque, giving nothing back. The break is clean, as if the bridge simply decided to lie down.

6b98b8be4f.alt: A broken concrete bridge deck tilting down over a stream, leading up to an orange barrier and buildings beyond.
6b98b8be4f.story: Seen end-on, the collapsed deck rises like a ramp toward the far bank, where an orange barrier blocks the way. Buildings stand beyond it, pale and untroubled. Trees crowd the banks on both sides. Thin metal rails run along the slab's edge. There's no crossing here now. The road on the other side waits for a bridge that will need rebuilding.

778f9bec14.alt: Concrete steps climbing a riverbank among trees and vines, with cables strung across the scene.
778f9bec14.story: Concrete steps climb the far bank between leaning trees, their railings rusted and thin. Cables stretch across the frame, sagging and crossing at odd angles. Grass sprouts thick at the waterline. A pale trunk curves in from the right. The stairs look old but sturdy, the only clear path up from the water, now that the bridge is gone.

7d51b11a1e.alt: A muddy brown stream with rocks and a pipe outlet below a stony bank, a pale tree trunk and dirt mound in front.
7d51b11a1e.story: The stream lies brown and flat beneath a bank of broken stone. A round pipe opens into the water, a few rocks sitting near its mouth. Roots spill down from the trees above. In front, a pale trunk and a heap of fresh dirt frame the view. A dark blur creeps in at the lower right, something close by, slightly in the way.

8c3869db46.alt: A brown stream with rocks and a pipe outlet below a stony bank, framed by a pale tree trunk and a dirt mound.
8c3869db46.story: One step sideways clears the view. Now the stream, the rocks, the pipe and the stony bank sit cleanly in the frame. A cable droops overhead, looping from tree to tree. The water hasn't moved. It looks slow and heavy, carrying silt from somewhere upstream. The mound in front waits to be smoothed, or washed away by the next storm.

09d09455da.alt: A cable over a stream draped with dried vines and debris, tangled roots below and green trees behind.
09d09455da.story: A cable stretches over the stream, and dried vines hang from it like a fringe, left behind by water that once rose that high. Tangled roots and branches lie heaped below. Green trees fill the rest of the frame. It is an easy detail to miss, but it marks the flood line clearly, a note left by the river about what it can do.

b00e03ef89.alt: A concrete wall with blue graffiti beside a weathered wooden arrow sign with Thai lettering, trees behind.
b00e03ef89.story: Blue graffiti sprawls across a concrete wall, bubble letters outlined in black, a date scrawled at the top. Next to it, a weathered wooden sign points left with a painted arrow and Thai lettering. Weeds grow at their feet. Behind, trees and a papaya plant fill the gap. Two kinds of message, side by side: one giving directions, one simply saying someone was here.

38629e4087.alt: The cracked windscreen of a Volvo excavator cab, with tree reflections and a yellow handrail at the side.
38629e4087.story: The excavator's windscreen is cracked in a long web, reflections of leaves scattered across the glass. A yellow handrail runs up the side. Inside, a seat and a few controls can just be seen through the dapple. The machine is silent now. The cracks catch the light like static across an old screen, the picture still there, just broken into pieces.

d40fc9af42.alt: A person in a black T-shirt walks away down a road lined with shrubs toward a white house under construction.
d40fc9af42.story: The walk goes on, past the work site and down a road lined with round shrubs. On the right, a white house with ornate details stands half wrapped in green netting, still being built. Poles march along the edge, wires slung between them. Hills rise behind. The walker doesn't look at the house. It's just another landmark on a familiar route.

7e326667ca.alt: A white dog standing on a road beside hedges and power poles, a barrier and a wooded hill beyond.
7e326667ca.story: Mid-road, a white dog stands looking up the slope where a barrier and a blue sign mark the work zone. Power poles line the right side, their wires criss-crossing. Hedges sit along the verge. The hill behind is thick with trees, gold-green in the last light. The dog seems to be waiting for permission that will never come.

fff01b08a4.alt: Two birds perched on diagonal power lines against a flat grey sky.
fff01b08a4.story: Two birds sit on the wires, far apart, each on its own line. The cables cut across the grey sky in four neat diagonals, like the lines of a staff with only two notes written on it. Nothing else is in the frame. One bird might fly any second. The other looks settled for the night. The tune stays unfinished.

35cb12624b.alt: A quiet road with a dashed centre line, power poles and wires, red-roofed houses and hills under a pale sky.
35cb12624b.story: Red-roofed houses cluster by the road, half hidden by trees. Power poles step along the left side, their wires drooping in long arcs. Tall grass grows on both verges. The hills are faint and blue in the distance. Evening light is fading toward grey. The road is empty, waiting for the next car, which might not come for a while.

73ee5e8d37.alt: A paved road with a yellow centre line between tall grass and trees, power poles leaning on the left.
73ee5e8d37.story: A little further on, the same road narrows between tall grass and a thick wall of trees. The yellow line keeps going. Power poles lean slightly, their cables gathering in a sagging bundle toward the hills. The sky is pale, almost cream. It feels like the end of a broadcast day, the last quiet stretch before everything goes dark.

32fe283d2b.alt: An unfinished building with open window frames, a grey tiled roof and scaffolding, surrounded by tall grass and leaves.
32fe283d2b.story: Behind a curtain of leaves, an unfinished building stands with its window frames empty, the hills visible straight through them. The grey roof is complete, but scaffolding still clings to one side. Tall grass grows right up to the walls. It is a house made of open doorways, letting the evening wander in and out wherever it likes.

dd4ced9877.alt: A white ornate garden bench among white pedestal urns planted with succulents, small swan figures and a lamp.
dd4ced9877.story: Curls of white wrought iron form a bench in the grass, its back a lace of scrolls and leaves. Around it, white urns rise on pedestals, each crowned with spiky plants. Two small swan figures guard the lamp post. Red-leaved shrubs glow behind. The whole garden looks arranged for a portrait, every piece set just so, waiting for someone to come and sit.

eaad572d20.alt: A metal water tower standing among green fields and trees, with a forested hillside rising behind.
eaad572d20.story: A water tower stands alone in the valley, a pale tank on thin metal legs. Around it, fields roll in shades of pale and deep green. Behind, the hillside is covered in trees packed so closely they look like fur. Two small poles rise in the foreground. The tower looks like a lookout from an old film, keeping watch over nothing urgent.

d103c47f6e.alt: A forested slope with a road and guardrail cutting across it, power poles and a grassy field above.
d103c47f6e.story: A road cuts a thin pale line across the hillside, its guardrail glinting faintly. Power poles stand tall above the trees, wires strung between them. Higher up, a field opens out, smooth and green. Below, the forest is thick and bumpy. There's no traffic. The road looks like a seam stitched across the landscape, holding two halves of the hill together.

053dc18d14.alt: A thatched-roof hut seen from above among trees and grass, with a wooden bench and scattered items around it.
053dc18d14.story: Looking straight down the slope, a thatched hut sits among the trees, its roof a shaggy brown square. Underneath, the shade hides chairs, buckets, a strip of blue tarp. A wooden bench stands outside. Paths are worn into the grass around it. It looks like the kind of place where someone naps in the afternoon heat and nobody minds.

2375d6f1ac.alt: A concrete path curving down a grassy slope past tall trees and shrubs, a mountain rising in the distance.
2375d6f1ac.story: Concrete and narrow, a path winds down the hillside past tall trees and clumps of shrubs. A blue tent peeks out from the greenery halfway down. Off to the left, a mountain rises in a long, soft shape. The light is warm and directional, bringing out every blade of grass. The path promises something at the bottom, though the bend hides exactly what.

b1bcdab037.alt: A green valley of fields and forest below a cloudy sky, a lawn with white garden statues in the foreground.
b1bcdab037.story: The valley opens wider now. Rows of crops stretch toward a line of hills that fade blue under the clouds. In the foreground, a round lawn holds a little gathering of white statues, gathered in a circle as if mid-conversation. Shadows from the clouds drift slowly across the fields. The whole scene feels like a painting waiting for its final coat.

911e352716.alt: A bright, hazy view over green fields and forest with a lawn, benches and a flower bed in the foreground.
911e352716.story: Haze has bleached the sky almost white, washing the view in bright haze. Fields roll out in neat green rows, separated by dark lines of trees. Below, the lawn curves round with a few benches and a flower bed edged in orange. The air looks thick with moisture. Rain might arrive soon, or might just keep threatening, as it often does.

055ad64759.alt: The edge of a building's terrace with railing and lights at left, overlooking hazy green fields and forest.
055ad64759.story: The dark edge of a terrace juts into the frame from the left, its roof and lights black against the pale sky. Beyond it, fields and forest slide downhill into haze. A railing runs along the balcony. The view is the same as before, but now there's a hint of where it's seen from: a high, open room built for exactly this.

d8d2f6b826.alt: A blurred close-up of small fern-like sprigs and a twisted stalk, with soft pink and white shapes behind.
d8d2f6b826.story: Everything slips out of focus except a few tiny fern-like sprigs and a twisted stalk rising through them. Behind, soft shapes of pink and white glow like bulbs seen through a fogged window. It's hard to say what they are. The frame feels like a channel caught between stations, colour and shape without a clear picture, strangely pleasant to look at.

f3218a5a05.alt: A hazy panorama of green fields and forest under a white sky, with a curved lawn and benches below.
f3218a5a05.story: Back to the wide view. The sky has turned fully white, and the hills have melted into soft grey outlines. Fields still roll green below, and the lawn holds its benches and flower beds in a quiet curve. A lamp post stands at the edge. The haze makes the distance seem much farther than it is, as if the valley keeps going forever.

4c2a92a8ee.alt: Pink trumpet-shaped flowers and buds on a leafy stem, with blurred green fields in the background.
4c2a92a8ee.story: Pink trumpet flowers hang from a leafy stem, one fully open, others still curled into buds. The petals look soft and slightly crumpled, like paper. Behind them, the valley blurs into green bands. The stem leans out over the slope as if trying to see the view for itself. The colour is warm and sudden against all that green.

c0ce3dedbb.alt: A field of young corn with grass tips in the foreground, trees and hazy mountains beyond under a cloudy sky.
c0ce3dedbb.story: Tall grass tips brush the bottom of the frame, rusty and pink. Beyond them, a field of young corn stretches downhill in a sea of green leaves. Trees mark the far edge, and mountains rise faint and blue behind. The clouds hang low and grey. A wind ripples through the corn, the only sound for a long way.

6904dd1390.alt: Soft pink grass plumes glowing in backlight, a palm trunk and fronds against a bright sky.
6904dd1390.story: Pink grass plumes catch the low sun and glow like candyfloss. Behind them, a palm trunk rises, its fronds spraying out against the bright sky. The light pours in from the top right, turning everything soft and warm. The hills fade into a pale haze. Late afternoon has found its best hour, and the grass is making the most of it.

6417dc60ea.alt: A white two-storey house with a roofed terrace on top, sitting on a grassy slope with steps and plants.
6417dc60ea.story: Up the slope stands a white house, its top floor an open terrace under a broad dark roof. Steps climb the bank beside it, lined with young plants. A small red figure stands in the grass. The sky is pale blue with scattered clouds. From down here, the terrace looks like the bridge of a ship, steady above a green sea.

cf749a171d.alt: A white house with an open roof terrace on a planted slope, a white deer figure on the lawn in front.
cf749a171d.story: Stepping back, the house settles into the full scene: the terraced slope, the rows of plants, the steps leading up. A white deer figure stands on the lawn at the right edge, frozen mid-step. Lights hang from the terrace roof, still unlit. The evening is close now. Soon those bulbs will switch on, and the house will glow like a lantern on the hill.

31fbf8a390.alt: A bush of bright yellow trumpet flowers with slender green leaves against a soft, dark blurred background.
31fbf8a390.story: Yellow flowers scatter across the bush like coins thrown into the leaves. Some face outward, open and bright; others hang half-closed. The background melts into dark greens and pale blurs of trunks. From a distance, the colour pops out of the shade like a lamp left on. Up close, each bloom looks slightly crumpled, already halfway through its short day.

ebde0dcf8f.alt: Close portrait of a tan dog with upright ears, mouth open and tongue out, against a blurred wall.
ebde0dcf8f.story: A tan dog looks almost straight ahead, ears up, tongue hanging out in a lopsided grin. The collar sits snug around a thick neck of fur. Behind, a wall blurs into soft bands of brown and cream. The eyes are half closed, relaxed, as if the evening warmth has made everything easy. This is a dog that has decided the visitor is acceptable.

fc781aed66.alt: The same tan dog facing forward with ears spread wide and tongue out, wall blurred behind.
fc781aed66.story: Squaring up, the dog faces directly ahead, ears spread wide like a pair of satellite dishes tuning in. The tongue is still out, the grin wider. Whiskers catch the soft light. The blurred wall behind gives the whole thing the feel of a studio portrait. The dog seems to know it, and holds the pose with real professionalism.

bf21ef6e3b.alt: A tan dog with large pointed ears looks forward, tongue showing, a collar around its neck.
bf21ef6e3b.story: One more frame, and the head tilts a fraction to the left. The ears stay up and alert, the tongue a little pinker in the light. The eyes look past the lens, already distracted by something behind it, a sound, a smell, a person with food. The portrait session is ending. The dog is ready for whatever comes next.

f77c7c4aa8.alt: Drooping sprays of small purple flowers and green leaves hanging over a blurred garden.
f77c7c4aa8.story: Long thin branches hang down in a soft curtain, dotted with clusters of tiny purple flowers. The leaves are small and pale green. Behind them, the garden goes out of focus into creamy shapes. It looks like the branches are slowly raining flowers onto the ground. A breeze would set them swinging. For now, they drape perfectly still.

d2ed869ed2.alt: A cluster of white frangipani flowers and buds among broad glossy green leaves.
d2ed869ed2.story: White blossoms open at the tip of a branch, ringed by broad, glossy leaves that fan out in every direction. A few buds wait below, tightly closed. The leaves are dark and long, almost leathery. The flowers glow against them like a little lamp. Their scent would be strongest after sunset, which isn't very far away.

45636d4d02.alt: A small white cherub statue with wings blowing a trumpet, against a blurred garden background.
45636d4d02.story: A stone cherub raises a trumpet to its lips, wings folded neatly behind, cheeks puffed with effort. It has been playing the same silent note for years. The garden behind blurs into brown and green, out of focus. The statue's surface is slightly weathered, softened by rain. It is announcing something important, though nobody has worked out quite what.

882154683e.alt: A rider in an orange shirt on a scooter heading away down a tree-lined lane past a blue barrel.
882154683e.story: A rider in an orange shirt heads away down the lane, the scooter wobbling slightly over the patched surface. Banana plants hang ragged on the left. A blue barrel stands beside a pole on the right. Dry leaves lie scattered across the ground. The engine noise fades within seconds, and the lane slips back into its usual afternoon quiet.

6ec7ca6c68.alt: An empty paved lane curving between banana plants and bushes, a blue barrel beside a pole.
6ec7ca6c68.story: Empty again, half a minute later. Only the banana plants, the blue barrel and the scattered leaves remain where the scooter passed. The grass on the far bank glows faintly in the low light. Nothing seems to have changed, but something has gone, and the space it left is still visible for a moment in the stillness of the road.

12e7b33fdf.alt: A white dog with brown ears and a black patch, mouth open in a relaxed expression, a fence blurred behind.
12e7b33fdf.story: Tan ears, white coat, head up: a dog lies, mouth open in what looks like a laugh. A black patch spreads across its side. The fence behind dissolves into soft lines. Its eyes squint slightly against the light. Whatever joke it heard, it seems to be enjoying it in full. The tongue lolls, the ears flop, everything says relaxed.

ab2bb20bfa.alt: Several thin strands of pale dried seed pods hanging down against a dark blurred background.
ab2bb20bfa.story: Three thin strands hang in the dark, each lined with pale little pods like beads on a string. Light catches them from the side so they glow against the shadows. The background is black and green and completely blurred. They sway, just slightly. It is a small, strange thing to notice, like a frame of interference holding still on an empty channel.

346d3081f1.alt: A shrub covered in small white flowers beside a cracked and patched lane, trees and grass behind.
346d3081f1.story: A shrub spills tiny white flowers over the edge of the lane, its branches arching outward. The road beside it is cracked and patched, pale concrete showing through the old asphalt. Grass grows in the gaps. The light is low and soft. The lane looks forgotten by everyone except the plants, which have been steadily reclaiming it, flower by flower.

853a8b3e84.alt: A white dog trotting toward the viewer along a patched lane, bushes and a blue barrel in the background.
853a8b3e84.story: Far down the lane, a small white dog appears, trotting steadily forward, tail curled high. Bushes line the edges, and the blue barrel stands in its usual place. Dry leaves cover the verge. The dog hasn't noticed anyone yet. It is simply coming home along its usual route, as it presumably does every day at this hour.

fe8dbf9585.alt: A white dog with a curled tail walking along a gravel lane toward the viewer, bushes blurred at the side.
fe8dbf9585.story: Still the dog keeps coming, tail up, head slightly lowered. Its paws pick neatly across the gravel. A dark blur sits at the left edge, something close and out of focus. The lane is pale and cracked. The dog's eyes are fixed ahead. It has definitely noticed something now, and is weighing whether to be curious or cautious.

31f97c7b78.alt: A white dog with a black ear and tongue out walking across a gravel lane, tail raised.
31f97c7b78.story: Close enough now to see the black ear and the pink tongue. The dog walks with a slightly sideways gait, tail still raised like a flag. Tufts of grass dot the gravel. The dark blur at the edge is still there. The dog doesn't stop. It glances over once, decides there's no threat, and continues on its way.

e497a3f4d1.alt: An empty lane between banana plants and dense trees, a blue barrel and tall grass at the side.
e497a3f4d1.story: Empty lane again. Banana leaves hang heavy and ragged in the foreground. Tall trees rise on the right, and the blue barrel waits beside a pole. Grass grows thick along the bank. For a moment there's nothing to watch but the leaves moving slowly in the warm air, and the faint sound of an engine somewhere approaching.

59e94de759.alt: A carved figure holding a bowl, standing against a tree trunk beside a clay jar decorated with elephants.
59e94de759.story: A carved figure stands against a tree trunk, hands cupped around a small bowl, face calm and downcast. Beside it, a big clay jar shows a row of elephants in relief around its belly. Ferns spill in from the left. Everything is the colour of earth and dust. The figure has been offering that bowl for a long time, patient as the tree behind it.

9662ab93e0.alt: Close view of the tail light and HR-V badge on a silver car, a blurred grey shape in the foreground.
9662ab93e0.story: The back of a silver car fills the frame, its tail light glowing red and white, the badge reading HR-V in neat chrome letters. Something grey and blurred sits in the foreground, too close to make out. The morning light is clear and bright. It feels like a detail from a car advert, only without the music and the voice-over.

d142762881.alt: The same silver car's tail light and badge, slightly tighter, with a blurred grey shape in front.
d142762881.story: Ten seconds later, the frame shifts a little tighter. The tail light's red stripes and white reflector fill more of the frame. The blurred grey shape in front swells closer. The badge is half hidden now. Two almost identical frames, like a programme rerun with one angle changed. The car hasn't moved; it's parked, waiting for its driver.

3d77b4636d.alt: Blue roadside signs in Thai and English pointing to a police station, beside a no-right-turn sign and a palm trunk.
3d77b4636d.story: Blue signs crowd a corner, white Thai lettering pointing left with arrows. One sign adds two English words: POLICE STATION. A red no-right-turn sign stands nearby, and a striped traffic post. A palm trunk leans in from the right. Parked motorbikes and cars sit blurred behind. It is a busy little crossroads of directions, all insisting on their own way.

0eefc88161.alt: A white metal crowd barrier with rusted bars, in front of a dark folding metal gate.
0eefc88161.story: Rust streaks run down a white metal barrier that leans against a shuttered gate. The paint has chipped away at the joints, revealing orange underneath. Behind it, the folding gate makes a dark grid of vertical lines. It's been used to block something, many times, and will probably be used again. For now, it just leans, waiting for the next crowd.

7be92333b4.alt: A spiked iron gate with gold tips, white globe lamps on pillars and a blue house number plate reading 359.
7be92333b4.story: Iron spikes rise from the top of the gate, gold-tipped and slightly rusted, like a row of quills. White globe lamps sit on the pillars, unlit in the morning sun. A small blue plate on the gate reads 359. Diamond shapes decorate the bars below. The whole gate looks dressed up for an occasion, sharp and formal and faintly theatrical.

a706763970.alt: A dark car driving away along a quiet road lined with trimmed hedges, bougainvillea and power poles.
a706763970.story: A dark car drives away along a quiet road, hedges trimmed into round green lumps on both sides. Bougainvillea spills pink over the trees behind. Power poles lean along the right. The road curves gently uphill toward a line of trees. It's mid-morning, and the light is clean. The car will vanish over the rise in a few seconds.

fa0d8131a3.alt: A dark car further along a hedge-lined road climbing toward trees, a road sign and power poles at the sides.
fa0d8131a3.story: Moments later, the dark car has climbed further up the road, smaller now between the rounded hedges. A sign stands on the left verge; poles lean on the right. Bougainvillea glows pink at the top of the rise. The road is clean and empty behind it. It is the second beat of a very short scene: arrival, departure, and now nearly gone.

87e1422430.alt: A low concrete bridge railing with yellow and black posts beside a road edge strewn with dry leaves.
87e1422430.story: A low bridge railing runs along the road, its posts painted in fading yellow and black bands. Dry leaves have gathered in a neat line along the kerb, swept there by wind or tyres. Dense trees crowd behind the rails. A wooden structure peeks out at the top. The road bends away to the right. It is an ordinary crossing that most people drive over without noticing.

61fbdb6717.alt: Pink papery bougainvillea flowers among green leaves in bright sun, with a soft blurred background.
61fbdb6717.story: Pink bracts open among the leaves, thin and papery, almost see-through where the sun strikes them. Some of the leaves are pale, nearly white in the glare. The background turns to warm brown blur. The plant looks dry and a little dusty, yet it keeps flowering. Bougainvillea seems to like a hard climate, the brighter the better.

e6d49d8e7b.alt: A close view of pink bougainvillea flowers and pale green leaves along the top of a hedge, background blurred.
e6d49d8e7b.story: Lower down, the hedge-top comes into focus as a ridge of leaves with pink flowers poking up like little flags. The sunlight is harsh and white. Shadows sit deep inside the branches. Behind, the blur turns greenish at the top. It's the same plant, the same moment, seen once more from a slightly different height.

5f1138ada0.alt: A blue Imarflex desk fan with a round grille in front of a pale wall and window frame.
5f1138ada0.story: Plastic and bright blue, a fan sits in front of a pale window, its round grille spiralling toward a centre badge reading imarflex. It isn't running; the blades sit visible behind the cage. Afternoon light filters through frosted glass behind it. On hot days, this is the most important object in the room. Right now it waits, switched off, for the next wave of heat.

99b8c7d81e.alt: A painted eagle statue with half-spread wings and a white head, against a blurred green background.
99b8c7d81e.story: A painted eagle perches against a green blur, wings half raised, white head turned sharply to the side. Its feathers are carved in neat rows of grey and black. The yellow beak hooks down. It looks ready to launch, but it has been ready for years. The garden behind hums with insects that pay it no attention at all.

19956f3cf2.alt: A large shrub covered in small yellow flowers, with darker green leaves at the left edge.
19956f3cf2.story: Yellow has erupted across a shrub, hundreds of small blooms scattered across its green. Darker leaves crowd in from the left, shaded and out of focus. The light is high and strong, mid-afternoon. Bees are probably working the flowers, though too small to see. It is a burst of colour that feels almost loud, like a channel turned up too far.

9fa8ba861b.alt: A yellow artificial sunflower held between dark carved wooden branches against a bright pale background.
9fa8ba861b.story: A yellow sunflower sits wedged between dark carved branches, its petals a little stiff, a little too perfect. It's artificial, or very nearly. The wood around it curves like antlers, rough and almost black. Behind, the sky is a white glare. It is a strange little arrangement: something fake and bright held tightly by something real and dark.

e3beadc8f8.alt: A spiky plant with spotted leaves in a white carved pot, a small eagle figurine perched above on a wooden ledge.
e3beadc8f8.story: A spiky plant fans out of a white carved pot, its leaves streaked with pale spots. Above it, a small eagle figurine perches on the ledge, brown wings and white head. Wooden beams frame the scene, weathered and grey. The eagle seems to be guarding the plant, or maybe just enjoying the view from the top of the balcony.

d87fa65b2a.alt: A small eagle figurine on a wooden ledge in front of a rough carved wall, spiky leaves below.
d87fa65b2a.story: From further off, the eagle stands taller in the frame, perched on a wooden ledge in front of a rough, rust-coloured wall. The spiky leaves of the plant poke up from below. A decorative carving shows on the right edge, painted in faded blue and cream. The eagle's head is turned, watching the street, small but serious about its duty.

5a979f8760.alt: Blurred dark roof tiles on the left, with green leafy sprigs and fine strands in the foreground on the right.
5a979f8760.story: Dark roof tiles slope across the left side, soft and blurred, their ridges catching a little light. On the right, green sprigs push into the frame, leaves fanned out, a few fine dry strands curling among them. The sun picks out the edges of each leaf. It's the corner of a roof where a plant has found its own space to grow.

c7b556b144.alt: A red satellite dish with a white true logo and a black receiver arm, a dark leaf at the right edge.
c7b556b144.story: A red satellite dish faces the sky, the word true printed on a white patch at the top. A black arm reaches across it, holding the receiver with a tangle of cables. A dark leaf slices in from the right. Somewhere, a signal is landing on this dish, carrying channels into a living room below. The dish catches it quietly, all day and night.

fa37ddf811.alt: The dark silhouette of a pine tree top against a flat grey-lavender sky.
fa37ddf811.story: The top of a pine tree rises in a dark silhouette against a flat lavender-grey sky, its branches stacked in neat layers like a paper cut-out. Nothing else is in the frame. No wind, no birds. The shape is almost too perfect, like the test pattern of a tree, broadcast at dusk when the colour drains from everything.

09aa8ac0e3.alt: A white dog with a black ear and tongue out walking down a gravel road, tail curled up.
09aa8ac0e3.story: Back on patrol, the white dog with the black ear pads down the gravel with its tongue hanging out. The tail curls high over its back. Grass and dark debris line the edge of the road. It walks with the comfortable swagger of an animal that owns the street, and it has clearly been out patrolling since morning.

1d9be65211.alt: A black dog on a chain sits behind a dark post, mouth open, in front of a pale wall and window.
1d9be65211.story: A black dog sits behind a dark post, chain trailing from its collar. Its mouth hangs open, ears flopped, eyes fixed on something just outside the frame. The wall behind is pale and plain. It's not barking, not yet. It's working up to it, gathering breath and opinion. The chain lies slack for now on the floor.

18ff0e2465.alt: A black dog with its head raised and mouth wide open, barking, with a collar and chain clip.
18ff0e2465.story: And there it is: the dog lifts its head and lets the bark go, mouth wide, teeth showing, ears flying outward. The collar clip swings. The wall behind is pale and still. The sound must be huge, filling the whole street, though here it is only a frozen shape. The neighbours, presumably, have long since stopped reacting.

edd9ec7a86.alt: A black dog in a collar seen from the side, mouth open mid-bark, against a pale blurred background.
edd9ec7a86.story: Turning sideways now, the dog keeps up the commentary, mouth open, tongue curled. The collar sits loose on its neck, the metal clip glinting. Its eyes are bright and focused on something to the right. The pale wall behind fades to grey. It isn't angry, exactly. It just has a lot to say, and the afternoon is long.

d6d133e5d6.alt: A row of thin pale tree trunks with sparse leaves standing in front of a dense, dark green forest.
d6d133e5d6.story: Thin trunks rise in a pale row, their branches sparse and spidery, a few small leaves clinging near the tops. Behind them, the forest is dense and dark. The light is soft and even, the colour drained toward grey-green. It looks like the edge of a woodland after a long dry season, waiting for the rain to restart everything.

855ebbf970.alt: A red fire truck parked beside a rusted shipping container on a dirt track under large trees
855ebbf970.story: The fire truck has pulled up beside a rust-brown container as if the two had arranged to meet here. Its doors are shut, its lamps unlit. Under the arching trees the dirt track runs back toward a pale building, and a shelf of red equipment stands alone on the left. Evening is coming in slowly, and nothing on this road seems in any hurry to be anywhere else.

ade6cdaa5e.alt: The corner of a weathered blue shipping container with partial white lettering, tall grass and trees beyond
ade6cdaa5e.story: Only the edge of the container makes it into the frame, a slab of faded blue with an orange cross and half a word in white: XINF, then nothing. The rest of the name has drifted off to the right, out of reach. Tall grass leans against the steel. The trees above are flecked with small orange blooms, and the light is soft enough to make the rust look almost warm.

510ab991d1.alt: Rear of a red fire truck with ladders and emblem panels, an old wrecked car parked in the grass beside it
510ab991d1.story: Two vehicles share the lawn: a red fire truck with its ladders folded and its emblems polished, and beside it the shell of an old car, roof caved, windows gone dark. One is waiting for a call. The other stopped waiting long ago. Behind them, under a tangle of pipes and branches, the evening collects in brown shadow. The grass between them has not been cut for a while.

dcaaffafc0.alt: Close view through rusty orange railings of a metal stair underside, a grey shape resting on a platform
dcaaffafc0.story: Through the bars of a rusted railing, the underside of a staircase cuts across the frame at a hard angle. Everything is orange: the rails, the steps, the platform with its peeling edge. Out in the middle sits a small grey shape, curled and still, hard to read at first. The background has dissolved into green haze. It is twenty past six, and something here is having a nap.

e93d758feb.alt: Rusty orange stair and railings with a small grey animal curled asleep on the metal platform
e93d758feb.story: Five seconds later, nothing has moved. The grey shape on the platform is still curled under the slant of the stairs, tucked between rust and air. A railing post blurs past in the foreground like a finger across a lens. The scene holds its breath the way late-night channels sometimes do, a still image left running while everyone waits for the program to resume.

4554287cf5.alt: A grey tabby cat lies on a rusty platform under a metal staircase, framed by blurred orange railings
4554287cf5.story: The shape has a face now. A grey tabby lies on the platform beneath the staircase, head lifted, ears up, looking out through the gap in the railings. Rust frames it on every side like a set built for exactly one actor. The trees behind have melted into green fog. It does not look alarmed. It looks like it has been expecting someone.

d320503b14.alt: Grey tabby cat on a rusted metal platform staring forward between blurred orange railings
d320503b14.story: Six seconds on, the cat has turned to face forward, eyes level and patient. It lies with its paws tucked under, a small grey loaf on a warm orange shelf. One railing post sits right across the corner of the frame, slightly out of focus, as though the view is being peeked at through a fence. The evening air is still. Even the leaves in the distance are holding position.

10e1f1c6e5.alt: Grey tabby cat resting on a rusty platform beneath a slanted staircase, looking straight ahead
10e1f1c6e5.story: Another seven seconds. The stare has not wavered. Framed by a slanted beam above and a rusted ledge below, the tabby keeps its watch over the yard as if this platform were a booth and it were the only one on shift. A faint breeze lifts the fur on its back. Somewhere out of frame a dog barks once and is ignored.

fb533a031f.alt: A man with a shaved head reaches toward a tabby cat on a rusty platform under a metal staircase
fb533a031f.story: Someone has climbed up to meet it. Seen from behind, a man in a black T-shirt leans in under the staircase and offers an open hand. The tabby steps forward, tail raised, nose dipping toward his fingers. Between them a railing post blurs the frame. For a moment the whole rusted structure seems to exist only to hold this greeting off the ground.

bf2a09610c.alt: A man seen from behind sits on a rusty platform, arm outstretched, a tabby cat pressed against his side
bf2a09610c.story: Eighteen seconds later the introductions are over. The man sits with his back to the yard, one arm thrown wide along the ledge, a watch catching the dull light at his wrist. The tabby has moved in close, almost hidden behind his shoulder, leaning on him like an old acquaintance. The orange railings box them in. Neither seems in a hurry to climb down.

3d7827704e.alt: A black and tan dog stands on dry leaf-covered ground, tail up, looking toward the viewer
3d7827704e.story: Down on the ground a black dog with tan legs plants itself in the leaf litter, tail up like an antenna. It has a crooked, half-open grin and one ear folded wrong. The dirt around it is scattered with brown leaves and small twigs. It looks over with total confidence, the way a dog looks at a visitor it has already decided to allow, provisionally, for now.

225f9403ea.alt: A black and tan dog with a curled tail stands on dry leaves, head turned toward the viewer
225f9403ea.story: Half a minute on, the dog has squared its body and turned its head, as though posing for an official portrait of the yard's security staff. The curled tail stays high. Reddish earth spreads out behind it, freckled with leaves. Its ears are up, its mouth now closed. Evening light flattens everything to the same warm brown, except the dog, which stays stubbornly black.

6dfd6f9d4f.alt: A tan dog stands on a gravel path near a tree trunk, a black dog walks behind, another dark dog blurred in front
6dfd6f9d4f.story: The pack reveals itself. A lean tan dog stands on the gravel by a tree, tail curved high, staring straight across. Farther back, a small black one trots along the path past a blue barrel. And in the foreground, a dark blur slides through the bottom of the frame, too close and too quick to be anything but a shape. Three dogs, three speeds, one dusty yard.

10d77f841e.alt: Close crop of a person's side in a black T-shirt and dark shorts against a pink wall, arm at their side
10d77f841e.story: Faced with a pink wall, the long lens finds only fragments: the hem of a black T-shirt, dark shorts, an arm resting loose at the side. No face, no feet, just a torso standing against flat coral paint. It looks like a costume test, or a frame from a broadcast where the camera operator has wandered too close and nobody has called cut.

737273dc79.alt: Tight crop of a person's torso in black shirt and shorts standing beside a soft pink wall
737273dc79.story: Three seconds later the same figure has shifted left, so more of the pink wall gets the screen. The black shirt and shorts are almost one piece now, a dark block against the coral. A hand slides toward a pocket. The wall is the real subject, maybe: smooth, warm, a little uneven, glowing the way painted walls do in the last half hour of daylight.

c72bc4db54.alt: Concrete picnic table and benches on dirt ground, an old wooden table and metal rack behind
c72bc4db54.story: A concrete table and four concrete benches sit in the dirt, painted white long ago and now chalky. The table's base has a round hole cut through it, like a porthole. Behind them stands a heavier wooden table with a tyre lying on top, and a metal rack, and a pale wall. It looks like a meeting has just ended, or will start the moment someone sits down.

8bdb684e6e.alt: Two green gas cylinders inside a fenced wire cage under a small roof, grass and a fence line nearby
8bdb684e6e.story: Inside a little cage of chain-link and rusted pipe, two green gas cylinders lean together, one upright, one tipped at an angle. A tin roof shades them from nothing much. Beside the cage, long grass has grown wild along a fence of thin posts that runs off toward the trees. The cylinders have the look of two figures waiting for a bus that stopped running years ago.

d2c9bd643f.alt: Wire cage with green gas cylinders under a slanted roof, tall grass and a post fence to the right
d2c9bd643f.story: Thirteen seconds later the view drifts right, letting the cage slip to the left edge. Now the tall grass and the fence posts have more of the frame, receding into a green blur of trees. The gas cylinders are still leaning on each other inside their wire room. The evening holds that flat grey-green tone that comes just before the colour drains out entirely.

c92fb126dc.alt: Almost entirely out-of-focus dark green foliage with pale bright patches of sky between leaves
c92fb126dc.story: Everything has gone soft. Dark leaves become blobs, and the sky between them turns into pale circles floating in green. Nothing is sharp enough to name. It looks like the screen between stations, when the signal is almost there and shapes keep forming and dissolving. Then focus will snap in and it will be a tree again, ordinary and leafy. For now it is weather.

566a9aebe1.alt: Dense tree branches and green leaves against a pale sky, a dark tangle of twigs near the centre
566a9aebe1.story: Focus has come back. The branches resolve into a web of thin limbs and broad green leaves, backlit by a white sky. Near the middle sits a darker knot of twigs, dense and round, the kind of shape that makes you look twice. Half past six, and the light is going grey. The leaves barely move. Whatever lives in that tangle is keeping quiet.

930cd7cb45.alt: A thin crescent moon low in a dusky blue sky
930cd7cb45.story: By twenty to seven the trees are gone and the lens points up. A thin crescent hangs in a plain blue-grey sky, bright on its lower edge, the rest of the disc invisible. There is nothing else in the frame, no branches, no wires, no birds. After an evening of rust and dogs and gas cylinders, the day ends on one clean curve of light, like a station sign-off.

5e924a0697.alt: Empty outdoor playground with a yellow tube slide, red canopies and wooden posts under shady trees
5e924a0697.story: Nobody is on the playground. A fat yellow tube slide coils out of a tower, red scalloped canopies hang overhead like party hats, and a round porthole window looks out at nothing. Big trees keep the whole structure in shade. It is a quarter to four on a hot afternoon, and the equipment seems to be resting, saving its colours for whoever arrives first.

e0661da387.alt: Playground climbing frame with blue and red poles, a red slide, hanging rings and a spring seesaw on sand
e0661da387.story: Swing a little left: a different angle on the same quiet. Blue poles, a red slide, a row of gymnastic rings hanging perfectly still from a bar. In front, a little red spring seesaw waits on the sand for two riders. Patches of sun fall through the leaves onto the ground. Somewhere nearby there must be noise, voices, a vendor, but none of it reaches this frame.

4e5f58a7f4.alt: A person in black studies a large yellow illustrated zoo map board with routes, icons and a legend
4e5f58a7f4.story: A figure in black stands close to a huge yellow map, nose almost to the board, tracing a route with their eyes. The map is a cartoon world of winding blue paths, tiny animals and numbered stops, with a legend down the left for toilets, food and parking. Opening hours are printed at the bottom. Everything a visitor needs is here, if they can find the dot that says start.

93177ca930.alt: A paved road curves through tall palms and trees, a distant cart and a person on a bike, a large boulder in front
93177ca930.story: The road dips and curves away between palms and leaning trunks, a grey ribbon disappearing into green. Far down it, a cart and a lone cyclist are small as toy pieces. A large boulder sits at the roadside in the foreground, unbothered. At five to five the shade has deepened into something almost cool, and the whole avenue feels like a tunnel leading somewhere unhurried.

83dc47e263.alt: Three monkeys sit together on a paved walkway, a man with a shoulder bag standing nearby, a parked motorbike
83dc47e263.story: Three monkeys have taken a seat in the middle of the brick walkway, huddled together like a committee. A man with a shoulder bag stands a few steps off, watching them watch nothing in particular. A scooter is parked by the steps behind. Nobody is sure who has right of way here. The monkeys, at least, look as if they have already decided.

2b3686e7a5.alt: Seaside promenade with a white balustrade, an orange-roofed pavilion and a tall lamp post under clear sky
2b3686e7a5.story: Noon, and the sky is a pale, bleached blue. A white balustrade runs along the promenade, its pillars flaking orange where the paint has given up. Behind it sits a small pavilion with a terracotta roof, and a lamp post rises with a solar panel bolted to its side. The rounded hood of a dark car noses into the lower corner, parked and patient in the glare.

0e6abbf638.alt: View from a covered balcony over a blue pool to white buildings, a colourful splash park and the sea beyond
0e6abbf638.story: From under a shaded overhang, the view lines up like a stage set. A dark blue pool in the foreground, a lawn with a round flowerbed, then two rows of white boxy buildings framing a splash park full of bright mushroom umbrellas. At the far end, a narrow stripe of sea. Twenty past three, and the symmetry feels deliberate, as though someone drew it with a ruler first.

1fbbcb1835.alt: Infinity pool surface in the foreground leading to white villas, a colourful splash park and a strip of ocean
1fbbcb1835.story: Two minutes later, closer to the water. Now the pool fills the bottom half, rippling dark blue, and its far edge seems to pour straight into the splash park and the white villas beyond. The mushroom umbrellas glow red, yellow and green. Palms stand at the edges like extras. The distant sea is just a thin blue line, a horizon keeping its distance.

2a90c7144d.alt: Long white hallway with doors on the left and slatted railings on the right, opening to bright daylight at the end
2a90c7144d.story: Indoors, a white corridor stretches away with doors on one side and slatted wooden screens on the other. At the far end it opens into blazing daylight and a glimpse of trees. A small bench sits by the wall, holding nobody. The floor reflects the light in a long pale stripe. It is the kind of hallway that feels longer the further you walk.

961d771a3c.alt: Rooftop view across a sandy flat roof to a modern building, a small wind turbine and solar panels
961d771a3c.story: Up on the roof, a sandy flat expanse leads the eye to a long low building with solar panels laid along its top. A slim wind turbine stands off to the side, blades still. Metal frames lean at odd angles near the edge, and the sky above is hazy and bright. Everything here appears to be waiting for weather that is not coming today.

56d3c2153b.alt: Elevated view of white villas around a colourful splash park, palm trees and a turquoise sea behind
56d3c2153b.story: From higher up, the whole arrangement makes sense at last. White villas sit in a neat row beside the splash park, its umbrellas scattered like sweets on a tray. Palms crowd around the edges, and beyond them the sea turns a bright turquoise that looks almost edited. The sky is clean, with one thin streak of cloud. It is half past three and the water calls.

1031c1b156.alt: Wide high view of a splash park with colourful umbrellas between white buildings, the sea on the horizon
1031c1b156.story: Fifteen seconds on, the view widens a little. More palm fronds creep in at the left edge, more lawn appears at the bottom with its round red flowerbed. The splash park stays empty, umbrellas bright and unused. Beyond the buildings the sea stretches into a band of blue. It looks like a postcard someone forgot to post, sitting quietly in a drawer for years.

5e39c0d80d.alt: Red fire hose cabinet and extinguisher mounted on a white wall in a shaded hallway with grey floor tiles
5e39c0d80d.story: In a shaded corner of a white hallway hangs a bright red fire hose cabinet, its glass door reflecting a sliver of the bright world outside. Below it, a red extinguisher, and above, a small sign. The grey floor tiles are polished enough to hold the light. Everything is ready for an emergency that, this afternoon at least, shows no sign of coming.

7be0f53851.alt: Paved courtyard with modern dark-panelled buildings, a small golf cart and a tuk-tuk parked near trees
7be0f53851.story: A paved courtyard opens out between buildings clad in dark slatted panels. A little golf cart with a canopy sits parked by the steps, and the nose of a tuk-tuk pokes in from the right edge. Topiary trees stand in pots like sculptures. It is twenty to five, and the light is turning golden at the edges, softening every hard line of the architecture.

fab00dccd2.alt: Circular paved forecourt with a compass rose inlay, modern buildings with dark angled roofs and a covered walkway
fab00dccd2.story: A compass rose is set into the paving of the forecourt, pointing in every direction at once. Around it the buildings rise in dark angled panels and glass, linked by a covered walkway. A lamp post stands alone in the middle distance. The sky has gone pale and streaky. Nobody crosses the circle. It feels like a broadcast test card laid flat on the ground.

46ac3231f5.alt: Indoor corridor with electric scooters and bicycles parked against a wall, a large resort map on the right
46ac3231f5.story: Along a cool interior corridor, a row of small electric scooters and bicycles stand parked nose to wall, handlebars all turned the same way. On the right, a large illustrated map shows paths and buildings in pastel blocks. The corridor runs on toward a dim lounge with a few chairs. It is the hour when the vehicles rest and the map does all the work.

46468d1adc.alt: Three drink fridges, one red, one white and one glass display, against a grey concrete wall on a dark glossy floor
46468d1adc.story: Three cabinets stand in a row against a bare concrete wall: a glass display with snacks, a red fridge glowing with cans and bottles, and a white one stacked with drinks. The dark floor reflects all three like still water. Nobody is shopping. The fridges hum to themselves, three lit windows in a grey room, each tuned to a slightly different channel of refreshment.

9cbed3b559.alt: Covered white walkway with recessed ceiling lights leading toward a bright exit and a white building outside
9cbed3b559.story: A long covered walkway runs between white pillars toward a bright rectangle at the far end, where another white building waits in the sun. Ceiling lights sit unlit in neat rows. A few grey wall panels break up the white. Quarter to five, and the shadow inside is cool and deep. Stepping out of it will feel like stepping into a lamp.

85866719a1.alt: Calm sea under a wide blue sky with a few small clouds, dark beach vegetation and sand in the foreground
85866719a1.story: By five past five the buildings are behind and the sea takes over. A wide calm sheet of blue runs to a flat horizon, dotted with tiny shapes that might be boats or might be swimmers. A low line of dark beach plants covers the foreground. A couple of small clouds sit near the horizon, pale and polite, not interfering.

c9149ef747.alt: Beach with people wading and playing in gentle waves, a figure silhouetted in the left foreground
c9149ef747.story: Twenty seconds later the shore fills in. Small figures wade into the low waves or sit in clusters on the sand, and a silhouetted figure stands at the left edge, watching the water. Soft white clouds drift in from the right. The sea is busy with tiny bodies, and its sound, though invisible here, is easy to imagine: steady, wide, unbothered by any of them.

edc4be5252.alt: Families on a sandy beach and in the shallow surf, breaking waves and a sky with soft white clouds
edc4be5252.story: More of the afternoon arrives at the shoreline. Families stand in the shallows while white-capped waves curl in around their knees. A child runs along the wet sand. The clouds above have stretched into long brushstrokes. It is just after five, and the light lies flat and golden across everything, the kind of hour when nobody wants to be the first to pack up.

7dfbbef2f3.alt: Open sea with gentle rolling waves under a pale blue sky with wispy clouds, no land visible
7dfbbef2f3.story: No sand, no people, just water. The sea fills the lower half, rolling in soft green-blue ridges, and the sky fills the upper half, pale with a few torn white clouds. The horizon cuts straight across like a line on a screen. Ten minutes past the busy beach, the frame has emptied itself on purpose, tuning to a quieter frequency.

44ae3dd5b1.alt: Seawall and sandy beach curving into the distance with people in the waves and a long pier on the horizon
44ae3dd5b1.story: Along the sand a concrete seawall curves away along the sand, and the waves fold in white against it. Small figures stand in the surf, and two children crouch at the water's edge in the foreground. Far off, a long low structure stretches across the horizon, thin as a pencil line. At eighteen past five the sky is turning that soft evening blue that comes before colour arrives.

6482f7408e.alt: Beach and seawall at dusk under a hazy glowing sky, trees and lamp posts along the shore, swimmers far off
6482f7408e.story: Eleven seconds later the light has flipped. Now the sky is a hazy sheet of cream and grey, the sun burning white behind cloud, and the trees along the shore have turned to silhouettes. Lamp posts stand like matchsticks. The seawall runs down toward the distant headland, and the waves arrive silver, one after another, as if being replayed.

e67809a711.alt: Seen from above, an adult stands in foamy surf beside a child sitting on the sand with a pink float
e67809a711.story: Looking down at the edge of the sea: an adult stands ankle-deep in the foam, hands behind their back, while a small child sits on the wet sand with a pink inflatable ring. Waves fold in white around them and slide back. Nobody looks up. The water keeps offering the same gift over and over, and the child keeps deciding whether to take it.

d0c246a94f.alt: Shoreline with a seawall and dark trees under an overcast pale sky, the sea grey-blue and calm
d0c246a94f.story: Twelve seconds after the last wide view, the colour has drained toward blue-grey. The same seawall, the same trees, the same headland on the far side of the bay, but the warmth has gone out of it, like a picture retuned to a cooler channel. A few figures sit far down the sand. The clouds look heavier. Evening is no longer approaching; it is here.

e35f1042d1.alt: Sandy beach path lined with palms and trees, a blue shelter, lamp posts and parked cars under a pale sky
e35f1042d1.story: Turning inland, the beach opens into a wide sandy strip edged with patchy grass. A pale blue shelter sits under the trees, and a row of cars has parked in the shade. Someone sits on a bench near the water. Lamp posts with little solar panels line the way. The palms lean in the breeze, and the whole scene has the hush of a seaside town after lunch.

3a303033c8.alt: Weathered grey wall with a small white spirit house in front, white flowering tree above and a striped kerb
3a303033c8.story: In front of a weathered grey wall, a small white spirit house stands on its pedestal, with a little white table beside it. Above the wall a frangipani tree is heavy with white flowers, and a red tiled roof peeks through. The kerb is painted in stripes of red and white. It is a still, tidy corner of the street, cared for by someone who is not in the picture.

f27493b816.alt: Dusk view of white villas and a splash park with colourful umbrellas, a dark pool in the foreground
f27493b816.story: Back at the window overlooking the splash park, it is just past six and the whole view has dimmed into blue. The white villas have gone grey, the mushroom umbrellas have lost their shine, and the pool in front has turned to dark glass. The sky still holds a few streaks of cloud. Soon the lamps will come on, and it will become a different channel altogether.

8a19d344ab.alt: Close view from the seat of a red golf cart, its steering wheel and basket, a paved road and hedges beyond
8a19d344ab.story: From the passenger side of a red golf cart: the steering wheel, a wire basket, a printed card tucked behind the windscreen, a seat with a stain of sunlight. Outside, the paved road curves past a trimmed hedge and an orange traffic cone. A small stone ornament stands nearby. It feels like the cart has just been parked and its driver will be back any second.

5d28ff3c69.alt: A tuk-tuk with a pink canopy and blue seats parked on concrete in front of tall clipped hedges and palms
5d28ff3c69.story: A tuk-tuk is parked on the concrete, its pink canopy faded to coral, its blue seats empty. Behind it tall hedges have been clipped into green columns, and palm trunks rise between them. A wooden building with slatted walls stands to the right. Nobody is around to hire it. It waits there, sideways to the view, like a prop between scenes.

33254b7944.alt: The same pink-canopied tuk-tuk parked before clipped hedges and palms, framed slightly wider
33254b7944.story: Sixteen seconds on, the view has stepped back just a little. More concrete, more hedge, a little more of the pale sky. The tuk-tuk has not moved; it remains a small black-and-pink vehicle in an oversized space. The light has softened, and the green columns behind it look even more like theatre scenery. The evening is getting ready to close the curtain.

51c897fe23.alt: Spacious hotel lobby with a blue carpet runner and WELCOME mat leading toward glass doors and a flower display
51c897fe23.story: A blue carpet runs straight across the tiled lobby to a mat with WELCOME spelled out in faded letters. At the end, a table of flowers stands before tall glass doors that look out onto palms. A carved red chair waits on the left. The lobby is huge and empty, lit only by evening light, like a set built for an arrival that keeps being postponed.

60fc2c2c64.alt: Paved circular forecourt with a compass rose at dusk, modern buildings with dark panels and a covered walkway
60fc2c2c64.story: The compass rose again, an hour and a half later. Now the forecourt is grey and dim, and the dark buildings around it have turned into flat silhouettes, one lit window glowing high on the right. The covered walkway still leads off between the trees, and an orange cone stands near its entrance. The circle keeps pointing every way, and nobody chooses.

2e59ebd439.alt: Beachfront with white plastic chairs around blue tables, string lights overhead and the sea at dusk
2e59ebd439.story: On the sand, blue tables and stacks of white plastic chairs have been set out for a crowd that has not arrived. Strings of bulbs hang overhead, still unlit. A swing seat and a large picture frame stand near a thatched umbrella, facing the dim blue sea. A small tree bends in the breeze. Twelve past six, and the party is waiting for its signal.

1ca6c23ab6.alt: Sandy beach at sunset with gentle waves, distant hills on the horizon and a broken wooden post in front
1ca6c23ab6.story: The sun is down behind the clouds and the sky has gone peach at the horizon. Low hills line the far side of the bay. Waves roll in steadily, and a broken wooden post leans in the foreground, half a fence that forgot what it was for. At the edge of the frame, someone is walking a small dog along the waterline.

345a59c1bc.alt: Two people walk along the beach at sunset, one with a small dog, waves breaking and distant hills behind
345a59c1bc.story: Nine seconds later, two figures stroll across the middle of the beach, one with a hand raised in mid-gesture, a small dog trotting between them. Behind them the waves lay down their white lines, and the hills sit dark on the horizon. Nobody looks at the sunset; they are busy talking. The sky goes on glowing anyway, mostly for itself.

c0d4441a34.alt: Two thatched beach umbrellas on wooden poles silhouetted on the sand at dusk, the sea and a lone swimmer
c0d4441a34.story: Two thatched umbrellas stand on the sand like tall figures with straw hats, their wooden poles dark against the dusk. The nearest one has a rope looped round it. Beyond them the sea is pale blue and wide, and one small head bobs in the water. The sky is cooling from peach to lilac. The umbrellas have nothing left to shade.

6b6fb73e29.alt: A person in a white T-shirt stands on wet sand facing the sea at sunset, distant hills across the water
6b6fb73e29.story: Someone in a white T-shirt has walked down to where the sand turns wet and stopped there, hands on hips, looking out at the hills across the water. The waves curl in at their feet and draw back. The sky has stretched into thin peach clouds. It is a quarter past six, and the only decision left is whether to stay a few more minutes.

994e1217eb.alt: Waves wash up a curving sandy shore at sunset, the sky pink and blue, dark hills on the horizon
994e1217eb.story: Seventeen seconds later, the figure is gone from the frame and only the shoreline remains, curving off to the right. The waves catch a little pink from the sky as they spread across the wet sand. The hills are flat dark shapes now. Above, a long trail of cloud glows orange from underneath, the last warm signal before the sky changes programmes.

d6355c3425.alt: Close view of white sea foam spreading over smooth wet sand
d6355c3425.story: Look down and the whole sea shrinks to this: a lace of white foam sliding across the sand, holes opening and closing in it, its edge drawn in a curving line. The grains below are coarse and golden. In a second the water will soak away and leave a darker stain. Then the next wave will draw the same line again, slightly differently.

697235e9da.alt: Close-up of coarse golden beach sand with small shells and grains
697235e9da.story: Nothing but sand. Coarse golden grains, flecks of shell, a few tiny pits where something has burrowed or a drop has landed. The light is low and warm, so every grain throws its own small shadow. It looks almost like static on an old set, a fine noise of particles. Hold still long enough and it might resolve into a picture.

ab390656c6.alt: Close-up of beach sand with the faint impression of a footprint
ab390656c6.story: Eight seconds later, the same patch of sand, but now a shape emerges at the bottom: the faint curve of a footprint, the heel pressed deeper than the toes. Someone passed here not long ago. The grains around it have already started to settle back. By morning the tide will have rubbed it out, and this whole stretch will be blank again.

01de080494.alt: A white modern beachfront building with a railing on its roof, seen across dark sand under a pale dusky sky
01de080494.story: Up the beach, a white building sits behind a low wall, its windows glowing faintly, a railing running along the roof. The sand in front of it is already dark, and the trees behind have gone black. The sky is pale with a few loose clouds. It has the look of a place that will be lit up soon, a quiet bulb about to switch on.

65de8a9b67.alt: Long sandy beach curving into the distance at dusk, thatched umbrellas and trees, waves washing in
65de8a9b67.story: Leftward, the sand curves away past a row of thatched umbrellas and a dark bank of trees. Small figures move near the water far off. The waves come in shallow and wide, smoothing the sand. The sky is fading from blue to faint pink at the horizon. At this hour the shoreline seems longer than it was at noon, as if the dark were stretching it.

c44a09a92d.alt: Close-up of a small cluster of white shells or barnacles and a pebble on coarse sand
c44a09a92d.story: At the feet, something small: a cluster of white shell fragments fanned out in the sand, edges sharp, beside a reddish pebble and a scrap of yellowish shell. A dark bit of something lies near the bottom. Everything else is blurred into warm grains. The waves have left it here and moved on, a tiny object washed up between tides.

c8daed60b9.alt: Waves breaking white on a shore at dusk, the sea teal and the sky pale pink at the horizon
c8daed60b9.story: Nineteen minutes past six. The waves break in long white rows, one after another, and spread across the dark wet sand. The water has turned teal, the sky above it a soft pink fading to grey. No people, no buildings, only the repeating pattern of foam. It feels like the channel at the end of the night that just plays the sea until morning.

4ffa4a51bd.alt: Empty beach at sunset, waves washing in, dark trees on a low point and peach clouds over distant hills
4ffa4a51bd.story: The beach is empty now. Waves wash up in pale ribbons and the wet sand catches the glow, while a low point of dark trees juts out on the right. Peach clouds stretch over the hills across the bay. It is twenty to half past six, and the sky has started its long slow fade, one shade at a time, like dimmer lights in a theatre.

90ccf3e665.alt: Vertical view of a long empty beach at sunset with gentle waves, distant hills and a pastel sky
90ccf3e665.story: Turned on its side, the same stretch of beach becomes a long corridor of sand leading to the horizon. The waves run in at a slant. The sky takes up most of the frame, layered with soft peach and grey clouds. Bits of seaweed lie scattered along the tide line. Nobody else is walking this way, and the footprints in the sand are already softening.

aa8c488949.alt: Sunset over a bay with streaked orange and grey clouds, dark hills, a curving shoreline and waves
