aa8c488949.story: Three minutes later the clouds have caught fire along their undersides, streaks of orange laid across grey. The shoreline curves away beneath them and the hills have gone flat and dark. Small waves break in a scatter of white. It is the moment the sky turns louder than the sea, broadcasting at full volume for a few minutes before signing off.

6d5476ca9d.alt: Dusky sky with lilac and pink clouds over a dark shoreline, waves and distant hills
6d5476ca9d.story: Already the orange has started to cool into lilac. The clouds look heavier, edged in pink, and the beach below has slipped into near darkness. A few waves still catch some light at their crests. Down at the water, the evening breeze is picking up. The broadcast is winding down, colour bleeding slowly into grey.

c525dc9d1c.alt: A green neon palm tree outline mounted on a metal pole against a blue evening sky
c525dc9d1c.story: Looking up: a palm tree drawn in green neon tube, mounted on a ladder-like pole against the blue evening sky. Its fronds are loops of bright glowing line. Behind it the clouds are pale. The real palms along the beach have turned to silhouettes, and this one, made of light, has taken over. It looks like a sign for a station that only broadcasts at night.

eda509dc6a.alt: A dry bamboo sculpture with cut branches standing in lit sand at night, the dark sea behind
eda509dc6a.story: Ten to eight, and the beach is black except for a pool of warm light on the sand. In it stands a pole of dry bamboo with cut stubs sticking out like arms, a dried palm tuft on top. A blue wooden edge peeks in from below. Behind it, a pale line of surf glimmers in the dark. It looks like a figure keeping watch over an empty stage.

d2f7a05bb4.alt: A cold glass of water with condensation on a table at night, blurred lights and a pool behind
d2f7a05bb4.story: A glass of water sits on the table, beaded with condensation, catching a stripe of light on its rim. Behind it everything has melted into blur: a teal smear that must be the pool, warm patches of lamplight, darker shapes. The night is warm enough that the glass is sweating more than anyone. One sip and the table will leave a wet ring.

d844ff9c15.alt: Beachside dining area at night under string lights, wooden chairs and blue tables on sand, a trampoline behind
d844ff9c15.story: The string lights are on now. They hang in loops across a wooden frame, lighting up a scatter of chairs and blue tables on the sand. Behind them stands a trampoline enclosed in netting and a few colourful play pieces. A figure in white is caught at the right edge, half out of frame. The tables from earlier have found their crowd, or at least started to.

640a3c4fd0.alt: Waves breaking white on a dark beach at night, sand lit warm in the foreground
640a3c4fd0.story: Beyond the lights, the sea keeps working in the dark. A single row of white foam breaks across the beach, faintly lit by the lamps behind, and the sand in front glows amber. Everything above that line is black. You can hear it better than see it now: the hush, the pause, the hush again, like a channel tuned to nothing but surf.

fd0ec3834e.alt: Resort buildings and street lamps reflected in a dark pond at night, a lawn and palms along the edge
fd0ec3834e.story: Across a dark stretch of water, the buildings have lit their windows and the lamp posts throw long shivering columns of light onto the surface. A low lawn and a few palms sit along the edge. Everything above the rooftops is pure black. The reflections wobble slightly, the only movement in the scene, as if the picture were being received through a weak signal.

1da8cf9e13.alt: Open-sided restaurant at night with wooden tables and chairs under a corrugated roof, plants and fairy lights beyond
1da8cf9e13.story: Under a corrugated roof, a long room of wooden tables and folding chairs sits mostly empty, lit by strip lights overhead. Beyond the open sides, plants and strings of small bulbs glow in the dark garden. A round clock hangs from the beams. It is eight o'clock and the place has the relaxed tidiness of a restaurant whose last orders may already have been taken.

46bc0d7cf6.alt: A white modern two-storey villa lit warmly at night against a black sky, a tree to the left
46bc0d7cf6.story: One of the white villas glows warmly in the dark, its walls washed in yellow light, a balcony rail drawn across the upper floor. A tree stands black against it on the left, and the sky above is completely empty. The lawn in front has disappeared into shadow. It looks like a house that exists only while the lights are on.

756e7b9325.alt: Two-storey villa at night with a lit upper balcony, street lamps and a dark pool in front
756e7b9325.story: Across the dark pool, a row of villas sits under two street lamps, and only one upper balcony is lit, a bright rectangle in the middle of the dark. Trees frame the edges. A small object floats or rests by the water's edge, catching a little light. It looks like a broadcast from one window, every other channel switched off for the night.

d8548093ca.alt: A villa facade at night with only an upper balcony and doorway lit, the rest in darkness
d8548093ca.story: Closer now. The upper balcony glows like a lantern: white walls, a black railing, a single orange door at the back. Everything else in the building has fallen into black, so the lit room seems to float in mid-air. A palm frond hangs across the top edge. The door is closed. Whatever is behind it, it is keeping to itself.

5e796018b7.alt: Side of a white villa at night with an outdoor staircase and wall lit warm, palms in shadow
5e796018b7.story: Around the side, an outdoor staircase climbs the white wall, each step lit from below so it looks like a ladder of light. A plain wall glows warm at the bottom, and a palm leans into the frame from the right. The grass is invisible. The whole structure seems to hang in the dark, a set built for a scene nobody is filming tonight.

8b8562ef95.alt: A tiled path between buildings at night leading toward a lit hotel block with umbrellas and street lamps
8b8562ef95.story: A narrow tiled path runs between a building and a low wall, toward a bigger block across the way where every floor has a few lit windows. Street lamps glow orange. A row of folded umbrellas stands near the far building. The near wall is rough and warm in the light. Somewhere along this path, the sound of the sea fades behind the hum of air conditioners.

4efb0af80b.alt: A lit paved walkway and stairs leading up through a grassy slope to a tall hotel building at night
4efb0af80b.story: A straight paved walkway runs uphill, its edges lit, toward a staircase that climbs into the bright lobby of a tall building. Grass slopes away on the left, shrubs line the right. A couple of figures are tiny at the top of the steps. Lamps glow along the facade, and above it all the night is solid black, like the dead air after a programme ends.

816079c0a2.alt: Large hotel building at night with lit glass lobby, white umbrellas and lights reflected in a pool
816079c0a2.story: Seen from the poolside, the whole hotel lights up the dark. Its glass lobby glows, round lamps hang like moons above the terrace, and a row of white umbrellas stands folded along the edge. All of it doubles in the still water below. It is five past eight, and the building has the look of a giant television left on in an empty room.

6c1223c9df.alt: Side of a multi-storey building at night with warm lit balconies, a dark hedge and trees in front
6c1223c9df.story: A tall building at the end of the walk, balconies stacked in rows, each one glowing warm behind its railing. A dark hedge and a small tree cut into the bottom of the frame. The wall around the corner is blank and pale. It is the last frame of the night, and the building seems to be broadcasting from every window at once.

4d8f02479c.alt: Dim underground car park with a parked dark car, a concrete pillar and caged storage areas
4d8f02479c.story: Next day, one in the afternoon, and the light outside does not reach in here. A concrete ceiling presses down over a car park, a single strip light glowing. A dark car sits parked by the wall. Behind it, chain-link cages hold boxes and shelves, numbered and locked. Arrows on the floor point toward exits nobody seems to need. It is cool, quiet and grey.

e25c8629ec.alt: Lawn lounge with white beanbags, low tables, white umbrellas and people seated under shady trees
e25c8629ec.story: White beanbags lie scattered across a shady green lawn like dropped pillows, arranged around low tables with drinks and a little box of napkins. White umbrellas and a canvas pavilion give extra shade. A few people sit at the tables in the back, and one person stands among the beanbags. Two minutes past one, and nobody here has anywhere urgent to be.

b8a8eb531e.alt: A grey pigeon perched on a thick textured tree branch, blurred green leaves and bright sky behind
b8a8eb531e.story: A grey pigeon sits on a thick branch with deeply grooved bark, its body in silhouette against a bright sky. The leaves behind it have dissolved into green blur. It holds very still, head turned to one side, as if listening for something in the bar below. Then it shifts its weight, a small adjustment, and goes on sitting.

09cd2f70ce.alt: A sandy beach and turquoise bay framed by tree branches, a buoy line, boats and swimmers in the shallows
09cd2f70ce.story: Through a fringe of overhanging branches, the bay opens out below: a curve of pale sand, turquoise shallows, a line of buoys strung across the water, and a few small boats waiting offshore. Tiny figures stand waist-deep. The sky is hazy and bright. The leaves above make a dark lace border, as though the view has been printed on a postcard with a decorative frame.

ee73037d28.alt: Bay with sandy shore, buoy line, boats and swimmers, framed by dark tree branches and distant hills
ee73037d28.story: Slightly wider: a little more leaf on the left, a little more beach at the bottom. The buoys still mark their line across the water. A few more swimmers have walked out. On the horizon, a hazy island sits low and pale. Midday light has flattened all the colours to soft blues and creams, so the whole scene looks slightly faded, like an old print.

31ae7af2d5.alt: Terrace restaurant under a large leaning tree with outdoor tables and chairs, buildings and greenery behind
31ae7af2d5.story: A huge tree leans its trunk across the top of the frame, and under its shade a terrace spreads out with wicker chairs, tables, potted plants and a few steps leading down. Buildings rise behind in the bright haze. The light falls in patches through the leaves. It is the kind of place where lunch quietly turns into a long afternoon without anyone deciding it should.

1cffc5839f.alt: A wooden tissue box on a dark table beside menus, a patterned concrete wall and greenery blurred behind
1cffc5839f.story: A square wooden tissue box sits on the table with one white tissue standing up like a flag. A couple of menus lie at its sides, one showing a scrap of blue print. Behind it, a perforated concrete wall and some blurred greenery. Nothing has been ordered yet. The table is clean, the tissue is ready, and the afternoon has just begun.

cae4e16a19.alt: Hazy turquoise sea with a few boats and swimmers, a pale sky and a faint island on the horizon
cae4e16a19.story: Ten past one, and the haze has thickened until the sky and sea almost meet in one pale wash. A few boats sit anchored offshore and small heads bob in the turquoise shallows. A faint island floats on the horizon. Leaves poke into the top corner. The scene seems faded on purpose, as though the colour knob had been turned halfway down.

ad85f80bf0.alt: Wooden boardwalk leading toward a glass-fronted building with a bench and stools, hedge on the left, gravel right
ad85f80bf0.story: A wooden boardwalk runs straight ahead between a dense hedge and a bed of white gravel, ending at a long bench in front of a glass-fronted building. Bar stools stand on its terrace, and a plant hangs in the window. A small red can sits on the boardwalk, forgotten. A stripe of sun cuts across the planks. Quarter past two, the hottest hour.

65d9c638bf.alt: The same wooden boardwalk with a small red can on it, sunlight striping the planks, a glass building behind
65d9c638bf.story: Barely a step to the side, and the red can is still there on the planks, a tiny bright full stop at the end of the walk. Sun falls in a broad band across the boards. The hedge stays dark, the gravel stays bright. Nothing else has changed. Some scenes run twice, just to make sure nobody missed the can.

dcdc660b0e.alt: Cafe corner with exposed brick wall, a black-framed window, a small table with a plant and a standing fan
dcdc660b0e.story: The cafe corner is quiet before anyone sits down. Old red brick shows through where the plaster has been chipped away, and a black-framed window lets in a bright green view. A small table holds a potted plant and a card. A standing fan faces the room, switched off, and a little yellow stool waits underneath. Somewhere off to the side, a cat basket sits on the floor.

c0ef76ef02.alt: Side profile of a woman with long dark hair eating with a fork, a hair clip and a sign on the brick wall behind
c0ef76ef02.story: Mid-bite, the fork arrives with something small and golden on it. She is turned in profile, a blue butterfly clip holding back her hair, a small earring catching the warm light. Behind her a battered sign on the brick wall reads ON LEFT ARROW ONLY, a rule for traffic that will never pass through here. Lunch is in progress and conversation is about to resume.

ee1452c4fa.alt: A woman with long hair smiles and talks, warm light on her face, a brick wall and road sign behind
ee1452c4fa.story: The bite is finished and the story has started. She turns toward the room, mouth open mid-sentence, eyes bright, the warm afternoon light catching her cheek and the ends of her hair. The same road sign hangs crooked on the brick behind her, half cut off by the frame. Whatever she is describing, it sounds like it has a good ending.

ed63ceec35.alt: A woman in glasses and a pink SUPER SUN T-shirt smiles at a wooden table with an iced drink, brick wall behind
ed63ceec35.story: Opposite her, a different mood: a pink T-shirt that says SUPER SUN, round glasses, a grin that is trying not to become a laugh. An iced drink sweats on the wooden table next to a phone and a small plate. The brick wall behind her glows orange. She is listening to the story from the other side, and clearly enjoying the ending.

fc16d43159.alt: A person with long hair sits at a cafe table seen from behind, a TV, clocks and a Route 66 sign on the brick wall
fc16d43159.story: The view pulls back across the room. Someone in red sits at a high table with their back turned, and above them the brick wall is crowded with clocks, enamel signs and a ROUTE 66 shield. A television in the corner shows a figure singing to nobody in particular. A blurred shoulder edges the foreground. The cafe is half radio, half roadside diner.

45aee41998.alt: A woman with long hair looks down at her phone at a cafe table, backlit by a bright window
45aee41998.story: Against the bright window she has become mostly silhouette, long hair falling forward, the phone held low in one hand. A half-finished iced drink and a bowl sit on the table. The light catches the edge of her profile and a strand of hair. The conversation has paused for a message. In a minute she will read it aloud, and the table will react.

744b36f1b7.alt: A black cat curled asleep in a round cushioned pet bed, wearing a pink bow collar
744b36f1b7.story: Down in the round basket, a black cat has folded itself into a perfect comma, face tucked away, a pink bow knotted at its neck. The cushion around it is soft cream with a faint pattern. The fur shines where the light hits. Above, plates are clattering and somebody is laughing, but none of that is anything to do with this particular resident.

684a416ad1.alt: Two women seated behind a low brick wall, one in black smiling, one in pink with glasses making a peace sign
684a416ad1.story: Two friends have taken the window seat behind a low brick wall. One in a black T-shirt smiles calmly. The other, in pink with round glasses, leans her chin on one hand and throws up a peace sign with the other. The window behind them shows a sunny building across the street. The brick in front forms a kind of stage, and they know their cues.

d98125e526.alt: Two women behind a brick wall, one in pink raising two peace signs, one in black smiling
d98125e526.story: Take two: the peace sign has doubled. Both hands are up now, fingers spread, while the friend in black tilts her head and grins with her eyes. The pink shirt glows against the dark window. The pose has escalated, as poses do when the first one gets a laugh, and the brick wall holds steady below like an audience that cannot leave.

658b51ff12.alt: Two women at a window table behind a brick wall, one resting her face on her hands, the other looking sideways
658b51ff12.story: And then the energy drops into something quieter. The friend in pink cups her face in both hands and smiles sweetly, a classic still-life pose. The friend in black glances sideways with a straight face, not quite in on the joke this time. Between them the window frames a bright slice of the afternoon. Every photo session needs one frame like this.

6f8d8a1478.alt: A worn metal road sign on a brick pillar reading ON LEFT ARROW ONLY with a curved turn arrow
6f8d8a1478.story: Bolted to the corner of a brick pillar is a battered metal sign with a curved arrow and the words ON LEFT ARROW ONLY, its paint scraped away in patches. Behind it the room blurs into cream ceiling and a glowing television. It is an instruction for a road that does not exist indoors, followed faithfully by absolutely nobody, and kept on the wall anyway for the look of it.

8ec55934f1.alt: An empty wooden table against a concrete wall below a black-framed window with green plants outside
8ec55934f1.story: The window seat is empty for a moment. A wooden tabletop catches a stripe of light along its edge, and the concrete wall below the window is rough and grey. Through the glass, a spray of green leaves stands against a brick wall outside. Nobody is posing. It is the pause between scenes, when the set is lit and waiting for the actors to return.

d142156912.alt: A grey hatchback with a checkered stripe parked in front of closed metal shutter doors on a quiet street
d142156912.story: Outside on the street, a small grey hatchback sits parked against a row of closed metal shutters, a checkered stripe running along its lower door. A potted plant stands by the wall, and the back wheel of a motorbike peeks out from behind. The road is empty and pale with afternoon light. The car looks like it has been waiting a while, and could wait longer.

2aa6cfd498.alt: Two women behind a brick wall at a window, one in a red cap making a rock sign, the other in pink with glasses posing
2aa6cfd498.story: Suddenly there is a red cap. The friend in black now wears it, hand raised in a little rock-and-roll sign, while the friend in pink makes a playful claw shape with both hands near her face. Above them three black pendant lamps hang in a row. The brick wall below glows like a stage front. Act two has begun.

1b41edfbd8.alt: Two women posing at a window behind a brick wall, one in a red cap, the other in pink making hand gestures
1b41edfbd8.story: A beat later and the gestures have shifted. The red cap tilts, the hand sign holds, and the friend in pink has moved her fingers closer to her face, half frame, half joke. The pendant lights still hang overhead. They are clearly running through a whole repertoire of poses, and the brick wall in front keeps giving them a clean, warm backdrop for every one.

9c14ebe9b7.alt: Two women at a cafe window, one in a red cap smiling, one in pink with glasses raising peace signs
9c14ebe9b7.story: Tighter now, and the peace signs are back, both hands up beside the pink shirt and round glasses. The friend in the red cap has dropped her hand and just smiles, letting the other carry the pose. Behind them the reflections in the window are warm and slightly hazy. It is easy to imagine the counting before each frame: one, two, change.

e76962e62e.alt: Two women posed behind a brick wall at a window, the one in pink pressing a hand to her cheek
e76962e62e.story: Change: the friend in pink has turned shy, a hand pressed to her cheek, eyes narrowed in a smile. The friend in the red cap looks straight ahead, composed, as if she is the anchor of a news programme and her co-host has gone slightly off script. The three lamps glow overhead. The brick counter in front of them is beginning to feel like a desk.

ceb3cb465b.alt: Two women at a window, one in a red cap, the other in pink resting her face in both hands
ceb3cb465b.story: Both hands under the chin now, the friend in pink turned into a small flower. Her companion in the red cap keeps her steady half-smile and lets the moment play. The window behind them is a soft blur of red brick and leaves. Nobody seems to be getting tired of this, and the light, warm and low, is still on their side.

212c98cf65.alt: Two women at a window, one in a red cap pointing a finger, the other in pink with face cupped in her hands
212c98cf65.story: A new idea arrives. The friend in the red cap raises one finger beside her face, eyes rolled sideways, a mock-serious thinker. The friend in pink keeps her cheeks cupped in her hands, eyes closed in a big smile. The pendant lamps watch from above. It looks like the last part of a sketch, the bit where the logic falls apart and everyone enjoys it.

e53ad5a1e2.alt: Two women at a window, the one in pink leaning in with one finger raised, the other in a red cap looking down
e53ad5a1e2.story: Now the roles swap. The friend in pink leans in and points one finger skyward, head tilted, pulling a face of pure mischief. The friend in the red cap looks down with a deadpan expression. The window, the lamps and the brick wall stay perfectly in place. This is the frame where somebody at the next table probably turned to see what was so funny.

5d5a30a45e.alt: Two women posing at a window, the one in pink making a horns hand sign and grinning, the other in a red cap smiling
5d5a30a45e.story: Final frame of the run. The friend in pink throws a horns sign and grins sideways into the light, glasses glinting. The friend in the red cap mirrors it with a quieter gesture of her own. The brick counter, the lamps, the window: the set has been the same all along, and they have used it fully. Somebody calls it a wrap, and the drinks are probably warm by now.

6a22670c60.alt: A thin orange crescent moon glowing against a near-black sky
6a22670c60.story: Low and late, the crescent has turned the colour of a dying ember, a thin orange smile hanging in an almost black sky. There are no stars around it, no clouds, nothing to give it scale. The glow bleeds softly at the edges. It looks less like the moon than like the last lit pixel on a screen after the set has been switched off.

5d174c2737.alt: Close portrait of a tiger facing forward with mouth slightly open, against dark green foliage
5d174c2737.story: Out of the dark leaves, a tiger's face arrives straight on: amber eyes level and steady, white whiskers fanned out, mouth just open enough to show its teeth. The stripes around its eyes look painted on with a fine brush. Everything behind it falls away into deep green shadow. It is half past two in the afternoon, yet the frame feels like midnight, and the stare does not let go.

5b202008c9.alt: A tiger steps down from a rope-bound log, mouth open, dark jungle leaves behind it
5b202008c9.story: Five minutes later the tiger is on the move, one big paw reaching down from a log bound with thick rope. Its mouth hangs open, tongue showing, and its eyes are fixed somewhere just past the frame. The striped coat glows orange against black leaves. Every muscle seems in the middle of a decision. Then the paw lands, softly, and it keeps walking.

0b0bc867b8.alt: A nearly full moon with enhanced colours showing blue and brown tones across its seas and craters
0b0bc867b8.story: Almost full, and almost unreal. The moon hangs in black space with its colours pushed until the plains bloom blue and rust and the highlands go pale gold. A thin sliver on one edge is still in shadow, so the disc is not quite round. Rays of brighter ground spread from the craters near the bottom. It looks like a planet seen on a broadcast from much farther away.

889467440b.alt: A nearly full moon in vivid false colour, blue maria and golden highlands, pulled from a video
889467440b.story: The same almost-full moon, built from video this time, frame layered on frame until the noise cleared. The blues are deeper here, the golds warmer, and the edge in shadow a little crisper. It is four hours later in the timestamp, but the face is the same patient face. Somewhere inside it are hundreds of shaky moments, stacked into one still one.

005b8f6395.alt: Wide starfield around the Belt of Orion with red and pink nebulae and a bright bluish glowing cloud
005b8f6395.story: Thousands of stars are scattered like grain across this frame, and in among them the colours start: a red-pink cloud in the middle, a dark notch shaped like a horse's head, a bright white-blue glow to the upper right. The Belt of Orion runs through it, three stars lined up as though placed by hand. On an ordinary night they look like three dots. Here, they are a neighbourhood.

a3a0da4b8a.alt: Tall starfield with a small elongated galaxy near the top and reddish clouds of the Milky Way below
a3a0da4b8a.story: This slice of sky runs from Cassiopeia down toward Andromeda. Near the top, a small tilted smudge of light sits apart from the stars, oval and soft: the galaxy itself. Below, the Milky Way spills in red and brown clouds and dark dust lanes. The whole frame is grainy with stars, so dense it looks like static, and somewhere in that static is a signal.

fa9b24a1e8.alt: A full moon in vivid false colour, blue and gold tones across its surface, bright ray craters
fa9b24a1e8.story: The Full Worm Moon, at two minutes to midnight, perfectly round at last. Its colours have been coaxed out until the dark plains shimmer with blue and the bright ground glows ochre. Ray craters splash white lines across the surface. Compared with the almost-full frames, this one has no shadowed edge left. Every part of the face is lit, and it is staring back.

4950854687.alt: A small moon inside a large soft halo of light against a dark grey sky
4950854687.story: Here the moon is small, a coin in the middle of a vast grey sky, wrapped in a soft glowing halo several times its own size. Blended exposures keep both the bright surface and the faint light around it. The craters are still readable on the tiny disc. It looks like a lamp seen through fog, or a station logo floating in the corner of a dark screen.

782953a517.alt: A moon partly lit, its shadowed part glowing faintly, with a bright golden rim against black space
782953a517.story: At 300mm the moon floats in black space with a bright golden rim on its lit side and a ghostly, bluish surface across the rest. The dark part is not quite dark; it holds a faint glow of its own. Below, a soft green blur hovers like a reflection inside the lens. It looks like an eye half-opened in the night, slowly taking everything in.

384b65ac32.alt: A bright point of light with sharp diffraction spikes in a dark starfield, identified as Jupiter
384b65ac32.story: Jupiter shows up as one blazing point, eight thin spikes radiating from it like a cartoon sparkle, set in a field of faint stars. At this scale it looks no bigger than its neighbours, only brighter, much brighter. No bands, no moons are visible here, only the light itself. It is the kind of dot you could point at from a rooftop and say: that one.

c709572997.alt: The Andromeda Galaxy, a large tilted spiral with a bright core and dust lanes, surrounded by stars
c709572997.story: M31, the Andromeda Galaxy, tilted across the dark like a dinner plate held at an angle. A bright golden core fades out into pale blue arms, threaded with dark dust lanes. A smaller fuzzy companion sits just below it, and a scattering of foreground stars lies over everything. On a dark night it is a smudge to the naked eye. Here, it has a shape.

92ebe02629.alt: Wide starfield of Orion with a faint red arc of nebula, a bright white nebula and small red glows
92ebe02629.story: Orion, taken wide. The stars are packed so tightly that the sky becomes texture, and through it runs a faint red arc, like a curve drawn in chalk and half rubbed out. Near the middle, a bright white cloud and a smaller pinkish glow. Down in the corner, a round red bubble. The whole frame hums with faint colour, a signal just above the noise.

0568ae3063.alt: Starfield with a small blue star cluster, a red nebula at the left edge and dark dust lanes
0568ae3063.story: One sweep of sky catches three things at once. Up top, the small blue knot of the Pleiades shines like a cluster of sequins. On the left edge, a red streak of the California Nebula. And below, the dark dust lanes of Taurus wind through a carpet of stars. It is a map with no labels, held together by the gaps between the lights.

92017b9979.alt: The Pleiades star cluster glowing blue with soft nebulosity, surrounded by dense faint stars and dust
92017b9979.story: Closer now, at 135mm, the Pleiades become a small family of bright blue stars, each with a cross of spikes, all wrapped in a soft blue haze. Around them, faint wisps of dust drift through a field crowded with tiny stars. It looks like a cluster of streetlights seen through mist from very far away, the kind of view that makes a cold night worth it.

aa6985ec85.alt: The full disc of the Sun in orange, its surface finely textured with bright spots near the edges
aa6985ec85.story: The Sun, inverted, fills the frame as a flat orange disc, its surface grainy with fine texture like orange peel. Bright flecks scatter across it, gathered in little groups near the edges, and a thin bright rim glows around the whole circle. Inverting the tones turns the familiar glare into something that looks almost solid, a burning coin held still for a moment.
